recipe.title: Herb-Roasted Turkey with Pan Gravy
recipe.intro: Remove turkey from refrigerator 1 hour before roasting and pat dry. Preheat oven to 325°F with rack in lower third. Have a roasting pan with rack, instant-read thermometer, foil, and a fat separator ready. Do not stuff the bird; cook stuffing separately for even, safe roasting.
recipe.finish: The turkey is done when the breast reads 165°F and the thickest part of the thigh reads 175°F; juices should run clear. Rest 20–30 minutes tented with foil before carving. Make pan gravy from the drippings while the bird rests, then carve and serve with warm gravy.

steps.title: Season and herb the turkey
steps.details: Rub the turkey all over with 2 tbsp salt and the pepper. Mix the softened butter with the chopped sage and thyme, then spread it under and over the breast skin and over the outside of the bird. Tuck wings behind the back.

steps.title: Build the roasting bed
steps.details: Scatter the onion, carrots, and celery in the bottom of the roasting pan and pour in the chicken broth. Set the turkey breast-side up on the rack over the vegetables.

steps.title: Roast the turkey
steps.details: Roast at 325°F. Baste with pan juices every 45 minutes if you like. Roast until the breast reads 165°F and the thigh reads 175°F, about 3 to 3½ hours for a 12–14 lb bird; tent loosely with foil if browning too fast.

steps.title: Rest the bird
steps.details: Transfer the turkey to a carving board, tent loosely with foil, and rest 25 minutes while you make the gravy.

steps.title: Strain the drippings
steps.details: Pour the pan drippings through a strainer into a fat separator or heatproof bowl. Let stand 2 minutes, then skim off and reserve 3 tbsp of the fat; keep the defatted drippings.

steps.title: Make the roux
steps.details: In a saucepan over medium heat, whisk the reserved turkey fat with the flour-water slurry and cook 1–2 minutes until lightly bubbling and thickened.

steps.title: Finish the gravy
steps.details: Whisk the defatted drippings and warm stock into the roux. Simmer 5–8 minutes, whisking, until the gravy coats a spoon; season with the remaining 1 tbsp salt and more pepper to taste. Keep warm.

steps.title: Carve and serve
steps.details: Carve the rested turkey and serve with the warm pan gravy spooned over.

recipe.title: Sausage and Apple Stuffing
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 350°F. You will need a large skillet, a large bowl, and a 9x13-inch baking dish. Use sturdy day-old bread so the cubes hold their shape.
recipe.finish: The stuffing is done when the top is crisp and golden and the center reaches 165°F, about 40 minutes. Let rest 10 minutes before serving.

steps.title: Toast the bread cubes
steps.details: Spread bread cubes on two baking sheets and bake at 350°F until dry and lightly toasted, 12–15 minutes, stirring once. Leave the oven on.

steps.title: Brown the sausage
steps.details: Cook sausage in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up, until no pink remains and it reaches 160°F, 8–10 minutes. Transfer to the large bowl.

steps.title: Soften vegetables
steps.details: Add onion and celery to the skillet with the sausage drippings and cook over medium heat until softened, 6–8 minutes.

steps.title: Cook apples with herbs
steps.details: Stir in apples, sage, thyme, salt, and pepper and cook until apples just begin to soften, 4–5 minutes.

steps.title: Combine bread and sausage mixture
steps.details: Scrape skillet contents into the bowl with the sausage and toasted bread. Toss to combine.

steps.title: Add broth and eggs
steps.details: Whisk warm broth with eggs, pour over bread mixture, and toss until evenly moistened. It should be moist but not soupy; add splash more broth if dry.

steps.title: Bake the stuffing
steps.details: Transfer to buttered 9x13-inch dish, cover with foil, and bake at 350°F for 25 minutes.

steps.title: Crisp the top
steps.details: Uncover and bake until top is crisp and golden and center reaches 165°F, 15–20 minutes more. Cool 10 minutes before serving.

recipe.title: Roasted Garlic Mashed Potatoes
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). You'll need a large pot, a baking sheet, a skillet or small saucepan, a potato masher or ricer, and a hand mixer or sturdy whisk. Peel potatoes and cut into 1-inch chunks; keep them in cold water until cooking so they don't brown.
recipe.finish: Mash or rice potatoes until smooth, then fold in the warm dairy and roasted garlic. Taste and add salt and pepper. If potatoes seem stiff, stir in extra warm milk 1 tablespoon at a time. Serve hot; hold covered over barely simmering water if needed, adding a splash of milk before serving.

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.prep: top sliced off to expose cloves

ingredients.name: black pepper
ingredients.prep: freshly ground, plus more to taste

steps.title: Preheat and prep
steps.details: Heat oven to 400°F (200°C). Peel and chunk the potatoes and keep them in a bowl of cold water. Slice the top off the garlic head to expose the cloves.

steps.title: Roast the garlic
steps.details: Set garlic cut-side up on foil, drizzle with olive oil, wrap loosely, and roast until cloves are soft and golden, 35–40 minutes.

steps.title: Boil the potatoes
steps.details: Drain potatoes, put in a large pot, cover with cold water by 1 inch, and add 1 teaspoon salt. Bring to a boil, then simmer until a knife slides in with no resistance, 15–20 minutes.

steps.title: Warm the dairy
steps.details: In a small saucepan over low heat, warm milk and butter with 1/2 teaspoon salt until butter melts and milk steams; do not boil. Keep warm.

steps.title: Squeeze roasted garlic
steps.details: Unwrap garlic and let cool slightly. Squeeze soft cloves into a small bowl and mash with a fork into a paste.

steps.title: Drain and dry potatoes
steps.details: Drain potatoes in a colander, then return them to the hot pot over low heat for 1–2 minutes, stirring, to dry excess moisture.

steps.title: Mash the potatoes
steps.details: Mash potatoes until mostly smooth, or pass through a ricer. Do not over-work with a mixer or potatoes may turn gluey.

steps.title: Fold in dairy and garlic
steps.details: Add warm milk-butter mixture and roasted garlic paste. Stir or mash just until combined and creamy. Season with remaining salt and pepper to taste.

recipe.title: Classic Green Bean Casserole
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 350°F. You need a large pot, a colander, a skillet, and a 9x13-inch baking dish. Thaw or trim the beans while the oven heats.
recipe.finish: The casserole is done when the sauce bubbles at the edges and the onions are deep golden. Let it rest 5 minutes so the sauce sets before serving.

steps.title: Boil green beans
steps.details: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add the green beans and cook 5–6 minutes, until crisp-tender; a bean should bend without snapping but still have a little bite. Drain well.

steps.title: Sauté mushrooms
steps.details: While the beans boil, melt the butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the mushrooms and cook 5–6 minutes, stirring occasionally, until softened and lightly browned.

steps.title: Make creamy sauce
steps.details: Pour the soup and milk into the skillet with the mushrooms. Stir in the salt and pepper. Simmer 3–4 minutes, stirring, until smooth and slightly thickened.

steps.title: Combine beans and sauce
steps.details: Add the drained green beans to the skillet and toss until evenly coated. Taste and adjust salt if needed.

steps.title: Fill baking dish
steps.details: Transfer the mixture to the 9x13-inch baking dish and spread it level. Stir half of the fried onions and the Parmesan, if using, into the top layer.

steps.title: Bake casserole
steps.details: Bake uncovered at 350°F for 20 minutes, until the sauce bubbles at the edges and the center is hot.

steps.title: Add crispy topping
steps.details: Scatter the remaining fried onions over the top. Return to the oven and bake 5–7 minutes more, until the onions are deep golden and crisp.

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.details: Let the casserole rest 5 minutes before serving so the sauce thickens slightly.

recipe.title: Homemade Cranberry Sauce
recipe.intro: No special equipment needed—just a medium saucepan, a zester or fine grater, and a wooden spoon. Make this up to 3 days ahead; it thickens as it cools.
recipe.finish: Sauce is done when the berries have mostly popped and the liquid coats a spoon, about 10–12 minutes of simmering. It will look slightly loose but thickens a lot as it cools. Cool at least 30 minutes before serving; it reaches a jammy set when fully cool. Serve chilled or at room temperature alongside turkey.

ingredients.name: fresh cranberries
ingredients.prep: rinse, pick out and discard any soft or shriveled berries

ingredients.name: orange zest
ingredients.prep: use a zester or fine grater to remove just the orange part, about 2 inches long

ingredients.name: fresh orange juice
ingredients.prep: squeeze from the zested orange, seeds removed

steps.title: Combine sugar and water
steps.details: In a medium saucepan, stir the sugar into the water and set over medium-high heat until the sugar dissolves, about 2 minutes.

steps.title: Zest and juice orange
steps.details: While the syrup heats, grate the orange zest and squeeze the juice; set aside.

steps.title: Add cranberries and zest
steps.details: Add the rinsed cranberries, orange zest, and orange juice to the saucepan and stir once.

steps.title: Simmer until berries pop
steps.details: Bring to a gentle boil, then reduce heat to medium-low and simmer uncovered, stirring occasionally, 10–12 minutes. The berries will pop and the sauce will thicken; it is ready when most berries have burst and a spoon dragged across the pan bottom leaves a brief trail.

steps.title: Cool and thicken
steps.details: Remove from heat and let cool in the pan at least 30 minutes; the sauce will set to a jammy consistency as it cools. Stir once before serving.

recipe.title: Roasted Butternut Squash Soup
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Use a large baking sheet and a large pot.
recipe.finish: Serve hot, garnished with a swirl of cream. Season to taste.

steps.title: Preheat oven
steps.details: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).

steps.title: Prepare squash and onion
steps.details: Peel, seed, and cut squash into 1-inch cubes. Peel and quarter onion. Peel garlic.

steps.title: Toss with oil and season
steps.details: On a large baking sheet, toss squash, onion, and garlic with 1 tablespoon olive oil, salt, and pepper.

steps.title: Roast vegetables
steps.details: Roast for 30-35 minutes, until squash is tender and lightly caramelized, stirring halfway.

steps.title: Sauté aromatics
steps.details: While vegetables roast, heat remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add roasted garlic and onion (from the baking sheet) and cook until soft, about 5 minutes.

steps.title: Simmer soup
steps.details: Add roasted squash and vegetable broth to the pot. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Blend soup
steps.details: Remove from heat. Use an immersion blender to puree until smooth, or blend in batches in a countertop blender.

steps.title: Add cream and season
steps.details: Stir in heavy cream and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper. Warm gently if needed.

recipe.title: Soft Dinner Rolls
recipe.intro: Get ready: bring 1 cup whole milk, 1 large egg, and 4 tbsp butter to room temperature. Grease a 9x13-inch baking pan. No stand mixer needed—just a large bowl, a wooden spoon, and a lightly floured counter. Have 2 tbsp melted butter ready to brush on after baking.
recipe.finish: Rolls are done when deep golden brown on top and an instant-read thermometer tucked into the center of a middle roll reads 190°F. Cool in the pan 5 minutes, then brush with the remaining melted butter. Serve warm for sopping up gravy. Store leftovers airtight up to 2 days; reheat wrapped in foil at 300°F for 8 minutes.

ingredients.name: instant or active dry yeast
ingredients.prep: use label quick-rise instructions if different

ingredients.name: unsalted butter
ingredients.prep: softened, plus 2 tbsp melted for finishing

steps.title: Warm milk and butter
steps.details: In a small saucepan over low heat or in a microwave-safe bowl, warm the milk and softened butter to 105–110°F; the butter should just melt. If it gets hotter, let it cool before adding yeast.

steps.title: Mix dry ingredients
steps.details: While the milk warms, whisk the flour, yeast, sugar, and salt in a large bowl until evenly combined.

steps.title: Add wet ingredients
steps.details: Pour the warm milk-butter mixture and the beaten egg into the dry ingredients. Stir with a wooden spoon until a shaggy dough forms and no dry flour remains.

steps.title: Knead the dough
steps.details: Turn the dough onto a lightly floured counter and knead 6–8 minutes until smooth, elastic, and slightly tacky, adding flour 1 tbsp at a time only if it sticks badly. Dough is ready when it springs back when poked.

steps.title: Let dough rise
steps.details: Shape into a ball, place in a greased bowl, cover with a clean towel, and let rise in a warm spot until doubled, about 60–75 minutes.

steps.title: Shape into rolls
steps.details: Punch down the dough, divide into 16 equal pieces (about 55 g each), and roll each into a tight ball. Arrange seam-side down in the greased 9x13-inch pan, 4 across by 4 down.

steps.title: Second rise
steps.details: Cover the pan with a towel and let the rolls rise until puffy and nearly touching, 35–45 minutes. Near the end, heat the oven to 350°F.

steps.title: Bake the rolls
steps.details: Bake at 350°F for 20–25 minutes until deep golden brown and the center of a middle roll reads 190°F on an instant-read thermometer. Rotate the pan halfway through if your oven browns unevenly.

steps.title: Butter and serve
steps.details: Cool in the pan 5 minutes, then brush the tops with the 2 tbsp melted butter. Serve warm.

recipe.title: Classic Pumpkin Pie
recipe.intro: Heat oven to 425°F with a rack in the lower-middle position. You need a 9-inch pie plate, a mixing bowl, a whisk, and a saucepan or microwave for warming the pumpkin mixture. Let a frozen 9-inch deep-dish pie crust sit at room temperature while you mix the filling. Have whipped cream ready for serving.
recipe.finish: The pie is done when the center still jiggles slightly like set gelatin and a knife inserted 1 inch from the edge comes out clean; the very center may look a touch moist. Cool completely on a rack, at least 2 hours, then refrigerate until serving. Slice with a sharp knife and serve each piece with a generous spoonful of whipped cream.

ingredients.name: frozen deep-dish pie crust
ingredients.prep: thaw at room temperature, keep in its foil pan

steps.title: Heat oven and thaw crust
steps.details: Set rack in the lower-middle position and heat oven to 425°F. Leave the frozen crust in its foil pan and let it thaw on the counter while you make the filling, about 10 minutes. If using a homemade or refrigerated crust, fit it into a 9-inch deep-dish pie plate and crimp the edge.

steps.title: Whisk pumpkin and sugar
steps.details: In a large bowl, whisk the pumpkin, sugar, cinnamon, ginger, cloves, and salt until smooth and evenly colored, about 1 minute.

steps.title: Add eggs
steps.details: Whisk the beaten eggs into the pumpkin mixture until fully blended and glossy, about 1 minute; do not whip in extra air.

steps.title: Warm and whisk in milk
steps.details: Warm the evaporated milk in a small saucepan over low heat or in a microwave-safe bowl until steamy but not boiling, about 2 minutes. Slowly whisk it into the pumpkin mixture until smooth.

steps.title: Fill the crust
steps.details: Pour the filling into the thawed crust, filling it nearly to the rim; it should settle level. Set the pie on a baking sheet to catch drips.

steps.title: Bake hot to set the edge
steps.details: Bake at 425°F for 15 minutes, until the crust edge is light golden and the filling has puffed slightly at the rim.

steps.title: Lower heat and finish baking
steps.details: Reduce oven to 350°F and continue baking 40 to 50 minutes, until the center jiggles slightly and a knife 1 inch from the edge comes out clean. If the crust browns too fast, tent the edge loosely with foil.

steps.title: Cool completely
steps.details: Set the pie on a wire rack and cool to room temperature, about 2 hours, so the custard sets fully before slicing.

steps.title: Chill and serve with cream
steps.details: Refrigerate until serving time (up to 1 day). Slice and top each piece with whipped cream.

recipe.title: Apple Cider Punch
recipe.intro: Chill all liquids in advance for the coldest, fizziest punch. You need a large pitcher or punch bowl, a small saucepan, and a long spoon. No oven needed.
recipe.finish: Ladle over ice into cups and garnish with the orange slices and cinnamon sticks. The punch is best the day it is made; if it sits out more than 2 hours, discard any remaining ice and refrigerate the punch.

ingredients.name: orange
ingredients.prep: halved and thinly sliced into rounds

steps.title: Simmer cinnamon syrup
steps.details: Combine the water and cinnamon sticks in a small saucepan. Bring to a gentle simmer over medium heat and cook 5 minutes until fragrant and slightly reduced.

steps.title: Steep and cool syrup
steps.details: Remove from heat and let the cinnamon sticks steep in the liquid 15 minutes, then cool to room temperature.

steps.title: Slice the orange
steps.details: While the syrup steeps, slice the orange into thin rounds and set aside for garnish.

steps.title: Combine cider base
steps.details: In a large pitcher or punch bowl, stir together the chilled apple cider, lemon juice, and cooled cinnamon syrup (discard or reserve the sticks for garnish).

steps.title: Add ginger ale and orange
steps.details: Just before serving, slowly pour in the chilled ginger ale and add most of the orange slices, stirring gently once.

steps.title: Serve over ice
steps.details: Pour over ice in cups, garnish with remaining orange slices and cinnamon sticks, and serve immediately while fizzy.

generatedRecipes.title: Roast Beef Tenderloin with Red Wine Sauce

recipe.title: Roast Beef Tenderloin with Red Wine Sauce
recipe.intro: A centerpiece roast for Christmas Eve. Use a whole center-cut beef tenderloin (2–2.5 lb) trimmed and tied. You'll need a roasting pan or heavy skillet, an instant-read thermometer, and a small saucepan. Let the beef sit at room temperature for 30 minutes before roasting. Preheat oven to 425°F.
recipe.finish: The beef is done when the thickest part reads 130°F for medium-rare (about 135°F after resting); for medium, aim for 140°F. Rest 15 minutes before slicing. The sauce should coat the back of a spoon; if too thin, simmer a little longer, if too thick, add a splash of stock. Slice into 1/2-inch medallions and spoon sauce over. Serve with the reserved sauce on the side.

steps.title: Season and preheat
steps.details: Pat the tenderloin dry, rub all over with 2 tbsp olive oil, then season evenly with 1 tbsp salt and 1 tsp pepper. Let it sit at room temperature while the oven preheats to 425°F.

steps.title: Sear the beef
steps.details: Heat a heavy roasting pan or skillet over high heat. Add 1 tbsp butter and sear the tenderloin 2–3 minutes per side until well browned on all sides.

steps.title: Roast to temperature
steps.details: Transfer the pan to the 425°F oven. Roast 20–25 minutes, until an instant-read thermometer in the thickest part reads 130°F for medium-rare. Tent loosely with foil and rest 15 minutes; the temperature will rise about 5°F.

steps.title: Start the sauce base
steps.details: While the beef roasts, melt 1 tbsp butter in a small saucepan over medium heat. Add the shallots and cook 3–4 minutes until softened and lightly golden.

steps.title: Deglaze with wine
steps.details: Pour in the red wine and add the thyme sprig. Simmer 5–6 minutes until reduced by about half and the harsh alcohol smell is gone.

steps.title: Add stock and reduce
steps.details: Stir in the beef stock and tomato paste. Simmer 8–10 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly and coats the back of a spoon.

steps.title: Thicken the sauce
steps.details: Stir the cornstarch slurry, then add it to the simmering sauce. Cook 1–2 minutes until glossy and thickened. Season with salt to taste, then remove the thyme sprig. Keep warm.

steps.title: Rest the beef
steps.details: Remove the beef from the oven and let it rest on a cutting board, tented with foil, for 15 minutes. This finishes the cooking and keeps it juicy.

steps.title: Slice and serve
steps.details: Slice the rested tenderloin into 1/2-inch medallions. Arrange on a platter, spoon the warm red wine sauce over, and serve any extra sauce alongside.

recipe.title: Herb-Roasted Salmon Fillets
recipe.intro: A lighter second main of flaky salmon brushed with lemon-herb butter. Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C) and line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment. Take salmon out of the fridge 15 minutes before roasting. Use ordinary equipment: small bowl, baking sheet, pastry brush.
recipe.finish: Salmon is done when it is opaque at the edges and flakes easily with a fork at the thickest part, or an instant-read thermometer reads 125–130°F (52–54°C) for moist, flaky salmon. Rest 3 minutes, then serve with lemon wedges and any extra herb butter spooned over the top.

ingredients.name: skin-on salmon fillets
ingredients.prep: pat dry, check for pin bones

steps.title: Preheat oven and ready pan
steps.details: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C) with a rack in the middle. Line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper. Meanwhile take the salmon out of the fridge so it loses its chill.

steps.title: Mix lemon-herb butter
steps.details: In a small bowl, stir together melted butter, lemon juice, lemon zest, parsley, dill, garlic, salt and pepper until evenly combined.

steps.title: Arrange salmon on pan
steps.details: Place salmon fillets skin-side down on the lined baking sheet, leaving a little space between them. Pat the tops dry again with paper towel so the butter clings.

steps.title: Brush with herb butter
steps.details: Brush the top and sides of each fillet generously with the lemon-herb butter, using about two-thirds of it. Keep the rest for serving.

steps.title: Roast the salmon
steps.details: Roast until salmon is opaque at the edges and flakes easily with a fork at the thickest part, 12–15 minutes depending on thickness. Check at 12 minutes; an instant-read thermometer in the center should read 125–130°F (52–54°C).

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.details: Let the salmon rest 3 minutes. Transfer to plates, spoon over the reserved herb butter and serve with lemon wedges.

recipe.title: Garlic Mashed Potatoes
recipe.intro: Peel and cut potatoes into 1-inch chunks. Use a large pot and a potato masher or ricer. Keep potatoes warm while mashing.
recipe.finish: Mash until smooth and creamy, adding hot milk mixture gradually. Taste and adjust salt and pepper. Serve hot; hold in a covered bowl over simmering water if needed.

steps.title: Boil potatoes and garlic
steps.details: Put potatoes and garlic in a large pot; add cold water to cover by 1 inch and the 1 tbsp salt. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer. Cook until a knife slides easily into the center of a potato, 15–20 minutes.

steps.title: Warm milk and butter
steps.details: While potatoes cook, warm milk and butter in a small saucepan over low heat until butter melts and milk is hot but not boiling. Keep warm.

steps.title: Drain potatoes and garlic
steps.details: Drain potatoes and garlic in a colander and return them to the dry pot. Let steam dry 1–2 minutes.

steps.title: Mash potatoes smoothly
steps.details: Mash potatoes and garlic until smooth and lump-free; do not overwork or they may turn gluey.

steps.title: Add hot milk mixture
steps.details: Pour the warm milk-butter mixture into the potatoes in thirds, stirring gently after each addition until absorbed before adding more.

steps.title: Season and serve
steps.details: Stir in black pepper and additional salt to taste. Serve hot.

recipe.title: Roasted Brussels Sprouts with Bacon
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C) with a rack in the upper third. You need a large rimmed sheet pan, a cutting board, a chef's knife, a mixing bowl, and tongs. Line the pan with parchment for easier cleanup if you like.
recipe.finish: Sprouts should be deeply caramelized at the edges and fork-tender, and the bacon crisp. Taste and add more pepper or a squeeze of lemon if the sprouts taste flat. Transfer to a warm serving bowl and serve right away; the dish holds well for about 20 minutes in a warm oven.

ingredients.name: Brussels sprouts
ingredients.prep: trimmed and halved lengthwise (quarter any very large ones)

steps.title: Heat oven and cut sprouts
steps.details: Heat oven to 425°F (220°C) while you trim and halve the sprouts. Keep them dry so they brown rather than steam.

steps.title: Cook bacon partway
steps.details: Put the bacon pieces in a cold large skillet over medium heat and cook 6–8 minutes, stirring, until browned but still slightly soft. Do not let it get fully crisp now; it will finish in the oven.

steps.title: Toss sprouts with fat
steps.details: With a slotted spoon, move the bacon to a plate. In a large bowl, toss the sprouts with the olive oil, salt, and pepper, then add 1 tablespoon of the rendered bacon fat and toss again (discard or save the rest).

steps.title: Spread on the pan
steps.details: Spread the sprouts cut-side down in a single layer on the sheet pan. Scatter the bacon pieces among them but keep them from covering the cut sides of the sprouts.

steps.title: Roast until browned
steps.details: Roast 20–25 minutes, stirring once at about the 12-minute mark, until the cut sides are deeply browned and a sprout pierces easily with a knife.

steps.title: Check bacon and season
steps.details: Pull the pan; the bacon should be crisp and the sprouts tender. If the bacon needs more time, return the pan for 3–5 minutes and check again. Taste and adjust salt and pepper.

generatedRecipes.title: Winter Greens Salad with Cranberries and Walnuts

recipe.title: Winter Greens Salad with Cranberries and Walnuts
recipe.intro: Get out a large salad bowl, a small bowl for dressing, a whisk, and a rimmed baking sheet. If serving as part of a larger meal, toast the walnuts and make the dressing ahead, then dress the greens just before serving.
recipe.finish: Toss once more right before serving so the greens are evenly coated but not weighed down. Taste and add a pinch of salt or a splash of vinegar if needed. Serve immediately alongside the rest of the Christmas Eve spread.

ingredients.name: mixed winter greens (kale, spinach, radicchio, or baby greens)
ingredients.prep: wash and dry very well, tear into bite-size pieces

steps.title: Toast the walnuts
steps.details: Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Spread the chopped walnuts on a rimmed baking sheet in a single layer and toast for 8–10 minutes, until fragrant and lightly golden. Watch closely in the last 2 minutes so they don't burn.

steps.title: Whisk the vinaigrette
steps.details: While the walnuts toast, whisk the olive oil, red wine vinegar, Dijon mustard, honey, salt, and pepper in a small bowl until smooth and slightly thickened.

steps.title: Cool the walnuts
steps.details: Remove the toasted walnuts from the oven and let them cool on the baking sheet for 10 minutes so they don't wilt the greens.

steps.title: Toss the greens
steps.details: Place the washed and dried greens in a large serving bowl. Just before serving, drizzle with about half the vinaigrette and toss gently.

steps.title: Top with cranberries and walnuts
steps.details: Scatter the dried cranberries and cooled walnuts over the greens. Add the remaining dressing and toss gently. If using, sprinkle the blue cheese or feta over the top and serve.

recipe.title: Creamy Butternut Squash Soup
recipe.intro: Peel and cube the squash before starting; a blender or immersion blender is needed for a silky finish. Use a large pot. No preheat needed.
recipe.finish: The soup is done when the squash mashes easily against the pot and the soup is smooth and steaming. Ladle into warm bowls and swirl a little cream on top if you like.

steps.title: Melt butter with oil
steps.details: In a large pot over medium heat, melt the butter with the olive oil until shimmering, about 2 minutes.

steps.title: Soften onion and carrot
steps.details: Add the onion and carrot and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and the onion is translucent, 6 to 7 minutes.

steps.title: Bloom garlic and spices
steps.details: Stir in the garlic, cinnamon, nutmeg and cayenne and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute; do not let the garlic brown.

steps.title: Simmer squash in broth
steps.details: Add the squash and broth, raise the heat to high and bring to a boil. Reduce to a gentle simmer, cover partly and cook until the squash is very tender and mashes easily with a spoon, 20 to 25 minutes.

steps.title: Blend until silky
steps.details: Remove from heat. Blend with an immersion blender until completely smooth, or blend in batches in a countertop blender with the lid vented and a towel held over it.

steps.title: Stir in cream
steps.details: Stir in the cream, salt and pepper. Return to low heat and warm gently without boiling, 3 to 5 minutes, until steaming. Taste and adjust salt.

recipe.title: Warm Buttery Dinner Rolls
recipe.intro: Soft enriched rolls for the holiday table. You'll need a stand mixer or a large bowl with a sturdy spoon, a 9x13-inch baking pan, and a clean towel. Start the yeast while you melt butter and grease the pan.
recipe.finish: Rolls are done when deep golden on top and the center reads 190°F. Brush with melted butter and serve warm; cool leftovers fully and store covered up to 2 days.

steps.title: Warm milk and melt butter
steps.details: Warm the 1 cup milk to about 110°F (lukewarm, not hot). Melt 4 tablespoons butter and let it cool slightly. Grease a 9x13-inch pan.

steps.title: Melt pan butter
steps.details: While the milk warms, melt the 4 tablespoons butter for the dough (reserve the separate 2 tablespoons for brushing later) and set aside to cool slightly.

steps.title: Bloom yeast with sugar
steps.details: Stir the yeast and sugar into the warm milk. Let stand 5 minutes until foamy; if it does not foam, the liquid was too hot or the yeast is dead.

steps.title: Mix in butter, egg, salt
steps.details: Stir the cooled melted butter, beaten egg and salt into the yeast mixture until combined.

steps.title: Add flour and form dough
steps.details: Add 3 1/2 cups flour, one cup at a time, stirring until a shaggy dough forms. Turn out onto a floured counter and knead 6–8 minutes until smooth and slightly tacky, adding flour a tablespoon at a time only if it sticks badly.

steps.title: First rise until doubled
steps.details: Place dough in a greased bowl, cover with a towel, and let rise in a warm spot 60–75 minutes until doubled in size and an indentation stays when poked.

steps.title: Shape into 12 rolls
steps.details: Punch down the dough, divide into 12 equal pieces, and roll each into a smooth ball. Arrange in the greased pan, spacing evenly.

steps.title: Second rise and preheat
steps.details: Cover rolls with a towel and let rise 35–45 minutes until puffy and nearly touching. Meanwhile preheat the oven to 375°F.

steps.title: Bake until golden
steps.details: Bake at 375°F for 18–22 minutes, until deep golden on top and the center roll reaches 190°F on an instant-read thermometer. Rotate the pan halfway through if browning unevenly.

steps.title: Brush with butter and serve
steps.details: Brush hot rolls with the reserved 2 tablespoons melted butter and serve warm.

recipe.title: Classic Cheesecake with Berry Compote
recipe.intro: Let cream cheese and eggs sit at room temperature about 1 hour before starting. You need a 9-inch springform pan, a roasting pan or large baking dish for the water bath, and aluminum foil. Preheat oven to 325°F (165°C) with a rack in the middle. Boil a kettle of water for the water bath. Wrap the outside of the springform pan in two layers of foil
recipe.finish: The cheesecake is done when the edge is set but the center still jiggles slightly like firm gelatin when the pan is nudged; it will firm up as it cools. Cool completely, then refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight before slicing. Spoon the cooled compote over each slice just before serving.

steps.title: Make and press crust
steps.details: Mix cracker crumbs, 3 tbsp sugar and melted butter until like damp sand. Press firmly into the bottom and 1 inch up the sides of the foil-wrapped springform pan.

steps.title: Bake the crust
steps.details: Bake at 325°F until fragrant and just set, 10 to 12 minutes. Set pan on a rack while you make the filling; leave the oven on.

steps.title: Beat cream cheese and sugar
steps.details: In a large bowl, beat cream cheese and 1 cup sugar on medium-low just until smooth and lump-free, about 2 minutes. Scrape the bowl.

steps.title: Add eggs and flavorings
steps.details: Add eggs one at a time, mixing on low just until blended. Stir in sour cream, vanilla and flour until smooth. Do not overmix or whip in air.

steps.title: Fill pan in water bath
steps.details: Pour filling over crust and smooth the top. Set the pan inside the roasting pan and pour hot water in to reach halfway up the sides.

steps.title: Bake cheesecake
steps.details: Bake at 325°F until edges are set and the center jiggles slightly when nudged, 55 to 65 minutes. Check at 55 minutes; do not let it crack or brown deeply.

steps.title: Cool in oven
steps.details: Turn oven off and crack the door open. Leave the cheesecake inside 30 minutes to cool gently, then remove from water bath.

steps.title: Chill overnight
steps.details: Run a thin knife around the edge. Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours, preferably overnight, before releasing the pan.

steps.title: Make berry compote
steps.details: While the cheesecake chills, combine berries, 3 tbsp sugar and lemon juice in a small saucepan. Simmer 4 minutes, stirring, then stir in cornstarch and simmer until glossy and slightly thickened, about 2 minutes. Cool and refrigerate.

steps.title: Top and serve
steps.details: Release the pan and slice with a hot, dry knife. Spoon cooled compote over each slice just before serving.

recipe.title: Sparkling Cranberry Punch
recipe.intro: A festive, all-ages punch of cranberry and citrus. You need a large punch bowl or 4-quart pitcher, a small saucepan, and a freezer-safe ring mold or bundt pan (optional). Chill everything ahead; assemble just before serving so it stays fizzy.
recipe.finish: Ladle into cups over the ice ring or ice cubes. Taste and add a splash more juice or soda if desired. Serve immediately; punch is best within the first hour while fizzy. Keep refills cold and add fresh soda to revive the fizz.

ingredients.name: orange juice
ingredients.prep: freshly squeezed or from concentrate, chilled

ingredients.name: cold water
ingredients.prep: for ice ring or ice cubes

ingredients.name: fresh cranberries
ingredients.prep: rinsed, for garnish and ice ring

ingredients.name: chilled lemon-lime soda or club soda

steps.title: Make ice ring
steps.details: Fill a bundt pan or ring mold with the cold water and scatter in half the cranberries and a few orange slices. Freeze at least 4 hours or overnight until solid. If using ice cubes instead, freeze the cranberries and orange slices in a zip-top bag and use regular ice.

steps.title: Dissolve sugar in juices
steps.details: In a large punch bowl or 4-quart pitcher, stir the cranberry juice, orange juice, and lemon juice with the sugar until the sugar dissolves, about 1 minute. Taste; add up to 1/4 cup more sugar only if too tart. Chill until serving.

steps.title: Chill punch base
steps.details: Refrigerate the juice mixture at least 1 hour before serving so it is thoroughly cold. This keeps the punch from diluting the ice quickly.

steps.title: Unmold ice ring
steps.details: Run warm water over the outside of the frozen mold for a few seconds, then invert onto a plate. Keep frozen until ready to float in the bowl.

steps.title: Add soda and float ring
steps.details: Pour the chilled juice base into the punch bowl. Slowly add the chilled lemon-lime soda or club soda and stir once gently. Float the ice ring or add ice cubes, then garnish with remaining cranberries and orange slices.

recipe.title: Herb-Roasted Turkey with Pan Gravy
recipe.intro: Remove the turkey from the fridge 1 hour before roasting. Position a rack in the lower third of the oven and preheat to 325°F (165°C). Have a roasting pan with a rack, a meat thermometer, and a fat separator or small ladle ready. Keep stuffing out of this bird; cook any stuffing separately.
recipe.finish: The turkey is done when the thickest part of the thigh reads 175°F (79°C) and the breast reads 165°F (74°C), and the juices run clear. Rest 30 minutes before carving so juices redistribute. Make the gravy in the same pan, then carve and serve with the hot gravy.

ingredients.name: whole turkey, thawed
ingredients.prep: remove giblets and neck, pat dry

steps.title: Season the turkey
steps.details: Pat the turkey very dry. Season the cavity and all over with kosher salt and pepper. Let it sit at room temperature for 1 hour while you prep.

steps.title: Mix herb butter
steps.details: Mash the softened butter with the sage, thyme, and rosemary until evenly combined.

steps.title: Fill pan and rub bird
steps.details: Scatter the onion, carrots, and celery in the roasting pan and add 1 cup of water. Rub the herb butter all over the turkey skin and gently under the breast skin. Tie the legs with twine if not already trussed and place breast-side up on the rack.

steps.title: Roast the turkey
steps.details: Roast uncovered at 325°F. Start checking at 2 hours; a 12–14 lb bird takes about 2½–3½ hours. If the skin browns too fast, tent loosely with foil. The thigh must read 175°F and the breast 165°F.

steps.title: Rest and collect drippings
steps.details: Move the turkey to a carving board, tent loosely with foil, and rest 30 minutes. Pour the pan drippings into a fat separator or a measuring cup and spoon off the fat, reserving 4 tbsp fat and all the defatted juices.

steps.title: Make the roux
steps.details: Set the roasting pan over medium heat, add the reserved 4 tbsp turkey fat, and whisk in the flour. Cook 2 minutes, scraping up the browned bits.

steps.title: Add broth and simmer
steps.details: Whisk in the reserved pan juices and the warm broth, adding a splash more water if too thick. Simmer 5–8 minutes, whisking, until the gravy coats a spoon. Season to taste and strain if desired.

steps.title: Carve and serve
steps.details: Carve the rested turkey and serve with the hot gravy.

recipe.title: Honey-Glazed Ham
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 325°F. Use a fully cooked bone-in ham (about 8-10 lb). Score fat, insert cloves, and glaze with honey mixture. Roast until heated through and glazed.
recipe.finish: Let ham rest 10-15 minutes before carving. Internal temperature should reach 140°F. Serve with accumulated pan juices.

steps.title: Preheat oven
steps.details: Position rack in lower third; preheat to 325°F. Line a roasting pan with foil and set a rack inside.

steps.title: Score ham and stud
steps.details: Remove rind from ham if present, leaving a thin layer of fat. Score fat in a diamond pattern about 1/4 inch deep. Insert whole cloves at intersections.

steps.title: Make glaze
steps.details: In a small bowl, whisk honey, melted butter, mustard, ground cloves, and pepper until smooth.

steps.title: Initial roast
steps.details: Place ham fat side up on rack in pan. Pour water into bottom of pan. Tent loosely with foil and bake for 1 hour.

steps.title: Glaze ham
steps.details: Remove foil; brush ham generously with half the glaze. Return to oven uncovered.

steps.title: Roast and baste
steps.details: Bake 30 minutes more, brushing with remaining glaze halfway through, until internal temperature reaches 140°F and glaze is sticky. If browning too quickly, tent with foil.

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.details: Transfer ham to cutting board; rest 10-15 minutes. Remove whole cloves before carving. Skim fat from pan juices and serve alongside.

recipe.title: Savory Sausage and Herb Stuffing
recipe.intro: Get ready: heat oven to 375°F (190°C) with a rack in the middle. You need a large rimmed baking sheet, a large skillet, a big mixing bowl, and a 9x13-inch baking dish. If your bread is fresh and soft, dry the cubes on the baking sheet in the oven for 10 minutes while you brown the sausage, then raise oven to 375°F.
recipe.finish: The stuffing is done when the top is golden brown and crisp and the center registers 165°F (74°C) on an instant-read thermometer, with no wet spots. Let it rest 10 minutes before serving so slices hold together. Serve hot alongside the turkey; cool leftovers within 2 hours and refrigerate up to 3 days.

ingredients.name: day-old rustic bread, cut into 3/4-inch cubes
ingredients.prep: cut into cubes; dry in oven if soft

steps.title: Toast the bread cubes
steps.details: Spread bread cubes on a rimmed baking sheet in a single layer. Bake at 375°F (190°C) until dry and lightly toasted, 10–12 minutes, stirring once. Set aside in a large bowl.

steps.title: Brown the sausage
steps.details: While bread toasts, melt 1 tablespoon butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add sausage and cook, breaking it up, until browned and no pink remains, 7–8 minutes. Transfer with a slotted spoon to a plate.

steps.title: Soften vegetables
steps.details: Add remaining 3 tablespoons butter to the skillet drippings. Cook onions and celery over medium heat, stirring, until soft and translucent, 7–8 minutes.

steps.title: Add garlic and herbs
steps.details: Stir in garlic, sage, thyme, salt, and pepper. Cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.

steps.title: Combine stuffing mixture
steps.details: Add sausage and cooked vegetables to the bowl of bread. Add parsley and toss to combine.

steps.title: Mix in broth and eggs
steps.details: Pour warmed broth and beaten eggs over the bread mixture and toss gently until evenly moistened. It should be moist but not soupy; add a splash more broth only if dry.

steps.title: Bake the stuffing
steps.details: Transfer to a buttered 9x13-inch baking dish and spread evenly. Cover with foil and bake 25 minutes at 375°F (190°C), then uncover and bake until golden and 165°F (74°C) in the center, 20–25 minutes more.

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.details: Let rest 10 minutes, then serve hot.

recipe.title: Roasted Garlic Mashed Potatoes
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 400°F. You need a pot for boiling, a baking pan for the garlic, a potato masher or ricer, and a strainer. Start water boiling while garlic roasts.
recipe.finish: Mash until smooth but not gluey; fold in butter and cream just until absorbed. Taste and adjust salt. Serve hot with an extra pat of butter. Potatoes hold well covered on low heat for 20 minutes; loosen with a splash of warm milk if needed.

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.prep: top sliced off to expose cloves

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.prep: for boiling water, plus more to taste

steps.title: Preheat and ready oven
steps.details: Preheat oven to 400°F with a rack in the middle.

steps.title: Roast the garlic
steps.details: Drizzle cut garlic heads with olive oil, wrap loosely in foil, and roast until cloves are very soft and golden, about 35-40 minutes.

steps.title: Boil the potatoes
steps.details: Put potatoes in a large pot, cover with cold water by 1 inch, add 1 tbsp salt, and bring to a boil. Cook until a knife slides in easily, about 15-18 minutes after boiling starts.

steps.title: Warm cream and butter
steps.details: While potatoes cook, warm cream and butter gently in a small saucepan until butter melts; keep warm, do not boil.

steps.title: Drain and dry potatoes
steps.details: Drain potatoes in a strainer, then return them to the dry pot over low heat for 1-2 minutes, shaking, to steam off excess moisture.

steps.title: Squeeze roasted garlic
steps.details: Unwrap garlic and squeeze the soft cloves into a small bowl, discarding skins.

steps.title: Mash potatoes with garlic
steps.details: Mash potatoes with the roasted garlic until mostly smooth, leaving a few small lumps if desired.

steps.title: Fold in butter and cream
steps.details: Stir in the warm butter-cream mixture, pepper, and salt to taste; mix just until creamy and combined. Do not overbeat.

recipe.title: Classic Green Bean Casserole
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Use a 9x13-inch baking dish or 2-quart casserole. No special equipment needed beyond a bowl and spoon. If making ahead, assemble up to 1 day in advance, cover, and refrigerate; add crispy onions just before baking.
recipe.finish: The casserole is done when the edges bubble and the center is hot, about 25–30 minutes. The internal temperature should read 165°F (74°C) if checked. If the onions need more browning, broil 1–2 minutes, watching closely. Let rest 5 minutes before serving.

steps.title: Preheat oven
steps.details: Set oven to 350°F (175°C) and place a rack in the middle position.

steps.title: Mix soup base
steps.details: In a large bowl, stir together the condensed cream of mushroom soup, milk, sour cream, and black pepper until smooth.

steps.title: Fold in beans and onions
steps.details: Add the drained green beans, 2/3 cup of the French-fried onions, and the cheddar if using. Stir gently until evenly coated.

steps.title: Fill baking dish
steps.details: Spread the mixture evenly in a 9x13-inch baking dish or 2-quart casserole.

steps.title: Bake casserole
steps.details: Bake uncovered for 25 minutes, until the edges bubble and the center is hot.

steps.title: Top with onions and finish
steps.details: Sprinkle the remaining 2/3 cup French-fried onions over the top. Bake 5 more minutes, until the onions are golden and crisp. Broil 1–2 minutes if needed, watching closely.

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.details: Let stand 5 minutes before serving. The casserole should be bubbling at the edges and 165°F (74°C) in the center.

recipe.title: Orange-Scented Cranberry Sauce
recipe.intro: A tangy-sweet homemade cranberry sauce with a hint of orange zest, ready in about 20 minutes. You need a medium saucepan (about 2-quart), a zester or fine grater, a wooden spoon, and a heatproof bowl. No preheat needed; zest the orange and rinse the cranberries while the sugar-water comes to a boil.
recipe.finish: The sauce is done when most berries have burst and the liquid coats the spoon (about 10 minutes of simmering); it will thicken more as it cools. Cool at least 30 minutes before serving—it sets to a soft gel. Serve chilled or at room temperature alongside roast turkey. Store covered in the fridge up to 1 week; stir before serving.

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen cranberries
ingredients.prep: rinsed; discard soft or shriveled berries, frozen need no thawing

ingredients.name: orange
ingredients.prep: zest 1 tsp before juicing; then juice to get 1/4 cup

steps.title: Zest and juice orange
steps.details: Use a zester or fine grater to remove 1 tsp orange zest, avoiding the bitter white pith. Halve the orange and squeeze to get 1/4 cup juice; set zest and juice aside.

steps.title: Rinse and sort cranberries
steps.details: Rinse the cranberries in a colander and pick out any soft or shriveled ones. Leave frozen berries frozen until they go in the pot.

steps.title: Dissolve sugar in water
steps.details: Combine sugar, water and salt in a medium saucepan. Stir over medium heat until the sugar dissolves and the liquid comes to a gentle boil, about 4–5 minutes.

steps.title: Add cranberries and simmer
steps.details: Stir the cranberries and cinnamon into the boiling syrup. Return to a boil, then reduce heat to medium-low and simmer uncovered, stirring occasionally, until most berries have burst and the liquid coats the spoon, about 10–12 minutes.

steps.title: Stir in orange and thicken
steps.details: Add the orange zest, orange juice and salt; stir and simmer 2 more minutes until slightly thickened. A spoon dragged across the pan bottom should leave a brief trail.

steps.title: Cool to set
steps.details: Remove from heat and cool in the pan at least 30 minutes; the sauce thickens to a soft gel as it sits. Stir once before serving.

recipe.title: Soft Dinner Rolls
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Use a stand mixer with dough hook or mix by hand. Grease a 9x13-inch baking pan.
recipe.finish: Brush warm rolls with melted butter. Serve warm. Rolls are best fresh but can be stored in an airtight container for 2 days.

steps.title: Proof yeast
steps.details: In a small bowl, combine warm milk, yeast, and 1 tablespoon of the sugar. Let sit 5-10 minutes until foamy. If not foamy, yeast is dead; start over.

steps.title: Mix wet ingredients
steps.details: In a large bowl or stand mixer bowl, combine softened butter, remaining sugar, salt, egg, and the yeast mixture. Mix until well blended.

steps.title: Add flour and knead
steps.details: Add 3 cups of the flour and mix until a soft dough forms. Gradually add remaining flour, 1/4 cup at a time, until dough pulls away from sides of bowl. Knead on floured surface 6-8 minutes until smooth and elastic. Dough should be tacky but not sticky.

steps.title: First rise
steps.details: Place dough in a greased bowl, turning to grease top. Cover with a clean towel and let rise in a warm place until doubled in size, about 1 hour.

steps.title: Shape rolls
steps.details: Punch down dough. Turn out onto lightly floured surface and divide into 15 equal pieces. Shape each into a smooth ball by pulling edges underneath. Place in greased 9x13-inch pan. Cover and let rise until doubled, about 30-40 minutes.

steps.title: Bake rolls
steps.details: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Bake rolls for 20-25 minutes, until golden brown and internal temperature reaches 190°F. Brush with melted butter if desired.

recipe.title: Classic Pumpkin Pie
recipe.intro: Get ready: 9-inch pie plate, rolling pin, mixing bowl, whisk, saucepan. If using refrigerated pie dough, let it soften per the package. Position a rack in the lower third of the oven and preheat to 425°F (220°C).
recipe.finish: The pie is done when the edges are set but the center still has a slight jiggle; a knife inserted 1 inch from the edge comes out clean. Cool completely on a rack for at least 2 hours before slicing so the custard sets; serve at room temperature or chilled with whipped cream. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and keep up to 3 days.

ingredients.name: refrigerated pie crust
ingredients.prep: softened per package; or 1 unbaked homemade single crust

steps.title: Fit crust into pie plate
steps.details: Unroll the softened pie crust and ease it into a 9-inch pie plate, pressing gently against the sides. Crimp or flute the edge and prick the bottom a few times with a fork. Keep chilled while you make the filling.

steps.title: Preheat oven
steps.details: While you fit the crust and mix the filling, heat the oven to 425°F (220°C) with a rack in the lower third.

steps.title: Whisk sugar and spices
steps.details: In a large bowl, whisk together the sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg and salt until evenly combined with no lumps.

steps.title: Add pumpkin, eggs, milk
steps.details: Add the pumpkin puree and beaten eggs and whisk until smooth. Gradually whisk in the evaporated milk and vanilla until the filling is uniform and glossy.;

steps.title: Blend remaining liquids
steps.details: Whisk in the last of the evaporated milk and the vanilla, scraping the bowl bottom and sides, until thoroughly combined.

steps.title: Fill the pie crust
steps.details: Pour the filling into the chilled crust, stopping about 1/4 inch below the rim. Tap the pie plate gently on the counter to release large air bubbles; wipe any drips off the rim.

steps.title: Bake at high heat
steps.details: Bake at 425°F (220°C) on the lower rack for 15 minutes to set the crust and start the custard.

steps.title: Finish at lower heat
steps.details: Reduce the oven to 350°F (175°C) and continue baking 40–50 minutes, until the edge is set and the center jiggles only slightly; a knife 1 inch from the edge should come out clean. Check at 40 minutes.

steps.title: Cool and serve
steps.details: Transfer the pie to a wire rack and cool completely, at least 2 hours, so the custard sets. Slice with a sharp knife and serve with whipped cream if desired.

recipe.title: Spiced Apple Cider
recipe.intro: Use a 3-quart saucepan or slow cooker. No specialty gear needed; a fine-mesh strainer helps for serving. If using a slow cooker, warm on low 2–3 hours instead of simmering.
recipe.finish: Cider is ready when fragrant and hot but not boiling. Taste and add more honey if needed. Lift out the orange slices; keep spices in for a stronger flavor or strain before serving. Serve hot in mugs, optionally with a fresh cinnamon stick or orange slice.

steps.title: Combine cider and water
steps.details: Pour the apple cider and water into a 3-quart saucepan. Set over medium-high heat.

steps.title: Add spices and orange
steps.details: While the pot heats, add the cinnamon sticks and cloves. Cut the orange into 1/4-inch rounds and add them (peel and all). Stir in the honey and nutmeg until the honey dissolves.

steps.title: Bring to a gentle simmer
steps.details: Heat until small bubbles ring the edge and steam rises, about 190–200°F. Do not let it boil hard; reduce heat as needed.

steps.title: Simmer to infuse
steps.details: Turn heat to low and keep at a bare simmer, uncovered, for 20 minutes so the spices and orange infuse. The cider should stay hot and fragrant, not rolling.

steps.title: Taste and adjust
steps.details: Taste carefully with a spoon. If too spicy, remove the cloves; if too tart, stir in another teaspoon of honey. Keep warm over low heat until serving.

steps.title: Strain and serve hot
steps.details: Ladle through a fine-mesh strainer into mugs, or lift out the orange slices and cinnamon sticks. Serve hot, adding a fresh cinnamon stick if desired.

recipe.title: Sparkling Cranberry-Brie Bites
recipe.intro: Let the phyllo cups stand at room temperature for 15 minutes so they separate easily. Preheat the oven to 350°F and line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment. Have a small spoon and a melon baller or butter knife ready for filling.
recipe.finish: The bites are done when the Brie slumps and looks glossy and the phyllo cup edges are deep golden, about 8–10 minutes; Brie should be fully melted, not just softened. Cool 2 minutes on the sheet, then transfer to a platter and top with the sparkling cranberries just before serving so they stay fizzy. Serve warm; these are best within 20 minutes of baking.

ingredients.name: mini phyllo shells
ingredients.prep: thaw 15 minutes at room temperature; keep in trays until filling

ingredients.name: Brie wheel
ingredients.prep: rind left on, cut into 24 rough 1/2-inch cubes

ingredients.name: whole-berry cranberry sauce
ingredients.prep: stir to loosen; cold is fine

steps.title: Heat oven and set up
steps.details: Set a rack in the middle of the oven and preheat to 350°F. Line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment. Arrange the 24 phyllo shells on the sheet, spacing them 1 inch apart.

steps.title: Toss sugared cranberries
steps.details: While the oven heats, put the dry cranberries in a small bowl, sprinkle with the water and toss to barely dampen. Add the sugar and toss until each berry is coated in a thin, sparkly crust. Set aside; do not refrigerate.

steps.title: Fill shells with Brie
steps.details: Press one Brie cube into each phyllo cup, rind side up, flattening slightly so it sits below the rim. Work quickly so the shells stay crisp.

steps.title: Top with cranberry sauce
steps.details: Spoon a scant 1/2 teaspoon cranberry sauce onto each Brie cube; a small dollop is plenty, as it spreads as it melts. Wipe the rim of each cup if any sauce drips over the edge.

steps.title: Bake until Brie melts
steps.details: If the oven has not yet reached 350°F, wait for it. Bake 8–10 minutes, until the Brie is fully melted and glossy and the phyllo edges are deep golden. Begin checking at 8 minutes.

steps.title: Cool on the sheet
steps.details: Set the sheet on a heatproof surface and cool the bites 2 minutes, until the Brie stops bubbling. Warm filling can burn, so keep them on the sheet until then.

steps.title: Garnish and serve
steps.details: Transfer the bites to a platter with a small spatula. Top each with 1–2 sparkling cranberries and a pinch of rosemary, if using. Serve warm.

recipe.title: Smoked Salmon Crostini with Dill
recipe.intro: Heat oven to 400°F (200°C) with a rack in the middle. Slice the baguette thinly on a slight diagonal for larger tops. Use a baking sheet; no specialty gear needed. If you prefer, toast the bread up to a day ahead and store airtight, then assemble just before serving.
recipe.finish: Each crostini should be crisp at the base, creamy on top, and cool-topped with salmon. Serve within about 20 minutes of assembly so the bread stays crisp, or assemble moments before guests arrive. Arrange on a platter and finish with the firmed dill.

ingredients.name: French baguette
ingredients.prep: sliced 1/4 inch thick on a slight diagonal into about 24 slices

steps.title: Preheat oven
steps.details: Set a rack in the middle and preheat to 400°F (200°C) while you slice the bread and make the spread.

steps.title: Slice baguette
steps.details: Cut the baguette into about 24 slices, 1/4 inch thick. A slight diagonal gives a sturdier base.

steps.title: Whip cream cheese spread
steps.details: In a bowl, beat the softened cream cheese with the sour cream, lemon juice, chopped dill, salt, and pepper until smooth and fluffy, about 1 minute.

steps.title: Brush and toast bread
steps.details: Arrange slices on a baking sheet and brush lightly with olive oil. Toast at 400°F (200°C) until golden at the edges, 6 to 8 minutes. Watch closely near the end so they do not burn.

steps.title: Prepare salmon pieces
steps.details: While the bread toasts, cut the cold-smoked salmon into 24 small pieces, roughly the size of each crostini. Keep chilled until assembling.

steps.title: Spread cream cheese on toasts
steps.details: Let the toasts cool 2 to 3 minutes, then spread each with about 2 teaspoons of the whipped cream cheese, leaving a small border.

steps.title: Top with salmon and dill
steps.details: Top each toast with a piece of smoked salmon and finish with fresh dill fronds. Arrange on a platter and serve.

recipe.title: Baked Spinach and Artichoke Dip
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 375°F. You need a 9-inch pie plate or 2-quart baking dish, a skillet, and a colander. Thaw and squeeze the spinach dry while the oven heats; drain and chop the artichokes. Serve with tortilla chips and vegetable dippers.
recipe.finish: Dip is done when bubbling around the edges and lightly golden on top, 20–25 minutes. Rest 5 minutes before serving; it will be very hot. Serve warm with tortilla chips and raw vegetable dippers.

ingredients.name: frozen chopped spinach
ingredients.prep: thaw and squeeze very dry in a colander or clean towel

ingredients.name: cream cheese
ingredients.prep: soften at room temperature or cut into cubes

steps.title: Heat oven and prep spinach
steps.details: Preheat oven to 375°F. Thaw spinach if frozen, then squeeze out as much water as possible; it should feel dry, not dripping.

steps.title: Soften garlic and drain artichokes
steps.details: While the oven heats, warm olive oil in a small skillet over medium-low heat and cook garlic 1 minute until fragrant but not browned. Drain and chop artichoke hearts.

steps.title: Soften cream cheese
steps.details: In a large bowl, stir cream cheese until smooth; if still firm, microwave 15–20 seconds.

steps.title: Mix dip base
steps.details: Stir sour cream, mayonnaise, salt, and pepper into the cream cheese until evenly blended.

steps.title: Fold in vegetables and cheese
steps.details: Add spinach, artichokes, garlic with oil, 1 cup mozzarella, and 1/4 cup Parmesan. Stir until uniform.

steps.title: Fill baking dish
steps.details: Spread mixture evenly in a 9-inch pie plate or 2-quart baking dish. Top with remaining 1/2 cup mozzarella and 1/4 cup Parmesan.

steps.title: Bake until bubbling
steps.details: Bake at 375°F for 20–25 minutes, until bubbling at the edges and lightly golden on top. If the top browns too fast, tent loosely with foil.

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.details: Let stand 5 minutes so it is safe to eat and holds together, then serve warm with tortilla chips and vegetable dippers.

generatedRecipes.title: Herb-Roasted Beef Tenderloin with Horseradish Cream

recipe.title: Herb-Roasted Beef Tenderloin with Horseradish Cream
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 425°F. Let a 3-lb center-cut tenderloin sit at room temperature 30 minutes. Have a roasting pan with a rack, kitchen twine, and an instant-read thermometer ready.
recipe.finish: Rest the roast 10–15 minutes before slicing. Internal temperature will rise about 5°F while resting. Slice into 1-inch-thick medallions and serve with the chilled horseradish cream.

ingredients.name: center-cut beef tenderloin, trimmed
ingredients.prep: tie at 1-inch intervals with twine; rest 30 min at room temperature

steps.title: Make horseradish cream
steps.details: Stir together sour cream, horseradish, lemon juice, Dijon, 1/4 tsp salt and chives in a small bowl. Cover and refrigerate until serving.

steps.title: Heat oven and season roast
steps.details: Heat oven to 425°F. Pat the tied tenderloin dry, rub with olive oil, then press on garlic, rosemary, thyme, 1 1/2 tsp salt and pepper evenly.

steps.title: Sear tenderloin
steps.details: Heat a large oven-safe skillet or roasting pan over high heat. Sear the roast on all sides, about 2 minutes per side, until browned.

steps.title: Roast to temperature
steps.details: Transfer to the oven and roast until an instant-read thermometer inserted in the thickest part reads 125°F for medium-rare, 18–22 minutes, or 135°F for medium, 24–28 minutes.

steps.title: Rest the roast
steps.details: Transfer to a cutting board, tent loosely with foil, and rest 10–15 minutes before slicing.

steps.title: Slice and serve
steps.details: Remove twine, slice into 1-inch medallions, and serve with the chilled horseradish cream.

recipe.title: Roasted Garlic Mashed Potatoes
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). You'll need a baking sheet, a large pot, a potato masher or ricer, and a hand mixer or whisk. Roast the garlic while the potatoes boil.
recipe.finish: Mash until smooth and creamy, taste, and adjust salt and pepper. Keep warm over low heat, stirring in a splash of milk if needed. Serve with extra butter on top.

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.prep: slice off top third of each head to expose cloves, leaving skins on

steps.title: Preheat oven
steps.details: Set oven to 400°F (200°C) with a rack in the middle.

steps.title: Roast the garlic
steps.details: Drizzle garlic heads with olive oil, wrap loosely in foil, and roast until cloves are soft and golden, 35 to 40 minutes. Squeeze cloves from skins when cool enough to handle.

steps.title: Boil the potatoes
steps.details: Put potatoes in a large pot, cover with cold water by 1 inch, and add 1 tbsp salt. Bring to a boil, then simmer until a knife slides in easily, 15 to 20 minutes. Drain well.

steps.title: Warm the dairy
steps.details: Gently warm milk and butter in a small saucepan over low heat until butter melts; keep warm, do not boil.

steps.title: Mash the potatoes
steps.details: Return drained potatoes to the dry pot. Mash until mostly smooth.

steps.title: Add roasted garlic and dairy
steps.details: Squeeze roasted garlic into the potatoes. Add warm milk-butter mixture and sour cream. Stir and mash until creamy.

steps.title: Season and serve
steps.details: Season with pepper and salt to taste. Serve hot.

recipe.title: Maple-Glazed Carrots with Brown Butter
recipe.intro: Peel and slice the carrots into 1/4-inch coins. Use a large skillet with a lid and a wide serving bowl. No special equipment needed.
recipe.finish: The carrots should be tender when pierced with a knife and coated in a glossy, syrupy glaze. Serve warm immediately, or hold covered on low heat and stir in a splash of water before serving.

steps.title: Slice the carrots
steps.details: Peel the carrots and slice into even 1/4-inch coins so they cook at the same rate.

steps.title: Simmer carrots until tender
steps.details: Put the carrots in the skillet with 1/2 cup water and the salt. Cover and simmer over medium heat 8–10 minutes, until a knife slides easily into a coin but it still holds its shape.

steps.title: Brown the butter
steps.details: While the carrots simmer, melt the butter in a small light-colored saucepan or skillet over medium heat. Swirl 2–4 minutes until it smells nutty and the milk solids turn golden brown. Remove from heat.

steps.title: Drain the carrots
steps.details: Uncover and drain off any remaining water. Return the skillet to medium heat and let the carrots dry for about 1 minute.

steps.title: Add butter, syrup and pepper
steps.details: Pour in the browned butter (scraping in the browned bits), maple syrup, and black pepper. Toss to coat.

steps.title: Glaze the carrots
steps.details: Cook over medium heat 4–6 minutes, stirring often, until the syrup thickens into a glossy coating on the carrots and they are fully tender. Do not let the syrup scorch.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.details: Taste and adjust salt. Transfer to a serving bowl and scatter with parsley if using. Serve warm.

recipe.title: Winter Greens Salad with Pomegranate
recipe.intro: No special equipment needed—just a skillet, a small jar or bowl for shaking up the dressing, and a large salad bowl. Toast the pecans first so they cool while you mix the vinaigrette and prep the greens; dress everything just before serving so the baby kale and arugula stay crisp.
recipe.finish: Give the salad one final gentle toss right before it goes to the table, then scatter the remaining pomegranate seeds and pecans over the top for looks. Taste a leaf—it should be bright, lightly sweet, and not drowning in dressing; add a pinch of salt or a squeeze of lemon if needed. Serve immediately.

ingredients.name: baby kale
ingredients.prep: rinsed, patted very dry, large stems removed

steps.title: Toast the pecans
steps.details: Put the pecans in a dry skillet over medium heat. Stir often until fragrant and one shade darker, 4–6 minutes. Watch closely—they go from toasted to burnt fast. Pour onto a plate to cool; they crisp as they cool.

steps.title: Make the citrus vinaigrette
steps.details: While the pecans toast, combine the olive oil, lemon juice, orange juice, honey, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a small jar or bowl. Shake or whisk until smooth and slightly thickened.

steps.title: Dry and chill the greens
steps.details: Make sure the baby kale and arugula are very dry—wet leaves water down the dressing. If needed, roll them in a clean kitchen towel. Keep in the fridge until the pecans have cooled.

steps.title: Cool and chop pecans
steps.details: Let the toasted pecans cool completely, about 5 minutes, then roughly chop or break them into bite-size pieces.

steps.title: Combine greens and pomegranate
steps.details: Put the dry kale and arugula in a large salad bowl. Add the pomegranate seeds and two-thirds of the cooled pecans (reserve the rest for the top).

steps.title: Toss with dressing
steps.details: Pour about two-thirds of the vinaigrette over the salad and toss gently with clean hands or tongs until every leaf is lightly coated. Add more dressing a tablespoon at a time if it looks dry—don't soak it.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.details: Scatter the reserved pecans over the top and serve right away. If holding briefly, set the salad bowl in the fridge and add the topping just before serving.

recipe.title: Gruyère and Chive Popovers
recipe.yield: 12 popovers (one standard 12-cup popover or deep muffin pan)
recipe.intro: Airy, golden popovers flecked with nutty Gruyère and fresh chives. Get ready: oven rack in the lower-middle position, pan on that rack, preheat to 450°F (230°C) for 20 minutes. Have a blender or whisk, a liquid measuring cup, and a warm towel ready. Grate the cheese and snip the chives while the oven heats.
recipe.finish: Popovers are done when deeply golden brown and puffed high, with a hollow, custardy interior and crisp sides; a skewer inserted into the center should come out nearly clean. Do not open the oven during the first 20 minutes or they may collapse. Serve immediately, or hold in a 200°F oven with the door cracked for up to 20 minutes.

steps.title: Preheat pan and oven
steps.details: Place the empty popover or deep muffin pan on the lower-middle rack and preheat the oven to 450°F (230°C) for 20 minutes. The pan must be screaming hot.

steps.title: Grate cheese and snip chives
steps.details: While the oven heats, finely grate the Gruyère and snip the chives. Set aside about 2 tablespoons of cheese for topping.

steps.title: Warm milk and melt butter
steps.details: Warm the milk to lukewarm (about 100°F) in the microwave or a small saucepan; it should feel barely warm on your wrist. Melt the 1 tablespoon butter and let it cool slightly.

steps.title: Blend the batter
steps.details: In a blender or with a whisk, combine the eggs, lukewarm milk, melted butter, flour, salt, and pepper. Blend or whisk until smooth with only small lumps, about 30–45 seconds. Do not overbeat.

steps.title: Fold in cheese and chives
steps.details: Stir in the 3/4 cup Gruyère (reserving the 2 tablespoons topping) and the chives until evenly distributed. Scrape the batter into a liquid measuring cup for easy pouring.

steps.title: Grease the hot pan
steps.details: Pull the hot pan to the stovetop and quickly brush every cup generously with softened butter, including the rims. Work fast so the pan stays hot.

steps.title: Fill and top the cups
steps.details: Pour the batter into the hot cups, filling each about three-quarters full (about 1/3 cup per cup). Sprinkle the reserved Gruyère over the tops.

steps.title: Bake at high heat
steps.details: Bake at 450°F (230°C) for 20 minutes without opening the door. The popovers should be puffed high and just beginning to color.

steps.title: Reduce heat and finish
steps.details: Reduce the oven to 350°F (175°C) and bake another 12–15 minutes, until deeply golden brown and crisp. A skewer inserted into the center should come out nearly clean.

steps.title: Pierce and serve
steps.details: Immediately pierce each popover near the base with a skewer to release steam. Turn out onto a rack or serve straight from the pan while hot.

recipe.title: Champagne Spritz Punch
recipe.intro: Chill all ingredients thoroughly before mixing. Use a large punch bowl or pitcher and a ladle. For best fizz, add sparkling wine just before serving.
recipe.finish: Serve immediately over ice. Garnish with citrus slices and mint if desired. Punch is best enjoyed within 1 hour of mixing.

steps.title: Combine base ingredients
steps.details: In a large punch bowl or pitcher, stir together elderflower liqueur, lemon juice, and simple syrup.

steps.title: Add ice and citrus
steps.details: Add ice cubes, lemon slices, and orange slices to the bowl. Stir gently to chill.

steps.title: Top with club soda
steps.details: Pour in chilled club soda and stir gently to combine.

steps.title: Add sparkling wine
steps.details: Just before serving, slowly pour in chilled sparkling wine and stir very gently once or twice to mix—do not overstir or you will lose carbonation.

steps.title: Garnish and serve
steps.details: Ladle punch into ice-filled glasses. Garnish each with a mint sprig and a citrus slice if desired. Serve immediately.

recipe.title: Chocolate-Espresso Midnight Cake
recipe.intro: A rich chocolate layer cake with espresso syrup and whipped ganache. You'll need two 9-inch round cake pans, parchment paper, a stand or hand mixer, a saucepan, and a wire rack. Allow 3½–4 hours total (including cooling).
recipe.finish: Serve at cool room temperature. Store leftovers covered in the refrigerator for up to 3 days; bring to room temperature before serving.

ingredients.name: hot brewed espresso or strong coffee
brewed espresso or strong coffee (for syrup)
semisweet chocolate chips or chopped chocolate

steps.title: Preheat oven and prepare pans
steps.details: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease two 9-inch round cake pans, line bottoms with parchment, and grease parchment.

steps.title: Mix dry ingredients
steps.details: In a large bowl, whisk flour, sugar, cocoa, baking soda, baking powder, and salt until evenly combined.

steps.title: Combine wet ingredients
steps.details: In another bowl, whisk eggs, buttermilk, oil, and vanilla until smooth.

steps.title: Make cake batter
steps.details: Pour wet mixture into dry and whisk just until combined. Slowly whisk in hot espresso and hot water until smooth; batter will be thin.

steps.title: Bake cake layers
steps.details: Divide batter evenly between pans. Bake 30–35 minutes, until a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean and cakes pull away from sides. Cool in pans 10 minutes, then turn out onto rack to cool completely, about 1 hour.

steps.title: Make espresso syrup
steps.details: While cakes cool, combine ¾ cup sugar and ¾ cup espresso in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring to dissolve sugar; boil 2 minutes. Remove from heat and cool.

steps.title: Make ganache
steps.details: Heat 1 cup cream in a saucepan until steaming (do not boil). Put chocolate in a heatproof bowl, pour hot cream over, and let stand 5 minutes. Stir gently until smooth; stir in butter, vanilla, and salt. Cool to room temperature, about 45 minutes, then refrigerate 15 minutes if needed to thicken.

steps.title: Whip ganache
steps.details: Whip cooled ganache with an electric mixer on medium-high until lightened and fluffy, about 1–2 minutes. Do not overbeat or it may become grainy.

steps.title: Assemble and frost cake
steps.details: Place one cake layer on a serving plate. Brush generously with half the espresso syrup. Spread about 1 cup whipped ganache on top. Add second layer, brush with remaining syrup, and spread remaining ganache over top and sides.

recipe.title: Sparkling Cranberry Orange Punch
recipe.intro: A fizzy, festive non-alcoholic punch. Serve it well chilled: chill the ginger ale, cranberry juice, and oranges ahead. Use a large punch bowl or a 4-quart pitcher. Make an ice ring or plenty of ice so the punch stays cold without getting watery too fast.
recipe.finish: Ladle into cups over ice and garnish each glass with an orange slice. The punch is ready when the ginger ale has just been stirred in and it is fully cold; do not let it sit out more than 2 hours. Add more ginger ale to stretch the batch if needed.

ingredients.name: orange juice, freshly squeezed or store-bought, chilled
ginger ale, chilled
ingredients.prep: keep in refrigerator until just before serving

ingredients.name: ice, plus an ice ring if you have one

steps.title: Chill and prep
steps.details: Refrigerate cranberry juice, orange juice, and ginger ale until very cold, at least 2 hours. Thinly slice the orange and rinse the cranberries. If using an ice ring, freeze it now (needs about 4 hours, so make it the day before if possible).

steps.title: Mix juices and sweetener
steps.details: In a large punch bowl or 4-quart pitcher, stir together the chilled cranberry juice, orange juice, lemon juice, and honey until the honey dissolves completely.

steps.title: Add fruit and ice
steps.details: Add the orange slices, cranberries, and ice (or ice ring) to the juice mixture. Stir gently once so the fruit is distributed.

steps.title: Top with ginger ale
steps.details: Just before serving, slowly pour in the chilled ginger ale and stir once or twice, gently, to combine. Do not over-stir or the fizz will escape.

steps.title: Check and serve
steps.details: Taste: it should be tart-sweet and fizzy. If too tart, stir in 1 more tablespoon honey; if too strong, add 1/2 cup ginger ale. Ladle over ice into cups and garnish with an orange slice. Serve immediately.

generatedRecipes.title: Make-Ahead Egg and Sausage Breakfast Casserole

recipe.title: Make-Ahead Egg and Sausage Breakfast Casserole
recipe.intro: Use a 9x13-inch baking dish. The night before, cook the sausage, layer everything, and refrigerate; in the morning just bake. Preheat oven to 350°F and let the dish sit out while the oven heats.
recipe.finish: Casserole is done when the center is set and reaches 160°F, with lightly browned edges and bubbling cheese. Rest 10 minutes before cutting into 12 squares. Serve warm with fruit or a green salad.

ingredients.name: sturdy white bread
ingredients.prep: cut into 1-inch cubes, lightly toasted if fresh

steps.title: Cook sausage
steps.details: Brown sausage in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up, 6–8 minutes until no pink remains and it reaches 160°F. Drain fat on paper towels.

steps.title: Grease and cube bread
steps.details: While sausage cooks, grease the baking dish with butter and cut bread into 1-inch cubes (toast fresh bread 5 minutes if soft).

steps.title: Layer bread and sausage
steps.details: Spread half the bread in the dish, scatter half the sausage and half the cheese, then repeat with remaining bread, sausage, and cheese.

steps.title: Whisk egg mixture
steps.details: Whisk eggs, milk, salt, pepper, and dry mustard until smooth; pour evenly over the layers. Press gently so bread soaks.

steps.title: Chill overnight
steps.details: Cover and refrigerate at least 8 hours or overnight so the bread absorbs the custard.

steps.title: Preheat oven
steps.details: Set oven to 350°F and let the covered dish sit on the counter while the oven heats.

steps.title: Bake casserole
steps.details: Bake uncovered 50–60 minutes, until center is set, edges are browned, and a thermometer in the center reads 160°F. Tent with foil if browning too fast.

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.details: Rest 10 minutes, then cut into 12 squares and serve warm.

generatedRecipes.title: Smoked Salmon and Cream Cheese Bagel Platter

recipe.title: Smoked Salmon and Cream Cheese Bagel Platter
recipe.intro: A build-your-own brunch platter. You will need a toaster or oven, a small bowl, and a large serving board or platter. Have everything else ready before toasting bagels.
recipe.finish: Serve as soon as the bagels are toasted, with the salmon platter at cool room temperature. Leftover salmon and cream cheese should be refrigerated promptly and used within 2 days.

ingredients.name: cream cheese

ingredients.name: fresh dill
ingredients.prep: finely chopped, plus sprigs for garnish

ingredients.name: cold-smoked salmon

steps.title: Soften cream cheese
steps.details: Set the cream cheese out on the counter for 15 minutes so it spreads easily. Meanwhile, slice the bagels, chop the dill, zest the lemon, drain the capers, slice the onion and tomato, and cut the lemon wedges.

steps.title: Mix the spread
steps.details: In a small bowl, stir the softened cream cheese with the sour cream, chopped dill and lemon zest until smooth and flecked with green. Season with a few grinds of black pepper.

steps.title: Arrange the salmon platter
