steps.title: Toast the bagels
steps.details: Toast the bagel halves in a toaster or on a baking sheet under the broiler until golden and crisp at the edges, 2 to 4 minutes. Watch closely so they do not burn.

steps.title: Serve the platter
steps.details: Pile the warm bagels beside the platter or in a basket. Let guests spread cream cheese on the bagels, then top with salmon, onion, tomato, capers, a squeeze of lemon and black pepper.

recipe.title: Maple-Glazed Bacon
recipe.intro: Heat oven to 400°F with a rack in the middle position. Line a rimmed baking sheet with foil, then parchment, for easy cleanup. Stir the maple syrup and brown sugar together in a small bowl. Have a pastry brush or spoon ready.
recipe.finish: The bacon is done when deep mahogany, crisp at the edges, and bubbling; it will crisp further as it cools. Lift slices onto a paper-towel-lined plate with tongs for 2 minutes, then serve warm. Watch the final minutes, since the sugar can scorch.

steps.title: Mix maple glaze
steps.details: Stir the maple syrup and brown sugar in a small bowl until mostly smooth; stir in the pepper if using. Set aside.

steps.title: Arrange bacon on sheet
steps.details: Lay the bacon slices in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet, close together but not overlapping.

steps.title: Bake bacon until half done
steps.details: Bake at 400°F for 12 minutes, until the fat has rendered and slices are starting to curl but are still floppy.

steps.title: Brush with maple glaze
steps.details: Pull the sheet out and close the oven door. Brush the tops of the slices generously with the maple mixture.

steps.title: Bake until crisp and glazed
steps.details: Return to the oven and bake 8–10 minutes more, until deep mahogany and crisp at the edges. Start checking at 8 minutes to prevent scorching.

steps.title: Drain and serve
steps.details: Transfer slices to a paper-towel-lined plate with tongs and rest 2 minutes before serving.

generatedRecipes.title: Roasted Sweet Potato and Kale Hash

recipe.title: Roasted Sweet Potato and Kale Hash
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 425°F. Use a large rimmed baking sheet. Have all ingredients ready before starting.
recipe.finish: Serve hot, directly from the skillet. Sweet potatoes should be tender and lightly browned; kale wilted but still bright green.

ingredients.name: kale
ingredients.prep: stems removed, leaves torn into bite-size pieces

steps.title: Preheat oven
steps.details: Set oven to 425°F with rack in center. Let it heat while you prep.

steps.title: Prep vegetables
steps.details: Peel and cube sweet potatoes, slice onion, and strip and tear kale. Mince garlic. Keep kale and garlic separate.

steps.title: Season sweet potatoes and onion
steps.details: On a large rimmed baking sheet, toss sweet potatoes and onion with 2 tablespoons olive oil, smoked paprika if using, 1/2 teaspoon salt, and 1/4 teaspoon pepper until evenly coated. Spread in a single layer.

steps.title: Roast until tender
steps.details: Roast for 20 minutes. Stir, then continue roasting 5–10 minutes more, until sweet potatoes are fork-tender and edges are browned.

steps.title: Wilt kale with garlic
steps.details: While the potatoes roast, heat remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add garlic and cook 30 seconds until fragrant, then add kale with remaining 1/4 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper. Cook, tossing, 3–4 minutes until wilted. Remove from heat.

steps.title: Combine and serve
steps.details: Add the roasted sweet potato mixture to the skillet with the kale. Toss gently to combine. Taste and adjust seasoning. Serve hot.

recipe.title: Winter Citrus and Pomegranate Salad
recipe.intro: Bright, juicy winter salad for a New Year's brunch. You need a sharp knife, a cutting board, a small bowl, and a large serving platter or wide bowl. No cooking required; chill the citrus and pomegranate while you prep so the salad stays crisp and cold.
recipe.finish: Taste and adjust with a pinch of salt or a squeeze of lemon if needed. Serve immediately while the greens are crisp, or hold undressed in the fridge for up to 1 hour. Toss with dressing only at the table.

steps.title: Chill and dry greens
steps.details: Rinse the greens well and dry thoroughly in a salad spinner or with paper towels. Refrigerate in a covered bowl while you prep the fruit.

steps.title: Supreme the citrus
steps.details: Slice the top and bottom off each orange and grapefruit so they sit flat. Cut away the peel and white pith following the curve of the fruit. Working over a bowl to catch juice, cut between the membranes to release clean segments. Reserve 1 tbsp of the caught juice for the dressing; discard membranes and seeds.

steps.title: Seed the pomegranate
steps.details: Cut the pomegranate in half and submerge it in a bowl of water. Break it apart with your hands and pull the seeds free; the seeds sink and the white pith floats. Skim off the pith, drain the seeds, and pat dry. Reserve 1/4 cup for garnish.

steps.title: Whisk the dressing
steps.details: In a small bowl, whisk the olive oil, lemon juice, reserved citrus juice, honey, and salt until thick and slightly glossy. Taste and adjust salt.

steps.title: Dress the greens
steps.details: Pile the dry greens on a wide platter or into a large bowl. Drizzle with about half the dressing and toss gently with your hands or tongs until just coated.

steps.title: Arrange citrus and pomegranate
steps.details: Arrange the citrus segments over the greens in overlapping pinwheels, leaving a little green showing. Spoon the drained pomegranate seeds (minus the reserved garnish) over the citrus and greens.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.details: Drizzle the remaining dressing over the citrus, then scatter the reserved 1/4 cup pomegranate seeds on top. Serve immediately.

recipe.title: Buttermilk Biscuits with Honey Butter
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 450°F (232°C) with a rack in the middle. Use a box grater, a large bowl, a 2½-inch round cutter (or a glass), and a baking sheet. Grate the cold butter and keep it cold until needed; measure the buttermilk and chill it. Line the baking sheet with parchment.
recipe.finish: Biscuits are done when tall, golden brown on top, and baked through with no doughy center—about 14–16 minutes. Cool 3 minutes, split, and serve warm with the whipped honey butter. Best the day they are made.

ingredients.name: baking powder
ingredients.prep: freshly opened or checked for date

steps.title: Preheat oven and grate butter
steps.details: Set oven to 450°F (232°C). Grate the cold butter on the large holes of a box grater onto a plate and return it to the fridge.

steps.title: Whisk dry ingredients
steps.details: In a large bowl, whisk the flour, baking powder, and 1 tsp salt until evenly combined.

steps.title: Cut in cold butter
steps.details: Add the grated cold butter to the flour and toss with your fingers until every piece is coated and the mixture looks like coarse crumbs with some pea-size pieces. Do not overwork.

steps.title: Whip honey butter
steps.details: In a small bowl, beat the softened butter, honey, and ¼ tsp salt with a fork until smooth and fluffy. Set aside at room temperature.

steps.title: Add buttermilk and stir
steps.details: Make a well in the flour-butter mixture, pour in the cold buttermilk, and stir just until a shaggy, sticky dough forms, about 15–20 strokes. It is fine if some dry bits remain.

steps.title: Fold and pat dough
steps.details: Turn the dough onto a lightly floured counter, pat into a rough rectangle, and fold it in thirds like a letter. Repeat twice, then pat to ¾ inch thick. Work quickly to keep the butter cold.

steps.title: Cut biscuits
steps.details: Press a floured 2½-inch cutter straight down without twisting and place biscuits 1 inch apart on the lined baking sheet. Gently press scraps together and cut remaining biscuits for 9 total.

steps.title: Bake until golden
steps.details: Bake the biscuits on the middle rack for 14–16 minutes, until tall and golden brown on top and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Watch that the bottoms do not overbrown.

steps.title: Cool and serve
steps.details: Cool the biscuits on the pan for 3 minutes, then split and serve warm with a generous smear of whipped honey butter.

recipe.title: Lemon Yogurt Parfaits with Granola
recipe.intro: No cooking needed—just zest, stir, and layer. Use four clear 8-oz glasses or jars. If your granola is clumpy, break it into small pieces so it layers neatly.
recipe.finish: Serve right away so the granola stays crunchy. If making ahead, keep the yogurt and granola separate and layer just before serving; the parfaits are best within 2 hours.

ingredients.name: fresh mixed berries
ingredients.prep: rinsed and patted dry; hull strawberries and slice large ones

steps.title: Zest and juice lemon
steps.details: Zest the lemon into a small bowl, then halve and juice it. You need about 1 tsp zest and 2 tbsp juice.

steps.title: Sweeten the yogurt
steps.details: In a medium bowl, stir together the yogurt, honey, vanilla if using, lemon zest, and 1 tbsp lemon juice. Taste and add up to 1 tbsp more lemon juice for a brighter flavor. The yogurt should be smooth and softly spoonable.

steps.title: Prep the berries
steps.details: Rinse the berries and pat completely dry. Hull and slice any strawberries so all berries are bite-sized.

steps.title: Layer the parfaits
steps.details: Spoon 2 tbsp yogurt into each glass. Top with 1 tbsp granola and a few berries. Repeat layers once, then finish each glass with a final 2 tbsp yogurt. Divide the remaining granola and berries among the tops, piling berries gently.

steps.title: Drizzle and serve
steps.details: Drizzle each parfait with a little extra honey if you like and serve immediately with long spoons.

recipe.title: Cinnamon Roll Monkey Bread
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 350°F. You need a 10-inch Bundt pan or tube pan, greased well with butter. Have a rimmed baking sheet ready to catch drips. Let refrigerated biscuit dough come to room temperature for easier cutting.
recipe.finish: Let the bread cool in the pan 5 minutes, then invert onto a plate and lift off the pan. Serve warm; the caramel glaze will firm as it cools. Pull apart with fingers.

ingredients.name: refrigerated flaky biscuit dough
ingredients.prep: separate biscuits and cut each into quarters

steps.title: Preheat and grease pan
steps.details: Heat oven to 350°F. Brush the inside of a 10-inch Bundt pan generously with 2 tbsp melted butter, reaching into all the crevices. Set the pan on a rimmed baking sheet.

steps.title: Mix cinnamon sugar
steps.details: Stir granulated sugar and cinnamon together in a shallow bowl until evenly combined.

steps.title: Make caramel glaze
steps.details: Stir the 1/2 cup melted butter and brown sugar together in a small bowl until smooth. Set aside.

steps.title: Coat dough pieces
steps.details: Cut each biscuit into 4 pieces. Toss the pieces in the cinnamon sugar in batches, pressing lightly so the coating sticks.

steps.title: Layer with pecans and sugar
steps.details: Sprinkle half the pecans in the bottom of the Bundt pan. Add half the coated dough pieces in an even layer, then scatter 1 tbsp of any leftover cinnamon sugar over them. Top with remaining dough, then remaining pecans and another 1 tbsp cinnamon sugar.

steps.title: Pour over caramel glaze
steps.details: Spoon the brown sugar butter mixture evenly over the top of the dough. Do not stir.

steps.title: Bake until deep golden
steps.details: Bake 35–40 minutes, until puffed and deep golden brown and a skewer inserted near the center meets little resistance. Check at 30 minutes; if browning too fast, tent loosely with foil.

steps.title: Rest and invert
steps.details: Cool in the pan on a rack 5 minutes only. Invert onto a plate, tap the pan, and lift it off. Scrape any remaining caramel from the pan over the bread.

generatedRecipes.title: Loaded Nachos with Queso and Jalapeños

recipe.title: Loaded Nachos with Queso and Jalapeños
recipe.intro: Heat oven to 400°F with a rack in the middle. Line a large rimmed sheet pan with foil for easy cleanup. Set out a skillet for the beef and a small saucepan for the queso. Have chips, drained beans, and sliced jalapeños ready before you start cooking.
recipe.finish: Nachos are done when the queso and shredded cheese are fully melted and bubbling at the edges, about 10–12 minutes. Scatter scallions and cilantro over the top, add sour cream and salsa on the side, and serve immediately while hot so chips stay crisp.

steps.title: Brown the beef
steps.details: Set the skillet over medium-high heat. Add the ground beef and cook, breaking it up, until no pink remains and it reaches 160°F, 6–8 minutes.

steps.title: Season the beef
steps.details: Stir in the taco seasoning and water. Simmer 2–3 minutes until the liquid thickens and coats the meat. Turn off the heat.

steps.title: Warm the beans
steps.details: While the beef simmers, microwave the drained black beans in a bowl for 1–2 minutes until hot. Set aside.

steps.title: Make the queso base
steps.details: In a small saucepan over medium heat, melt the butter. Whisk in the flour and cook 1 minute until it smells toasty and looks like a smooth paste.

steps.title: Build the queso
steps.details: Slowly whisk in the milk, a splash at a time, until smooth. Cook, whisking, until it bubbles and thickens slightly, about 4 minutes. Reduce heat to low.

steps.title: Melt the cheddar
steps.details: Add the shredded cheddar in handfuls, whisking until fully melted and smooth. Keep warm on low, stirring occasionally.

steps.title: Preheat the oven
steps.details: Heat oven to 400°F if not already on. Line a large rimmed sheet pan with foil.

steps.title: Layer the nachos
steps.details: Spread the chips on the sheet pan. Spoon the beef over them, scatter the beans, then drizzle the warm queso evenly and top with Monterey Jack and jalapeño slices.

steps.title: Bake until bubbling
steps.details: Bake 10–12 minutes, until the cheese is fully melted and bubbling at the edges. Watch for the chips browning at the pan edges.

steps.title: Garnish and serve
steps.details: Scatter the scallions over the top. Serve right away with sour cream and salsa on the side.

recipe.title: Oven-Baked Buffalo Chicken Wings
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 425°F with a rack in the upper-middle position. Line a rimmed baking sheet with foil and set a wire rack on top (or use parchment). Have paper towels ready. Make the blue cheese dip and cut celery while the oven heats.
recipe.finish: Wings are done when skin is deep golden and crisp and juices run clear (internal temp 175°F+). Toss hot wings with the butter-hot sauce and serve right away with blue cheese dip and celery sticks.

ingredients.name: chicken wings, split into drumettes and flats
ingredients.prep: pat very dry with paper towels

steps.title: Preheat oven
steps.details: Heat oven to 425°F. Position rack in upper-middle. Line a rimmed baking sheet with foil and set a wire rack on it.

steps.title: Make blue cheese dip
steps.details: Stir blue cheese, sour cream, mayonnaise, and lemon juice together in a small bowl until combined but still chunky. Cover and refrigerate until serving.

steps.title: Cut celery sticks
steps.details: Wash and cut celery into 4 short sticks; refrigerate alongside the dip.

steps.title: Dry and season wings
steps.details: Pat wings very dry. In a large bowl, toss wings with baking powder, salt, and pepper until evenly coated.

steps.title: Arrange wings on rack
steps.details: Arrange wings in a single layer on the wire rack, skin side up, without crowding.

steps.title: Bake wings
steps.details: Bake 40-45 minutes at 425°F, turning once halfway through, until deep golden and crisp. Check doneness: juices run clear and internal temp reaches 175°F.

steps.title: Melt butter and make sauce
steps.details: While wings finish, melt butter in a microwave-safe bowl. Whisk in hot sauce until combined.

steps.title: Toss wings in sauce
steps.details: Remove wings from oven and let rest 2 minutes. Transfer to a large bowl, pour hot butter sauce over, and toss until fully coated.

steps.title: Serve with dip and celery
steps.details: Pile wings on a platter and serve immediately with chilled blue cheese dip and celery sticks.

recipe.title: Baked Spinach and Artichoke Dip
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 375°F. Use a 9-inch pie plate or 1-quart baking dish. Thaw and squeeze spinach very dry; drain and chop artichokes. Slice baguette while oven heats.
recipe.finish: Dip is done when bubbly at the edges and lightly golden on top, about 20–25 minutes. Let rest 5 minutes before serving. Serve warm with toasted baguette slices; refill the bread basket as needed.

steps.title: Preheat oven and slice bread
steps.details: Set oven to 375°F. Slice baguette into 1/2-inch rounds and arrange on a baking sheet. Brush lightly with olive oil. Let oven finish heating while you make the dip.

steps.title: Toast baguette slices
steps.details: Bake bread at 375°F until crisp and light golden, 8–10 minutes. Set aside; leave oven on.

steps.title: Squeeze spinach dry
steps.details: Thaw spinach, then squeeze in a clean towel or handfuls until almost no water remains. This keeps the dip creamy, not watery.

steps.title: Drain and chop artichokes
steps.details: Drain artichoke hearts well and chop into bite-size pieces.

steps.title: Mix creamy base
steps.details: In a large bowl, stir softened cream cheese, sour cream, mayonnaise, garlic, salt and pepper until smooth.

steps.title: Fold in vegetables and cheeses
steps.details: Stir in spinach, artichokes, 3/4 cup mozzarella and 1/4 cup Parmesan until evenly combined.

steps.title: Bake until bubbly
steps.details: Spread dip in a 9-inch pie plate or 1-quart dish. Top with remaining 1/4 cup mozzarella and 1/4 cup Parmesan. Bake at 375°F until bubbly at the edges and lightly golden on top, 20–25 minutes.

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.details: Let dip rest 5 minutes so it firms slightly and is safe to scoop. Serve warm with toasted baguette slices.

recipe.title: Slow-Cooker Pulled Pork Sliders
recipe.intro: Use a 5- to 6-quart slow cooker and a small bowl for coleslaw. Plan on about 9 hours total; most of it is hands-off. Keep finished pork on the warm setting and add slaw just before serving so buns stay crisp.
recipe.finish: Pork is done when it shreds easily and reaches 200-205°F in the thickest part. Toss shredded pork with enough juices and barbecue sauce to be moist but not soupy, then pile onto split buns and top with a spoonful of slaw. Hold leftovers in the slow cooker on warm for up to 2 hours, stirring in a splash of water or sauce if needed.

ingredients.name: boneless pork shoulder (Boston butt)
ingredients.prep: cut into 3-inch chunks, trim large fat caps

steps.title: Season the pork
steps.details: Pat pork dry with paper towels. In a small bowl, stir together brown sugar, smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt and pepper. Rub all over the pork chunks.

steps.title: Load the slow cooker
steps.details: Put pork in the slow cooker. Pour in 1/2 cup barbecue sauce, 1/4 cup vinegar and the broth. Turn pork to coat.

steps.title: Slow-cook the pork
steps.details: Cover and cook on low until pork is fork-tender, 7 to 8 hours. Do not lift the lid during the first 6 hours. Check at 7 hours; it should shred easily and reach 200-205°F.

steps.title: Make the slaw
steps.details: While pork finishes, whisk mayonnaise, sugar, 1 tbsp vinegar and 1/4 tsp salt in a large bowl. Add cabbage mix and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate until serving.

steps.title: Shred the pork
steps.details: Carefully lift pork out with tongs or a slotted spoon and shred with two forks. Discard excess fat. Skim obvious fat from the slow-cooker juices and reserve about 1 cup juices.

steps.title: Sauce the shredded pork
steps.details: Return pork to the slow cooker with the reserved juices and remaining 1/2 cup barbecue sauce. Toss to coat, adding more sauce or splashes of water if needed. Set slow cooker to warm.

steps.title: Toast the slider buns
steps.details: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Place split buns cut-side up on a baking sheet and brush lightly with melted butter. Toast until edges are golden, about 5 minutes, then transfer to a serving basket.

steps.title: Assemble and serve
steps.details: Fill each bun with about 1/3 cup hot pork, top with a spoonful of slaw and a pickle slice, and serve with extra barbecue sauce on the side.

recipe.title: Chili Cheese Dogs
recipe.intro: Set up a grill or grill pan over medium-high heat and gather a pot for the chili. Have buns, cheese, and onions ready to assemble.
recipe.finish: Serve dogs hot with extra chili and cheese on the side. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and reheat chili to 165°F before serving.

steps.title: Brown the beef
steps.details: Heat oil in a medium saucepan over medium-high. Add beef and half the diced onion; cook 6–7 minutes, breaking up, until no pink remains and beef reaches 160°F.

steps.title: Simmer the chili
steps.details: Stir in tomato sauce, beans, chili powder, cumin, and salt. Bring to a simmer, then cook 12 minutes, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened.

steps.title: Grill the hot dogs
steps.details: Grill hot dogs over medium-high heat 6–8 minutes, turning, until browned and 160°F inside.

steps.title: Toast the buns
steps.details: Place buns cut-side down on the grill for 1–2 minutes, until lightly toasted.

steps.title: Assemble the dogs
steps.details: Put a hot dog in each bun, spoon chili over the top, then add cheddar and remaining diced onion.

recipe.title: Seven-Layer Taco Dip
recipe.intro: Use a 9x13-inch glass dish or a large shallow platter. No cooking needed—just layer and chill. Have chips ready for serving.
recipe.finish: Serve chilled or slightly cool with tortilla chips. Dip keeps covered in the fridge up to 2 days; stir gently before serving if it sits.

ingredients.name: guacamole
ingredients.prep: ready-made, or mash 2 avocados with lime and salt

steps.title: Spread beans
steps.details: Spread refried beans evenly over the bottom of a 9x13-inch dish, using a spatula to make a flat base layer.

steps.title: Add guacamole
steps.details: Spoon guacamole over the beans and gently spread to the edges without mixing the layers.

steps.title: Spread sour cream
steps.details: Dollop sour cream over the guacamole and spread in an even layer.

steps.title: Add salsa
steps.details: Spoon drained salsa evenly over the sour cream; tilt the dish to level it.

steps.title: Top with cheese
steps.details: Scatter shredded cheese over the salsa in an even layer.

steps.title: Finish with olives and onions
steps.details: Sprinkle drained olives and sliced green onions over the cheese.

steps.title: Chill before serving
steps.details: Cover and refrigerate at least 20 minutes so layers set; keep cold until serving.

steps.title: Serve with chips
steps.details: Set out the chilled dip with tortilla chips for scooping.

recipe.title: Classic Guacamole
recipe.intro: No cooking required. Have ready: chef's knife, cutting board, spoon, fork, citrus juicer (or reamer), and a serving bowl. No preheating needed.
recipe.finish: Taste and adjust salt or lime. Serve immediately, or press plastic wrap directly onto the surface and refrigerate for up to 2 hours. Stir before serving.

ingredients.name: ripe tomato
ingredients.prep: cored, seeded, and finely chopped (about 1/2 cup)

steps.title: Prep vegetables and lime
steps.details: Finely chop onion and cilantro; core, seed, and finely chop tomato; juice lime. Set aside.

steps.title: Mash avocados
steps.details: Scoop avocado flesh into a bowl and mash with a fork until mostly smooth with some lumps.

steps.title: Add aromatics and seasonings
steps.details: Add chopped onion, tomato, cilantro, lime juice, salt, pepper, and cumin (if using) to the mashed avocado.

steps.title: Fold and adjust seasoning
steps.details: Gently fold everything together until combined. Taste and add more salt or lime juice if needed. Serve immediately.

recipe.title: Soft Garlic Parmesan Breadsticks
recipe.intro: Great for a crowd. You need a large bowl, a sturdy spoon, a lightly floured counter, a baking sheet, and a clean kitchen towel. Have butter, garlic, and Parmesan ready before the dough rises so the topping is fast.
recipe.finish: Breadsticks are done when golden at the edges and the centers feel soft but set; brush hot sticks with garlic butter, sprinkle with Parmesan, and serve warm with marinara for dipping.

steps.title: Bloom yeast
steps.details: Whisk warm water, yeast, and sugar in a large bowl. Let stand 5 minutes until foamy; if it does not foam, the water was too hot or the yeast is dead.

steps.title: Mix dough
steps.details: Stir in flour and salt until a shaggy dough forms, then mix until no dry flour remains.

steps.title: Knead dough
steps.details: Turn dough onto a lightly floured counter and knead 6 minutes until smooth and slightly tacky, dusting with flour only if it sticks badly.

steps.title: First rise
steps.details: Lightly oil the bowl, return dough, cover with a towel, and let rise in a warm spot 45 minutes until doubled.

steps.title: Heat oven and make topping
steps.details: Heat oven to 400°F with a rack in the center. Stir melted butter and garlic together in a small bowl.

steps.title: Shape breadsticks
steps.details: Punch down dough and divide into 12 pieces. Roll each into an 8-inch rope and place on a parchment-lined baking sheet, spacing them 1 inch apart.

steps.title: Second rise
steps.details: Cover shaped sticks with a towel and let rise 20 minutes while the oven finishes heating; they should look puffy.

steps.title: Bake breadsticks
steps.details: Bake 14–16 minutes until pale golden and the centers spring back when gently pressed; rotate the pan halfway through.

steps.title: Brush and top
steps.details: Brush hot breadsticks generously with garlic butter and sprinkle evenly with Parmesan. Serve warm with marinara.

recipe.title: Chocolate Chip Cookie Bars
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Line a 9x13-inch baking pan with parchment paper or grease with butter. Gather ingredients and let butter and eggs come to room temperature if possible.
recipe.finish: Let bars cool completely in the pan on a wire rack (about 1 hour) before cutting into 24 squares. Store airtight at room temperature for up to 4 days.

steps.title: Preheat and prepare pan
steps.details: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Line a 9x13-inch baking pan with parchment paper, leaving overhang on two sides, or grease with butter.

steps.title: Cream butter and sugars
steps.details: In a large bowl, beat softened butter, brown sugar, and granulated sugar with an electric mixer on medium speed until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes.

steps.title: Add eggs and vanilla
steps.details: Beat in eggs one at a time, then vanilla, until well combined.

steps.title: Combine dry ingredients
steps.details: In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, baking soda, and salt.

steps.title: Mix dry into wet
steps.details: Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing on low speed just until no flour streaks remain. Do not overmix.

steps.title: Fold in chocolate chips
steps.details: Stir in chocolate chips until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Spread dough in pan
steps.details: Transfer dough to prepared pan and press into an even layer with a spatula or your hands.

steps.title: Bake bars
steps.details: Bake at 350°F for 25–30 minutes, until golden brown and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out with moist crumbs (not raw batter).

steps.title: Cool completely
steps.details: Remove pan from oven and let cool completely on a wire rack, about 1 hour. This allows bars to set for clean cuts.

recipe.title: Sparkling Lime Punch
recipe.intro: No cooking required. You need a 2-quart pitcher, a long spoon, a knife and cutting board, and a measuring cup. Chill the limeade concentrate in the fridge if you can, and chill the sparkling water and lime slices so the punch stays fizzy and cold.
recipe.finish: Stir gently just before serving so the lime slices float through the pitcher. Serve over plenty of ice in chilled glasses, ladling gently to keep the bubbles. If the punch sits out, add fresh ice and a splash more sparkling water; keep any leftovers covered in the fridge for up to 1 day, though it will lose fizz.

ingredients.name: cold water
ingredients.prep: measure from the tap or fridge

ingredients.name: cold sparkling water or club soda

steps.title: Mix limeade base
steps.details: Pour the thawed limeade concentrate and cold water into a 2-quart pitcher. Stir with a long spoon until the concentrate is fully dissolved and no syrupy streaks remain, about 30 seconds.

steps.title: Slice the lime
steps.details: While the base rests, cut the scrubbed lime crosswise into thin 1/8- to 1/4-inch rounds. Pick out any seeds and set the slices on a small plate.

steps.title: Chill the base
steps.details: Refrigerate the covered limeade base for at least 10 minutes so the punch is cold before the sparkling water goes in. This keeps the fizz lively.

steps.title: Add ice and lime
steps.details: Drop the ice cubes into the chilled pitcher, then tuck most of the lime slices between the ice cubes, reserving a few rounds for the glasses.

steps.title: Top with sparkling water
steps.details: Slowly pour the chilled sparkling water down the inside of the pitcher to avoid foaming. Stir once or twice very gently with the long spoon just to combine; do not overstir or the punch will go flat.

steps.title: Serve over ice
steps.details: Fill glasses with fresh ice, add a reserved lime slice to each, and ladle or pour the punch gently over the ice. Taste and, if you want it tarter, squeeze a reserved lime wedge into the pitcher.

generatedRecipes.title: Oysters on the Half Shell with Mignonette

recipe.title: Oysters on the Half Shell with Mignonette
recipe.intro: Chill oysters thoroughly before shucking. You'll need a stiff brush, oyster knife, and a towel. Mignonette can be made ahead and refrigerated.
recipe.finish: Serve oysters immediately on crushed ice with mignonette. Oysters should be cold, liquor clear, and smell fresh. Discard any with open shells that won't close when tapped.

steps.title: Chill oysters
steps.details: Arrange oysters in a single layer on a tray and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to firm up.

steps.title: Make mignonette
steps.details: In a small bowl, combine vinegar, shallot, pepper, lemon juice, and chives (if using). Stir and let sit at least 10 minutes for flavors to meld.

steps.title: Scrub oysters
steps.details: Under cold running water, scrub oyster shells with a stiff brush to remove grit. Discard any with broken shells or that remain open when tapped.

steps.title: Shuck oysters
steps.details: Hold oyster flat side up, insert oyster knife near hinge, twist to pry open. Cut muscle from top shell, remove top shell, and loosen oyster from bottom shell, keeping liquor. Nestle on crushed ice.

steps.title: Serve
steps.details: Arrange oysters on crushed ice and serve immediately with mignonette alongside.

recipe.title: Creamy Roasted Tomato Basil Soup
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Have a rimmed baking sheet, a large pot, and a blender (or immersion blender) ready. Roast the vegetables first for deep flavor, then simmer and blend.
recipe.finish: Taste and adjust salt and pepper. Serve hot in warm bowls, swirl a little cream on top, and scatter reserved basil. Pair with crusty bread for dipping.

ingredients.name: ripe tomatoes
ingredients.prep: halved (or 2 28-oz cans whole tomatoes, drained, if out of season)

ingredients.name: fresh basil leaves
ingredients.prep: loosely packed, plus extra for garnish

steps.title: Preheat oven
steps.details: Set oven to 425°F (220°C) and position a rack in the middle.

steps.title: Season vegetables
steps.details: On a rimmed baking sheet, toss tomatoes, onion, and garlic with 2 tbsp olive oil, salt, and pepper until coated.

steps.title: Roast until tender
steps.details: Roast until tomatoes collapse and onion edges are browned, 30–35 minutes.

steps.title: Simmer with broth
steps.details: Transfer roasted vegetables to a large pot. Add broth and bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer and cook 10 minutes to meld flavors.

steps.title: Blend until silky
steps.details: Add basil, then blend with an immersion blender until smooth (or blend in batches, venting the lid). Return to pot.

steps.title: Finish with cream
steps.details: Stir in cream and heat gently 3–4 minutes until hot but not boiling. Taste and adjust salt and pepper.

steps.title: Garnish and serve
steps.details: Ladle into warm bowls and top with a swirl of cream and fresh basil.

recipe.title: Herb-Crusted Beef Tenderloin for Two
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Let the tenderloin sit at room temperature for 20 minutes while the oven heats and you make the herb crust. Use a small roasting pan or oven-safe skillet and an instant-read thermometer.
recipe.finish: The roast is done when the center reads 130°F (54°C) for medium-rare; the temperature will rise about 5°F while resting. Rest 10 minutes before slicing into 1-inch medallions. If you prefer medium, cook to 140°F (60°C). Serve sliced with the pan juices spooned over.

ingredients.name: center-cut beef tenderloin roast
ingredients.prep: pat dry, tie with twine if uneven

steps.title: Heat oven and temper beef
steps.details: Set oven to 425°F (220°C). Pat the tenderloin dry and let it sit on the counter for 20 minutes while you prep the herb mixture.

steps.title: Make herb paste
steps.details: Stir together the garlic, rosemary, thyme, 1 tablespoon olive oil, salt and pepper into a rough paste.

steps.title: Season and coat beef
steps.details: Rub the tenderloin all over with the remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil, then press on the herb paste in an even layer. If using, brush the top with Dijon first so the herbs stick.

steps.title: Sear all sides
steps.details: Heat an oven-safe skillet over medium-high until shimmering. Sear the beef on all sides, about 2 minutes per side, until browned.

steps.title: Roast to temperature
steps.details: Transfer the skillet to the oven and roast until the center reads 130°F (54°C) on an instant-read thermometer, 18–22 minutes. Start checking at 15 minutes.

steps.title: Rest before slicing
steps.details: Set the beef on a cutting board, tent loosely with foil and rest 10 minutes so juices redistribute.

steps.title: Slice and serve
steps.details: Slice against the grain into 1-inch medallions, spoon over any pan juices and season lightly with salt.

generatedRecipes.title: Pan-Seared Sea Bass with Lemon Butter

recipe.title: Pan-Seared Sea Bass with Lemon Butter
recipe.intro: Pat the fish very dry and score the skin so it crisps. Use a heavy skillet (cast iron or stainless) large enough to hold both fillets without crowding, and have everything chopped before you turn on the heat, since searing is fast.
recipe.finish: The fish is done when the flesh is opaque and flakes easily at the thickest point (about 145°F). Serve skin-side up on warm plates and spoon the lemon-caper butter over the top so the skin stays crisp.

ingredients.name: sea bass fillets, skin on
ingredients.prep: pat very dry, score skin 3 times with a knife, season both sides with salt and pepper

steps.title: Season and rest the fish
steps.details: Season the fillets on both sides with the salt and pepper and let them sit at room temperature for 10 minutes while you prep the sauce ingredients.

steps.title: Prep the lemon butter
steps.details: Zest the lemon, juice it, slice the garlic, chop the capers and parsley, and cut the butter into pieces so everything is ready before searing.

steps.title: Heat the skillet
steps.details: Heat the olive oil in a heavy skillet over medium-high heat until it shimmers and a drop of water sizzles instantly, about 3 minutes.

steps.title: Sear skin-side down
steps.details: Lay the fillets in the skillet skin-side down, pressing gently with a spatula for 10 seconds so the skin stays flat. Cook undisturbed until the skin is deep golden and crisp, 4 to 5 minutes.

steps.title: Flip and finish fish
steps.details: Flip the fillets and cook until the flesh is opaque and flakes at the thickest point, about 145°F, 2 to 3 minutes more. Transfer to warm plates skin-side up.

steps.title: Build the lemon butter
steps.details: Lower the heat to medium, add the butter and garlic to the same skillet, and cook until the garlic is fragrant and the butter foams, about 1 minute; do not brown the garlic.

steps.title: Add lemon and capers
steps.details: Stir in the lemon juice, zest and capers and simmer 30 to 60 seconds until the sauce thickens slightly. Taste and add a pinch of salt if needed.

steps.title: Sauce and serve
steps.details: Stir in the parsley, spoon the lemon-caper butter over the fish and serve immediately.

recipe.title: Roasted Garlic Mashed Potatoes
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). You will need a large pot, a sheet of foil, a potato masher or ricer, and a small saucepan. Peel potatoes while the garlic roasts.
recipe.finish: Mash until fluffy but stop before potatoes turn gummy. Taste and adjust salt and pepper. Serve hot with a pat of butter on top; hold covered over low heat for up to 20 minutes if needed, stirring in a splash of warm cream before serving.

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.prep: slice off top quarter to expose cloves

steps.title: Roast the garlic
steps.details: Set garlic cut-side up on foil, drizzle with olive oil, wrap loosely, and roast at 400°F until cloves are soft and golden, 35–40 minutes.

steps.title: Boil the potatoes
steps.details: While garlic roasts, put potatoes in a large pot, cover with cold water by 1 inch, and add 1 tbsp salt. Bring to a boil, then simmer until a fork slides in easily, 15–18 minutes.

steps.title: Warm the cream
steps.details: Gently heat cream and butter in a small saucepan over low heat until butter melts; keep warm without simmering.

steps.title: Drain the potatoes
steps.details: Drain potatoes well in a colander and return them to the dry pot. Let steam 2 minutes to release excess moisture.

steps.title: Squeeze the garlic
steps.details: Unwrap roasted garlic and squeeze the soft cloves into a small bowl; mash them with a fork.

steps.title: Mash potatoes with butter
steps.details: Mash hot potatoes with the warm butter-cream mixture and mashed garlic until smooth and fluffy.

steps.title: Season and serve
steps.details: Stir in black pepper and extra salt to taste. Serve hot.

recipe.title: Roasted Asparagus with Parmesan
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C) with a rack in the upper-middle position. Have a rimmed sheet pan and a vegetable peeler or sharp knife ready. Shave the Parmesan into thin curls with a peeler just before serving if you like; a block and peeler give the nicest shavings.
recipe.finish: Asparagus is done when the spears are tender when pierced with a knife at the thickest point and lightly browned at the tips. Transfer to a warm platter, shower with the Parmesan curls while hot so they soften slightly, add a final pinch of pepper, and serve right away.

ingredients.name: fresh asparagus
ingredients.prep: rinse, snap off woody ends, pat dry

ingredients.name: Parmesan cheese block
ingredients.prep: shave into thin curls with a peeler

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.details: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C), rack in the upper-middle position. Let it heat fully, about 12 minutes, while you trim the asparagus.

steps.title: Trim and dry asparagus
steps.details: Rinse the asparagus, bend each spear near the base until it snaps to remove the woody end, and pat completely dry with a towel so the oil clings and the spears brown.

steps.title: Toss with oil and season
steps.details: Pile the spears on a rimmed sheet pan, drizzle with the olive oil, sprinkle with the salt and pepper, and toss with your hands until evenly coated; spread in a single layer with a little space between spears.

steps.title: Roast until tender
steps.details: Roast on the upper-middle rack until tender when pierced at the thickest point and tips are lightly browned, 10 to 14 minutes depending on spear thickness; shake the pan once halfway through.

steps.title: Shave the Parmesan
steps.details: While the asparagus roasts, shave the Parmesan block into thin curls with a vegetable peeler and set aside; keep the block cold for easier shaving if time allows.

steps.title: Shower with Parmesan and serve
steps.details: Slide the hot asparagus onto a warm platter, scatter the Parmesan curls over the top so they soften slightly, add a final pinch of pepper, and serve immediately.

generatedRecipes.title: Crusty French Baguette with Herb Butter

recipe.title: Crusty French Baguette with Herb Butter
recipe.intro: Use a fresh store-bought baguette and softened butter. You'll need a small bowl, fork or whisk, and a baking sheet. Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C) while you whip the herb butter.
recipe.finish: The baguette is ready when the crust is crisp and warm and the cut sides are lightly golden. Serve immediately with the bowl of whipped herb butter for spreading.

ingredients.name: fresh French baguette
ingredients.prep: left whole, split lengthwise or sliced 1 inch thick

steps.title: Preheat the oven
steps.details: Set the oven to 400°F (200°C) with a rack in the middle. Let it preheat while you make the herb butter.

steps.title: Whip the herb butter
steps.details: In a small bowl, mash and whisk the softened butter with the parsley, chives, garlic, salt, and pepper until fluffy and evenly green-flecked. Taste and add a pinch more salt if needed.

steps.title: Warm the baguette
steps.details: Place the baguette on a baking sheet. If split, lay the halves cut-side up. Bake 6–8 minutes, until the crust is crisp and the cut sides are lightly golden.

steps.title: Slice and serve
steps.details: Transfer the warm baguette to a board and slice into 1-inch pieces or serve as split halves. Serve right away with the whipped herb butter.

generatedRecipes.title: Molten Chocolate Lava Cakes for Two

recipe.title: Molten Chocolate Lava Cakes for Two
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Use two 6-ounce (175 ml) ramekins or oven-safe custard cups. Butter and lightly flour the ramekins, tapping out excess. Have a small baking sheet ready. Let eggs and butter come to room temperature if possible; this helps the batter emulsify smoothly.
recipe.finish: Cakes are done when the edges are set and puffed but the centers still jiggle slightly, 11–13 minutes. Do not overbake or the centers will set solid. Let rest 1 minute, then run a thin knife around each edge and invert onto small plates. Serve immediately with vanilla ice cream or whipped cream and berries.

ingredients.name: unsalted butter
ingredients.prep: plus extra softened butter for greasing ramekins

ingredients.name: vanilla ice cream or whipped cream

steps.title: Preheat and prepare ramekins
steps.details: Set oven rack in the middle and preheat to 425°F (220°C). Generously butter two 6-ounce ramekins, dust with flour, and tap out excess. Place them on a small baking sheet.

steps.title: Melt butter and chocolate
steps.details: Combine chopped chocolate and butter in a heatproof bowl set over a saucepan of barely simmering water, or microwave in 20-second bursts. Stir until smooth and fully melted; do not let it get hot or the chocolate may seize. Let cool 2 minutes.

steps.title: Separate and whisk eggs
steps.details: While the chocolate cools, separate the eggs: whites into a clean medium bowl, yolks into a small bowl. Add the salt to the whites and whisk to soft, slightly foamy peaks. Add 1 tablespoon of the sugar to the yolks and whisk until pale and slightly thickened; stir in vanilla.

steps.title: Fold in chocolate
steps.details: Stir the warm melted chocolate mixture into the yolk mixture until smooth. Add the flour and stir just until no dry streaks remain.

steps.title: Fold in egg whites
steps.details: Add about one-third of the whisked egg whites to the chocolate batter and stir gently to loosen. Fold in the remaining whites in two additions with a spatula, stopping as soon as no large white streaks remain. Keep the batter airy.

steps.title: Fill ramekins
steps.details: Divide the batter evenly between the prepared ramekins. Smooth the tops lightly. If not baking immediately, refrigerate up to 1 hour; add about 2 minutes to the bake time if cold.

steps.title: Bake until just set
steps.details: Bake at 425°F (220°C) for 11–13 minutes, until the edges are puffed and set and the centers still jiggle when the pan is nudged. Begin checking at 11 minutes.

steps.title: Rest and unmold
steps.details: Let the cakes rest in the ramekins for 1 minute. Run a thin knife around each edge, invert onto serving plates, and lift off the ramekins.

steps.title: Serve immediately
steps.details: Add a scoop of vanilla ice cream or whipped cream and a few berries, if using. Serve right away so the centers stay molten.

recipe.title: Raspberry Chocolate Mousse Cups
recipe.intro: No special equipment needed beyond a saucepan, a mixing bowl and a whisk. Have 6 small glasses (about 4 oz each) ready. Chill the bowl and beaters for the cream if you have time. Chop 4 oz of the chocolate now so it melts evenly.
recipe.finish: Cups are set when the mousse holds a soft peak and a spoon leaves a clean line. Serve chilled within 24 hours; top with the reserved berries and a little grated chocolate just before serving.

ingredients.name: bittersweet or semisweet chocolate
ingredients.prep: chopped fine, divided (reserve 1/2 oz for garnish)

ingredients.name: heavy cream
ingredients.prep: divided: 1/2 cup for melting, 1 cup cold for whipping

ingredients.name: fresh raspberries
ingredients.prep: picked over, 12 berries reserved for topping, rest left whole

steps.title: Melt chocolate with cream
steps.details: In a small saucepan over low heat, stir 5 1/2 oz of the chopped chocolate with 1/2 cup of the cream, the salt and the sugar until fully melted and smooth, about 4 minutes. Do not let it bubble. Remove from heat and stir in the vanilla.

steps.title: Cool chocolate base
steps.details: Scrape the chocolate mixture into a large bowl and let it cool at room temperature until just barely warm to the touch, about 15 minutes, stirring once or twice so it does not set firm.

steps.title: Whip the cold cream
steps.details: While the chocolate cools, pour the remaining 1 cup cold cream into a chilled bowl and whip with a whisk or hand mixer to soft-medium peaks, about 3 minutes. Stop when the whisk leaves a trail that slowly settles.

steps.title: Fold cream into chocolate
steps.details: Add about one-third of the whipped cream to the cooled chocolate and whisk gently to lighten it, then fold in the rest with a spatula in three additions until no white streaks remain. Keep it airy; do not overmix.

steps.title: Layer berries and mousse
steps.details: Spoon a little mousse into each of 6 small glasses, add a few whole raspberries, then repeat until the glasses are nearly full, using most of the berries. Tap glasses gently to settle.

steps.title: Chill until set
steps.details: Cover each glass loosely with plastic wrap and refrigerate until the mousse is set and cold, at least 2 hours.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.details: Just before serving, warm the jam briefly if thick and dot a little over each cup, then top with the reserved raspberries and a pinch of the reserved grated chocolate. Serve cold.

recipe.title: Sparkling Raspberry Rose Spritzers
recipe.intro: No special equipment needed: a blender (or a fork and fine sieve), a fine-mesh sieve, and 4 tall glasses. Chill the sparkling water and glasses beforehand. Make the raspberry puree up to a day ahead and keep it covered in the fridge.
recipe.finish: Stir gently just before serving, taste, and add a little more syrup if the raspberries were tart. Serve immediately over the chilled ice with raspberries and a lemon twist; the spritzers are at their fizziest right after mixing.

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen raspberries, plus extra for garnish
rose water
ingredients.prep: measure carefully; add drop by drop

steps.title: Puree the raspberries
steps.details: Blend the raspberries, sugar, and lemon juice for about 1 minute until completely smooth, scraping down the blender once.

steps.title: Strain the puree
steps.details: Pour through a fine-mesh sieve into a bowl, pressing the solids with a spoon; discard the seeds. You should have about 3/4 cup puree.

steps.title: Add rose water
steps.details: Stir 1/8 teaspoon rose water into the puree, taste, and add 1 more drop only if you want a stronger floral note; rose water is potent.

steps.title: Chill the puree
steps.details: Refrigerate the rose-raspberry puree for at least 10 minutes so it does not melt the ice; cover if holding longer.

steps.title: Fill glasses with ice
steps.details: Divide the ice among 4 tall glasses and add a few extra raspberries to each if you like.

steps.title: Add puree to glasses
steps.details: Spoon about 3 tablespoons of the chilled puree into each glass over the ice.

steps.title: Top with sparkling water
steps.details: Pour about 3/4 cup cold sparkling water slowly down the side of each glass to preserve bubbles; it will fizz up, so leave a little headroom.

steps.title: Stir and garnish
steps.details: Stir each glass gently once or twice to swirl the puree through the water, then twist a lemon zest strip over the rim and drop it in. Serve at once.

recipe.title: Honey-Mustard Glazed Spiral Ham
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 325°F. Use a roasting pan with a rack and a baking brush. Let a fully cooked spiral-cut ham sit at room temperature 30 minutes while the oven heats and you mix the glaze.
recipe.finish: Ham is done when an instant-read thermometer in the thickest part reads 140°F. Rest 10 minutes, brush with pan juices, then carve along the spiral cuts. Serve warm.

ingredients.name: fully cooked spiral-cut ham
ingredients.prep: remove packaging and netting, rest 30 minutes

steps.title: Heat oven and rest ham
steps.details: Heat oven to 325°F. Place the ham cut-side down in a rack-lined roasting pan and let it stand at room temperature while the oven heats, about 30 minutes.

steps.title: Mix the glaze
steps.details: Stir honey, Dijon, melted butter, brown sugar and pepper in a small bowl until smooth.

steps.title: Add water and cover
steps.details: Pour water into the bottom of the pan and tent the ham loosely with foil, sealing around the pan edges.

steps.title: Bake covered
steps.details: Bake 10 minutes per pound until the ham is heated through, about 1 hour 20 minutes for an 8-pound ham or 1 hour 40 minutes for a 10-pound ham.

steps.title: Glaze first half
steps.details: Remove foil, brush half the glaze over the ham, and bake uncovered 10 minutes.

steps.title: Check temperature
steps.details: Insert an instant-read thermometer into the thickest part away from bone; it should read 140°F. Continue baking in 10-minute increments if needed.

steps.title: Glaze and brown
steps.details: Brush on remaining glaze and bake until glossy and lightly browned, 8 to 10 minutes more.

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.details: Transfer ham to a cutting board, tent with foil and rest 10 minutes. Spoon pan juices over the top and carve along the spiral cuts.

recipe.title: Spinach and Mushroom Quiche
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 375°F with a rack in the lower third. Use a 9-inch deep-dish pie plate or tart pan; have a rimmed baking sheet ready for the quiche. Let refrigerated pie crust sit at room temperature while you prep. A standard quiche works best with a deep-dish crust because the filling is generous.
recipe.finish: The quiche is done when the center barely jiggles when nudged and a knife inserted 1 inch from the edge comes out clean, about 40–45 minutes. If the crust browns too fast, tent the edges with foil. Cool on a rack at least 20 minutes before slicing so the custard sets. Serve warm or at room temperature; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and reheat to 165°F.

ingredients.name: cremini mushrooms
ingredients.prep: wipe clean and slice 1/4 inch thick

steps.title: Preheat and fit crust
steps.details: Preheat oven to 375°F. Press the pie crust into a 9-inch deep-dish pie plate, crimp the edge, and prick the bottom all over with a fork. Keep it chilled in the refrigerator until filling is ready.

steps.title: Sauté mushrooms
steps.details: Melt 1 tablespoon butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the sliced mushrooms in a single layer and cook undisturbed 3 minutes, then stir and cook until browned and their liquid has evaporated, about 5 more minutes. Season with a pinch of the salt.

steps.title: Soften onion
steps.details: Add the diced onion to the mushrooms and cook, stirring, until translucent and tender, about 4 minutes. If the pan looks dry, add the extra 1 teaspoon butter.

steps.title: Wilt spinach
steps.details: Add the spinach in handfuls and stir until just wilted, 2–3 minutes. Remove the skillet from the heat and spread the vegetables on a plate to cool slightly; blot excess moisture with a paper towel if needed.

steps.title: Whisk custard
steps.details: In a large bowl, whisk the eggs, milk, cream, remaining salt, pepper, and nutmeg until smooth and fully blended. Do not whip in too much air.

steps.title: Layer filling
steps.details: Remove the chilled crust from the refrigerator. Scatter half the Gruyère over the bottom, then spread the cooled mushroom-spinach mixture evenly over the cheese. Top with the remaining Gruyère.

steps.title: Add custard and bake
steps.details: Pour the custard over the filling, filling to just below the crimped rim; do not overfill. Set the quiche on a rimmed baking sheet and bake until the center barely jiggles and a knife inserted 1 inch from the edge comes out clean, 40–45 minutes. Tent crust edges with foil if they darken too much.

steps.title: Cool and serve
steps.details: Transfer the quiche to a wire rack and cool at least 20 minutes before slicing. Serve warm or at room temperature.

recipe.title: Classic Deviled Eggs
recipe.intro: Hard-cook the eggs and cool them while you set out the other ingredients. You'll need a pot with a lid, a bowl of ice water, a small skillet, and a fork or potato masher. No special equipment required.
recipe.finish: Eggs are safe when the yolks are fully set and firm, with no runny center. Serve chilled or cool, not warm, and refrigerate any leftovers within 2 hours; eat within 2 days.

steps.title: Boil the eggs
steps.details: Place eggs in a single layer in a pot and cover with 1 inch cold water. Bring to a full rolling boil over high heat, then cover, remove from heat, and let stand 11 minutes for firm set yolks.

steps.title: Ice-bath the eggs
steps.details: While eggs stand, fill a bowl with ice and cold water. Transfer eggs with a slotted spoon into the ice bath and chill at least 10 minutes to stop cooking and make peeling easy.

steps.title: Mix the filling base
steps.details: In a small bowl, stir together mayonnaise, mustard, relish, salt, and pepper until smooth; set aside.

steps.title: Peel and halve eggs
steps.details: Crack each chilled egg all over on the counter, peel under cool running water, then cut in half lengthwise. Arrange whites cut-side up on a plate.

steps.title: Mash yolks into filling
steps.details: Pop yolks into the bowl with the mayonnaise mixture and mash with a fork until completely smooth and creamy, with no lumps.

steps.title: Fill the egg whites
steps.details: Spoon or pipe about 1 heaping teaspoon filling into each white, mounding slightly. If filling looks stiff, stir in a few drops of water.

steps.title: Garnish and chill
steps.details: Dust tops lightly with paprika and scatter chives if using. Chill 15 minutes before serving so the filling sets.

generatedRecipes.title: Spring Pea Salad with Radishes and Mint

recipe.title: Spring Pea Salad with Radishes and Mint
recipe.intro: Bright Easter brunch side. Use a 3-quart saucepan and a small jar for the vinaigrette. If using fresh shelling peas, shell about 2 pounds in pods to get 2 cups.

ingredients.name: fresh or frozen peas

steps.title: Boil water for peas

steps.title: Make lemon vinaigrette

steps.title: Slice radishes and chop mint

steps.title: Blanch peas

steps.title: Shock peas in ice water

steps.title: Toss salad with vinaigrette

steps.title: Chill and finish with feta

generatedRecipes.title: Roasted Asparagus with Lemon and Parmesan

recipe.title: Roasted Asparagus with Lemon and Parmesan
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C) with a rack in the upper-middle position. Have a rimmed baking sheet ready. Rinse and dry the asparagus well so it roasts instead of steams. Zest the lemon and grate the Parmesan while the oven heats.
recipe.finish: Asparagus is done when the spears are tender and the tips are lightly browned, 10–12 minutes. Transfer to a serving platter, scatter with lemon zest and Parmesan, and finish with a squeeze of lemon juice. Serve warm.

ingredients.name: asparagus

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.details: Set oven to 425°F (220°C) with a rack in the upper-middle position. Let it preheat fully, about 15 minutes, while you trim and dry the asparagus.

steps.title: Trim and dry asparagus
steps.details: Snap or cut off the woody bottom ends of the asparagus. Rinse and pat completely dry with a clean towel; wet spears will steam rather than brown.

steps.title: Zest lemon and grate cheese
steps.details: Zest the lemon into a small bowl and grate the Parmesan. Juice half the lemon and set the juice aside separately.

steps.title: Toss asparagus with oil
steps.details: Pile the dry asparagus on a rimmed baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil, sprinkle with salt and pepper, and toss with your hands until evenly coated. Spread in a single layer without crowding.

steps.title: Roast asparagus
steps.details: Roast on the upper-middle rack for 10–12 minutes, until the spears are tender when pierced with a knife and the tips are lightly browned. Shake the pan once halfway through.

steps.title: Finish with lemon and Parmesan
steps.details: Transfer the hot asparagus to a platter. Scatter with lemon zest and grated Parmesan, then squeeze over a little reserved lemon juice to taste. Serve immediately.

recipe.title: Herbed Potato Salad
recipe.intro: Boil the potatoes in salted water until just tender, and stir the dressing together while they cook. A 5-quart pot and a large bowl are all you need; no preheat.
recipe.finish: Serve at room temperature or chilled. Taste and add salt or a splash of vinegar before serving. Keeps covered in the fridge up to 2 days; stir in a spoonful of mayonnaise if it dries out.

ingredients.name: Yukon Gold or red potatoes
ingredients.prep: scrub, cut into 1-inch chunks, leave skins on

steps.title: Boil the potatoes
steps.details: Put the potatoes in a large pot, add cool water to cover by 1 inch and the 1 tbsp salt. Bring to a boil over high heat, then lower to a gentle simmer. Cook 12–15 minutes, until a knife slides into the largest chunk with no resistance but the potato still holds its shape. Do not overcook.

steps.title: Mix the dressing
steps.details: While the potatoes boil, whisk the mayonnaise, sour cream, Dijon and vinegar in a large bowl until smooth. Stir in the dill, parsley, scallions and pepper.

steps.title: Drain and steam-dry
steps.details: Drain the potatoes in a colander and let them sit 3 minutes so excess steam escapes; this helps the dressing cling instead of turning watery.

steps.title: Toss warm potatoes
steps.details: Add the warm potatoes to the dressing bowl and fold gently with a rubber spatula until every chunk is coated. Warm potatoes absorb the dressing best.

steps.title: Fold in eggs and chill
steps.details: Gently fold in the chopped hard-boiled eggs, if using. Cover and refrigerate at least 20 minutes to let the flavors meld; stir once before serving.

recipe.title: Hot Cross Buns
recipe.intro: Warm the milk to lukewarm (about 110°F). Have a large bowl, a small saucepan, and a baking sheet lined with parchment ready. No stand mixer needed — the dough can be kneaded by hand.
recipe.finish: Buns are done when deep golden and the center reads 190°F; the cross should be set and pale. Cool in the pan 10 minutes, then pull apart and serve warm with butter. Best the day they are made.

steps.title: Proof the yeast
steps.details: Stir the yeast and 1 tbsp of the sugar into the lukewarm milk. Let stand 8 minutes until foamy; if it does not foam, the milk was too hot or the yeast is dead.

steps.title: Mix the dry ingredients
steps.details: In a large bowl whisk the 4 cups flour, cinnamon, nutmeg, salt, and remaining sugar. Stir in the currants.

steps.title: Make the dough
steps.details: Pour the foamy yeast mixture into the dry ingredients with the egg and melted butter. Stir with a wooden spoon until a shaggy dough forms.

steps.title: Knead the dough
steps.details: Turn out onto a floured counter and knead 8 minutes until smooth, elastic, and only slightly tacky, adding flour a spoonful at a time if needed.

steps.title: First rise
steps.details: Shape into a ball, place in a lightly oiled bowl, cover, and let rise in a warm spot about 60 minutes until doubled.

steps.title: Shape the buns
steps.details: Punch down the dough and divide into 12 pieces. Roll each into a tight ball and set 2 inches apart on the lined baking sheet.

steps.title: Second rise
steps.details: Cover loosely and let rise 35 minutes until puffy and nearly touching.

steps.title: Heat oven and make cross paste
steps.details: Heat oven to 375°F. Mix the 1/2 cup flour with the water to a thick, pipeable paste; add water a teaspoon at a time if too stiff.

steps.title: Pipe crosses and bake
steps.details: Pipe a cross over each bun, then bake 22–25 minutes until deep golden and the center reads 190°F.

steps.title: Glaze and cool
steps.details: Warm the jam and brush over the hot buns. Cool in the pan 10 minutes before serving.

recipe.title: Lemon Poppy Seed Cake
recipe.intro: Moist lemon-poppy seed loaf with a simple lemon glaze. Use a 9x5-inch loaf pan, a whisk, and two bowls. Heat oven to 350°F (175°C) with a rack in the middle and grease and flour the pan. Bring the butter, eggs, and milk to room temperature.
recipe.finish: The cake is done when a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean or with only a few moist crumbs, about 50–55 minutes. Cool in the pan 10 minutes, then turn out onto a rack and cool completely before glazing. Whisk the glaze until smooth, pour over the cooled cake, and let it set for about 15 minutes before slicing.

steps.title: Heat oven and prep pan
steps.details: Heat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and flour a 9x5-inch loaf pan, tapping out excess flour.

steps.title: Whisk dry ingredients
steps.details: In a medium bowl, whisk the flour, poppy seeds, baking powder, baking soda, and salt until evenly combined.

steps.title: Rub zest into sugar
steps.details: In a large bowl, rub the lemon zest into the granulated sugar with your fingers until fragrant and damp-looking.

steps.title: Cream butter and sugar
steps.details: Add the softened butter to the lemon sugar and beat with a hand mixer or sturdy whisk until pale and fluffy, 2–3 minutes. Scrape the bowl.

steps.title: Beat in eggs and flavorings
steps.details: Beat in the eggs one at a time until fully incorporated, then mix in the milk, lemon juice, and vanilla; the mixture may look slightly curdled, which is fine.

steps.title: Fold in dry ingredients
steps.details: Add the flour mixture to the wet ingredients and fold gently with a spatula just until no dry streaks remain; do not overmix.

steps.title: Bake the loaf
steps.details: Scrape the batter into the prepared pan and smooth the top. Bake until golden and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean or with a few moist crumbs, 50–55 minutes. If the top browns early, tent loosely with foil.

steps.title: Cool the cake
steps.details: Let the cake cool in the pan 10 minutes, then turn it out onto a wire rack and cool completely, about 1 hour, so the glaze sets without melting through.

steps.title: Make lemon glaze
steps.details: While the cake cools, whisk the powdered sugar and lemon juice until smooth and pourable, adding a few drops more juice or sugar if needed.

steps.title: Glaze and set
steps.details: Pour the glaze over the completely cooled cake, spread to the edges letting it drip down the sides, and let it set about 15 minutes before slicing.

recipe.title: Fresh Berry Salad with Mint
recipe.intro: Rinse and dry all berries gently; wet berries dilute the salad. Have a large serving bowl and a small whisk ready. No oven needed. A light honey-lime syrup with fresh mint ties the berries together; assemble within an hour of serving for best texture.
recipe.finish: Taste and add a splash more lime or drizzle of honey if needed. Serve chilled or cool, within 1 hour for firmest berries. Leftovers keep covered in the fridge up to 1 day; stir before serving.

ingredients.name: fresh strawberries
ingredients.prep: hulled and halved or quartered if large

ingredients.name: fresh mint leaves
ingredients.prep: thinly sliced, plus extra leaves to garnish

steps.title: Prep the berries
steps.details: Gently rinse and thoroughly dry the strawberries, blueberries, and raspberries. Hull and halve or quarter the strawberries; remove any bruised berries.

steps.title: Make the honey-lime dressing
steps.details: In a small bowl, whisk the honey, lime juice, and optional pinch of salt until smooth and pourable. Warm honey briefly if it is too thick to whisk.

steps.title: Slice the mint
steps.details: Stack the mint leaves and slice thinly into fine ribbons. Keep a few small leaves aside for garnish.

steps.title: Combine berries and mint
steps.details: Put the strawberries, blueberries, raspberries, and sliced mint into a large serving bowl.

steps.title: Dress the salad
steps.details: Drizzle the honey-lime dressing over the berries and fold very gently with a rubber spatula, just until coated. Do not overmix or the raspberries will break apart.

steps.title: Chill briefly and serve
steps.details: Refrigerate 10 minutes to let the flavors meld; berries should look glossy but still hold their shape. Garnish with reserved mint leaves and serve.

recipe.title: Sparkling Raspberry Lemonade
recipe.intro: No cooking—just muddling, mixing, and chilling. You need a pitcher, a muddler or wooden spoon, a fine-mesh strainer, and a small saucepan for the syrup. Make the raspberry syrup up to 3 days ahead and refrigerate. Chill the sparkling water and lemon juice until cold.
recipe.finish: Stir gently just before serving so the fizz stays lively. Serve over ice with lemon slices and a few whole raspberries. If it sits out, taste again—diluted ice may need a squeeze of lemon.

ingredients.name: fresh raspberries
ingredients.prep: rinsed; reserve a handful for garnish

ingredients.name: cold sparkling water or club soda

steps.title: Simmer sugar and water
steps.details: Combine sugar and water in a small saucepan over medium heat. Stir until sugar dissolves, about 3 minutes; do not boil hard. Remove from heat.

steps.title: Muddle raspberries
steps.details: While syrup heats, put 10 oz raspberries in a medium bowl and crush with a muddler or wooden spoon until broken down and juicy.

steps.title: Combine syrup and raspberries
steps.details: Pour the warm syrup over the crushed raspberries. Stir, then let steep 10 minutes to draw out color and flavor.

steps.title: Strain raspberry mixture
steps.details: Pour through a fine-mesh strainer into a pitcher, pressing solids with a spoon. Discard seeds and pulp.

steps.title: Add lemon juice and chill
steps.details: Stir lemon juice into the raspberry syrup. Refrigerate until cold, at least 30 minutes.

steps.title: Add sparkling water and ice
steps.details: Pour cold sparkling water into the chilled pitcher and add ice. Stir gently once—over-stirring knocks out carbonation.

steps.title: Garnish and serve
steps.details: Float lemon slices and reserved raspberries in the pitcher or in glasses. Taste and add a splash more lemon juice if too sweet. Serve immediately.

generatedRecipes.title: Smoked Salmon and Cream Cheese Toasts with Dill

recipe.title: Smoked Salmon and Cream Cheese Toasts with Dill
recipe.intro: A quick, elegant starter. Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and set out a baking sheet. Use a serrated knife for the baguette and let the cream cheese soften at room temperature for about 10 minutes while the oven heats.
recipe.finish: Serve within 20 minutes so the toasts stay crisp. Look for toasted edges and a warm, dry surface on the bread; the salmon is served cold and cured, so no further cooking is needed. Garnish with dill just before serving.

ingredients.name: fresh dill
ingredients.prep: chopped, plus small sprigs for garnish

ingredients.name: lemon
ingredients.prep: cut into thin wedges for serving

steps.title: Preheat oven and slice baguette
steps.details: Heat oven to 400°F (200°C). Slice the baguette diagonally into 16 pieces about 1/2 inch thick and arrange on a baking sheet.

steps.title: Whip cream cheese spread
steps.details: While the oven heats, beat the softened cream cheese, heavy cream, lemon juice, and salt with a fork or hand mixer until smooth and spreadable, about 1 minute.

steps.title: Toast baguette slices
steps.details: Bake the slices on the middle rack until lightly golden and crisp at the edges, 8 to 10 minutes. Check at 8 minutes; they should feel dry and firm when tapped.

steps.title: Cool toasts briefly
steps.details: Remove the baking sheet from the oven and let the toasts cool for 3 minutes so the cream cheese won't melt and slide off.

steps.title: Spread cream cheese on toasts
steps.details: Spread about 1 generous tablespoon of the whipped cream cheese on each warm toast, covering most of the surface.

steps.title: Top with salmon and dill
steps.details: Drape one piece of smoked salmon on each toast, folding it loosely. Scatter the chopped dill over the salmon.

steps.title: Garnish and serve
steps.details: Add a small dill sprig to each toast and arrange on a platter with lemon wedges. Serve right away.

generatedRecipes.title: Mixed Berry Fruit Salad with Honey-Lime Dressing

recipe.title: Mixed Berry Fruit Salad with Honey-Lime Dressing
recipe.intro: A bright Mother's Day starter. You need a colander, a small bowl, a whisk or fork, and a large serving bowl. No oven needed; chill the bowl if you like. Start by rinsing and drying the berries, then make the dressing while they drain.
recipe.finish: Toss gently right before serving so the berries stay whole and glossy. The salad is best the day it's made; if held longer than 2 hours, stir gently and add a few fresh raspberries on top. Serve chilled in small bowls or alongside the brunch spread.

steps.title: Rinse and dry berries
steps.details: Put the strawberries, blueberries, and raspberries in a colander and rinse gently under cool water. Spread on a clean towel and pat dry, especially the raspberries, so the dressing clings instead of pooling.

steps.title: Make honey-lime dressing
steps.details: In a small bowl, whisk the honey, lime juice, lime zest, and optional pinch of salt until smooth. If the honey is thick, microwave it 10–15 seconds first. Taste and add a little more lime juice if you want it brighter.

steps.title: Chill berries and dressing
steps.details: Refrigerate the dried berries and the dressing separately while you finish other brunch prep, at least 10 minutes and up to 2 hours. Keep the raspberries on top so they don't get crushed.

steps.title: Toss salad gently
steps.details: Put the strawberries and blueberries in a large serving bowl. Pour over the dressing and fold gently with a rubber spatula. Add the raspberries last and fold once or twice, just until coated.

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.details: Let the salad sit 5 minutes so the juices and dressing mingle, then scatter with mint if using. Serve chilled. The berries should look glossy and hold their shape; if it sits longer than 2 hours, stir gently before serving.

recipe.title: Spinach and Gruyère Quiche
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 375°F. You will need a 9-inch pie dish, a skillet, a mixing bowl, a whisk, and a baking sheet. Let refrigerated pie crust come to room temperature for easier handling.
recipe.finish: Let quiche cool for at least 10 minutes before slicing. The center should be set and a knife inserted near the center should come out clean. Serve warm or at room temperature.

steps.title: Preheat oven
steps.details: Preheat oven to 375°F.

steps.title: Fit pie crust
steps.details: Press pie crust into a 9-inch pie dish and crimp edges. Set aside.

steps.title: Wilt spinach
steps.details: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add spinach and cook, stirring, until wilted, about 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool slightly.

steps.title: Whisk custard
steps.details: In a large bowl, whisk together eggs, milk, cream, salt, pepper, and nutmeg until well blended.

steps.title: Combine spinach and cheese
steps.details: Squeeze excess moisture from wilted spinach, then chop roughly. Stir spinach and 1 cup of the Gruyère into the custard mixture.

steps.title: Assemble quiche
steps.details: Sprinkle remaining 1/2 cup Gruyère over bottom of pie crust. Pour spinach-custard mixture over cheese. Carefully transfer to oven.

steps.title: Bake quiche
steps.details: Bake at 375°F for 35-40 minutes, until center is set and a knife inserted near center comes out clean. If crust browns too quickly, cover edges with foil.

steps.title: Cool and serve
steps.details: Remove from oven and let cool for at least 10 minutes before slicing. Serve warm or at room temperature.

recipe.title: Lemon Ricotta Pancakes
recipe.intro: Get ready: whisk together dry ingredients, separate the eggs, zest the lemon, and warm the maple syrup in a small saucepan over low heat. Have a large nonstick skillet or griddle and a spatula ready. Set the oven to 200°F to keep finished pancakes warm.
recipe.finish: Pancakes are done when the edges look set and bubbly and the underside is golden brown; the center should spring back when lightly pressed. Serve hot in stacks with warm maple syrup and extra lemon zest or fresh berries if you like.

ingredients.name: unsalted butter
ingredients.prep: melted, plus more for the pan

steps.title: Whisk dry ingredients
steps.details: In a large bowl, whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt until evenly combined.

steps.title: Warm the maple syrup
steps.details: Put the maple syrup in a small saucepan over low heat to warm gently while you make the batter; keep it on low and stir occasionally.

steps.title: Mix ricotta and yolks
steps.details: In a second bowl, whisk the ricotta, milk, egg yolks, lemon juice, lemon zest, and vanilla until smooth. Whisk in the melted butter.

steps.title: Combine wet and dry
steps.details: Pour the ricotta mixture into the dry ingredients and stir gently with a spatula just until no dry flour remains; a few small lumps are fine. Do not overmix.

steps.title: Whip the egg whites
steps.details: In a clean bowl with clean beaters, beat the egg whites to soft peaks, about 2 minutes with a hand mixer or 4 minutes by hand. They should hold a soft curl, not be stiff and dry.

steps.title: Fold in egg whites
steps.details: Gently fold the whipped whites into the batter in three additions with a spatula, lifting from the bottom until just a few white streaks remain.

steps.title: Heat the skillet
steps.details: Set a large nonstick skillet or griddle over medium heat and brush lightly with butter. Test with a drop of water: it should sizzle and evaporate within a second or two.

steps.title: Cook the pancakes
steps.details: Scoop about 1/4 cup batter per pancake onto the skillet, leaving room to spread. Cook until bubbles form across the surface and the edges look set, 2 to 3 minutes, then flip and cook until golden and springy in the center, 1 to 2 minutes more. Work in batches, brushing the pan with butter as needed.

steps.title: Keep warm and serve
steps.details: Transfer finished pancakes to an ovenproof plate in the 200°F oven to stay warm while you cook the rest. Serve in stacks with the warm maple syrup and fresh berries if using.

recipe.title: Maple-Glazed Bacon
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment or foil for easy cleanup. Use thick-cut bacon, about 1/4-inch thick; thin bacon will overcook. Have a small bowl of maple syrup and a pastry brush ready.
recipe.finish: Bacon is done when deeply browned, crisp at the edges, and bubbling; internal fat should look rendered, not white and flabby. If some slices brown faster, move them to a cooler part of the pan. Let the pan rest 2 minutes, then transfer bacon to a paper-towel-lined plate and serve warm while the glaze is still glossy. Do not pour off hot fat until the pan has cooled.

ingredients.name: thick-cut bacon
ingredients.prep: separate slices, keep in a stack

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.prep: measure; optional, for a sweet-salty finish

steps.title: Preheat and line pan
steps.details: Set an oven rack in the middle position and preheat to 400°F (200°C). Line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper or aluminum foil, dull side up, for easier cleanup and to keep bacon from sticking.

steps.title: Arrange bacon slices
steps.details: Lay bacon slices flat on the lined pan in a single layer, close together but not overlapping; edges can touch and they will shrink. If needed, use a second pan rather than crowding.

steps.title: Bake until partly rendered
steps.details: Bake on the middle rack for 12 minutes. Bacon should be lightly browned, beginning to crisp, and have rendered some fat. Ovens vary, so check at 10 minutes.

steps.title: Mix maple glaze
steps.details: Stir the maple syrup and kosher salt together in a small bowl until the salt dissolves. Keep the brush handy.

steps.title: Brush with maple glaze
steps.details: Pull the pan out and close the oven door to keep heat in. Brush the tops of the bacon evenly with about half the maple glaze; it will sizzle on the hot pan. Work carefully around hot fat.

steps.title: Bake until glaze sets
steps.details: Return pan to the oven and bake 5 minutes, until the glaze bubbles and darkens slightly. Do not let it burn; maple syrup goes from caramelized to bitter quickly.

steps.title: Add final glaze and crisp
steps.details: Brush with the remaining maple glaze, then bake 4 to 6 more minutes until bacon is crisp at the edges and deeply browned. Watch closely during this final stretch.

steps.title: Drain and serve
steps.details: Let the pan rest 2 minutes off the heat. Transfer bacon with tongs to a paper-towel-lined plate, blot the top lightly, and serve warm. Discard hot fat only after it has cooled.

recipe.title: Herbed Roasted Baby Potatoes
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C) with a rack in the middle. Have a rimmed baking sheet and a large bowl ready. Halve larger potatoes so all pieces are about 1 to 1½ inches for even roasting.
recipe.finish: Potatoes are done when fork-tender and deeply golden on the cut sides. Taste and add a pinch of salt if needed, then transfer to a serving platter and scatter with the remaining fresh herbs. Serve warm.

ingredients.name: baby potatoes (red or yellow)
