ingredients.prep: scrub, halve any larger than 1½ inches

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.prep: peel and smash with the flat of a knife

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.details: Set oven to 425°F (220°C) with a rack in the middle. Let it come to temperature while you prep; this usually takes about 15 minutes.

steps.title: Prep the potatoes
steps.details: Scrub the potatoes and pat dry. Halve any larger than 1½ inches so all pieces are similar in size for even cooking.

steps.title: Chop the herbs
steps.details: While the oven heats, strip and chop the rosemary, strip the thyme leaves, peel and smash the garlic, and chop the parsley; keep parsley aside for finishing.

steps.title: Toss with oil and seasonings
steps.details: In a large bowl, toss the potatoes with olive oil, salt, pepper, garlic, rosemary, and thyme until evenly coated.

steps.title: Spread on the pan
steps.details: Arrange potatoes cut-side down in a single layer on a rimmed baking sheet, leaving space between pieces so they brown instead of steam.

steps.title: Roast until golden
steps.details: Roast at 425°F (220°C) for 25 minutes. Do not stir yet; the cut sides should begin to turn golden.

steps.title: Turn and finish roasting
steps.details: Turn the potatoes with a spatula and roast 10 to 15 minutes more, until fork-tender and deeply golden. Check at 10 minutes.

steps.title: Season and serve
steps.details: Transfer to a platter, taste and add salt if needed, then scatter with the reserved parsley and serve warm.

recipe.title: Buttermilk Biscuits with Honey Butter
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 425°F with rack in the middle. Have a baking sheet ready (lining with parchment helps). Keep butter and buttermilk cold; use a box grater or two knives. A 2 1/2-inch round cutter or a glass works.
recipe.finish: Biscuits are done when tall, golden brown on top and bottoms, and firm on the sides; serve warm, split, with the whipped honey butter. Best the day they're made.

ingredients.name: cold unsalted butter
ingredients.prep: cut into 1/2-inch cubes, plus melted butter for brushing

steps.title: Preheat oven and pan
steps.details: Heat oven to 425°F with a rack in the middle. Line a baking sheet with parchment or lightly grease it.

steps.title: Make honey butter
steps.details: Beat the softened butter, honey and 1/4 tsp salt with a fork or electric mixer until pale and fluffy, about 2 minutes. Scrape into a small bowl and refrigerate until serving.

steps.title: Whisk dry ingredients
steps.details: In a large bowl, whisk the flour, baking powder, baking soda and 1 tsp salt until combined.

steps.title: Cut in cold butter
steps.details: Add the cold cubed butter and toss to coat. Rub the butter into the flour with your fingertips or a pastry cutter until most pieces are pea-sized with a few larger flakes remaining. Work quickly so the butter stays cold.

steps.title: Add buttermilk and shape dough
steps.details: Pour in the cold buttermilk and stir with a fork just until a shaggy dough forms; do not overmix. Turn onto a floured surface, pat into a 1-inch-thick rectangle, fold in thirds like a letter, then pat back to 1 inch thick. Repeat the fold once more, then pat to 3/4 inch thick.

steps.title: Cut and transfer biscuits
steps.details: Dip a 2 1/2-inch cutter in flour and press straight down without twisting. Cut biscuits, pressing scraps together gently and cutting again, until you have 8. Place on the baking sheet about 1 inch apart.

steps.title: Brush tops with buttermilk
steps.details: Lightly brush the tops of the biscuits with the extra 1 tbsp buttermilk, taking care not to drip down the sides.

steps.title: Bake until golden
steps.details: Bake until tall and golden brown on top and bottom, 15 to 18 minutes. Rotate the pan halfway through if your oven browns unevenly.

steps.title: Brush with melted butter
steps.details: Remove from the oven and immediately brush the hot tops with a little melted butter. Cool on the pan 2 to 3 minutes.

steps.title: Serve warm with honey butter
steps.details: Serve the warm biscuits with the chilled whipped honey butter.

recipe.title: Lemon Poppy Seed Loaf Cake
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and flour a 9x5-inch loaf pan or line it with parchment. Let butter and eggs sit at room temperature for 30 minutes before starting. You need a mixing bowl, whisk, spatula, and loaf pan.
recipe.finish: The loaf is done when a toothpick inserted in the center comes out with just a few moist crumbs, about 50–55 minutes. Cool 15 minutes in the pan, then turn out onto a rack. Whisk the glaze and pour over the cooled cake. Let set 10 minutes before slicing. Store loosely covered at room temperature for 3 days.

steps.title: Preheat oven
steps.details: Set oven to 350°F (175°C) with a rack in the middle. Grease and flour a 9x5-inch loaf pan or line it with parchment.

steps.title: Whisk dry ingredients
steps.details: In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, salt, and poppy seeds until evenly combined.

steps.title: Cream butter and sugar
steps.details: In a large bowl, beat the softened butter and granulated sugar with a whisk or hand mixer until pale and fluffy, 3–4 minutes.

steps.title: Add eggs and zest
steps.details: Beat in the eggs one at a time until smooth, then stir in the lemon zest. Scrape down the bowl.

steps.title: Alternate milk and flour
steps.details: With the mixer on low, add one-third of the dry mixture, then half the milk, then half the remaining dry mixture, then the remaining milk, ending with the last of the dry mixture. Stir in 2 tbsp of the lemon juice. Mix just until no dry streaks remain; do not overmix.

steps.title: Bake the loaf
steps.details: Scrape batter into the prepared pan and smooth the top. Bake until golden and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out with just a few moist crumbs, 50–55 minutes. Rotate the pan halfway through if your oven browns unevenly.

steps.title: Cool the cake
steps.details: Cool in the pan on a rack for 15 minutes, then turn out onto the rack to cool completely, about 45 minutes more.

steps.title: Make lemon glaze
steps.details: While the cake cools, whisk the sifted powdered sugar with the remaining 1 tbsp lemon juice until smooth and pourable. Add a few drops of water if too thick.

steps.title: Glaze and set
steps.details: Pour the glaze over the cooled cake, letting it drip down the sides. Let set 10 minutes, then slice.

recipe.title: Sparkling Strawberry Lemonade
recipe.intro: No cooking required—just a pitcher, a muddler or wooden spoon, and a fine-mesh strainer. Chill the sparkling water and lemons ahead of time so the drink stays cold. Make the strawberry-lemon base up to 4 hours ahead and stir in the sparkling water just before serving.
recipe.finish: Taste and adjust with more syrup if needed. Serve immediately over ice, garnished with lemon slices and a strawberry if you like. Stir gently before each pour because the strawberry bits settle.

ingredients.name: fresh strawberries
ingredients.prep: hulled, half sliced and half roughly chopped

ingredients.name: lemons
ingredients.prep: rolled on the counter, then juiced (about 1 cup juice); slice 1 for garnish

ingredients.name: cold sparkling water or club soda

steps.title: Make the simple syrup
steps.details: Combine the sugar and 1 cup water in a small saucepan over medium heat. Stir until the sugar dissolves completely, about 3 minutes; do not boil. Remove from the heat and let cool while you prepare the fruit, about 10 minutes.

steps.title: Juice the lemons
steps.details: While the syrup cools, roll the lemons firmly on the counter, cut them in half, and squeeze through a strainer into a bowl to catch seeds and pulp. You should get about 1 cup of juice; set aside. Slice one lemon for garnish.

steps.title: Muddle the strawberries
steps.details: Put the chopped strawberries in the bottom of a large pitcher. Mash with a muddler or the back of a wooden spoon until juicy and mostly broken down, leaving some small pieces for texture, about 3 minutes.

steps.title: Combine base and chill
steps.details: Pour the cooled syrup and lemon juice into the muddled strawberries and stir well. Refrigerate until cold, at least 30 minutes and up to 4 hours.

steps.title: Add sparkling water and ice
steps.details: Just before serving, pour in the chilled sparkling water and add the ice. Stir gently once or twice—don't over-stir, or the bubbles will fade.

steps.title: Taste and serve
steps.details: Taste; if it's too tart, stir in a splash more cooled syrup. Pour over ice and garnish with lemon slices and a strawberry. Serve right away.

recipe.title: Iced Coffee with Vanilla Cream
recipe.intro: Brew strong coffee and chill it quickly. While it cools, make the vanilla cream and fill glasses with ice. Use a whisk or fork for the cream.
recipe.finish: Pour chilled coffee over ice, leaving room for cream. Stir in vanilla cream to taste. Serve immediately.

steps.title: Brew strong coffee
steps.details: Combine coffee grounds and cold water in a French press or pitcher. Stir, cover, and let steep at room temperature for 12 hours (or brew 4 cups strong coffee using your usual method and chill).

steps.title: Make vanilla cream
steps.details: Whisk heavy cream, sugar, and vanilla in a small bowl until sugar dissolves. Cover and refrigerate until needed.

steps.title: Strain and chill coffee
steps.details: Strain coffee through a fine-mesh sieve into a pitcher. Discard grounds. Refrigerate until cold, at least 1 hour.

steps.title: Fill glasses with ice
steps.details: Fill four tall glasses with ice cubes.

steps.title: Pour coffee over ice
steps.details: Pour chilled coffee over ice, filling each glass about three-quarters full.

steps.title: Add vanilla cream
steps.details: Stir vanilla cream and pour a splash (about 2 tablespoons) over each glass. Serve immediately.

recipe.title: Classic Grilled Cheeseburgers
recipe.intro: Preheat a gas grill to medium-high (about 450°F) or light a charcoal chimney until coals are ash-covered, about 15 minutes. Have a platter and clean tongs ready. Keep raw and cooked meat separate.
recipe.finish: Check burgers hit 160°F in the center with an instant-read thermometer. Rest 3 minutes off heat, then serve on the toasted buns with lettuce, tomato, and your favorite condiments.

steps.title: Preheat grill
steps.details: Heat gas grill on medium-high to about 450°F, or light charcoal and let coals ash over. Clean and oil grates.

steps.title: Form and season patties
steps.details: Gently shape each beef ball into a 3/4-inch-thick patty, press a shallow dimple in the center, and season both sides with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Butter buns
steps.details: Spread softened butter on the cut sides of the buns; stack cut-side up until grilling.

steps.title: Toast buns
steps.details: Place buns cut-side down on the grill away from direct flames and toast 1–2 minutes until golden; move to a platter.

steps.title: Grill first side
steps.details: Place patties on the hot grill; do not press. Close lid and cook 4 minutes for a browned crust and grill marks.

steps.title: Flip patties
steps.details: Flip once with a spatula and continue grilling 4 more minutes with the lid closed.

steps.title: Add cheese and finish
steps.details: Lay a cheese slice on each patty, close the lid, and cook until cheese melts and the center reads 160°F, 1–2 minutes more.

steps.title: Rest and build burgers
steps.details: Move burgers to a platter off heat for 3 minutes, then place patties on toasted buns with lettuce and tomato.

recipe.title: Smoky Grilled Chicken Thighs
recipe.intro: Get ready: light a gas grill or chimney of charcoal for medium indirect heat (about 375°F/190°C) and oil the grates. Have a small bowl, a rimmed plate, and tongs or a spatula ready. Bone-in thighs benefit from a 20-minute rub rest before grilling.
recipe.finish: Chicken is done when the thickest part away from the bone reads 175–180°F (79–82°C) and juices run clear with no pink at the bone. Rest 5 minutes, then serve hot with extra paprika rub on the side.

steps.title: Heat the grill
steps.details: Light a gas grill to medium (about 375°F/190°C) with one burner off for indirect heat, or bank charcoal to one side. Clean and oil the grates with the vegetable oil just before cooking.

steps.title: Mix the rub
steps.details: Stir together smoked paprika, brown sugar, kosher salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and cayenne in a small bowl until evenly combined.

steps.title: Coat the chicken
steps.details: Pat the thighs dry, then rub the spice mixture all over the skin and meat, getting under the skin where you can. Place on a rimmed plate.

steps.title: Rest the rub
steps.details: Let the seasoned thighs sit at room temperature while the grill finishes heating, up to 20 minutes. Do not leave out longer than 30 minutes total.

steps.title: Sear over direct heat
steps.details: Place thighs skin-side down over direct medium heat and cook undisturbed until lightly charred and easy to release, 5–6 minutes. Watch for flare-ups from dripping fat; move pieces to the cooler side if flames rise.

steps.title: Flip and move indirect
steps.details: Flip thighs and move them to the indirect (cooler) side of the grill, skin-side up. Close the lid.

steps.title: Cook through indirect
steps.details: Continue covered over indirect heat until the thickest part reads 175–180°F (79–82°C) and juices run clear, 20–28 minutes. Check at 20 minutes and rotate pieces if one side is browning faster.

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.details: Transfer thighs to a clean plate, tent loosely with foil, and rest 5 minutes before serving.

recipe.title: Creamy Old-Fashioned Potato Salad
recipe.intro: A classic creamy potato salad with celery, hard-boiled eggs, and a tangy mayo-mustard dressing. Perfect for a Father's Day cookout. Equipment: large pot, colander, mixing bowls, whisk, knife, cutting board.
recipe.finish: Chill for at least 1 hour before serving to allow flavors to meld. Garnish with paprika if desired. Store leftovers in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

ingredients.name: Yukon Gold or red potatoes
ingredients.prep: scrub, peel if desired, cut into 1-inch cubes

steps.title: Boil potatoes
steps.details: Place potatoes in a large pot and cover with cold water by 1 inch. Add 1 tablespoon salt. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce to a simmer. Cook until potatoes are tender but not falling apart, about 10-12 minutes. Test by piercing with a fork; it should slide in easily.

steps.title: Boil eggs
steps.details: While potatoes cook, place eggs in a saucepan and cover with cold water by 1 inch. Bring to a boil, then cover and remove from heat. Let stand 10 minutes. Transfer eggs to an ice bath to cool. Peel and chop.

steps.title: Prep vegetables
steps.details: While potatoes and eggs cook, finely dice celery and red onion. Set aside.

steps.title: Make dressing
steps.details: In a small bowl, whisk together mayonnaise, mustard, vinegar, 1 teaspoon salt, and pepper until smooth. Taste and adjust seasoning.

steps.title: Drain and cool potatoes
steps.details: Drain potatoes in a colander and let cool for 5 minutes. Do not rinse.

steps.title: Combine ingredients
steps.details: In a large bowl, gently toss warm potatoes, chopped eggs, celery, and onion with the dressing until evenly coated. Be careful not to mash the potatoes.

steps.title: Chill and serve
steps.details: Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour to allow flavors to blend. Sprinkle with paprika before serving, if desired.

generatedRecipes.title: Grilled Corn on the Cob with Herb Butter

recipe.title: Grilled Corn on the Cob with Herb Butter
recipe.intro: Soak the corn in the husk so it steams and chars without drying out. Light a gas grill to medium-high (about 400°F) or prepare charcoal for medium-high heat. Have a small bowl and basting brush ready. Herb butter can be mixed while the grill heats.
recipe.finish: Corn is done when husks are charred in spots and a kernel pierced near the tip is tender and juicy, 15–20 minutes. Peel back husks carefully, brush generously with herb butter, and serve hot with extra butter on the side.

ingredients.name: corn on the cob, in husks
ingredients.prep: soak in cold water 10 minutes, then drain

steps.title: Heat the grill
steps.details: Preheat a gas grill to medium-high, about 400°F, for 10–15 minutes; for charcoal, build a medium-high fire and let coals ash over. Cover if using gas.

steps.title: Mix the herb butter
steps.details: In a small bowl, mash the softened butter with the grated garlic, chopped parsley, chopped chives, salt and pepper until evenly blended. Set aside at room temperature.

steps.title: Grill the corn
steps.details: Place the drained corn in husks on the hot grill grate. Cover and cook, turning every 4–5 minutes, until husks are charred in spots and kernels are tender, 15–20 minutes total.

steps.title: Butter and serve
steps.details: Wearing gloves or using a towel, peel back the husks. Brush each ear generously with the herb butter, season with a little more salt if needed, and serve hot.

recipe.title: Classic Creamy Coleslaw
recipe.intro: Have a large bowl and a whisk ready. If your cabbage is warm from the store, chill it first for the crispest slaw. No cooking required, but the slaw needs at least 30 minutes in the fridge to marry flavors before serving.
recipe.finish: Taste and adjust with a pinch of salt, a splash of vinegar, or a little sugar. Serve cold alongside cookout favorites; keep any leftovers covered in the fridge for up to 2 days, stirring before serving.

ingredients.name: green cabbage
ingredients.prep: remove tough outer leaves, quarter, core, and shred thinly (about 8 cups)

ingredients.name: carrots
ingredients.prep: peel and shred on the large holes of a box grater (about 1 cup)

steps.title: Shred the cabbage
steps.details: Cut the cored cabbage quarters into thin shreds with a chef's knife or slice on a mandoline. Put the shreds in a large bowl.

steps.title: Shred the carrots
steps.details: Peel and shred the carrots on the large holes of a box grater. Add them to the bowl with the cabbage.

steps.title: Whisk the dressing
steps.details: In a medium bowl, whisk the mayonnaise, sugar, vinegar, lemon juice, salt, and pepper until smooth. Whisk in the milk until pourable.

steps.title: Toss slaw with dressing
steps.details: Pour the dressing over the cabbage and carrots. Toss well with tongs or two forks until every shred is coated; the slaw should look glossy and evenly dressed.

steps.title: Chill to blend flavors
steps.details: Cover and refrigerate at least 30 minutes so the cabbage softens slightly and the dressing thickens. The slaw is ready when it is cold, glossy, and holds together when lifted with tongs.

recipe.title: Bacon and Cheddar Deviled Eggs
recipe.intro: Hard-cook the eggs and fry the bacon first, then cool both before mixing the filling. You'll need a large pot, a skillet, a mixing bowl, a fork or whisk, a small spoon, and a piping bag or zip-top bag. Have a bowl of ice water ready for the eggs.
recipe.finish: Spoon or pipe the filling into the whites, sprinkle with bacon and cheddar, and refrigerate until serving. Keep cold (below 40°F) for no more than 2 hours at the cookout; the filling can be made up to 1 day ahead and stored covered in the fridge.

steps.title: Boil the eggs
steps.details: Place eggs in a large pot and cover with 1 inch of cold water. Bring to a rolling boil over high heat, then cover, remove from heat, and let stand 11 minutes for firm yolks.

steps.title: Fry the bacon
steps.details: While the eggs heat, cook bacon in a skillet over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until crisp and browned, 8–10 minutes. Transfer to a paper-towel-lined plate.

steps.title: Ice-bath the eggs
steps.details: Drain the hot water and transfer eggs to a bowl of ice water for at least 10 minutes to stop cooking and make peeling easy.

steps.title: Peel and halve eggs
steps.details: Crack and peel the cooled eggs, then cut each in half lengthwise. Pop the yolks into a mixing bowl and arrange the whites cut-side up on a serving platter.

steps.title: Mash the yolks
steps.details: Mash the yolks with a fork until no large lumps remain.

steps.title: Mix the filling
steps.details: Add mayonnaise, mustard, salt, pepper, and all but 2 tablespoons of the cheddar to the yolks. Stir until smooth and creamy; taste and adjust salt.

steps.title: Fill the egg whites
steps.details: Spoon the filling into a zip-top bag, snip a corner, and pipe into the whites (or spoon it in). Mound the filling slightly above the rim.

steps.title: Top and chill
steps.details: Sprinkle the reserved cheddar, crispy bacon, and chives over the filling. Refrigerate covered until serving, at least 20 minutes.

recipe.title: Buttermilk Cornbread Squares
recipe.intro: Heat oven to 425°F with a 9-inch cast-iron skillet (or 8-inch square pan) inside. Have a whisk, two bowls, and a spatula ready. If you don't have buttermilk, stir 1 tbsp lemon juice into 1 cup milk and let stand 5 minutes.
recipe.finish: Cornbread is done when the top is golden and a toothpick in the center comes out clean, 20–25 minutes. Cool in the skillet 10 minutes, then turn out and cut into 9 squares. Serve warm with butter.

steps.title: Heat oven and skillet
steps.details: Place a 9-inch cast-iron skillet in the oven and heat to 425°F. Let it heat at least 15 minutes while you mix the batter.

steps.title: Whisk dry ingredients
steps.details: In a large bowl, whisk together cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt until evenly combined.

steps.title: Mix wet ingredients
steps.details: In a second bowl, whisk buttermilk, eggs, and melted butter until smooth.

steps.title: Combine batter
steps.details: Pour the wet ingredients into the dry and stir with a spatula just until no dry streaks remain; a few small lumps are fine. Don't overmix.

steps.title: Prep hot skillet
steps.details: Carefully pull the hot skillet from the oven, add the oil, and swirl to coat the bottom and sides. The oil should shimmer.

steps.title: Pour and bake
steps.details: Pour batter into the hot skillet (it will sizzle), spread evenly, and bake at 425°F until golden and a toothpick in the center comes out clean, 20–25 minutes.

steps.title: Cool and cut
steps.details: Cool in the skillet 10 minutes, then loosen edges with a knife, turn out onto a cutting board, and cut into 9 squares.

recipe.title: Fresh Watermelon and Berry Salad
recipe.intro: No cooking needed — just a sharp knife, a cutting board, a large bowl, and space in the fridge. Chill everything ahead if your kitchen is hot; the salad is best served cold.
recipe.finish: Taste and add a little more lime or sugar if needed. Serve chilled within 1 hour of assembling so the watermelon stays crisp.

ingredients.name: seedless watermelon
ingredients.prep: cut into 1-inch chunks (about half a small watermelon)

steps.title: Chill and cut watermelon
steps.details: Place watermelon chunks in a large serving bowl and refrigerate while you prep the berries; chill at least 20 minutes for a cold salad.

steps.title: Prep strawberries
steps.details: Hull and halve strawberries, then add to a second bowl. Do this while the watermelon chills.

steps.title: Rinse blueberries and raspberries
steps.details: Rinse blueberries and raspberries gently; drain well so water doesn't dilute the salad.

steps.title: Make lime dressing
steps.details: Zest 2 limes, then squeeze 3 tablespoons juice into a small cup. Stir in honey or sugar until dissolved.

steps.title: Combine fruit
steps.details: Add strawberries, blueberries, and raspberries to the chilled watermelon in the large bowl.

steps.title: Dress and toss gently
steps.details: Drizzle lime mixture over the fruit and fold very gently with a large spoon so berries stay whole.

steps.title: Rest and serve chilled
steps.details: Refrigerate 10 to 15 minutes to let flavors meld, then scatter mint on top, if using, and serve cold.

recipe.title: S'mores Brownie Bars
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Line an 8x8-inch baking pan with parchment paper, leaving overhang. Gather ingredients. Use a boxed brownie mix for ease, or your favorite fudgy brownie recipe scaled for an 8x8 pan.
recipe.finish: Let bars cool completely in the pan on a wire rack for at least 1 hour before cutting. Lift out using parchment overhang and cut into 9 squares. Serve at room temperature. Store leftovers covered at room temperature for up to 2 days.

ingredients.name: brownie mix
ingredients.prep: plus ingredients per package (eggs, oil, water)

steps.title: Preheat and line pan
steps.details: Preheat oven to 350°F. Line an 8x8-inch pan with parchment, leaving overhang.

steps.title: Mix brownie batter
steps.details: In a bowl, prepare brownie batter according to package directions (eggs, oil, water). Stir until just combined.

steps.title: Add graham and marshmallows
steps.details: Fold half the graham cracker pieces (about 1 cup) and 1 cup of mini marshmallows into the batter.

steps.title: Bake brownie base
steps.details: Spread batter evenly in prepared pan. Bake 25-30 minutes, until a toothpick inserted 2 inches from edge comes out with moist crumbs (not wet batter). Center may be slightly fudgy.

steps.title: Top with marshmallows and crackers
steps.details: Remove pan from oven. Immediately sprinkle remaining 1 cup mini marshmallows and remaining graham pieces evenly over hot brownies. Scatter nuts if using.

steps.title: Broil to toast marshmallows
steps.details: Set oven to broil (high). Return pan to oven and broil 1-2 minutes, watching constantly, until marshmallows are golden brown and toasted. Do not walk away.

steps.title: Melt chocolate for drizzle
steps.details: In a small microwave-safe bowl, microwave chocolate chips in 20-second bursts, stirring between, until melted and smooth. Drizzle over warm bars.

steps.title: Cool completely
steps.details: Let bars cool in pan on a wire rack at least 1 hour before cutting. For cleanest cuts, refrigerate 30 minutes after cooling.

recipe.title: Fresh-Squeezed Lemonade
recipe.intro: You'll need a citrus juicer or reamer, a small saucepan, a pitcher, and a long spoon. Make the simple syrup first so it can cool while you juice the lemons. Serve well chilled over plenty of ice.
recipe.finish: Taste once more before serving; add a splash of water if it's too tart or a spoonful of sugar if it's too sharp. Pour over tall glasses packed with ice and garnish with lemon slices. Keep the pitcher in the shade or a cooler with ice; discard any lemonade left out in the sun for more than 2 hours.

steps.title: Make the simple syrup
steps.details: Combine sugar and 1 cup water in a small saucepan over medium heat. Stir until sugar fully dissolves, about 3 minutes; do not boil. Remove from heat and set aside to cool.

steps.title: Juice the lemons
steps.details: While the syrup cools, roll and halve the lemons, then squeeze through a strainer into a bowl, picking out seeds. You want about 1 1/2 cups of juice.

steps.title: Let syrup cool
steps.details: Leave the syrup in the saucepan off the heat until just warm or room temperature, about 10 more minutes.

steps.title: Combine lemonade
steps.details: In the pitcher, stir together the cooled syrup, fresh lemon juice, and 5 cups cold water until evenly blended.

steps.title: Chill and taste
steps.details: Refrigerate the pitcher for at least 20 minutes. Taste; adjust with a little extra water or sugar if needed.

steps.title: Serve over ice
steps.details: Fill glasses generously with ice, pour lemonade over the top, and garnish with lemon slices.

recipe.title: Classic Cheeseburgers
recipe.intro: Preheat a gas grill to medium-high (about 450°F) or prepare a charcoal fire for medium-high heat while you shape the patties and set out toppings. Have a clean platter and an instant-read thermometer ready.
recipe.finish: Patties are done when the center reaches 160°F, about 3–4 minutes per side depending on thickness. Let burgers rest 2–3 minutes, then serve on the toasted buns with your favorite toppings.

steps.title: Preheat the grill
steps.details: Light the grill and heat to medium-high, about 450°F. Clean and oil the grates just before cooking.

steps.title: Shape and season patties
steps.details: Gently form beef into 6 patties about 3/4 inch thick, making a shallow dimple in the center of each. Season both sides with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Set out toppings
steps.details: Arrange lettuce, tomato, ketchup, and mustard on a platter. Keep cheese slices chilled until needed.

steps.title: Butter and toast buns
steps.details: Spread softened butter on the cut sides of the buns. Toast cut-side down on the grill for 1–2 minutes until golden, then set aside.

steps.title: Grill the patties
steps.details: Place patties on the hot grill. Cook undisturbed for 3–4 minutes, then flip and cook 3–4 minutes more, until the center reaches 160°F.

steps.title: Melt the cheese
steps.details: In the last minute of cooking, top each patty with a slice of cheddar, close the lid, and cook until melted.

steps.title: Rest the burgers
steps.details: Transfer patties to a clean platter and rest 2–3 minutes while you assemble the buns.

steps.title: Assemble and serve
steps.details: Place lettuce and tomato on the bottom buns, add patties, and finish with ketchup and mustard and the top buns. Serve immediately.

recipe.title: Honey-Lime Grilled Chicken Thighs
recipe.intro: Preheat a gas grill to medium-high (about 400–450°F) or light a charcoal chimney and bank coals for indirect heat. You'll need tongs, a small saucepan, a whisk, a bowl for the raw chicken, and a clean platter or tray for finished thighs. Make the glaze while the grill heats, then grill the chicken bone-side down first for even cooking.
recipe.finish: Thighs are done when a thermometer inserted into the thickest part away from bone reads 175°F, juices run clear, and the surface is charred in spots. Rest 5 minutes, then serve with extra glaze on the side. Discard any glaze that touched raw chicken.

ingredients.name: bone-in skin-on chicken thighs
ingredients.prep: trim excess skin and pat very dry

steps.title: Preheat grill
steps.details: Heat a gas grill to medium-high, about 400–450°F, or light charcoal and set up a cooler zone. Clean and oil the grates.

steps.title: Season chicken
steps.details: Pat thighs very dry and rub all over with the oil, kosher salt, and black pepper. Keep them on a clean tray.

steps.title: Simmer glaze
steps.details: In a small saucepan over medium-low heat, whisk honey, lime juice, lime zest, soy sauce, garlic, and red pepper flakes. Simmer gently 2–3 minutes until slightly thickened, then remove from heat; keep about half in a separate bowl for serving.

steps.title: Grill skin-side down
steps.details: Place thighs skin-side down on the hot side of the grill. Cook undisturbed 5–6 minutes until the skin releases easily and has grill marks.

steps.title: Flip and cook through
steps.details: Flip thighs and move to the cooler side or over medium heat. Cover and cook 14–16 minutes, turning once, until a thermometer in the thickest part away from bone reads 170°F.

steps.title: Brush on glaze
steps.details: Brush the thighs generously with the saucepan glaze, turning to coat. Cook 2 minutes, then flip, brush again, and cook 2–3 minutes more until charred in spots and the thickest part reads 175°F. Watch for flare-ups from the honey and move thighs away from direct flame if needed.

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.details: Transfer thighs to a clean platter, tent loosely with foil, and rest 5 minutes. Serve with the reserved glaze on the side.

generatedRecipes.title: Grilled Corn on the Cob with Herb Butter

recipe.title: Grilled Corn on the Cob with Herb Butter
recipe.intro: Soften the butter first (20 minutes on the counter, or 10 seconds at a time in the microwave). Heat a gas grill to medium-high (about 400°F) or light a charcoal grill until coals are ash-covered. No grill? Roast the foil-wrapped corn at 425°F for 25–30 minutes.
recipe.finish: Corn is done when the kernels are hot and slightly charred at the tips and a kernel pierces easily with a knife. Roll each hot ear in the herb butter (or brush generously), sprinkle with salt, and serve right away while the butter melts.

ingredients.name: corn on the cob, husks on

steps.title: Soak the corn
steps.details: Put the 6 husked-on ears in a large pot or sink of cold water and soak 10 minutes so the husks don't burn. Meanwhile heat the grill to medium-high (about 400°F).

steps.title: Make herb butter
steps.details: Mash the softened butter with the parsley, chives, 1/2 tsp salt and the pepper until evenly combined. Scrape into a small bowl.

steps.title: Grill the corn
steps.details: Drain the corn and grill covered, turning every 3–4 minutes, until the husks are charred in spots and the kernels are tender, 15–18 minutes total.

steps.title: Check doneness
steps.details: Peel back a husk; a kernel should pinch easily and be hot through. If still firm, grill 3–5 minutes more. Pull off the husks and silk (a kitchen towel helps).

steps.title: Butter and serve
steps.details: Roll each hot ear in the herb butter to coat, sprinkle with extra salt, and serve immediately.

recipe.title: Creamy Potato Salad
recipe.intro: A classic creamy potato salad with celery, red onion, and hard-boiled eggs. Start by boiling potatoes and eggs, then chop vegetables and make dressing while they cook.
recipe.finish: Chill for at least 30 minutes before serving. Garnish with paprika if desired. Store leftovers in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

steps.title: Boil potatoes
steps.details: Place potatoes in a large pot and cover with cold water by 1 inch. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce to a simmer. Cook until potatoes are tender when pierced with a fork, about 10-12 minutes. Drain and let cool slightly.

steps.title: Hard-boil eggs
steps.details: While potatoes cook, place eggs in a saucepan and cover with cold water by 1 inch. Bring to a boil, then cover and remove from heat. Let stand for 12 minutes. Transfer eggs to an ice bath to cool, then peel and chop.

steps.title: Chop vegetables
steps.details: Finely chop celery and red onion.

steps.title: Make dressing
steps.details: In a large bowl, whisk together mayonnaise, mustard, vinegar, salt, and pepper until smooth.

steps.title: Combine potato salad
steps.details: Add warm potatoes, chopped eggs, celery, and red onion to the dressing. Gently toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow flavors to meld.

steps.title: Chill and serve
steps.details: Chill for 30 minutes. Sprinkle with paprika before serving, if desired.

recipe.title: Watermelon and Feta Salad
recipe.intro: Chill the watermelon and feta first for the freshest taste. You need a cutting board, knife, large bowl, and a small whisk or fork. No cooking or oven needed; keep the finished salad cold until serving.
recipe.finish: Serve chilled within 1 hour of dressing. The salad is done when the cubes are glossy with lime dressing and the feta is evenly scattered. If it sits longer, the salt draws juice from the melon, so stir gently and drain excess liquid before serving.

ingredients.name: seedless watermelon, chilled
ingredients.prep: cut into 1-inch cubes; remove any seeds

ingredients.name: fresh mint leaves
ingredients.prep: rinse, pat dry, and tear or thinly slice

steps.title: Cube the watermelon
steps.details: Cut the chilled watermelon into 1-inch cubes, discarding rind and any seeds. You should have about 6 cups. Put the cubes in a large serving bowl.

steps.title: Cube or crumble feta
steps.details: While the watermelon is being cut, cut the chilled feta into 1/2-inch cubes or crumble it into bite-size pieces. Keep chilled until needed.

steps.title: Whisk lime dressing
steps.details: In a small bowl, whisk the lime juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper until evenly combined and slightly thickened.

steps.title: Add feta and mint
steps.details: Scatter the feta and torn mint over the watermelon cubes. Do not stir yet.

steps.title: Drizzle and toss
steps.details: Pour the lime dressing evenly over the salad. Toss very gently with a large spoon just until the cubes are coated and the feta is distributed, about 30 seconds.

steps.title: Chill before serving
steps.details: Cover and refrigerate the salad for at least 15 minutes to let the flavors blend. Keep cold until serving; drain any released juice just before placing it on the table.

recipe.title: Classic Deviled Eggs
recipe.intro: Hard-cook the eggs and cool them in ice water while you set out the other ingredients. You'll need a medium pot, a bowl of ice water, a small skillet (optional, for toasting paprika), and a piping bag or zip-top bag. Eggs are easiest to peel when shocked cold and peeled under running water.
recipe.finish: Spoon or pipe the filling into the whites, dust with paprika, and chill until serving. Keep cold at the cookout, and discard any eggs left out over 2 hours.

steps.title: Boil the eggs
steps.details: Place eggs in a medium pot and cover with 1 inch of cold water. Bring to a rolling boil over high heat, then cover, remove from heat, and let stand 10 minutes off the burner.

steps.title: Shock eggs in ice water
steps.details: Transfer eggs with a slotted spoon to a large bowl of ice water. Let sit at least 10 minutes until fully cool to the touch.

steps.title: Measure the filling
steps.details: While eggs cool, combine mayonnaise, Dijon, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a small bowl. Stir until smooth.

steps.title: Toast the paprika
steps.details: Optional but recommended: toast paprika in a dry small skillet over medium heat 30–60 seconds until fragrant; remove immediately so it doesn't burn.

steps.title: Peel the eggs
steps.details: Crack each egg all over on a hard surface and peel under cool running water, starting at the wide end. Pat dry.

steps.title: Halve and separate yolks
steps.details: Cut eggs in half lengthwise. Pop yolks into the bowl with the mayonnaise mixture and mash smooth with a fork.

steps.title: Whip the filling
steps.details: Mash and stir yolks into the dressing until creamy and pipeable; add a teaspoon more mayo if stiff. Taste and adjust salt.

steps.title: Pipe the filling
steps.details: Spoon filling into a zip-top bag, snip a corner, and pipe into the whites. Or spoon it in with two spoons.

steps.title: Dust and garnish
steps.details: Dust filled eggs with toasted paprika and scatter chives over the tops.

steps.title: Chill until serving
steps.details: Cover and refrigerate at least 20 minutes, up to 24 hours, and keep cold on the buffet.

recipe.title: Buttermilk Skillet Cornbread
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 425°F with a 10-inch cast-iron skillet inside. Have all ingredients at room temperature; measure dry ingredients into a bowl and buttermilk into a cup so the batter comes together fast once the skillet is hot.
recipe.finish: The cornbread is done when the top is deep golden, the edges pull slightly from the pan, and a toothpick in the center comes out clean (about 20–25 minutes). Cool 10 minutes in the skillet, then cut into wedges and serve warm with butter.

ingredients.name: unsalted butter
ingredients.prep: melted, plus 1 tbsp for the skillet

steps.title: Heat oven and skillet
steps.details: Set a rack in the middle of the oven and preheat to 425°F. Put a 10-inch cast-iron skillet on the rack to heat for at least 15 minutes while you mix the batter.

steps.title: Whisk dry ingredients
steps.details: In a large bowl, whisk the cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt until evenly combined, about 1 minute.

steps.title: Mix wet ingredients
steps.details: In a medium bowl, whisk the buttermilk, eggs, and 4 tablespoons melted butter until smooth, about 1 minute.

steps.title: Combine into batter
steps.details: Pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients and stir with a spatula just until no dry streaks remain; a few small lumps are fine. Do not overmix.

steps.title: Heat the skillet
steps.details: Carefully pull the hot skillet from the oven. Add the oil and remaining 1 tablespoon butter, swirl until melted and coating the bottom and sides, and return the empty skillet to the oven for 3 minutes to get very hot.

steps.title: Pour batter and bake
steps.details: Pour the batter into the hot skillet (it should sizzle at the edges) and smooth the top. Bake until deep golden and a toothpick in the center comes out clean, 20–25 minutes.

steps.title: Cool and serve
steps.details: Let the cornbread cool in the skillet on a rack for 10 minutes, then run a knife around the edge, cut into wedges, and serve warm.

recipe.title: Strawberry Shortcake
recipe.intro: Heat oven to 425°F. You need a baking sheet, a large bowl, a mixer or whisk, and a 3-inch biscuit cutter or drinking glass. Keep cream and butter cold until used.
recipe.finish: Biscuits are best the day they are made; split and fill just before serving so they stay crisp. Serve with extra macerated juices spooned over the top.

steps.title: Macerate the strawberries
steps.details: Toss sliced strawberries with 1/4 cup sugar in a large bowl. Let sit at room temperature, stirring once or twice, until juicy and softened, at least 20 minutes.

steps.title: Mix dry biscuit ingredients
steps.details: While berries sit, whisk 2 cups flour, 2 tbsp sugar, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.

steps.title: Cut in cold butter
steps.details: Rub or cut cold butter into the flour until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs with a few pea-size butter pieces remaining.

steps.title: Add milk and shape
steps.details: Pour in 3/4 cup cold milk and stir just until a shaggy dough forms. Turn onto a floured surface, pat to 3/4 inch thick, and cut 6 rounds with a floured 3-inch cutter, re-patting scraps once.

steps.title: Bake the biscuits
steps.details: Place rounds 1 inch apart on an ungreased baking sheet, brush tops with 1 tbsp milk, and bake at 425°F until risen and golden brown, 12 to 15 minutes.

steps.title: Whip the cream
steps.details: While biscuits bake, beat 1 cup cold heavy cream, 2 tbsp sugar, and vanilla with a mixer or whisk until soft peaks form; refrigerate until serving.

steps.title: Cool the biscuits
steps.details: Transfer baked biscuits to a rack and cool 10 minutes so they firm up and are easy to split.

steps.title: Split and assemble
steps.details: Split each warm biscuit horizontally. Spoon berries and juices over the bottom halves, add a generous dollop of whipped cream, and set the tops in place or lean them alongside.

recipe.title: Fresh Lemonade
recipe.intro: You'll need a vegetable peeler, a small saucepan, a pitcher, a long spoon and a strainer. No specialty gear required. Make the lemon syrup a day ahead if you like, then mix with cold water and ice just before serving.
recipe.finish: Taste and adjust: lemonade should be tart-sweet and brightly lemony. Serve over plenty of ice in tall glasses; add lemon slices if you like. Keep the pitcher chilled, and stir before each pour since the syrup sinks.

ingredients.name: lemons
ingredients.prep: scrubbed; zest 4 of them, then juice all to get 1 1/2 cups juice

steps.title: Make lemon syrup
steps.details: In a small saucepan, combine the sugar, 1 cup water and the zest from 4 lemons. Heat over medium, stirring, until the sugar dissolves completely and the syrup just begins to steam, about 5 minutes; do not boil hard.

steps.title: Steep off heat
steps.details: Remove the saucepan from the heat and let the syrup steep 10 minutes so the zest flavors it. It should smell strongly of lemon.

steps.title: Juice the lemons
steps.details: While the syrup steeps, roll the lemons on the counter, halve them and squeeze through a strainer into a bowl or measuring cup until you have 1 1/2 cups juice. Pick out seeds.

steps.title: Strain the syrup
steps.details: Pour the steeped syrup through a fine strainer into a large pitcher, pressing gently on the zest, then discard the zest.

steps.title: Combine lemonade
steps.details: Add the lemon juice and 5 cups cold water to the pitcher with the syrup. Stir well; the mixture should be cloudy pale yellow and taste tart-sweet.

steps.title: Chill and add ice
steps.details: Refrigerate until cold, about 20 minutes, or serve right away over ice. Add 4 cups ice to the pitcher just before serving and garnish with lemon slices if using.

recipe.title: Iced Tea Pitcher
recipe.intro: Use a 2-quart pitcher and a saucepan or kettle. Have a long spoon and ice ready. Brew the concentrate while the event setup happens, then chill.
recipe.finish: Tea is ready when fully chilled and clear. Serve over plenty of ice with lemon slices; stir before pouring since sugar settles.

steps.title: Boil half the water
steps.details: Bring 4 cups of the water to a rolling boil in a saucepan or kettle.

steps.title: Steep tea and sugar
steps.details: Off the heat, add the tea bags and sugar to the hot water. Cover and steep 5 minutes, then remove the bags without squeezing.

steps.title: Add cold water
steps.details: Pour the steeped concentrate into the pitcher and stir in the remaining 4 cups cold water.

steps.title: Chill the pitcher
steps.details: Add the ice to the pitcher and refrigerate until cold throughout, at least 40 minutes.

steps.title: Add lemon and serve
steps.details: Stir, add lemon slices, and serve over fresh ice. Taste and stir in a little more sugar if desired.

recipe.title: Classic Grilled Cheeseburgers
recipe.intro: Preheat a gas grill to medium-high (about 400–450°F) or light a charcoal chimney and let coals ash over. Have a clean platter and a spatula ready. Keep ground beef cold until patties are formed.
recipe.finish: Burgers are done when an instant-read thermometer inserted sideways into the center of a patty reads 160°F and juices run clear. Let patties rest 2 minutes, then place on toasted buns and add lettuce, tomato, onion, pickles, ketchup and mustard. Serve hot.

steps.title: Preheat grill
steps.details: Preheat a covered gas grill to medium-high, 400–450°F, about 12 minutes; scrape and oil the grates. For charcoal, light a chimney and spread ashed-over coals when ready.

steps.title: Form seasoned patties
steps.details: Gently mix beef with salt and pepper just until combined. Divide into 6 equal balls and flatten into patties about 3/4 inch thick, slightly wider than the buns and with a shallow dimple in the center so they stay flat.

steps.title: Prep toppings and buns
steps.details: While the grill heats, wash and dry lettuce, slice tomatoes and onion, drain pickles, and set out ketchup and mustard. Split the buns and set them near the grill.

steps.title: Grill patties
steps.details: Place patties on the hot grill, cover, and cook 4–5 minutes without moving until the underside is browned and releases cleanly. Do not press down on the patties.

steps.title: Flip and cook
steps.details: Flip patties with a spatula and continue grilling, covered, 4–5 minutes more until an instant-read thermometer inserted sideways into a center reads 160°F.

steps.title: Melt cheese
steps.details: Lay a slice of cheddar on each patty, close the lid, and heat about 1 minute until cheese is fully melted and draping over the edges.

steps.title: Toast buns
steps.details: Place split buns cut-side down on the grill, away from direct high heat, and toast 1–2 minutes until golden and warm. Watch closely so they do not burn.

steps.title: Rest and assemble
steps.details: Move patties to a clean platter and rest 2 minutes. Top each toasted bun with a patty, then lettuce, tomato, onion and pickles, and serve with ketchup and mustard.

recipe.title: Grilled Hot Dogs with Fixings
recipe.intro: Preheat a gas grill to medium (about 400°F) or light a charcoal chimney and spread coals when ashed over, about 15 minutes. Have a platter and tongs ready; set out buns and condiments so guests can build their own.
recipe.finish: Hot dogs are done when browned and lightly charred with an internal temperature of 160°F. Serve immediately in toasted buns with mustard, relish, and ketchup on the side for customization.

steps.title: Preheat grill
steps.details: Heat a gas grill to medium, about 400°F, with the lid closed, or let charcoal burn until coals are covered in gray ash, about 15 minutes. Brush the clean grates with oil using tongs and a folded paper towel.

steps.title: Set out condiments
steps.details: Spoon relish into a small bowl and set out mustard and ketchup with a serving platter for the finished hot dogs.

steps.title: Grill hot dogs
steps.details: Lay hot dogs on the oiled grates and grill, turning every 2 to 3 minutes, until browned and lightly charred all over and an instant-read thermometer reads 160°F, 6 to 10 minutes total.

steps.title: Toast buns
steps.details: During the last 2 minutes of grilling, place split buns cut-side down on the grates and toast until lightly golden, 1 to 2 minutes; watch closely so they don't burn.

steps.title: Assemble and serve
steps.details: Transfer each hot dog to a toasted bun and serve with mustard, relish, and ketchup for guests to add as they like.

generatedRecipes.title: Grilled Corn on the Cob with Herb Butter

recipe.title: Grilled Corn on the Cob with Herb Butter
recipe.intro: Soak corn in husks while the grill heats; soften herb butter at the same time. You need a grill (gas or charcoal), tongs, a small bowl, and foil or a plate for resting.
recipe.finish: Corn is done when husks are charred and the kernels are tender and steaming when a husk is pulled back. Serve hot with the remaining herb butter and lime wedges.

ingredients.name: fresh corn on the cob in husks
ingredients.prep: husks left on, silk trimmed at top

steps.title: Soak the corn
steps.details: Put the corn in a large pot or cooler and cover with cold water. Soak 20 minutes so the husks won't flare up on the grill.

steps.title: Heat the grill
steps.details: Light a gas grill to medium-high (about 400–450°F) or prepare a charcoal grill with a medium-high fire. Clean and oil the grates.

steps.title: Make the herb butter
steps.details: Mash the softened butter with the garlic, chopped herbs, 1/2 teaspoon salt, and 1/4 teaspoon pepper until evenly combined. Set aside.

steps.title: Grill the corn
steps.details: Drain the corn. Grill the ears in their husks, turning every 3–4 minutes, until the husks are charred in spots and the kernels are tender, 15–18 minutes total.

steps.title: Rest and husk
steps.details: Transfer the corn to a platter and let it rest 3 minutes. Pull back the husks and remove the silk; keep the husks as a handle.

steps.title: Butter and serve
steps.details: Brush or roll each hot ear in herb butter, season with a little more salt, and serve with lime wedges. Pass any remaining butter.

generatedRecipes.title: Red, White and Blue Potato Salad

recipe.title: Red, White and Blue Potato Salad
recipe.intro: Boil salted water in a large pot. You need a colander, a big bowl, and a whisk. No specialty gear. Serve chilled or cool; make up to a day ahead.
recipe.finish: The potatoes should be tender when pierced with a knife but still hold their shape, and the salad should be creamy and tangy with pockets of blue cheese. Taste and add salt or lemon before serving. Keep cold at the cookout; do not leave out over 2 hours.

ingredients.name: baby red and white potatoes
ingredients.prep: halve any larger than a golf ball

ingredients.name: scallions
ingredients.prep: thinly sliced, whites and greens separated

steps.title: Boil the potatoes
steps.details: Put the potatoes in a large pot, cover with cold water by 2 inches, add the 1 tbsp salt, and bring to a boil. Lower to a steady simmer and cook until a knife slides in easily, 12 to 15 minutes.

steps.title: Whisk the dressing
steps.details: While the potatoes cook, whisk the mayonnaise, sour cream, Dijon, vinegar, 1/2 tsp salt, and pepper in a large bowl until smooth. Stir in the scallion whites.

steps.title: Add scallion whites
steps.details: Stir the sliced scallion whites into the dressing so they soften slightly.

steps.title: Drain and cool potatoes
steps.details: Drain the potatoes in a colander and let them steam-dry for 5 minutes. Cut any large ones in half so they are bite-size.

steps.title: Fold potatoes into dressing
steps.details: Add the warm potatoes to the dressing and fold gently with a spatula until evenly coated.

steps.title: Chill the salad
steps.details: Cover and refrigerate until cold, at least 30 minutes, or up to 1 day.

steps.title: Top with blue cheese
steps.details: Just before serving, fold in half the blue cheese, then scatter the rest and the scallion greens on top.

recipe.title: Classic Creamy Coleslaw
recipe.intro: No cooking needed—just a sharp knife or box grater and a big bowl. If using a food processor, shred cabbage and carrots with the slicing disc. Chill the serving bowl so the slaw stays crisp on a hot day.
recipe.finish: Taste and adjust sugar, vinegar or salt to your liking. Serve chilled, within 2 hours if it sits out at the cookout, or keep it over ice. Store leftovers covered in the fridge up to 3 days; stir before serving.

ingredients.name: green cabbage
ingredients.prep: remove wilted outer leaves, cut into quarters, slice out core

steps.title: Shred the cabbage
steps.details: Thinly slice the cabbage quarters crosswise into shreds about 1/8 inch thick. Aim for about 8 cups loosely packed and put it in a large bowl.

steps.title: Grate the carrots
steps.details: Grate the carrots on the large holes of a box grater (about 1 cup). Add to the cabbage bowl.

steps.title: Mince the onion
steps.details: Mince the onion very finely so no big chunks remain; you want about 1/4 cup. Add to the bowl.

steps.title: Whisk the dressing
steps.details: In a small bowl, whisk the mayonnaise, vinegar, sugar, salt and pepper until smooth and the sugar dissolves. Taste; it should be creamy and a little sweet-tart.

steps.title: Toss slaw with dressing
steps.details: Pour the dressing over the cabbage mixture. Toss with tongs or clean hands until every shred is lightly coated, about 1 minute.

steps.title: Chill to meld
steps.details: Cover and refrigerate at least 30 minutes (up to 4 hours) so the flavors meld and the cabbage softens slightly while staying crisp.

steps.title: Check and serve
steps.details: Stir once more; if it looks dry, add 1 tablespoon mayonnaise. Taste for salt and vinegar, then serve cold.

recipe.title: Watermelon and Feta Salad
recipe.intro: No cooking required. Have a large serving bowl and a small whisk or jar ready. Chill the watermelon and feta beforehand if possible, and make the lime dressing first so the salad can be assembled just before serving.
recipe.finish: Serve immediately, or refrigerate up to 30 minutes before serving. The salad is best the day it is made; stir gently before serving if it has sat, and spoon off any excess liquid. Leftovers keep covered in the refrigerator up to 1 day, though the watermelon will soften.

ingredients.name: fresh mint leaves
ingredients.prep: loosely packed, then torn or thinly sliced

steps.title: Whisk lime dressing
steps.details: In a small bowl or jar, whisk or shake the lime juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper until evenly combined and slightly thickened. Set aside.

steps.title: Cube watermelon
steps.details: If not already done, cut the chilled watermelon into 1-inch cubes, discarding any rind, and place in a large serving bowl.

steps.title: Add feta and mint
steps.details: Scatter the crumbled feta and torn mint leaves over the watermelon.

steps.title: Dress and toss gently
steps.details: Drizzle the lime dressing over the salad and toss very gently with a large spoon just until the feta and mint are distributed; do not overmix or the watermelon will break down.

steps.title: Chill before serving
steps.details: Refrigerate the salad for 10 to 15 minutes to let the flavors meld and the salad stay cold for the cookout. Serve chilled.

recipe.title: Old-Fashioned Baked Beans
recipe.intro: Soak beans overnight, then simmer and bake for a deeply flavored side. Use a 3-quart Dutch oven or covered baking dish. Preheat oven to 325°F before baking.
recipe.finish: Beans should be tender and saucy; if too thick, stir in hot water. Let rest 10 minutes before serving. Great with grilled meats.

steps.title: Soak beans overnight
steps.details: In a large pot or bowl, combine beans and 8 cups water. Cover and let soak at room temperature 8 to 12 hours. Drain and rinse well.

steps.title: Cook bacon and onion
steps.details: In a skillet over medium heat, cook bacon until lightly browned, about 5 minutes. Add onion and cook until soft, about 5 minutes more. Do not drain.

steps.title: Simmer beans
steps.details: Put drained beans in a large pot and add enough fresh water to cover by 2 inches (about 6 cups). Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer uncovered until beans are tender, 45 to 60 minutes, skimming foam as needed. Drain, reserving 1 cup cooking liquid.

steps.title: Preheat oven
steps.details: Preheat oven to 325°F with rack in lower third.

steps.title: Combine beans with sauce
steps.details: In a 3-quart Dutch oven or baking dish, stir together the simmered beans, bacon-onion mixture, molasses, brown sugar, mustard, salt, pepper, and 1 cup reserved bean liquid (or hot water). Add up to 2 cups hot water if needed so beans are just covered.

steps.title: Bake covered
steps.details: Cover tightly and bake at 325°F for 1 hour.

steps.title: Bake uncovered
steps.details: Uncover and bake until beans are very tender and sauce is thickened, 30 to 45 minutes more. Check after 30 minutes; if too dry, add hot water a little at a time.

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.details: Let stand 10 minutes before serving. Taste and adjust salt if needed.

recipe.title: Cast-Iron Buttermilk Cornbread
recipe.intro: Position a rack in the center of the oven and preheat to 425°F (220°C). Put a 10-inch cast-iron skillet with 3 tablespoons of the butter in the oven to melt and heat while you mix the batter. Have a whisk, two bowls, and a spatula ready.
recipe.finish: The cornbread is done when the top is deep golden brown and the center springs back when lightly pressed, or a toothpick inserted in the center comes out with just a few moist crumbs, 22 to 26 minutes. Cool in the skillet 10 minutes, then run a knife around the edge and cut into wedges. Serve warm with extra butter.

steps.title: Heat skillet and butter
steps.details: Put the 10-inch cast-iron skillet with 3 tablespoons butter in the oven and preheat to 425°F (220°C). Let the skillet heat at least 15 minutes while you mix the batter; the butter should be melted and the skillet hot but not smoking.

steps.title: Whisk dry ingredients
steps.details: In a large bowl, whisk the cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt until evenly combined.

steps.title: Whisk wet ingredients
steps.details: In a second bowl, whisk the buttermilk, eggs, and melted 3 tablespoons butter until smooth and uniform.

steps.title: Combine into batter
steps.details: Pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients and fold gently with a spatula just until no dry streaks remain; the batter will be thick and slightly lumpy. Do not overmix.

steps.title: Swirl butter and add batter
steps.details: Carefully pull the hot skillet from the oven. Swirl the melted butter to coat the bottom and sides, then pour the excess melted butter into the batter and stir it in. Scrape the batter into the hot skillet and smooth the top.

steps.title: Bake until golden
steps.details: Bake at 425°F (220°C) until the top is deep golden and the center springs back when lightly pressed, 22 to 26 minutes. A toothpick in the center should come out with just a few moist crumbs.

steps.title: Cool and cut wedges
steps.details: Let the cornbread cool in the skillet 10 minutes, then run a knife around the edge and cut into wedges. Serve warm.

recipe.title: Flag Berry Trifle
recipe.intro: No-cook layered dessert for a crowd. You need a 3-quart glass trifle bowl or deep glass baking dish. Chill the bowl and cream in advance; wash and dry the berries. No oven needed.
recipe.finish: The trifle is best after at least 1 hour chilling so the cake softens slightly; serve within 6 hours. Spoon into bowls, keeping the flag design intact on top. Store leftovers covered in the refrigerator up to 24 hours.

ingredients.name: fresh strawberries
ingredients.prep: rinsed, hulled, half sliced lengthwise, half left whole or halved for top

steps.title: Whip the cream
steps.details: In a chilled large bowl, beat 2 cups heavy cream, 1/4 cup sugar, and 1 teaspoon vanilla with an electric mixer on medium-high until soft peaks form, about 2–3 minutes. Stop while peaks just bend over.

steps.title: Fold in mascarpone
steps.details: Add the softened mascarpone and beat on low just until smooth and thick, about 1 minute; do not overbeat or it may curdle. Refrigerate until layering.

steps.title: Build berry-and-cake base
steps.details: In the trifle bowl, spread a thin layer of whipped cream. Layer half the cake cubes, then half the sliced strawberries and half the blueberries; spoon over half the jam. Repeat with remaining cake, sliced strawberries, blueberries, and jam.

steps.title: Add whipped cream layer
steps.details: Spoon about two-thirds of the mascarpone whipped cream over the fruit and cake, spreading gently to the edges. Reserve remaining cream for the top.

steps.title: Chill the trifle
steps.details: Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour so the cake absorbs fruit juices and the layers set. Keep the reserved cream chilled.

steps.title: Make the flag topping
steps.details: Spoon the remaining whipped cream on top and smooth it. Arrange whole strawberries in the upper-left quarter for the blue field's stars, and lay blueberries in the remaining three bands in alternating rows to suggest stripes; or make a simple 3-band flag with strawberry rows, blueberry rows, and cream.

steps.title: Chill and serve
steps.details: Refrigerate 15–30 minutes to firm the topping, then serve cold. The cream should hold its shape and the cake should be moist but not mushy.

recipe.title: Fresh Lemonade
recipe.intro: No special equipment: a saucepan, a citrus juicer or reamer, a pitcher, and a long spoon. Chill the pitcher and glasses in the fridge or freezer while you work. Make the syrup first; it needs to cool before mixing so the lemonade stays crisp and cold.
recipe.finish: Taste and adjust: stir in 1 to 2 tablespoons more sugar if too tart, or a splash more lemon juice or water if too sweet. Serve over plenty of ice with lemon slices. Keep any leftovers covered in the fridge for up to 3 days and stir before serving.

steps.title: Make simple syrup
steps.details: Combine the sugar and 1 cup water in a small saucepan over medium heat. Stir until the sugar dissolves completely and the liquid turns clear, about 3–4 minutes; do not boil hard.

steps.title: Juice and strain lemons
steps.details: While the syrup heats, roll the lemons firmly on the counter, halve them, and juice until you have 1 cup. Strain out seeds and heavy pulp. This is your slack time while the syrup cooks.

steps.title: Cool the syrup
steps.details: Remove the syrup from the heat and let it sit off the burner until warm, not hot, about 15 minutes. Warm syrup is fine, but hot syrup will melt the ice too fast.

steps.title: Combine lemonade base
steps.details: Pour the cooled syrup and the strained lemon juice into a large pitcher. Add the 5 cups cold water and stir well to blend.

steps.title: Chill and add ice
steps.details: Add the ice and lemon slices to the pitcher, stir once, and refrigerate until thoroughly icy, about 20 minutes. Taste before serving and adjust sweetness or tartness as needed.

recipe.title: Classic Grilled Cheeseburgers
recipe.intro: Get ready: preheat a gas grill to medium-high (about 450°F) with the lid closed, or light a charcoal chimney and spread coals when ashed over. Have a platter, tongs, spatula, and a clean cutting board ready. Keep raw and cooked meat separate.
recipe.finish: Burgers are ready when the center reaches 160°F on an instant-read thermometer and juices run clear; do not judge by color alone. Let patties rest 2–3 minutes, then build on the toasted buns with lettuce, tomato, and onion. Serve warm.

ingredients.name: ground beef (80/20)
ingredients.prep: keep cold until ready to shape

steps.title: Preheat grill
steps.details: Heat a gas grill to medium-high, about 450°F, with the lid closed. For charcoal, light a chimney and spread ashed-over coals when ready.

steps.title: Prep toppings
steps.details: While the grill heats, rinse and dry lettuce, slice tomatoes and red onion, and soften the butter. Split the buns.

steps.title: Shape patties
steps.details: Divide the cold beef into 6 equal portions and gently form 3/4-inch-thick patties. Make a shallow thumb dimple in the center of each. Season both sides with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Butter buns
steps.details: Spread the softened butter on the cut sides of the buns and set them cut-side up near the grill.

steps.title: Grill patties
steps.details: Place patties on the hot grate over direct heat. Cover and cook 4–5 minutes on the first side until nicely browned.

steps.title: Flip and add cheese
steps.details: Flip patties and cook 4–5 minutes more. After 2 minutes, top each with a cheddar slice, close the lid, and cook until cheese melts and the center reads 160°F.

steps.title: Toast buns
steps.details: While the burgers finish, place buns cut-side down on the cooler edge of the grill for 1–2 minutes until golden. Watch closely to prevent burning.

steps.title: Rest burgers
steps.details: Transfer cooked patties to a clean platter and rest 2–3 minutes. Stack buns and toppings nearby for building.

recipe.title: Grilled BBQ Chicken Drumsticks
recipe.intro: Great for a picnic: cook drumsticks over indirect heat first, then glaze over direct heat. You need a grill with a lid, tongs, and an instant-read thermometer. Light a charcoal chimney or preheat a gas grill 10-15 minutes while you season the chicken.
recipe.finish: Drumsticks are done when the thickest part reads 175F (79C) and juices run clear, with no pink at the bone. Rest 5 minutes, then pile on a platter and serve warm or at room temperature. Keep any extra glaze separate for dipping.

steps.title: Heat the grill
steps.details: Light charcoal and let it ash over, or preheat a gas grill on high with the lid down. Set up two zones: hot coals on one side, empty on the other, or burners on one side only. Target 375-400F (190-205C) with the lid on.

steps.title: Season the drumsticks
steps.details: In a large bowl, toss the drumsticks with oil, salt, pepper, and smoked paprika until evenly coated.

steps.title: Make the glaze
steps.details: Stir together 3/4 cup barbecue sauce and the honey in a small bowl; set aside for glazing. Keep the remaining 1/4 cup sauce plain for serving.

steps.title: Grill over indirect heat
steps.details: Place drumsticks on the cooler side of the grill, close the lid, and cook 20 minutes. Turn once halfway through. Keep the lid closed between turns to hold heat.

steps.title: Turn and check temperature
steps.details: Turn the drumsticks and check the thickest one with an instant-read thermometer; it should read about 150-160F (65-71C). Continue cooking on the cool side if below.

steps.title: Grill over direct heat
steps.details: Move drumsticks to the hot side and grill 8-10 minutes, turning every 2-3 minutes, until browned and the thickest part reads 175F (79C). Move back to the cool side if flare-ups occur.

steps.title: Glaze the drumsticks
steps.details: Brush generously with the honey barbecue glaze, turning and brushing all sides. Grill 2-3 minutes over direct heat until sticky and set, watching closely so the sugars do not burn.

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.details: Transfer drumsticks to a platter and rest 5 minutes. Serve with the reserved plain barbecue sauce alongside.

recipe.title: Creamy Potato Salad
recipe.intro: Boil whole potatoes until tender, then cool slightly while you prep the crunchy vegetables and dressing. A 4-quart pot and a large mixing bowl are all you need.
recipe.finish: Chill at least 1 hour before serving for best flavor. Keep cold at the picnic (below 40°F); do not leave out more than 2 hours.

ingredients.name: Yukon Gold or red potatoes
ingredients.prep: scrub, leave whole, halve any larger than a golf ball

ingredients.name: red onion
ingredients.prep: finely diced, rinsed under cold water

steps.title: Boil the potatoes
steps.details: Put potatoes in a large pot and cover with 1 inch cold water; add 1 tbsp salt. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a gentle simmer and cook 15–20 minutes until a knife slides in with no resistance.

steps.title: Prep vegetables
steps.details: While potatoes cook, slice celery and finely dice the rinsed red onion. Set both aside in a large bowl.

steps.title: Make the dressing
steps.details: In a small bowl, whisk mayonnaise, sour cream, mustard, vinegar, salt, and pepper until smooth. Refrigerate until needed.

steps.title: Cool and peel potatoes
steps.details: Drain potatoes and let stand 5 minutes until cool enough to handle. Peel if desired, then cut into 3/4-inch chunks.

steps.title: Dress warm potatoes
steps.details: Add warm potato chunks to the celery and onion bowl. Pour dressing over and fold gently with a spatula until evenly coated.

steps.title: Fold in eggs and herbs
steps.details: Gently fold in chopped hard-boiled eggs and chives. Taste and adjust salt and pepper.

steps.title: Chill before serving
steps.details: Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour to let flavors meld. Serve cold.

generatedRecipes.title: Corn on the Cob with Herb Butter

recipe.title: Corn on the Cob with Herb Butter
recipe.intro: Fresh sweet corn brushed with parsley-chive butter. Use a large pot for boiling or a grill for charred corn. Soften the butter and chop the herbs while the water heats.
recipe.finish: Corn is done when kernels are tender and bright yellow, 4–6 minutes after the water returns to a boil; grilled corn should have light char spots on all sides. Brush generously with herb butter and serve warm with extra butter and salt.

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.prep: plus more for water and serving

steps.title: Boil the water
steps.details: Fill a large pot about two-thirds full with water and add 1 tbsp salt. Cover and bring to a rolling boil over high heat; this can take 8–10 minutes.

steps.title: Make the herb butter
steps.details: In a small bowl, mash the softened butter with the chopped parsley, chives, 1/2 tsp salt and black pepper until evenly combined. Set aside.

steps.title: Husk and clean the corn
steps.details: Pull back the husks, remove all silks, and snap off the stems. Rinse the ears and set them on a platter.

steps.title: Boil the corn
steps.details: Gently lower the ears into the boiling water. Return to a boil and cook 4–6 minutes, until kernels are tender when pierced with a knife. Do not overcook.

steps.title: Drain the corn
steps.details: Carefully transfer the corn to a platter with tongs and let it drain briefly.

steps.title: Butter and serve
steps.details: Brush each ear all over with the herb butter, sprinkle lightly with salt if desired, and serve warm with any remaining butter.

recipe.title: Classic Coleslaw
recipe.intro: No cooking required; use a sharp knife or box grater. A food processor with a shredding disc speeds things up. Have a large bowl and a small bowl ready.
recipe.finish: Coleslaw is best after at least 30 minutes of chilling so the cabbage softens slightly and the flavors meld. Stir once more before serving; taste and adjust salt and sugar. Keep cold at the picnic (under 40°F) and serve within 2 hours if it sits out.

ingredients.name: green cabbage
ingredients.prep: remove outer leaves, quarter, cut out core

steps.title: Shred the cabbage
steps.details: Thinly slice the cabbage quarters with a sharp knife or shred on the large holes of a box grater into a large bowl. Aim for pieces about 1/8 inch thick for a crunchy texture.

steps.title: Grate the carrots
steps.details: Grate the carrots on the large holes of a box grater and add them to the cabbage.

steps.title: Whisk the dressing
steps.details: In a small bowl, whisk the mayonnaise, vinegar, sugar, salt and pepper until smooth and pourable.

steps.title: Toss and chill
steps.details: Pour the dressing over the cabbage and carrots and toss well to coat every shred. Cover and refrigerate at least 30 minutes, or up to 8 hours, before serving.

generatedRecipes.title: Watermelon and Feta Salad with Mint

recipe.title: Watermelon and Feta Salad with Mint
recipe.intro: Chill the watermelon thoroughly before starting. You will need a cutting board, a sharp knife, a large bowl, and a small whisk or fork. No cooking required; keep the finished salad cold until serving.
recipe.finish: The salad is ready when the melon is cold, the feta is evenly scattered, and the mint smells fresh. Serve immediately, or cover and refrigerate for up to 1 hour. Do not let it sit longer or the melon will water down the dressing.

steps.title: Cut the watermelon
steps.details: Cut the chilled seedless watermelon into 1-inch chunks and place them in a large bowl. Remove any stray seeds.

steps.title: Whisk the dressing
steps.details: In a small bowl, whisk the olive oil, lime juice, flaky sea salt, and black pepper until combined.

steps.title: Slice the mint
steps.details: Thinly slice the fresh mint leaves and set aside.

steps.title: Toss the watermelon
steps.details: Drizzle the dressing over the watermelon and gently toss with a large spoon until the chunks are lightly coated.

steps.title: Add feta and mint
steps.details: Scatter the crumbled feta and sliced mint over the dressed watermelon. Gently fold once or twice, keeping the feta in visible pieces.

steps.title: Chill until serving
steps.details: Cover and refrigerate the salad until cold, at least 10 minutes and up to 1 hour. Keep chilled until ready to serve at the picnic.

recipe.title: Classic Deviled Eggs
recipe.intro: Hard-cook the eggs in advance or start them first; they need to cool fully before peeling and filling. Use a pot large enough to hold the eggs in a single layer. Have a piping bag or zip-top bag ready for filling.
recipe.finish: Serve chilled or at cool room temperature. Sprinkle with paprika just before serving. Keep leftovers refrigerated within 2 hours and use within 2 days.

steps.title: Boil the eggs
steps.details: Place eggs in a single layer in a pot and cover with 1 inch of cold water. Bring to a rolling boil over high heat, then cover, remove from heat, and let stand 12 minutes for firm yolks.

steps.title: Ice bath and peel
steps.details: Transfer eggs to a bowl of ice water for at least 10 minutes, then tap and peel under cool running water. Pat dry.

steps.title: Halve eggs and separate yolks
steps.details: Halve eggs lengthwise with a clean knife. Gently pop yolks into a medium bowl and arrange whites cut-side up on a serving platter.

steps.title: Mash yolks smooth
steps.details: Mash the yolks with a fork until no lumps remain. Press against the bowl to make a smooth paste.

steps.title: Mix the filling
steps.details: Add mayonnaise, mustard, vinegar, salt, and pepper to the yolks. Stir until creamy and uniform; taste and adjust salt.

steps.title: Fill the egg whites
steps.details: Spoon or pipe the yolk mixture into the whites, mounding slightly. Use a zip-top bag with a corner snipped for neat filling.

steps.title: Garnish and chill
steps.details: Dust with paprika and scatter chives if using. Refrigerate at least 15 minutes before serving for best flavor and firmness.

recipe.title: Cornmeal Buttermilk Biscuits
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C) with a rack in the middle. Have a baking sheet ready, a 2½-inch round cutter (or a drinking glass), and a pastry blender or two knives. Measure the dry ingredients while the oven heats.
recipe.finish: Biscuits are done when golden brown on top and the sides look set and dry. Cool on the pan 2 minutes, then transfer to a rack or basket. Serve warm or at room temperature for the picnic; wrap cooled biscuits in a clean towel to keep them tender.

ingredients.name: cold unsalted butter
ingredients.prep: cut into small cubes, keep chilled

ingredients.name: cold buttermilk
ingredients.prep: shake well; plus 1 tbsp for brushing

steps.title: Heat oven and whisk dry mix
steps.details: Heat oven to 425°F (220°C). In a large bowl, whisk the flour, cornmeal, baking powder, baking soda, salt and sugar until evenly combined.

steps.title: Cut in cold butter
steps.details: Add the cold cubed butter and toss to coat. Cut it in with a pastry blender or two knives until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs with some pea-size butter bits remaining.

steps.title: Stir in buttermilk
steps.details: Pour in ¾ cup cold buttermilk and stir gently with a fork just until the dough comes together and no dry flour remains. It will be shaggy and slightly sticky; do not overmix.

steps.title: Fold and pat dough
steps.details: Turn dough onto a lightly floured counter. Pat into a rough 1-inch-thick rectangle, fold it in half, and pat again to 1 inch thick. Repeat the fold once more, then pat to a final 1-inch thickness.

steps.title: Cut out biscuits
steps.details: Dip a 2½-inch cutter in flour and press straight down into the dough without twisting. Cut as many rounds as possible, gently reroll scraps once, and place biscuits 1 inch apart on an ungreased baking sheet.

steps.title: Brush tops with buttermilk
steps.details: Brush the tops lightly with the extra 1 tbsp buttermilk so they brown evenly.

steps.title: Bake until golden
steps.details: Bake on the middle rack for 14–17 minutes, until risen, golden brown on top and set on the sides. Check at 14 minutes and rotate the pan once if browning unevenly.

steps.title: Brush with melted butter
steps.details: Remove from the oven and immediately brush the hot tops with the 1 tbsp melted butter. Cool in the pan 2 minutes, then serve warm or transfer to a rack.

recipe.title: Fresh Berry Shortcakes
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 425°F with a rack in the middle. Have a baking sheet, mixing bowls, and a whisk or hand mixer ready. Use ripe summer berries; strawberries hulled and sliced, blueberries and raspberries left whole.
recipe.finish: Biscuits are best the day they are made. Split and fill just before serving so they stay crisp. Any leftover macerated berries spoon over ice cream.

ingredients.name: fresh mixed berries
ingredients.prep: hull and slice strawberries; leave blueberries and raspberries whole

steps.title: Macerate the berries
steps.details: In a bowl, toss berries with 3 tbsp sugar and the lemon juice. Let stand at room temperature, stirring once, until juicy and softened, about 20 minutes.

steps.title: Preheat the oven
steps.details: Heat oven to 425°F with a rack in the middle while the berries macerate.

steps.title: Mix dry ingredients
steps.details: Whisk flour, baking powder, 3 tbsp sugar, and salt in a large bowl.

steps.title: Cut in butter
steps.details: Add cold butter cubes and rub or cut in until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs with a few pea-size pieces.

steps.title: Add milk and shape
steps.details: Pour in 3/4 cup cold milk and stir just until a soft dough forms. Turn onto a floured surface, pat to 1 inch thick, and cut into 6 rounds. Place on an ungreased baking sheet, brush tops with milk, and sprinkle lightly with sugar.

steps.title: Bake the biscuits
