recipe.intro: Warm, gently spiced cider for a crowd. Use a large pot or slow cooker and a vegetable peeler for the orange peel. No specialty equipment needed. Keep the cider at a bare simmer — never a hard boil — so it stays clear and aromatic.
recipe.finish: Ladle into mugs, leaving the whole spices and orange peel behind (strain if you like). Serve hot with a cinnamon stick or orange slice garnish. Cool leftovers within 2 hours, refrigerate up to 4 days, and reheat to steaming before serving.

ingredients.name: apple cider
ingredients.prep: shake or stir; use fresh unfiltered or clear cider

ingredients.name: orange
ingredients.prep: scrub, then peel 3 wide strips with a vegetable peeler, avoiding white pith

steps.title: Peel the orange
steps.details: Scrub the orange and peel 3 wide strips with a vegetable peeler, pressing lightly to avoid the bitter white pith. Reserve the fruit for another use.

steps.title: Warm the cider
steps.details: Pour the cider into a large pot and set over medium heat. Warm uncovered until steam rises and small bubbles appear at the pot's edge, about 8 minutes; do not let it boil.

steps.title: Add the spices
steps.details: Add the orange peel, cinnamon sticks, cloves, and nutmeg to the warming cider.

steps.title: Simmer gently
steps.details: Reduce heat to low and keep at a bare simmer, 180–190°F, with just a few lazy bubbles, uncovered, for 20 minutes so the spices infuse. If it starts to boil, lower the heat.

steps.title: Sweeten and taste
steps.details: Stir in the honey or maple syrup, starting with 1 tbsp, then taste. Add more only if the cider is tart. Simmer 3 more minutes to blend.

steps.title: Strain and serve
steps.details: Turn off the heat. Fish out the orange peel and whole spices with a slotted spoon or strain into a pitcher. Ladle hot cider into mugs and garnish with a cinnamon stick or orange slice.

recipe.title: Pea and Mint Crostini
recipe.intro: Fresh spring starter: crisp baguette toasts topped with bright smashed peas, mint and lemon. You will need a rimmed baking sheet, a small saucepan, a fork or potato masher, and a zester. Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C) while you blanch the peas and slice the bread.
recipe.finish: Toasts should be crisp and golden at the edges, and the pea topping bright green and thick enough to mound on a spoon. Assemble just before serving so the bread stays crisp. Arrange on a platter and finish with a light drizzle of olive oil if you like.

ingredients.name: baguette
ingredients.prep: sliced on the bias into 12 slices about 1/2 inch thick

steps.title: Heat oven and slice bread
steps.details: Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C) with a rack in the middle. Slice the baguette on the bias into 12 pieces about 1/2 inch thick. Arrange on a rimmed baking sheet in a single layer.

steps.title: Blanch the peas
steps.details: Bring a small saucepan of water to a boil. Add the frozen peas and cook 2 to 3 minutes, until tender and bright green. Drain immediately and rinse briefly under cold water to stop the cooking; drain well.

steps.title: Brush and toast baguette
steps.details: Brush both sides of the bread slices with 2 tbsp of the olive oil. Bake 8 to 10 minutes, turning once, until crisp and lightly golden at the edges. Watch closely near the end so they do not burn.

steps.title: Smash the peas
steps.details: In a bowl, mash the drained peas with a fork or potato masher until broken down but still chunky. Stir in the chopped mint, lemon zest, lemon juice, salt, pepper, remaining 1 tbsp olive oil, and Parmesan if using. Taste and adjust salt and lemon.

steps.title: Top the toasts
steps.details: Spoon the pea mixture generously onto the warm toasts, mounding it slightly. Serve right away while the bread is crisp.

generatedRecipes.title: Asparagus and Radish Salad with Lemon Vinaigrette

recipe.title: Asparagus and Radish Salad with Lemon Vinaigrette
recipe.intro: Crisp spring vegetables tossed in a light citrus dressing with shaved Parmesan. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil, fill a bowl with ice water, and have a colander ready. Whisk the dressing while the water heats.
recipe.finish: Toss the chilled vegetables with the dressing and radishes just before serving, then top with shaved Parmesan and black pepper. Serve immediately while crisp; the salad is best the day it is made.

ingredients.name: asparagus
ingredients.prep: trim woody ends, cut into 2-inch pieces

steps.title: Boil water and make dressing
steps.details: Fill a large pot with water, salt it generously, and bring to a boil over high heat. While it heats, whisk the olive oil, lemon juice, Dijon, honey, 1/2 tsp salt, and 1/4 tsp pepper in a small bowl until smooth and slightly thickened.

steps.title: Blanch the asparagus
steps.details: Add the asparagus to the boiling water and cook until bright green and crisp-tender, 2 to 3 minutes. It should bend slightly without being soft.

steps.title: Shock in ice water
steps.details: Use a slotted spoon or tongs to transfer the asparagus straight into the bowl of ice water. Chill for 3 minutes to stop cooking and set the color, then drain well and pat dry.

steps.title: Slice the radishes
steps.details: While the asparagus cooks and chills, thinly slice the radishes with a knife or mandoline. Keep them crisp in a bowl of cold water if not using right away, then drain and pat dry.

steps.title: Shave the Parmesan
steps.details: Use a vegetable peeler to shave the Parmesan into thin curls. Set aside in a small bowl.

steps.title: Toss with vinaigrette
steps.details: In a large serving bowl, combine the drained, dried asparagus and radishes. Pour over the dressing and toss gently until evenly coated.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.details: Top with the shaved Parmesan and a little more black pepper. Taste and add salt if needed, then serve right away.

generatedRecipes.title: Herbed Roast Chicken with Spring Vegetables

recipe.title: Herbed Roast Chicken with Spring Vegetables
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Have a roasting pan or large ovenproof skillet and a small bowl ready. Pat the chicken dry and let it sit out while you prep the vegetables.
recipe.finish: The chicken is done when the thickest part of the thigh reads 165°F (74°C) and juices run clear. Rest 10 minutes before carving, then serve with the vegetables and pan juices spooned over.

steps.title: Season the chicken
steps.details: Rub chicken all over with 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp herbs, 1 tsp salt, and 1/4 tsp pepper. Place lemon halves inside the cavity.

steps.title: Toss the vegetables
steps.details: In the roasting pan, toss potatoes and carrots with remaining 1 tbsp oil, 1 tbsp herbs, 1/4 tsp salt, and 1/4 tsp pepper.

steps.title: Place chicken on vegetables
steps.details: Set the seasoned chicken breast-side up on top of the vegetables in the pan.

steps.title: Roast the chicken
steps.details: Roast uncovered at 425°F for 50 minutes, until the thigh reads 165°F in its thickest part and the skin is golden.

steps.title: Add the peas
steps.details: Scatter frozen peas around the chicken and stir them into the hot vegetables and pan juices.

steps.title: Rest and check doneness
steps.details: Remove chicken to a board and rest 10 minutes. Check vegetables are fork-tender; return pan to oven briefly if needed.

steps.title: Carve and serve
steps.details: Carve chicken, squeeze over roasted lemon if desired, and serve with the vegetables and pan juices.

recipe.title: Salmon with Dill Butter
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment or lightly oil it. Have a small saucepan and a fork or pastry brush ready. Pat the salmon dry and check for pin bones.
recipe.finish: Salmon is done when it is opaque at the edges and flakes easily with a fork at the thickest part, or registers 145°F (63°C) in the center. Spoon the warm dill butter over the fillets and serve immediately with lemon wedges.

ingredients.name: salmon fillets, skin on or off
ingredients.prep: pat dry, remove pin bones, season with salt and pepper

ingredients.name: fresh dill
ingredients.prep: finely chopped, plus extra sprigs for garnish

steps.title: Preheat oven and prep salmon
steps.details: Set oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment. Pat the salmon dry, remove any pin bones, and place fillets skin-side down with space between them. Sprinkle with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Make dill lemon butter
steps.details: In a small saucepan over low heat, melt the butter with the dill, lemon juice, lemon zest, a pinch of salt and a pinch of pepper. Stir gently for 1 minute until fragrant, then remove from heat and keep warm off the burner.

steps.title: Bake salmon
steps.details: Place salmon in the preheated oven and bake until just opaque and flaking at the thickest part, about 12–15 minutes depending on thickness. Check at 12 minutes; it should reach 145°F (63°C) in the center.

steps.title: Warm butter and plate
steps.details: Reheat the dill butter gently if needed, then spoon it over the hot salmon fillets. Garnish with dill sprigs and serve with lemon wedges.

recipe.title: Buttered New Potatoes with Chives
recipe.intro: Use a large pot and a colander. Scrub the potatoes well; no need to peel. Snip the chives while the potatoes cook.
recipe.finish: Potatoes should be fork-tender with no resistance at the center. Toss gently so they stay whole, taste and adjust salt, and serve warm.

steps.title: Boil the potatoes
steps.details: Put the potatoes in a large pot, add water to cover by 1 inch and the 1 tablespoon salt. Bring to a boil, then simmer 15 to 18 minutes, until a knife slides into the largest potato with no resistance.

steps.title: Snip the chives
steps.details: While the potatoes boil, snip the chives into small pieces and set aside.

steps.title: Melt the butter
steps.details: In a small saucepan over low heat, melt the butter gently; keep warm without browning.

steps.title: Drain the potatoes
steps.details: Drain the potatoes in a colander and let them steam-dry for 2 minutes. Return them to the dry pot.

steps.title: Butter and season
steps.details: Add the melted butter, 1/4 teaspoon salt and pepper to the pot. Toss gently until the potatoes are evenly coated.

steps.title: Add chives and serve
steps.details: Scatter the chives over the potatoes, toss once and transfer to a serving dish. Serve warm.

generatedRecipes.title: Spring Onion and Cheddar Quick Bread

recipe.title: Spring Onion and Cheddar Quick Bread
recipe.intro: A savory, tender loaf with scallions and sharp cheddar. You'll need a 9x5-inch loaf pan, two mixing bowls, a whisk, a box grater, and a rubber spatula. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C) and grease the loaf pan while you prep ingredients.
recipe.finish: Cool the loaf in the pan 10 minutes, then turn out onto a rack to cool at least 20 more minutes before slicing. The bread is done when a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean and the top springs back when gently pressed. Slice with a serrated knife and serve warm or at room temperature.

ingredients.name: spring onions (scallions)
ingredients.prep: trim and thinly slice, whites and greens kept together

ingredients.name: large eggs
ingredients.prep: crack into a small bowl and beat lightly

steps.title: Preheat and prep
steps.details: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Grease a 9x5-inch loaf pan with 1 tbsp butter or nonstick spray. Meanwhile, shred the cheddar, slice the spring onions, and melt 1/4 cup butter; let it cool slightly so it won't cook the eggs.

steps.title: Whisk dry ingredients
steps.details: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, salt, and black pepper until evenly combined.

steps.title: Combine milk, eggs, and butter
steps.details: In a medium bowl, whisk the milk and beaten eggs until smooth, then whisk in the cooled melted butter.

steps.title: Add cheese and onions
steps.details: Toss the shredded cheddar and sliced spring onions into the dry ingredients, reserving a small handful of cheese and greens for the top if you like.

steps.title: Fold batter together
steps.details: Pour the milk mixture into the dry ingredients. Fold gently with a rubber spatula just until no dry streaks remain; the batter will be thick and lumpy, and overmixing will make the loaf tough.

steps.title: Fill pan and top
steps.details: Scrape the batter into the greased pan and smooth the top. Sprinkle with any reserved cheddar and spring onion greens.

steps.title: Bake the loaf
steps.details: Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 45–50 minutes, until the top is golden and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. If the top browns too fast, tent loosely with foil after 35 minutes.

steps.title: Cool in pan
steps.details: Set the pan on a rack and let the loaf cool 10 minutes, then run a knife around the edges and turn it out onto the rack.

steps.title: Cool and slice
steps.details: Cool at least 20 more minutes before slicing with a serrated knife so the crumb sets. Serve warm or at room temperature.

recipe.title: Honey-Lavender Shortbread Cookies
recipe.intro: Let butter soften at room temperature for 30–45 minutes. Preheat oven to 325°F (165°C) with a rack in the middle. Line two baking sheets with parchment. Have a 2-inch round cookie cutter ready. Use only culinary-grade lavender; too much lavender makes cookies soapy.
recipe.finish: Cookies are done when edges are pale golden and centers look set but soft, 14–16 minutes. Cool on the sheet 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely, about 20 minutes. Store airtight up to 5 days.

ingredients.name: dried culinary lavender buds
ingredients.prep: finely crushed, plus extra for garnish if desired

ingredients.name: all-purpose flour
ingredients.prep: whisked and measured by spooning into cup

steps.title: Crush lavender
steps.details: Crush the culinary lavender buds with your fingers or a small mortar and pestle until fragrant and fine. Set aside.

steps.title: Cream butter and sugar
steps.details: In a large bowl, beat softened butter and powdered sugar with a hand mixer on medium until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes, scraping the bowl once.

steps.title: Beat in honey and flavorings
steps.details: Beat in honey, crushed lavender, vanilla, and salt until evenly combined, about 1 minute. Scrape the bowl.

steps.title: Mix in flour
steps.details: Add flour in two additions on low speed, mixing only until no dry streaks remain. Dough should be soft and slightly sticky.

steps.title: Chill dough
steps.details: Gather dough into a flat disk, wrap in plastic, and refrigerate until firm enough to roll, 30–40 minutes.

steps.title: Preheat oven and roll dough
steps.details: Heat oven to 325°F (165°C). Roll chilled dough between two sheets of parchment to 1/4-inch thickness. If dough cracks, let it stand 5 minutes and re-roll.

steps.title: Cut and arrange rounds
steps.details: Cut 2-inch rounds with a floured cutter, re-rolling scraps once. Place 1 inch apart on lined baking sheets. Sprinkle lightly with granulated sugar.

steps.title: Bake until pale golden
steps.details: Bake one sheet at a time on the middle rack until edges are pale golden and centers are set, 14–16 minutes. Rotate the sheet halfway through.

steps.title: Cool and finish
steps.details: Let cookies cool on the baking sheet 5 minutes, then move to a wire rack to cool completely, about 20 minutes. Sprinkle with a few extra lavender buds if desired.

recipe.title: Strawberry-Rhubarb Fool
recipe.intro: No special equipment needed beyond a saucepan, a bowl, and six small glasses. Have the cream and glasses well chilled. This can be made ahead and chilled; whip the cream just before serving if you like.
recipe.finish: Spoon or pipe the fool into chilled glasses, alternating fruit and cream for visible layers and ending with a cream swirl. Serve cool, within 1 hour of final assembly for the best texture; refrigerate leftovers up to 2 days.

ingredients.name: fresh rhubarb stalks
ingredients.prep: trimmed and cut into 1/2-inch pieces (about 3 cups)

steps.title: Cook rhubarb with sugar
steps.details: In a medium saucepan combine rhubarb, 1/2 cup granulated sugar, lemon juice and salt. Cook over medium heat, stirring often, until the rhubarb softens and releases its juices, about 8 minutes.

steps.title: Add strawberries and simmer
steps.details: Stir in the strawberries and remaining 1/4 cup granulated sugar. Simmer gently, stirring, until the strawberries soften and the mixture is saucy but still has some fruit pieces, about 6 minutes.

steps.title: Cool the fruit mixture
steps.details: Remove from heat and let cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then transfer to a bowl and refrigerate until cold, at least 20 minutes.

steps.title: Whip the cream
steps.details: In a chilled bowl, whip the heavy cream, powdered sugar and vanilla with a whisk or electric mixer to soft peaks, about 3 minutes. Stop when the whisk leaves a soft, droopy trail.

steps.title: Fold fruit into cream
steps.details: Gently fold about one-third of the chilled fruit into the whipped cream until just streaked, 4 or 5 turns; keep the rest of the fruit for layering.

steps.title: Layer into glasses
steps.details: Spoon alternating layers of the reserved fruit and the fruit-cream into six small glasses, ending with a swirl of cream. Serve cool.

recipe.title: Sparkling Elderflower Lemonade
recipe.intro: No cooking required, just chilling and mixing. You need a large 2½-quart pitcher, a citrus juicer or reamer, a long spoon, and a knife. Chill the sparkling water and elderflower syrup ahead so the drink stays cold.
recipe.finish: Serve immediately over ice while the bubbles are lively. Stir gently once more before pouring, since the syrup settles. If making ahead, keep the lemon-syrup base chilled and add sparkling water and ice just before serving.

ingredients.name: lemons
ingredients.prep: roll on counter, then juice to get ¾ cup; slice one lemon for garnish

ingredients.name: elderflower syrup
ingredients.prep: measure from bottle, chilled if possible

ingredients.name: cold sparkling water or club soda
ingredients.prep: chill thoroughly, open just before use

ingredients.name: fresh mint
ingredients.prep: rinse and set aside for garnish

steps.title: Juice and slice lemons
steps.details: Roll the lemons firmly on the counter, then juice them until you have ¾ cup of juice. Slice half of one lemon into thin rounds for garnish and set the slices aside.

steps.title: Mix lemon base
steps.details: In the pitcher, stir together the ¾ cup lemon juice, ¾ cup elderflower syrup, and ¼ cup sugar until the sugar dissolves, about 1 minute. Taste: it should be tart-sweet and a bit stronger than you want the final drink, because ice and sparkling water will dilute it. Add a little more sugar if needed.

steps.title: Add cold water and chill
steps.details: Stir in 2 cups cold water. Refrigerate the pitcher until completely cold, at least 20 minutes, or up to 4 hours. Keep the sparkling water and ice cold meanwhile.

steps.title: Add ice and fizz
steps.details: Just before serving, add 4 cups ice and the 4 cups cold sparkling water to the chilled pitcher. Stir very gently, only 2 or 3 turns, to combine without knocking out the bubbles.

steps.title: Garnish and serve
steps.details: Fill glasses with fresh ice, pour the lemonade, and garnish each glass with a lemon slice and a sprig of mint. Serve right away.

recipe.title: Fresh Mint Iced Tea
recipe.intro: Use a medium saucepan, a 2-quart pitcher, and a fine-mesh strainer. No specialty gear needed. Start the tea concentrate first, then steep the mint while it cools slightly; chill with ice and serve over more ice.
recipe.finish: Strain out the tea bags and mint, then taste. The tea should be clear amber with a bright mint aroma; add a squeeze of lemon if you like. Serve over plenty of ice and garnish with fresh mint sprigs. Keep chilled and use within 2 days.

ingredients.name: black tea bags
ingredients.prep: tags removed or left for easy removal

ingredients.name: fresh mint leaves, loosely packed
ingredients.prep: rinsed, plus extra sprigs for serving

ingredients.name: lemon
ingredients.prep: cut into wedges, optional for serving

steps.title: Bring water to boil
steps.details: Pour 6 cups of the cold water into a medium saucepan and set over high heat. Bring to a rolling boil, about 5–6 minutes; watch so it does not boil over.

steps.title: Rinse and measure mint
steps.details: While the water heats, rinse the mint leaves and loosely pack 1 cup, leaving the rest as sprigs for garnish.

steps.title: Steep tea and mint
steps.details: Turn off the heat. Add the tea bags and mint leaves to the hot water, cover, and steep 5 minutes. Do not steep longer than 7 minutes or the tea turns bitter.

steps.title: Stir in honey
steps.details: Remove the tea bags and mint with a slotted spoon or strainer, pressing gently. Stir the honey into the hot tea until fully dissolved, about 1 minute.

steps.title: Add remaining cold water
steps.details: Pour the hot tea concentrate into a 2-quart pitcher. Add the remaining 2 cups cold water and stir once.

steps.title: Chill pitcher with ice
steps.details: Add the ice cubes to the pitcher and stir gently for 1–2 minutes until the tea is cold, about 40°F. If serving later, chill the covered pitcher in the refrigerator instead for at least 2 hours.

steps.title: Taste and serve
steps.details: Taste the chilled tea; it should be bright and lightly sweet. Adjust with a little more honey if needed. Pour over fresh ice, garnish with mint sprigs, and offer lemon wedges on the side.

recipe.title: Grilled Burger Sliders
recipe.intro: Preheat a gas grill to medium-high (about 400°F) or light a charcoal grill. Have a large rimmed tray and a spatula ready. Keep raw beef cold until grilling and wash hands after handling it.
recipe.finish: Sliders are safe when the center reaches 160°F and juices run clear, about 5–7 minutes total. Rest 2 minutes, then set patties on buns with toppings and serve warm; hold cooked sliders covered if guests graze.

steps.title: Preheat grill
steps.details: Heat a gas grill to medium-high, about 400°F, with the lid closed, 10–15 minutes. For charcoal, light coals and wait until covered with gray ash.

steps.title: Prep toppings and buns
steps.details: While the grill heats, rinse and dry lettuce, slice tomatoes, drain pickles, split buns, and set out ketchup and mayonnaise. Keep toppings on a tray away from raw beef.

steps.title: Season beef mixture
steps.details: In a bowl, gently mix cold ground beef with salt, pepper, and Worcestershire just until combined; do not overwork. Divide into 12 equal portions.

steps.title: Form slider patties
steps.details: Shape each portion into a loose ball, then press into a patty about 1/2 inch thick and slightly wider than the buns. Make a shallow dimple in the center of each and place patties on a tray.

steps.title: Grill patties first side
steps.details: Oil the hot grill grates lightly. Place patties with space between them and grill undisturbed with the lid closed for 3 minutes, until browned and easy to release.

steps.title: Flip and add cheese
steps.details: Flip patties with a spatula. If using cheese, top each patty now. Grill with the lid closed for 2–4 minutes more, until the center reaches 160°F and juices run clear.

steps.title: Toast buns
steps.details: Move cooked patties to a clean tray to rest. Place split buns cut-side down on the grill for 30–60 seconds, until lightly toasted; watch closely so they do not burn.

steps.title: Rest patties
steps.details: Let patties rest off the heat for 2 minutes so juices settle. Meanwhile set out toasted buns and toppings.

steps.title: Assemble sliders
steps.details: Place a patty on each bun bottom, add lettuce, tomato, pickles, and a little ketchup and mayonnaise, then cap with the bun top. Serve warm to poolside guests.

recipe.title: Lemon Herb Grilled Chicken Skewers
recipe.intro: Soak 12 bamboo skewers in water 30 minutes if using bamboo. You need a grill (or grill pan), a zipper bag or shallow dish, and tongs. Marinate the chicken at least 1 hour. Keeps the pool party menu light and bright.
recipe.finish: Chicken is done when the thickest piece reads 165°F (74°C) on an instant-read thermometer and juices run clear, about 10–12 minutes total. Rest skewers 3 minutes, then serve warm with lemon wedges.

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts or thighs

steps.title: Soak the skewers
steps.details: Put 12 bamboo skewers in a shallow pan of water so they are fully submerged. Leave them to soak while you cut the chicken and make the marinade.

steps.title: Cut and trim chicken
steps.details: Cut chicken into even 1½-inch chunks so they cook at the same rate. Discard any fat or sinew.

steps.title: Whisk the marinade
steps.details: In a large bowl or zipper bag, whisk olive oil, lemon juice, lemon zest, parsley, oregano, garlic, salt and pepper until combined.

steps.title: Marinate the chicken
steps.details: Add chicken chunks to the marinade and toss to coat. Seal and refrigerate 1 hour (up to 4 hours). Do not leave at room temperature.

steps.title: Preheat the grill
steps.details: About 15 minutes before grilling, heat the grill to medium-high, 400–450°F (204–232°C). Clean and oil the grates well so the chicken does not stick.

steps.title: Thread the skewers
steps.details: Remove chicken from marinade and discard the used marinade. Thread 5–6 chunks onto each soaked skewer, leaving a small gap at each end for turning.

steps.title: Grill the skewers
steps.details: Grill skewers uncovered, turning every 3–4 minutes, until lightly charred and the thickest piece reaches 165°F (74°C), 10–12 minutes total.

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.details: Rest skewers 3 minutes, then slide chicken off skewers if desired and serve with lemon wedges.

generatedRecipes.title: Chilled Watermelon Feta Salad with Mint and Lime

recipe.title: Chilled Watermelon Feta Salad with Mint and Lime
recipe.intro: Seed and chill a ripe watermelon ahead if it isn't already cold. You'll need a large bowl, a small bowl for dressing, a cutting board, and a knife. No cooking required—keep everything cold until serving.
recipe.finish: Serve immediately while cold, or cover and refrigerate up to 2 hours (mint may darken). Give a gentle toss right before spooning into bowls. Best enjoyed the same day.

ingredients.name: feta
ingredients.prep: drained and cut into 1/2-inch cubes or crumbled

ingredients.name: fresh mint
ingredients.prep: rinsed, dried, and thinly sliced (plus a few whole leaves for garnish)

steps.title: Whisk the lime dressing
steps.details: In a small bowl, whisk the lime zest, lime juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper until combined and slightly thickened. Set aside.

steps.title: Cube the chilled watermelon
steps.details: On a cutting board, cut the chilled watermelon into 1-inch cubes, removing any rind or stray seeds. Place in a large bowl. The watermelon should be cold and firm so it holds its shape.

steps.title: Crumble the feta
steps.details: Cube or crumble the drained feta into 1/2-inch pieces and add on top of the watermelon.

steps.title: Slice the mint
steps.details: Stack the dried mint leaves, roll them tightly, and slice into thin ribbons. Add to the bowl with the watermelon and feta.

steps.title: Drizzle and toss gently
steps.details: Pour the lime dressing over the watermelon, feta, and mint. Toss very gently with a large spoon, just 2 to 3 turns, until lightly coated—feta should stay in distinct cubes rather than breaking up.

steps.title: Garnish and chill until serving
steps.details: Scatter a few whole mint leaves on top, then cover and refrigerate for 10 to 15 minutes before serving so the flavors meld and the salad stays cold. Serve chilled.

recipe.title: Classic Creamy Coleslaw
recipe.intro: No cooking needed—just sharp knife or box grater. Chill the finished slaw at least 30 minutes before serving. Keep cold at the pool party (under 40°F ideally).
recipe.finish: Taste and adjust salt/sugar/vinegar. Serve cold, ideally within 2 hours; keep on ice if outdoors. Stir before serving—some liquid will pool.

steps.title: Shred cabbage and carrots
steps.details: Using a sharp knife or box grater, finely shred cabbage and carrots into a large bowl. Aim for thin, even pieces so it stays crisp, not mushy.

steps.title: Slice red onion
steps.details: Very thinly slice the red onion (optional) and add to the cabbage and carrots.

steps.title: Whisk creamy dressing
steps.details: In a small bowl, whisk mayonnaise, sugar, vinegar, salt, pepper, and milk until smooth and pourable.

steps.title: Toss slaw with dressing
steps.details: Pour dressing over cabbage mixture and toss thoroughly with tongs or clean hands until every shred is coated.

steps.title: Chill and let flavors meld
steps.details: Cover and refrigerate at least 30 minutes (up to 4 hours) so cabbage softens slightly and flavors combine. Keep cold until serving.

recipe.title: Sweet Corn on the Cob
recipe.intro: Husk corn and preheat grill (if grilling). Bring a large pot of water to a boil for boiling method. Have butter and salt ready.
recipe.finish: Serve hot with butter and salt. Corn is done when kernels are tender and bright yellow, about 3-5 minutes boiling or 10-12 minutes grilling, turning occasionally.

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.prep: for boiling water, plus more for serving

steps.title: Husk corn
steps.details: Pull back husks and remove all silk from 8 ears of corn. Rinse if needed.

steps.title: Boil water
steps.details: Fill a large pot with 4 quarts water and add 1 tablespoon salt. Bring to a rolling boil over high heat.

steps.title: Boil corn
steps.details: Carefully add husked corn to boiling water. Cook until kernels are tender, 3-5 minutes. Do not overcook.

steps.title: Prepare butter
steps.details: While corn boils, melt butter in a small saucepan or microwave. Keep warm.

steps.title: Drain and serve
steps.details: Drain corn and transfer to a platter. Brush generously with melted butter and season with salt and pepper to taste. Serve hot.

recipe.title: Chunky Guacamole with Tortilla Chips
recipe.intro: No cooking needed—just mash and mix. Have a serving bowl and a large rimmed tray ready. Make the guacamole just before serving so it stays bright green; if making ahead, press plastic wrap directly onto the surface and refrigerate up to 2 hours.
recipe.finish: Taste and add lime or salt if needed. Serve immediately with the chips alongside, or cover the guacamole's surface with plastic wrap for up to 30 minutes. Guacamole browns quickly; a squeeze of extra lime on top helps.

ingredients.name: jalapeño
ingredients.prep: seeded and minced (leave seeds for heat)

ingredients.name: tortilla chips
ingredients.prep: opened, poured onto a serving tray

steps.title: Chop onion, tomato, chile, cilantro
steps.details: Combine the red onion, tomato, jalapeño, and cilantro in a medium bowl. Chop everything small so the guacamole stays easy to scoop.

steps.title: Scoop and mash avocado
steps.details: Scoop the avocado flesh into a large bowl and mash with a fork until mostly smooth but still a little chunky, about 15 to 20 strokes.

steps.title: Fold in lime and salt
steps.details: Add the lime juice and kosher salt to the avocado and fold gently with a spatula.

steps.title: Add vegetables and mix
steps.details: Scrape the onion mixture into the avocado bowl and fold just until evenly combined; do not overmix, or the guacamole will turn mushy.

steps.title: Taste and adjust
steps.details: Taste and stir in a pinch more salt or a squeeze of lime if needed. Guacamole should be bright and seasoned.

steps.title: Serve with chips
steps.details: Transfer the guacamole to a serving bowl, nestle it on the tray with the tortilla chips, and serve right away.

recipe.title: Soft Garlic Butter Breadsticks
recipe.intro: Great for a pool-party buffet: soft, pull-apart breadsticks brushed with garlic butter. You need a large bowl, a wooden spoon, a lightly floured counter, a rolling pin (or clean hands), a baking sheet, parchment paper, and a pastry brush. Best served warm. If making ahead, bake and cool completely, then rewrap and warm at 300°F for 5–7 minutes and
recipe.finish: Breadsticks are done when puffed and golden brown on top, and the center of a breadstick reads about 190–200°F or feels springy, not doughy. Brush hot breadsticks with the remaining garlic butter and serve warm. Keep covered with a clean towel until serving so they stay soft.

ingredients.name: olive oil or melted butter
ingredients.prep: plus a little for the bowl

steps.title: Warm oven and mix dry ingredients
steps.details: Heat oven to 375°F with a rack in the middle. In a large bowl, whisk the flour, yeast, sugar, and fine salt until evenly combined.

steps.title: Add water and oil, then stir
steps.details: Pour in the warm water and olive oil. Stir with a wooden spoon until a shaggy dough forms and no dry flour remains, about 1–2 minutes.

steps.title: Knead the dough
steps.details: Turn dough onto a lightly floured counter. Knead 5–6 minutes until smooth, elastic, and slightly tacky; add flour 1 tablespoon at a time only if it sticks badly.

steps.title: Let dough rise
steps.details: Lightly oil the bowl, put dough back in, and cover with a clean towel. Let rise in a warm spot until doubled, about 45–55 minutes.

steps.title: Make garlic butter
steps.details: While the dough rises, stir the melted butter and grated garlic together in a small bowl. Set aside; it can sit at room temperature while the dough finishes rising.

steps.title: Shape the breadsticks
steps.details: Line a baking sheet with parchment. Gently press dough down and divide into 12 pieces. Roll each into a 7–8 inch rope and place on the sheet about 1 inch apart.

steps.title: Second rise
steps.details: Cover shaped breadsticks loosely with a clean towel and let rise until slightly puffy, 20–25 minutes.

steps.title: Brush and bake
steps.details: Brush breadsticks lightly with about half the garlic butter. Bake 15–18 minutes until golden brown and cooked through; rotate the pan halfway if browning unevenly.

steps.title: Finish with garlic butter and salt
steps.details: Brush hot breadsticks with the remaining garlic butter and sprinkle with coarse salt and Parmesan, if using. Serve warm.

recipe.title: Chewy Cookie Ice Cream Sandwiches
recipe.intro: Soften the ice cream on the counter while the cookies cool. You need 2 baking sheets, parchment paper, a small ice cream scoop or spoon, and a flat spatula. If using homemade cookies, bake them first; store-bought chewy cookies work fine and skip the baking steps.
recipe.finish: Serve straight from the freezer; they soften fast. For a crowd, set out a tray and let people grab them within 10 minutes. Wrap leftovers individually in plastic wrap and freeze up to 2 weeks.

ingredients.name: chewy chocolate chip cookies
ingredients.prep: store-bought, or baked and fully cooled

steps.title: Soften ice cream
steps.details: Set the ice cream carton on the counter 10 minutes before assembling so it is scoopable but not melted.

steps.title: Pair and line up cookies
steps.details: Arrange the cookies in 12 pairs on a tray, matching similar sizes. Line a baking sheet with parchment.

steps.title: Scoop ice cream
steps.details: Place a scant 1/4 cup scoop of softened ice cream on one cookie of each pair and press the second cookie on top, gently flattening until the ice cream reaches the edges.

steps.title: Roll edges
steps.details: If using, spread the mini chips or sprinkles on a plate and roll the exposed ice cream edge of each sandwich to coat.

steps.title: Freeze to firm
steps.details: Place sandwiches on the lined sheet, cover loosely, and freeze at least 1 hour, until the ice cream is firm and the cookies hold together when lifted.

steps.title: Check and serve
steps.details: Lift one sandwich with a spatula to confirm it holds; if soft, freeze 15 more minutes. Serve directly from the freezer.

recipe.title: Fresh Lemonade
recipe.intro: You'll need a pitcher, a citrus juicer or reamer, a small saucepan, and a long spoon. Make a quick simple syrup first so it dissolves fully, then juice the lemons. Chill everything and serve over plenty of ice.
recipe.finish: Taste and adjust: add more syrup if too tart, more lemon juice if too sweet, or a splash of water if too strong. Serve over lots of ice in tall glasses and garnish each with a thin lemon slice. Keep the pitcher in the shade or a cooler at the party and stir before each pour, since the syrup settles.

ingredients.name: fresh lemon juice (about 6-8 lemons)
ingredients.prep: roll lemons, halve, and juice; strain seeds

ingredients.name: cold water
ingredients.prep: chill or use cold tap water

ingredients.name: lemon
ingredients.prep: slice thin into rounds for garnish

steps.title: Make simple syrup
steps.details: Combine sugar and 1 cup water in a small saucepan over medium heat. Stir until sugar fully dissolves, about 3 minutes; do not boil hard. Remove from heat.

steps.title: Juice the lemons
steps.details: While syrup heats, roll lemons firmly on the counter, halve them, and juice until you have 1 cup, straining out seeds.

steps.title: Cool the syrup
steps.details: Let the syrup sit off the heat to cool slightly, about 5 minutes, so it won't melt all the ice later.

steps.title: Combine lemonade
steps.details: In a large pitcher, stir together the cooled syrup, 1 cup lemon juice, and 4 cups cold water.

steps.title: Slice lemon garnish
steps.details: Thinly slice one lemon into rounds, discarding ends and any seeds, for glasses and the pitcher.

steps.title: Chill and serve over ice
steps.details: Add ice to the pitcher (or to glasses), stir well, float a few lemon slices, and serve immediately. Taste and adjust sweetness or tartness before pouring.

recipe.title: Frosted Fruit Punch
recipe.intro: A refreshing blend of fruit juices and ginger ale served ice-cold from a large dispenser. You'll need a large punch bowl or beverage dispenser (at least 1 gallon capacity), a long spoon, and a freezer-safe container for the ice ring. Make the ice ring the day before.
recipe.finish: Serve immediately. The punch is best when very cold; add the ice ring just before serving. If the punch becomes too diluted, add more ice or a splash of ginger ale. Enjoy responsibly!

ingredients.name: mixed fresh fruit slices (orange, lemon, lime, strawberries)

steps.title: Make ice ring
steps.details: Arrange fruit slices in a ring mold or small bundt pan. Add water to cover fruit. Freeze until solid, at least 4 hours or overnight.

steps.title: Chill juices
steps.details: Refrigerate orange juice, pineapple juice, cranberry juice, lemon juice, and ginger ale until cold, at least 2 hours.

steps.title: Combine juices
steps.details: In a large punch bowl or dispenser, stir together chilled orange juice, pineapple juice, cranberry juice, and lemon juice. Add sugar if desired and stir until dissolved.

steps.title: Add ginger ale
steps.details: Just before serving, gently stir in chilled ginger ale. Taste and adjust sweetness if needed.

steps.title: Add ice ring
steps.details: Unmold ice ring by dipping the bottom of the mold briefly in warm water. Float the ice ring in the punch. Serve immediately.

recipe.title: Classic Grilled Cheeseburgers
recipe.intro: Preheat a gas grill to medium-high (about 425°F/220°C) or build a medium-hot charcoal fire; clean and lightly oil the grates. Have a platter and instant-read thermometer ready. Mix the patties while the grill heats.
recipe.finish: Burgers are safe to eat when the center reaches 160°F (71°C). Rest 2–3 minutes, then serve on the toasted buns with lettuce, tomato, onion and condiments.

steps.title: Heat the grill
steps.details: Preheat a gas grill to medium-high, about 425°F (220°C), or light a medium-hot charcoal fire. Clean and lightly oil the grates.

steps.title: Form the patties
steps.details: Divide the beef into 4 portions and gently shape each into a patty about 3/4 inch thick, wider than the bun. Press a shallow dimple in the center of each so they cook flat. Season both sides with the salt and pepper.

steps.title: Butter and toast buns
steps.details: Spread the softened butter on the cut sides of the buns. While the grill heats or just before cooking the patties, toast buns cut-side down until golden, about 1–2 minutes; set aside.

steps.title: Prep the toppings
steps.details: Arrange the lettuce, sliced tomato and sliced onion on a platter. Put the ketchup and mayonnaise in small bowls for serving.

steps.title: Grill the patties
steps.details: Place patties on the hot grill and cook without moving for 3–4 minutes, until browned and releasing easily. Flip once and continue cooking 3–4 minutes more.

steps.title: Melt the cheese
steps.details: Lay a slice of cheddar on each patty during the last minute of cooking. Cover the grill briefly to melt the cheese.

steps.title: Check doneness and rest
steps.details: Remove burgers when the center registers 160°F (71°C) on an instant-read thermometer. Rest on a platter 2–3 minutes.

steps.title: Assemble the burgers
steps.details: Place each patty on a toasted bun with lettuce, tomato, onion and your choice of ketchup and mayonnaise. Serve immediately.

recipe.title: Grilled Veggie Burgers
recipe.intro: Great for a mixed grill: cook these plant-based patties on a clean, oiled section of the grate, away from beef drippings. Use a grill basket or a sheet of heavy-duty foil with holes if the patties feel fragile. Preheat a gas grill to medium-high (about 400°F/205°C) with lid closed, 10–12 minutes, while you prep. Have a spatula and a small bowl of o
recipe.finish: The patties are done when browned on both sides and hot through, 160°F (71°C) in the center if using a thermometer. Let rest 2 minutes; serve on toasted buns with cheese if desired, lettuce, tomato, onion and your favorite burger sauces. Keep them on a separate clean plate from raw beef.

ingredients.name: refrigerated or frozen plant-based veggie burger patties
ingredients.prep: keep chilled or frozen per package; do not thaw frozen patties unless label says so

ingredients.name: vegetable oil
ingredients.prep: for oiling grill and brushing patties

steps.title: Preheat grill and prep toppings
steps.details: Heat a gas grill to medium-high, about 400°F (205°C), lid closed, 10–12 minutes. Meanwhile split buns, wash and dry lettuce, slice tomato and onion, and set out ketchup and mayonnaise. Keep raw beef away from these toppings.

steps.title: Oil the clean grate
steps.details: Fold a paper towel into a pad, dip in vegetable oil, and use tongs to rub the hot grate. Reserve about 1 tbsp oil for brushing the patties. Use a clean section of the grill for veggie burgers.

steps.title: Brush patties with oil
steps.details: Lightly brush both sides of the chilled patties with the remaining oil so they don't stick. Handle gently; frozen patties can go straight on if the label directs.

steps.title: Grill first side
steps.details: Place patties on the oiled clean section of the grate over medium-high heat. Close lid and cook until the bottom is browned and releases easily with a spatula, usually 4–5 minutes. Do not press down.

steps.title: Flip and add cheese
steps.details: Flip carefully with a spatula. If using cheese, lay a slice on each patty in the last 1–2 minutes. Continue grilling until the second side is browned and the center is hot, 4–5 minutes more. Check the label for any required internal temperature; aim for 160°F (71°C).

steps.title: Toast buns
steps.details: During the last 2–3 minutes of grilling, place split buns cut-side down on the cooler edge of the grate until lightly toasted, watching closely so they don't burn.

steps.title: Rest patties
steps.details: Move cooked patties to a clean plate and let rest 2 minutes so they firm up and juices settle. Keep them away from raw beef.

steps.title: Assemble burgers
steps.details: Place each patty on a toasted bun. Top with lettuce, tomato and onion, and add ketchup and mayonnaise as desired. Close buns and serve warm.

recipe.title: Old-Fashioned Potato Salad
recipe.intro: Use a 4-quart pot and a large mixing bowl. Boil the eggs and potatoes, then chill the salad before serving.
recipe.finish: Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving so the flavors meld. Keep chilled until serving; garnish with paprika if desired.

ingredients.name: Yukon Gold or red potatoes
ingredients.prep: peeled if desired, cut into 1-inch cubes

steps.title: Boil the eggs
steps.details: Place eggs in a saucepan, cover with cold water by 1 inch, and bring to a boil. Cover, remove from heat, and let stand 12 minutes. Transfer to ice water for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Boil the potatoes
steps.details: Place potatoes in a 4-quart pot, cover with cold water by 1 inch, and add 1 tablespoon salt. Bring to a boil, then simmer 12–15 minutes until a knife slides in easily. Drain and cool 10 minutes.

steps.title: Prep the vegetables
steps.details: While the potatoes and eggs cook, slice the celery, chop the onion, and chop the parsley.

steps.title: Chop the eggs
steps.details: Peel the cooled eggs and chop them into 1/2-inch pieces. Refrigerate until needed.

steps.title: Make the dressing
steps.details: In a large bowl, whisk the mayonnaise, mustard, vinegar, 1 teaspoon salt, and pepper until smooth.

steps.title: Combine the salad
steps.details: Add the cooled potatoes, celery, onion, chopped eggs, and parsley to the dressing. Fold gently until evenly coated, keeping some potato chunks intact.

steps.title: Chill before serving
steps.details: Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour to meld flavors and chill thoroughly. Taste and adjust salt before serving.

generatedRecipes.title: Grilled Corn on the Cob in the Husk

recipe.title: Grilled Corn on the Cob in the Husk
recipe.intro: Set up a grill for medium-high heat, about 400-450°F, and give yourself 10 minutes to preheat while you soak and trim the corn. You will need a grill, tongs, and a platter. Soaking the husked corn keeps it from scorching before the kernels steam.
recipe.finish: Corn is done when the husk is charred in spots and a kernel near the middle pierces easily with a knife tip, 15-20 minutes total. Pull back the husks, brush generously with melted butter, and season with salt. Serve hot alongside the burgers.

ingredients.name: corn on the cob, in the husk
ingredients.prep: husks on, silk trimmed at the tip

steps.title: Preheat the grill
steps.details: Light the grill and set it for medium-high, about 400-450°F. Cover and let it heat while you prep the corn.

steps.title: Soak the corn
steps.details: Put the ears in the bowl of cold water, husks fully submerged, and soak for 10 minutes. This keeps the husks from flaring up on the grill.

steps.title: Trim and dry the ears
steps.details: Shake off excess water. Pull any loose outer husk leaves down but leave the inner husks wrapped around the kernels; trim the silk sticking out of the tip with scissors.

steps.title: Melt the butter
steps.details: Melt the butter in a small saucepan or microwave-safe bowl, then stir in the 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt. Keep warm off the heat.

steps.title: Grill the corn
steps.details: Place the ears on the hot grill, cover, and cook 15-20 minutes, turning every 4-5 minutes with tongs, until the husks are charred in spots and the corn feels tender when pressed.

steps.title: Butter and salt
steps.details: Using tongs and a towel, peel back the husks. Brush each ear all over with the salted butter and sprinkle with a little more salt to taste. Serve immediately.

recipe.title: Classic Coleslaw
recipe.intro: No cooking required; a sharp knife or box grater and a large bowl are all you need. Chill the finished slaw at least 30 minutes before serving.
recipe.finish: The slaw is ready when the cabbage is crisp-tender and glossy with dressing. Taste and adjust salt and pepper, then serve cold alongside burgers. Store leftovers covered in the refrigerator up to 2 days; stir before serving.

steps.title: Shred the cabbage
steps.details: Cut the cabbage into wedges, trim the core, and shred finely with a knife or the shredding blade of a box grater. You should have about 8 cups. Put it in a large bowl.

steps.title: Grate carrots and onion
steps.details: Peel and coarsely grate the carrots and thinly slice the onion. Add both to the bowl with the cabbage.

steps.title: Whisk the dressing
steps.details: In a small bowl, whisk the mayonnaise, vinegar, sugar, salt, and pepper until smooth and the sugar dissolves.

steps.title: Toss and chill
steps.details: Pour the dressing over the cabbage mixture and toss until every strand is coated. Cover and refrigerate at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours, to let the flavors meld. Stir again just before serving.

recipe.title: Loaded Guacamole and Chips
recipe.intro: Get ready: halve and pit the avocados, squeeze the limes, chop the onion and cilantro, and dice the tomato. Serve in a wide shallow bowl with a pile of tortilla chips on the side.
recipe.finish: Taste and adjust salt and lime. Press plastic wrap directly onto the surface if not serving within 30 minutes. Serve with tortilla chips. Best eaten within 2 hours.

steps.title: Mash avocados with lime
steps.details: Scoop the avocado flesh into a medium bowl. Add the lime juice and mash with a fork until mostly smooth with a few lumps.

steps.title: Chop onion and cilantro
steps.details: Finely chop the red onion and roughly chop the cilantro. Keep them together on the cutting board.

steps.title: Dice the tomato
steps.details: Cut the Roma tomato in half, scoop out the seeds, and dice into small pieces.

steps.title: Fold in vegetables and seasoning
steps.details: Add the onion, cilantro, tomato, salt, and cumin (if using) to the mashed avocado. Fold gently with a spoon until just combined; do not overmix.

steps.title: Taste and adjust
steps.details: Taste and add more salt or lime juice as needed. The guacamole should be bright and savory.

steps.title: Serve with chips
steps.details: Transfer to a serving bowl and serve with tortilla chips for scooping.

recipe.title: Grilled Garlic Butter Buns
recipe.intro: Get ready: 4 split burger buns, a small bowl, pastry brush, and a grill preheated to medium (about 375°F) with a cool zone. Make the garlic butter while the grill heats.
recipe.finish: Buns are ready when the cut sides are crisp and golden brown with toasted edges, 2–3 minutes on the grill. Serve cut-side up as a base for burgers, or close them loosely in foil to stay warm for up to 15 minutes.

steps.title: Preheat the grill
steps.details: Heat a gas or charcoal grill to medium, about 375°F, with one cooler zone for safety and control. Clean and lightly oil the grates.

steps.title: Mash the garlic butter
steps.details: In a small bowl, mash the softened salted butter with the minced garlic and chopped parsley until evenly combined.

steps.title: Brush the cut sides
steps.details: Brush the garlic butter generously over the cut sides of all 8 bun halves; use about 1 teaspoon per half and leave the crusts unbuttered.

steps.title: Toast cut-side down
steps.details: Place buns cut-side down on the grill over medium heat. Grill 2–3 minutes, watching closely, until the cut faces are golden and crisp with toasted edges.

steps.title: Turn and warm through
steps.details: Turn the buns and move them to the cooler zone. Close the lid and warm 1–2 minutes until the crusts are soft and warmed through; do not let them char.

recipe.title: Summer Berry Trifle
recipe.intro: Use a 3-quart glass trifle bowl or clear glass bowl. No cooking required except chilling; assemble while the pudding sets. Have everything cold for best results.
recipe.finish: The trifle is ready when chilled at least 2 hours and layers hold their shape. Scoop into bowls and top with reserved berries. Keep leftovers covered in the refrigerator up to 2 days.

ingredients.name: instant vanilla pudding mix
ingredients.prep: whisk with 4 cups cold milk per package

steps.title: Whisk pudding and chill
steps.details: Whisk pudding mix into 4 cups cold milk in a large bowl for 2 minutes until smooth and starting to thicken. Refrigerate 10 minutes to set slightly.

steps.title: Prep the berries
steps.details: While pudding chills, slice strawberries and rinse blueberries and raspberries. Toss berries gently with 1 tbsp sugar and set aside.

steps.title: Whip the cream
steps.details: Whip chilled cream, remaining 2 tbsp sugar, and vanilla on medium-high until soft peaks form, about 3 minutes. Stop when peaks curl slightly.

steps.title: Layer cake and pudding
steps.details: Spread half the cake cubes in the trifle bowl, press gently, then spoon half the pudding over the cake in an even layer.

steps.title: Add berries and cream
steps.details: Scatter half the berries over pudding, then spread half the whipped cream on top. Repeat with remaining cake, pudding, berries, and cream, reserving a few berries for garnish.

steps.title: Chill and serve
steps.details: Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours so layers set and flavors meld. Garnish with reserved berries just before serving.

recipe.title: Fresh-Squeezed Lemonade
recipe.intro: No special equipment needed: a citrus juicer or reamer helps, plus a pitcher and long spoon. Make the simple syrup first so it cools while you squeeze the lemons, then chill the lemonade thoroughly before serving over plenty of ice.
recipe.finish: Serve ice-cold over lots of ice, garnished with lemon slices if you like. Taste before serving; if it is too tart, stir in 1–2 more tablespoons of sugar, and if too sweet, add a splash more lemon juice. Store leftovers covered in the refrigerator up to 3 days and stir well before serving.

ingredients.name: lemons
ingredients.prep: scrubbed, at room temperature for easier juicing

ingredients.name: lemon
ingredients.prep: sliced into thin rounds, optional garnish

steps.title: Boil sugar and water
steps.details: Combine 1 cup sugar with 1 cup water in a small saucepan. Heat over medium-high, stirring occasionally, until the sugar fully dissolves and the liquid is clear, about 3–4 minutes; do not let it boil down. Remove from heat.

steps.title: Cool the syrup
steps.details: Let the simple syrup sit off the heat until warm but no longer hot, about 15 minutes. Meanwhile start juicing the lemons in the next step.

steps.title: Juice the lemons
steps.details: Roll each lemon firmly on the counter, halve it, and juice with a reamer or citrus juicer, straining out seeds. You need about 1 1/4 to 1 1/2 cups of juice.

steps.title: Combine juice and syrup
steps.details: Pour the lemon juice into a large pitcher and stir in the cooled simple syrup.

steps.title: Add cold water and taste
steps.details: Stir in 5 cups cold water. Taste and adjust: add a little more sugar for tartness or a squeeze of lemon for sweetness. The lemonade should taste slightly strong now, since ice will dilute it.

steps.title: Chill the lemonade
steps.details: Refrigerate the pitcher until thoroughly cold, at least 30 minutes. Stir well before serving, since the pulp settles.

steps.title: Serve over ice
steps.details: Fill glasses with ice, pour the chilled lemonade over the ice, and garnish with lemon slices if using. Serve immediately.

generatedRecipes.title: Classic Wedge Salad with Blue Cheese Dressing

recipe.title: Classic Wedge Salad with Blue Cheese Dressing
recipe.intro: Crisp iceberg wedges with creamy blue cheese dressing, crisp bacon, and sweet cherry tomatoes. Cook bacon first, then build the dressing while it cooks. Have a skillet, mixing bowl, whisk, knife, and cutting board ready.
recipe.finish: Serve each wedge with a generous pour of dressing, crisp bacon, and tomatoes scattered over the top; add extra blue cheese crumbles and cracked black pepper if you like. Best eaten right away while the lettuce is cold and crisp.

ingredients.name: iceberg lettuce
ingredients.prep: outer leaves removed, cut into 4 wedges through the core

steps.title: Cook the bacon
steps.details: Put the bacon in a cold skillet over medium heat. Cook 9–11 minutes, stirring occasionally, until crisp and deep golden brown. Transfer to a paper-towel-lined plate.

steps.title: Whisk the dressing
steps.details: In a mixing bowl, whisk the mayonnaise, buttermilk, vinegar, sugar, salt, and pepper until smooth, about 1 minute.

steps.title: Add most of the blue cheese
steps.details: Stir three-quarters of the crumbled blue cheese into the dressing, mashing some crumbles against the bowl to thicken it. Leave the rest for the top. Refrigerate until needed.

steps.title: Cut the lettuce wedges
steps.details: Trim the stem flat so the head sits level, then cut the iceberg into 4 wedges through the core. Rinse gently under cold water and shake off excess; keep the core intact so the wedges hold together.

steps.title: Prep the tomatoes and scallions
steps.details: Halve the cherry tomatoes and thinly slice the scallions. Set both aside.

steps.title: Plate the salad
steps.details: Place the iceberg wedges on 4 chilled plates. Spoon the blue cheese dressing generously over each wedge, then scatter over the crisp bacon, halved tomatoes, sliced scallions, and the reserved blue cheese crumbles.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.details: Finish with cracked black pepper to taste and serve immediately while the lettuce is cold and the bacon is crisp.

recipe.title: Shrimp Cocktail with Horseradish Sauce
recipe.intro: Chill a large bowl of ice water before you start. Use a 4-quart pot for poaching and a small bowl for the sauce. Have a colander ready and a serving bowl chilled if possible.
recipe.finish: Shrimp are safely done when opaque and curled into a loose C shape; drain and plunge into ice water immediately to stop cooking. Chill at least 30 minutes before serving. Serve shrimp on crushed ice with the horseradish cocktail sauce alongside, and lemon wedges if you like.

ingredients.name: large shrimp (21–25 per pound), peeled and deveined, tails left on

steps.title: Make horseradish sauce
steps.details: In a small bowl, stir together ketchup, horseradish, lemon juice, Worcestershire, hot sauce, 1/4 teaspoon salt and pepper. Cover and refrigerate until serving.

steps.title: Bring water to a boil
steps.details: Put 8 cups water, 1 tablespoon salt and the lemon halves in a 4-quart pot. Bring to a rolling boil over high heat.

steps.title: Prepare ice bath
steps.details: While the water heats, fill a large bowl with ice and cold water. Set a colander inside or beside it for draining the shrimp.

steps.title: Poach shrimp
steps.details: Add shrimp to the boiling water and stir gently. Cook just until shrimp turn opaque and curl into a loose C, about 2–3 minutes; do not let them curl tightly into an O.

steps.title: Shock shrimp in ice bath
steps.details: Drain shrimp immediately in the colander, then plunge them into the ice water. Let stand 3 minutes to stop cooking, then drain well and pat dry.

steps.title: Chill shrimp and sauce
steps.details: Refrigerate shrimp and the covered sauce until cold, at least 30 minutes. Serve shrimp on crushed ice with the horseradish sauce alongside.

generatedRecipes.title: Cast-Iron Ribeye Steaks with Herb Butter

recipe.title: Cast-Iron Ribeye Steaks with Herb Butter
recipe.intro: Let the steaks sit at room temperature for 30 minutes while you soften the butter and make the herb compound butter. Use a 10–12 inch cast-iron skillet and a meat thermometer. Have a cutting board and foil ready for resting.
recipe.finish: The steaks are done when an instant-read thermometer reads 120–125°F in the center for medium-rare (130–135°F for medium). Rest 5–8 minutes, then slice against the grain if desired and top each steak with a generous coin of herb butter so it melts over the meat.

ingredients.name: bone-in or boneless ribeye steaks
ingredients.prep: pat dry, sit at room temperature 30 minutes

steps.title: Make herb butter
steps.details: Mash the softened butter with the garlic, parsley, and thyme until evenly combined. Scrape onto plastic wrap, roll into a log, and refrigerate until firm.

steps.title: Season steaks
steps.details: Pat the steaks very dry and season both sides evenly with the salt and pepper.

steps.title: Preheat the skillet
steps.details: Set a cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat and let it get hot, about 5 minutes, until a drop of water sizzles and evaporates on contact.

steps.title: Sear the steaks
steps.details: Add the oil, then lay in the steaks. Sear without moving until a deep brown crust forms, 3–4 minutes.

steps.title: Flip and add aromatics
steps.details: Flip the steaks, add the butter and rosemary sprigs to the skillet, and baste by tilting the pan and spooning the foaming butter over the steaks.

steps.title: Check doneness
steps.details: Continue basting and cooking until the center reads 120–125°F for medium-rare, about 2–4 more minutes depending on thickness; add the remaining rosemary if the pan seems dry.

steps.title: Rest the steaks
steps.details: Transfer the steaks to a board and tent loosely with foil. Rest 6 minutes so the juices redistribute.

steps.title: Serve with herb butter
steps.details: Slice the chilled herb butter into coins and set one or two on each steak so it melts. Slice the meat against the grain if desired and serve.

recipe.title: Creamed Spinach
recipe.intro: Steakhouse-style creamed spinach with Parmesan. You'll need a large pot, a colander, a skillet or wide saucepan, and a wooden spoon. Thaw the spinach first (or blanch fresh) so it drains well; squeeze out as much water as you can — wet spinach makes a thin sauce.
recipe.finish: The creamed spinach is done when it's thick enough to coat the back of a spoon and bubbles gently at the edges; taste and adjust salt and pepper. Serve hot alongside steak. It holds well on low heat for 10–15 minutes; stir in a splash of milk if it tightens too much.

steps.title: Squeeze spinach dry
steps.details: Put the thawed spinach in a clean kitchen towel or several layers of paper towel and wring out as much liquid as you can; it should look dry and clumpy, not wet. Set aside.

steps.title: Sweat onion in butter
steps.details: Melt the butter in a large pot or deep skillet over medium heat. Add the onion and cook, stirring often, until soft and translucent but not browned, about 5 minutes.

steps.title: Add garlic and flour
steps.details: Stir in the garlic and cook 30 seconds until fragrant. Sprinkle the flour over the onions and cook, stirring constantly, for 1–2 minutes until the raw flour smell is gone and the mixture looks pasty.

steps.title: Whisk in milk and cream
steps.details: Pour in the warm milk and cream in a steady stream while whisking constantly to prevent lumps. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook, whisking, until thickened enough to coat a spoon, about 4–5 minutes.

steps.title: Melt in Parmesan
steps.details: Reduce heat to low. Stir in the Parmesan, nutmeg (if using), salt and pepper until the cheese melts and the sauce is smooth. Taste and adjust seasoning.

steps.title: Fold in spinach and simmer
steps.details: Add the squeezed spinach, breaking up clumps with your spoon, and stir until evenly coated. Simmer gently over low heat for 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until hot throughout and thickened; thin with a splash of milk if it becomes too stiff.

recipe.title: Twice-Baked Potatoes
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 400°F. Scrub potatoes, prick all over with a fork, and rub with a little oil and salt. Have a baking sheet, skillet, and mixing bowl ready.
recipe.finish: Potatoes are done when the filling is hot (165°F) and the tops are golden and bubbling. Let rest 5 minutes before serving alongside steak.

steps.title: Preheat oven and rub potatoes
steps.details: Heat oven to 400°F. Rub potatoes with oil and sprinkle with kosher salt. Place on a baking sheet.

steps.title: Bake potatoes until tender
steps.details: Bake until a knife slides in with no resistance, about 60 minutes.

steps.title: Cook bacon while potatoes bake
steps.details: In a skillet over medium heat, cook bacon until crisp, 8 to 10 minutes. Drain on paper towels.

steps.title: Cool potatoes briefly
steps.details: Remove potatoes from oven and cool 10 minutes so they are easy to handle. Keep oven on.

steps.title: Scoop and mash filling
steps.details: Halve potatoes lengthwise and scoop flesh into a bowl, leaving 1/4-inch shells. Mash flesh with sour cream, butter, pepper, half the cheddar, half the chives, and most of the bacon.

steps.title: Stuff potato shells
steps.details: Spoon filling back into shells, mounding slightly. Top with remaining cheddar and bacon.

steps.title: Bake until golden
steps.details: Bake stuffed potatoes until filling is hot and tops are golden and bubbling, 20 to 25 minutes.

steps.title: Garnish and rest
steps.details: Sprinkle with remaining chives and rest 5 minutes before serving.

recipe.title: Garlic Butter Skillet Mushrooms
recipe.intro: Get ready: wipe mushrooms clean with a damp paper towel (do not soak), slice 1/4 inch thick, mince the garlic, and chop the parsley. Use a large 12-inch skillet so the mushrooms brown instead of steam. No oven needed.
recipe.finish: Mushrooms should be tender and deeply golden brown with a glossy garlic butter coating. Taste and add salt if needed, scatter with parsley, and serve hot straight from the skillet alongside steak.

ingredients.name: cremini mushrooms
ingredients.prep: wiped clean, stem ends trimmed, sliced 1/4 inch thick

steps.title: Heat oil in skillet
steps.details: Heat the olive oil in a large 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat until it shimmers, about 2 minutes.

steps.title: Sear mushrooms in batches
steps.details: Add half the mushrooms in a single layer and cook undisturbed 3 minutes, then stir and cook 2 more minutes until browned. Transfer to a plate. Repeat with the remaining mushrooms, adding them to the plate. Work in batches so they brown rather than steam.

steps.title: Melt butter and add garlic
steps.details: Lower heat to medium. Add 3 tablespoons of the butter and let it melt, about 1 minute. Add the minced garlic and cook, stirring constantly, 30 seconds to 1 minute until fragrant but not browned.

steps.title: Return mushrooms and season
steps.details: Return all the browned mushrooms to the skillet along with any juices on the plate. Add the salt and pepper and toss to coat in the garlic butter.

steps.title: Finish with butter and parsley
steps.details: Cook 2 to 3 minutes more until the mushrooms are tender and glossy, then stir in the remaining 1 tablespoon butter and the parsley off the heat. Taste and adjust salt.

recipe.title: Steakhouse Dinner Rolls
recipe.intro: Soft, buttery yeast rolls finished with melted butter and flaky salt. You'll need a large bowl, a stand mixer with dough hook (or a sturdy spoon and strong arm), a 9x13-inch baking pan, and a clean towel. Have butter softened and warm milk ready before starting.
recipe.finish: Rolls are done when deep golden brown on top and the internal temperature reads about 190°F (88°C); the bottoms should sound hollow when tapped. Brush hot rolls generously with melted butter and sprinkle with flaky salt. Cool in the pan 10 minutes, then serve warm. Best the same day; reheat leftovers wrapped in foil at 300°F for 5–8 minutes.

steps.title: Warm milk and melt butter
steps.details: Warm the milk to 110–115°F (it should feel warm, not hot, on your wrist). Melt 4 Tbsp butter and let it cool slightly so it doesn't kill the yeast.

steps.title: Whisk dry ingredients
steps.details: In a large bowl or the stand mixer bowl, whisk 3 1/2 cups of the flour, the yeast, sugar, and fine salt until evenly combined.

steps.title: Mix wet into dry
steps.details: Add the warm milk, melted butter, and beaten egg to the dry ingredients. Stir with a dough hook on low (or a sturdy spoon) until a shaggy dough forms, about 1 minute.

steps.title: Knead until smooth
steps.details: Knead on medium-low with the dough hook 6–7 minutes, adding the remaining 1/2 cup flour a spoonful at a time only if the dough sticks badly. Dough is ready when smooth, slightly tacky, and pulls away from the bowl sides. By hand, knead 8–10 minutes on a floured counter.

steps.title: First rise
steps.details: Shape dough into a ball, place in a lightly greased bowl, cover with a towel, and let rise in a warm spot until doubled, about 60 minutes.

steps.title: Shape the rolls
steps.details: Grease a 9x13-inch pan. Punch down the dough, divide into 12 equal pieces (about 70 g each), and roll each into a tight ball. Arrange in the pan with small gaps between them.

steps.title: Second rise
steps.details: Cover the pan loosely with a towel and let rise until puffy and nearly touching, 35–45 minutes. Near the end, heat the oven to 350°F.

steps.title: Bake until golden
steps.details: Bake at 350°F for 22–26 minutes, until deep golden brown and the center roll reaches 190°F. Rotate the pan halfway through if your oven bakes unevenly.

steps.title: Butter and salt
steps.details: Immediately brush the hot rolls with the 2 Tbsp melted butter and sprinkle with flaky sea salt. Cool in the pan 10 minutes, then serve warm.

recipe.title: Classic New York Cheesecake
recipe.intro: Let cream cheese and eggs sit at room temperature for 1 hour before starting. You need a 9-inch springform pan, a roasting pan or large baking dish for the water bath, and aluminum foil. Preheat oven to 325°F with a rack in the lower-middle position. Start a kettle of water for the water bath.
recipe.finish: The cheesecake is done when the outer 2 inches are set and the center wobbles slightly like set gelatin when the pan is nudged; it should not look wet or soupy. Cool on a rack 1 hour, then refrigerate uncovered until cold, at least 4 hours or overnight. Run a thin knife around the edge, release the springform, and slice with a hot, dry knife. Serve plain or with a spoonful of cherry compote.

steps.title: Preheat oven and boil water
steps.details: Heat oven to 325°F. Put 6 cups water on to boil or heat a kettle; you will pour it into the roasting pan after the cheesecake goes in.

steps.title: Make and press crust
steps.details: Mix graham cracker crumbs, 3 tablespoons sugar, and melted butter until evenly moist. Press firmly into the bottom and about 1 inch up the sides of the springform pan.

steps.title: Bake crust
steps.details: Bake the crust until fragrant and just set, 10 to 12 minutes. Cool on a rack 10 minutes while you make the filling. Leave oven on.

steps.title: Wrap pan for water bath
steps.details: Wrap the outside of the cooled springform pan tightly in two layers of heavy-duty aluminum foil, coming up above the rim, to keep water out.

steps.title: Beat cream cheese smooth
steps.details: In a large bowl, beat softened cream cheese with 1 1/4 cups sugar and salt on medium-low until perfectly smooth and no lumps remain, 2 to 3 minutes, scraping the bowl.

steps.title: Add sour cream and vanilla
steps.details: Beat in sour cream and vanilla on low just until combined.

steps.title: Fold in eggs gently
steps.details: With the mixer on low, add beaten eggs and yolk in three additions, mixing just until each is incorporated; do not whip in air. Scrape the bowl and pour the filling over the cooled crust.

steps.title: Bake in water bath
steps.details: Set the foil-wrapped pan in the roasting pan on the oven rack. Pour the hot water into the roasting pan to reach about 1 inch up the side of the springform. Bake until the outer 2 inches are set and the center wobbles slightly, 60 to 70 minutes.

steps.title: Cool and chill
steps.details: Lift the pan out of the water bath, remove the foil, and cool on a rack 1 hour. Refrigerate uncovered until cold, at least 4 hours or overnight, before releasing the springform.

recipe.title: Classic Old Fashioned
recipe.intro: No cooking needed—just a mixing glass, a bar spoon (or teaspoon), a vegetable peeler, and a rocks glass. Chill the glass in the freezer while you prep. Use a large 2-inch ice cube if you have one; it dilutes the drink more slowly.
recipe.finish: The Old Fashioned is ready when the sugar has fully dissolved and the drink is cold and slightly amber. Garnish with the orange peel and cherry, and serve immediately. Sip slowly; the large ice cube keeps it cold without turning it watery.

ingredients.name: bourbon
ingredients.prep: 80–90 proof, such as Maker's Mark or Bulleit

ingredients.name: orange peel
ingredients.prep: about 2 inches, removed with a vegetable peeler, pith scraped off

steps.title: Chill the glass
steps.details: Put a rocks glass in the freezer to chill while you build the drink.

steps.title: Muddle sugar and bitters
steps.details: In a mixing glass, combine the sugar cube and bitters. Press and stir with the back of a bar spoon (or muddler) until the sugar is mostly broken down into a paste, about 30 seconds.

steps.title: Add bourbon and stir
steps.details: Pour in the bourbon and stir gently for 20–30 seconds to dissolve the remaining sugar. Do not add ice yet; you want the sugar fully dissolved before dilution.

steps.title: Express the orange peel
steps.details: Hold the orange peel over the mixing glass, skin side down, and squeeze to spray the citrus oils onto the drink. Rub the peel around the rim of the chilled rocks glass, then drop it into the mixing glass.

steps.title: Stir with ice and strain
steps.details: Add a handful of ice to the mixing glass and stir for 20–30 seconds until the outside of the glass feels very cold. Place the large ice cube in the chilled rocks glass, then strain the cocktail over it.

steps.title: Garnish and serve
steps.details: Fish the orange peel out of the mixing glass and twist it over the drink, then add it to the glass along with the cherry if using. Serve right away.

recipe.title: Herb-Crusted Prime Rib with Horseradish Cream
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 450°F (230°C). Let the prime rib sit at room temperature for 1 hour before roasting. You will need a roasting pan with a rack, a meat thermometer, and a small bowl for the horseradish cream.
recipe.finish: Remove the roast from the oven and let it rest for 20 minutes before carving. The internal temperature will rise about 5–10°F during resting. Carve the roast by separating the bones and slicing the meat across the grain. Serve with the horseradish cream on the side.

ingredients.name: bone-in prime rib roast
ingredients.prep: trim excess fat, leave a thin layer

steps.title: Preheat oven
steps.details: Preheat oven to 450°F (230°C).

steps.title: Make herb paste
steps.details: In a small bowl, combine minced garlic, rosemary, thyme, 2 teaspoons salt, 1 teaspoon pepper, and olive oil. Mix into a paste.

steps.title: Season roast
steps.details: Pat the roast dry with paper towels. Rub the herb paste all over the roast, pressing gently so it adheres. Let sit at room temperature for 30 minutes (optional but recommended).

steps.title: Make horseradish cream
steps.details: In a bowl, stir together sour cream, horseradish, lemon juice, 1/2 teaspoon salt, and 1/4 teaspoon pepper. Cover and refrigerate until serving. Stir in chives just before serving if using.

steps.title: Roast at high heat
steps.details: Place roast bone-side down on a rack in a roasting pan. Roast at 450°F for 15 minutes to sear.

steps.title: Reduce heat and roast
steps.details: Reduce oven temperature to 325°F (165°C). Continue roasting until internal temperature reaches 120°F for medium-rare, about 1 hour 45 minutes more (or 130°F for medium, 1 hour 55 minutes). Begin checking temperature after 1 hour 30 minutes.

steps.title: Rest roast
steps.details: Transfer roast to a cutting board, tent loosely with foil, and rest for 20 minutes. Internal temperature will rise to about 125-130°F for medium-rare.

steps.title: Serve
steps.details: Carve roast and serve with horseradish cream.

recipe.title: Yorkshire Puddings
recipe.intro: Classic popovers for prime rib, baked in hot beef drippings. Use a 12-cup muffin tin or two 6-cup tins. Have all ingredients at room temperature; preheat oven to 450°F (230°C) with a rack in the middle. Set the tin with 1/2 teaspoon drippings in each cup into the oven to heat while you mix the batter.
recipe.finish: Puddings are done when deeply golden, puffed high, and firm to the touch, with no pale, doughy centers; a skewer inserted in the center should come out clean. Serve immediately, straight from the tin, alongside sliced prime rib and gravy. If they must wait, keep them in a 200°F (95°C) oven with the door ajar for up to 10 minutes.

ingredients.name: beef drippings or melted beef tallow
ingredients.prep: divided; 1/2 teaspoon per cup, remainder optional

steps.title: Preheat oven and tin
steps.details: Set a rack in the middle of the oven and preheat to 450°F (230°C). Put 1/2 teaspoon beef drippings into each cup of a 12-cup muffin tin (or use vegetable oil if short on drippings). Place the tin in the oven to heat while you make the batter, at least 10 minutes.

steps.title: Whisk dry ingredients
steps.details: In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour and salt until evenly combined.

steps.title: Whisk eggs and milk
steps.details: In a large bowl or 4-cup measuring jug, whisk the eggs and milk until smooth and fully blended.

steps.title: Make smooth batter
steps.details: Pour the dry ingredients into the egg mixture and whisk just until smooth; a few small lumps are fine. Let the batter rest at room temperature while the oven and tin finish heating, about 10 minutes.

steps.title: Check tin is smoking hot
steps.details: The fat in the muffin tin should be shimmering and just beginning to smoke. Carefully pull the hot tin out onto a heatproof surface; close the oven door to keep the heat in.

steps.title: Fill cups and bake
steps.details: Working quickly, pour batter into the hot cups, filling each about two-thirds full (about 1/4 cup). Immediately return the tin to the oven and bake undisturbed for 20 minutes; do not open the door.

steps.title: Finish until puffed and golden
steps.details: Reduce oven to 375°F (190°C) and continue baking until the puddings are deep golden, puffed high, and firm, 10–15 minutes more. Do not underbake, or they will collapse.

steps.title: Pierce and serve
steps.details: Remove the tin from the oven. If any puddings look moist in the center, pierce each with a skewer to release steam and return to the oven for 2–3 minutes. Serve hot from the tin.

recipe.title: Garlic Mashed Potatoes
recipe.intro: Roast the garlic and boil the potatoes, then mash with butter and milk. You'll need a large pot, a baking sheet, and a potato masher or ricer.
recipe.finish: Potatoes are done when fluffy and heated through. Serve hot, with extra butter if desired. Keep warm in a covered bowl set over simmering water if needed.

steps.title: Preheat oven and roast garlic
steps.details: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Toss garlic cloves with olive oil, wrap in foil, and roast until tender and golden, about 25–30 minutes.

steps.title: Boil potatoes
steps.details: While garlic roasts, put potatoes in a large pot, cover with cold water by 1 inch, add 1 tablespoon salt, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer until fork-tender, about 15–20 minutes.

steps.title: Warm milk and butter
steps.details: In a small saucepan, warm milk and butter over low heat until butter melts and milk is hot but not boiling. Keep warm.

steps.title: Mash potatoes with garlic
steps.details: Drain potatoes well and return to the pot. Mash until smooth. Add roasted garlic, warmed milk mixture, 1/2 teaspoon salt, and pepper; stir until fluffy. Taste and adjust seasoning.
