recipe.title: Green Beans with Almonds and Lemon
recipe.intro: Use a large skillet or a wide pot so the beans cook evenly. Have a bowl of ice water ready to stop the beans from overcooking. If your green beans are already trimmed, skip that prep.
recipe.finish: The beans should be bright green and crisp-tender, with a slight snap when bitten. Taste and add a pinch more salt or lemon juice if needed. Transfer to a warm serving dish and top with the remaining toasted almonds and lemon zest. Serve immediately.

steps.title: Toast the almonds
steps.details: Put the sliced almonds in a large dry skillet over medium heat. Stir often for 4 to 6 minutes until golden brown and fragrant. Watch closely near the end so they do not burn. Pour onto a plate to cool.

steps.title: Boil water and make ice bath
steps.details: While the almonds toast, fill a large pot with water, add 1 tablespoon kosher salt, and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. Fill a large bowl with ice and cold water.

steps.title: Blanch the green beans
steps.details: Add the trimmed green beans to the boiling water. Cook for 4 to 5 minutes, until bright green and crisp-tender; a bean should bend slightly but still snap. Do not let them go soft.

steps.title: Shock the beans
steps.details: Use tongs or a spider to transfer the beans straight into the ice water. Chill for 2 minutes to stop the cooking, then drain well and pat dry with clean towels.

steps.title: Melt butter and warm beans
steps.details: Return the empty pot or a large skillet to medium heat. Add the butter and let it melt and foam, about 1 minute. Add the drained green beans, 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt, and the black pepper. Toss for 2 to 3 minutes until hot throughout.

steps.title: Add almonds, lemon, and serve
steps.details: Add the toasted almonds and lemon zest, reserving a small handful of almonds and a pinch of zest for the top. Drizzle in the lemon juice and toss well. Taste, adjust salt, and transfer to a serving dish. Finish with the reserved almonds and zest.

recipe.title: Roasted Root Vegetables
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C) with racks in upper and lower thirds. Have two rimmed baking sheets ready. Wash and peel vegetables; trim Brussels sprouts. This side roasts alongside a holiday prime rib, so keep oven space in mind — use two sheets if needed.
recipe.finish: Vegetables are done when fork-tender with deep golden caramelized edges, 35–40 minutes total. Toss gently, taste for salt, and serve hot straight from the sheet or transfer to a warm platter.

steps.title: Preheat oven
steps.details: Set oven to 425°F (220°C) with racks in upper and lower thirds. Allow 15 minutes to fully preheat while you cut vegetables.

steps.title: Cut carrots and parsnips
steps.details: Peel carrots and parsnips, then cut into even 1-inch chunks so they roast at the same rate. Keep pieces similar in size.

steps.title: Prep sprouts and onion
steps.details: Trim Brussels sprout stems and halve lengthwise; cut red onion into 1-inch wedges, leaving root end intact to hold layers together.

steps.title: Oil and season vegetables
steps.details: On two rimmed sheets, divide carrots, parsnips, sprouts, and onion. Drizzle each sheet with 2 tbsp olive oil, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp pepper, and 1 tbsp chopped herbs. Toss to coat evenly and spread in a single layer, cut sides down.

steps.title: Roast first side
steps.details: Roast both sheets 20 minutes without stirring so cut sides caramelize. Rotate sheets top to bottom and front to back halfway through.

steps.title: Stir and continue roasting
steps.details: Stir vegetables and swap sheet positions. Continue roasting until fork-tender and deeply browned at edges, 15–20 more minutes. Check doneness at 15 minutes.

steps.title: Season and serve
steps.details: Taste and adjust salt and pepper. Sprinkle with remaining fresh herbs if desired and serve hot.

recipe.intro: A bright holiday side salad of baby kale and spinach, dried cranberries, toasted pecans, and a maple-Dijon vinaigrette. You'll need a small skillet, a small bowl or jar for the dressing, a whisk, and a large salad bowl.

steps.title: Toast the pecans

steps.title: Whisk the vinaigrette

steps.title: Combine the greens

steps.title: Top with pecans and serve
steps.details: Scatter the cooled pecans over the top, toss once or twice, and serve right away.

recipe.title: Shrimp Cocktail with Lemon Wedges
recipe.intro: Get ready: thaw shrimp if frozen (overnight in the fridge or 30 minutes in cold water). Have a large pot, a big bowl of ice water, and a platter that fits in the fridge. Zest and juice the lemons before slicing the wedges.

lemon, halved

steps.title: Make cocktail sauce

steps.title: Cut lemon wedges
steps.details: Cut the 2 lemons into wedges and refrigerate until serving.

steps.title: Heat the poaching water

steps.title: Prepare the ice bath

recipe.title: Classic Beef Gravy
recipe.intro: Make this in the roasting pan right after the prime rib comes out to rest. You need the pan with its browned drippings, a fat separator or spoon, a whisk, and a wooden spoon. Have everything measured before the roast finishes so the gravy comes together in the 15–20 minutes the beef rests.
recipe.finish: Gravy should coat the back of a spoon and taste rich but not salty; loosen with hot stock if too thick. Keep warm over low heat, whisking now and then, and serve with the sliced prime rib. If the gravy cools and thickens, whisk in a splash of hot stock or water before serving.

ingredients.name: roasted prime rib pan drippings (fat and browned bits from the roasting pan)
ingredients.prep: reserved from the rested roast, pan deglazed

steps.title: Separate the pan drippings
steps.details: Pour the drippings from the rested roast into a glass measuring cup or fat separator and let stand 3 minutes. Spoon off and reserve 3 tbsp of the clear fat; keep the dark juices.

steps.title: Warm the stock
steps.details: Heat the beef stock in a small saucepan over medium-low until steaming but not boiling, about 4 minutes. Keep warm.

steps.title: Make a roux in the pan
steps.details: Set the roasting pan over medium heat. Add the reserved 3 tbsp fat and the flour and whisk constantly until the mixture bubbles and turns light tan, 1–2 minutes. Scrape up browned bits as it loosens.

steps.title: Deglaze with wine
steps.details: Pour in the red wine and whisk hard, scraping the bottom, until it bubbles and is nearly evaporated, about 1 minute.

steps.title: Whisk in stock
steps.details: Pour the warm stock in a steady stream while whisking constantly so no lumps form. Add the reserved dark juices, salt, and pepper and bring to a simmer.

steps.title: Simmer until glossy
steps.details: Simmer gently, whisking often and scraping the pan, until the gravy coats the back of a spoon, 6–8 minutes. Taste and adjust salt and pepper.

steps.title: Strain and serve
steps.details: Pour through a fine-mesh sieve into a warm gravy boat or bowl, pressing the solids. Serve hot with the sliced prime rib.

recipe.title: Individual Chocolate Lava Cakes
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Butter and lightly flour six 6-oz ramekins (or spray with baking spray). Set a baking sheet nearby and put a pot of water on to simmer for a water bath if you like; no specialty gear needed. Chop chocolate and cube butter while the oven heats.
recipe.finish: Cakes are done when edges are set and slightly puffed but centers still look soft and glossy, 11–13 minutes. Do not overbake or the centers set. Cool 1 minute, run a knife around each rim, invert onto plates, and serve immediately with a dollop of whipped cream.

steps.title: Preheat and prep ramekins
steps.details: Heat oven to 425°F (220°C) with a rack in the middle. Generously butter six 6-oz ramekins, dust with flour, and tap out excess.

steps.title: Melt chocolate and butter
steps.details: Combine chopped chocolate and butter in a heatproof bowl set over barely simmering water (or microwave in 20-second bursts), stirring until smooth. Remove from heat and let cool 3 minutes.

steps.title: Whisk eggs and sugar
steps.details: In a medium bowl, whisk eggs, egg yolks, sugar, salt, and vanilla until pale and slightly thickened, about 2 minutes.

steps.title: Fold in chocolate mixture
steps.details: Pour the slightly cooled chocolate-butter mixture into the egg mixture and whisk gently until just combined.

steps.title: Add flour and fill ramekins
steps.details: Sift flour over the batter and fold with a spatula until no streaks remain. Divide evenly among the prepared ramekins, filling about three-quarters full; set on a baking sheet.

steps.title: Bake lava cakes
steps.details: Bake 11–13 minutes, until edges are set and puffed but centers still jiggle softly and look glossy. Begin checking at 11 minutes.

steps.title: Whip the cream
steps.details: While cakes bake, whip cold cream with powdered sugar to soft-to-medium peaks, 2–3 minutes. Refrigerate until serving.

steps.title: Unmold and serve
steps.details: Cool cakes 1 minute, run a thin knife around rims, invert onto plates, dust with powdered sugar if desired, and top each with whipped cream. Serve immediately.

recipe.title: Sparkling Cranberry-Pomegranate Punch
recipe.intro: No cooking required. You need a large punch bowl or 3-quart pitcher, a ladle, and a rimmed tray for the ice ring if using. Chill all liquids and the ice ring at least 4 hours ahead; assemble just before serving so it stays fizzy.
recipe.finish: Ladle into glasses over ice, spooning in a few pomegranate seeds and an orange slice per glass. The punch is at its best within 30 minutes; if it sits longer the bubbles fade and the ice dilutes it, so top with the last cup of sparkling water if needed.

ingredients.name: orange
ingredients.prep: half sliced into rounds, half juiced

ingredients.name: cold sparkling water or club soda
ice cubes or a frozen ice ring
ingredients.prep: made from water or cranberry juice

steps.title: Chill and freeze
steps.details: Refrigerate the cranberry juice, pomegranate juice, lemon juice, and sparkling water until cold, at least 4 hours. If using an ice ring, freeze it the night before. No oven or stovetop needed.

steps.title: Prep the fruit
steps.details: Juice the lemons and half the orange into a small bowl, measure ½ cup lemon juice, and slice the remaining orange half into thin rounds. Pick over and pat dry the pomegranate seeds.

steps.title: Mix the juices
steps.details: In the punch bowl or a 3-quart pitcher, stir together the cranberry juice, pomegranate juice, lemon juice, orange juice, and sugar until the sugar dissolves. Taste; add up to 2 tablespoons more sugar only if it is too tart.

steps.title: Add fruit and ice
steps.details: Float the orange slices and pomegranate seeds in the juice, then add the ice cubes or slide in the ice ring. Stir gently once so the fruit spreads.

steps.title: Top with sparkling water
steps.details: Just before serving, pour in the cold sparkling water and stir once, very gently, with a long spoon. Do not over-stir or you will knock out the bubbles.

recipe.title: Oysters on the Half Shell with Mignonette
recipe.intro: Fresh raw oysters served on crushed ice with a classic shallot-vinegar mignonette. You will need a stiff oyster knife, a towel, and a platter or deep tray for ice. Serve oysters very cold; shuck close to serving time.

steps.details: Spread the crushed ice in a deep platter or tray and refrigerate until you are ready to arrange the oysters.

steps.title: Make mignonette

steps.title: Scrub and sort oysters

steps.details: Spoon a little mignonette over each oyster or set the bowl alongside. Scatter with chopped chives or parsley if using, and serve immediately.

recipe.title: Creamy New England Clam Chowder
recipe.intro: Have everything chopped before you start. Use a heavy 5-quart pot and a wooden spoon. If using fresh clams, steam them first (see step 1) and save the broth; canned clams are a fine shortcut.
recipe.finish: Chowder is done when the potatoes are fork-tender and the broth is lightly thickened. Taste, adjust salt and pepper, and serve hot with oyster crackers. Cool leftovers within 1 hour and refrigerate up to 3 days; reheat gently without boiling hard.

ingredients.name: clam broth or bottled clam juice

steps.title: Soften the vegetables

steps.title: Make the flour base

steps.details: Pour in clam broth, scraping up browned bits. Stir in potatoes, salt and pepper, and bring to a gentle boil.

steps.title: Simmer until potatoes are tender

steps.details: Take pot off the heat, stir in cream, and return to low heat just until hot, 2 to 3 minutes; do not boil. Taste and adjust salt and pepper.

recipe.title: Garlic Butter Steamed Mussels
recipe.intro: Rinse and debeard the mussels, discarding any that stay open when tapped. Chop the garlic and parsley. Have a large pot with a tight lid ready; no preheat needed.

steps.title: Melt butter and garlic

steps.title: Add wine and season

steps.details: Add all the cleaned mussels to the pot and cover tightly. Steam until the shells open, 6 to 8 minutes, shaking the pot once or twice.

steps.title: Check doneness and finish
steps.details: Uncover and check that the mussels are open and opaque. Discard any that remain closed. Scatter the chopped parsley over the top and toss with the broth.

recipe.title: Herb-Roasted Salmon Fillet
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a rimmed baking sheet with foil or parchment for easy cleanup. Pat salmon dry; ready a platter.
recipe.finish: Salmon is done when it flakes easily with a fork and reaches 145°F (63°C) in the thickest part. Let rest 5 minutes, then serve with lemon wedges.

ingredients.name: lemon
ingredients.prep: zest and slice half, cut other half into wedges

steps.title: Preheat oven
steps.details: Set oven to 400°F (200°C) and place rack in the middle.

steps.title: Prepare lemon and dill
steps.details: Zest the lemon, then slice half into thin rounds; cut the other half into wedges. Chop dill.

steps.title: Season salmon
steps.details: Rub salmon all over with olive oil, then sprinkle evenly with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Add lemon and dill
steps.details: Scatter lemon zest and half the dill over the salmon, then arrange lemon slices on top.

steps.title: Bake salmon
steps.details: Transfer salmon to lined baking sheet. Bake at 400°F until salmon flakes easily and reaches 145°F, 15–20 minutes.

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.details: Let rest 5 minutes, then sprinkle with remaining dill and serve with lemon wedges.

recipe.title: Crispy Beer-Battered Fish and Chips
recipe.intro: Thick-cut russet fries oven-roasted while you make a cold beer batter for flaky cod. Use a heavy pot with at least 3 inches of oil for frying. Pat the fish very dry and keep the batter cold and lumpy.
recipe.finish: Fish is done when the batter is deep golden and the fish flakes easily at the thickest point (145°F/63°C). Drain on a rack, salt immediately, and serve hot with fries, malt vinegar, and tartar sauce.

ingredients.name: russet potatoes
ingredients.prep: scrub, cut into 1/2-inch-thick batons, soak in cold water 10 min, drain and pat very dry

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.prep: for fries, plus more for finish

ingredients.name: cod or haddock fillets
ingredients.prep: pat very dry, cut into 4 equal portions, season lightly with salt

ingredients.name: vegetable oil
ingredients.prep: for deep frying, in a heavy pot

steps.title: Heat oven and fry oil
steps.details: Preheat oven to 425°F. Put 8 cups oil in a heavy pot and heat over medium to 350°F, monitoring with a thermometer.

steps.title: Season and roast fries
steps.details: Toss dried potato batons with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp salt, spread on a rimmed sheet in one layer, and roast 30–35 minutes, flipping twice, until golden and crisp.

steps.title: Mix dry batter
steps.details: Whisk 1 cup flour, baking powder, 1 tsp salt, and pepper in a bowl.

steps.title: Add cold beer
steps.details: Pour in cold beer gradually, whisking just until combined; leave small lumps. Keep batter cold until frying.

steps.title: Dredge fish
steps.details: Spread remaining 1/2 cup flour on a plate and coat each seasoned fish portion, shaking off excess.

steps.title: Fry first batch
steps.details: Dip 2 fish portions in batter, let excess drip off, and lower into 350°F oil. Fry 6–8 minutes, turning once, until deep golden and 145°F at the center. Drain on a rack.

steps.title: Fry second batch
steps.details: Recheck oil is 350°F and repeat with remaining fish, frying 6–8 minutes until golden and cooked through. Drain on a rack.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.details: Salt fish and fries, and serve with lemon wedges and tartar sauce.

generatedRecipes.title: Buttered Sweet Corn on the Cob

recipe.title: Buttered Sweet Corn on the Cob
recipe.intro: Use a large pot wide enough to hold the corn lying flat. Shuck corn right before cooking and bring plenty of salted water to a boil; have butter softened and ready.
recipe.finish: Corn is done when kernels are tender and bright yellow, 4–6 minutes after the water returns to a boil. Brush hot corn generously with salted butter and serve immediately with flaky salt.

ingredients.name: fresh sweet corn
ingredients.prep: shuck, remove silks, leave husks off

steps.title: Boil the water
steps.details: Fill a large pot with the water and salt. Cover and bring to a rolling boil over high heat; this can take 10–15 minutes.

steps.title: Shuck the corn
steps.details: While the water heats, pull back husks and remove all silks from each ear. Snap off any long stalk ends and set ears aside.

steps.title: Soften the butter
steps.details: Cut the salted butter into pieces and let it soften in a small bowl, or melt it gently in the microwave if you prefer brushing.

steps.title: Boil the corn
steps.details: Lower ears into the boiling water in a single layer, adding them in batches if needed. Cover and return to a boil, then cook 4–6 minutes until kernels are tender and bright yellow.

steps.title: Butter and season
steps.details: Lift corn out with tongs, letting excess water drip off. Brush or rub each ear with salted butter and sprinkle lightly with flaky sea salt if using. Serve hot.

recipe.title: Crusty Sourdough Baguettes
recipe.intro: You will need a digital scale, 3 baguette pans or a lined baking sheet, a spray bottle of water, and a baking stone or inverted heavy sheet pan if you have one. Start the night before if you have time for a slow, more flavorful rise; otherwise use the plain yeast version below. Bring all ingredients to room temperature. Preheat is covered in the st
recipe.finish: Baguettes are done when deeply golden and the internal temperature reads 200–205°F (93–96°C). Cool 15–20 minutes on a wire rack so the crumb sets, then slice on a slight diagonal and serve warm with chowder and mussel broth. Best the same day; refresh at 350°F for 5 minutes.

ingredients.name: active sourdough starter (or 7 g instant yeast)
ingredients.prep: let starter come to room temperature

steps.title: Combine flours and water
steps.details: In a large bowl whisk the bread flour and whole wheat flour, then stir in the warm water until no dry flour remains. Cover and rest 30 minutes; this lets the flour hydrate for easier handling.

steps.title: Add starter and salt
steps.details: Sprinkle the starter over the dough and the salt on top. Squeeze and fold until fully incorporated and the dough smooths out, about 2 minutes.

steps.title: Stretch and fold
steps.details: Do 4 sets of stretch-and-folds spaced about 30 minutes apart: lift one side of the dough, stretch upward, and fold over the center, rotating the bowl a quarter turn each time. Cover between sets.

steps.title: Bulk ferment
steps.details: Cover the bowl and let rise at room temperature until the dough is puffy, about 50% larger, and shows bubbles on the surface, 60–90 minutes for an active starter (or 45–60 minutes with instant yeast).

steps.title: Preheat oven and prep steam
steps.details: Set a rack in the lower third with a baking stone or inverted heavy pan and preheat to 475°F. Put a metal pan on the floor of the oven and have the boiling water and spray bottle ready.

steps.title: Divide and preshape
steps.details: Turn dough onto a lightly floured counter. Divide into 3 equal pieces (about 290 g each), gently shape each into a loose log, cover, and rest 15 minutes.

steps.title: Shape baguettes
steps.details: Pat each piece into a rough rectangle, fold the long edges toward the center, then roll into a 14–15 inch log with tapered ends. Dust with rice flour and place seam-side down in floured baguette pans or on parchment.

steps.title: Final proof
steps.details: Cover loosely with a clean towel and proof until the dough springs back slowly when poked, 35–45 minutes. Score each loaf with three shallow diagonal slashes right before baking.

steps.title: Bake with steam
steps.details: Slide loaves onto the hot stone or pan. Pour boiling water into the floor pan, spray the oven walls, and bake at 475°F for 12 minutes. Remove the steam pan, rotate the pans, lower to 425°F, and bake 12–18 minutes more until deeply golden and 200–205°F inside.

steps.title: Cool and slice
steps.details: Transfer loaves to a wire rack and cool 15–20 minutes before slicing on the diagonal. Serve warm alongside the chowder and mussel broth.

recipe.title: Key Lime Pie
recipe.intro: No specialty tools needed: a 9-inch pie plate, mixing bowls, a whisk, and a hand or stand mixer for the cream. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Use fresh-squeezed key lime or regular lime juice; do not use bottled key lime juice if you can avoid it.
recipe.finish: The filling is set when the center jiggles only slightly like firm gelatin and a small offset spatula inserted 1 inch from the edge comes out clean, 15–20 minutes. Cool completely, then chill at least 4 hours (overnight is best) before slicing. Top with the whipped cream just before serving, slice with a warm knife, and keep leftovers refrigerated up to 3 days.

ingredients.name: graham cracker crumbs
ingredients.prep: about 12 whole sheets, crushed, or use ready-made crumbs

ingredients.name: fresh lime juice (key lime or regular)

steps.title: Preheat oven and make crust
steps.details: Heat oven to 350°F (175°C). Stir graham crumbs and granulated sugar in a bowl, drizzle in melted butter, and mix until it looks like damp sand. Press firmly and evenly up the sides and across the bottom of a 9-inch pie plate.

steps.title: Bake crust
steps.details: Bake the crust on the middle rack until fragrant and lightly browned at the edges, 9–11 minutes. It should look set, not wet. Set on a rack; leave the oven on.

steps.title: Whisk egg yolks
steps.details: While the crust bakes, whisk the egg yolks in a medium bowl for about 1 minute, until smooth and slightly pale.

steps.title: Add condensed milk and zest
steps.details: Whisk in the sweetened condensed milk and lime zest until fully combined and glossy, about 1 minute.

steps.title: Whisk in lime juice
steps.details: Add the lime juice and whisk gently just until combined; the mixture will thicken slightly. Do not overwhisk or beat in air.

steps.title: Fill and bake pie
steps.details: Pour filling into the warm crust and smooth the top. Bake until the center jiggles only slightly and a small offset spatula inserted 1 inch from the edge comes out clean, 15–20 minutes. Do not let it brown or puff.

steps.title: Cool and chill
steps.details: Cool the pie on a rack 1 hour, then refrigerate uncovered until cold, at least 4 hours or overnight. The filling should be fully set and slice cleanly.

steps.title: Whip the cream
steps.details: Just before serving, beat chilled heavy cream, powdered sugar, and vanilla on medium-high until soft peaks form, 2–3 minutes; stop while it still holds a gentle peak and spreads nicely.

steps.title: Top and serve
steps.details: Spread or pipe whipped cream over the chilled pie, leaving a border of filling visible, or dollop per slice. Slice with a warm knife and serve immediately.

recipe.title: Sparkling Lemonade with Fresh Mint
recipe.intro: No special equipment needed: a pitcher, a small saucepan, a citrus juicer or reamer, and a long spoon. Chill the lemonade base well before adding ice and soda so it stays fizzy and cold. Have the mint and lemon slices ready before you start.
recipe.finish: Stir gently once more, taste, and add a little more syrup if you like it sweeter. Pour over ice into tall glasses, garnish each with a mint sprig and a lemon wheel, and serve right away while it is still sparkling.

ingredients.name: fresh mint
ingredients.prep: rinsed; leaves kept on sprigs, plus extra for garnish

steps.title: Make the sugar syrup
steps.details: Combine the sugar and 1 cup water in a small saucepan over medium heat. Stir until the sugar dissolves and the liquid is clear, about 3–4 minutes; do not let it boil hard. Remove from the heat.

steps.title: Cool the syrup
steps.details: Let the syrup cool in the pan at room temperature until it is no longer hot, about 15 minutes. Meanwhile, juice and strain the lemons and rinse the mint.

steps.title: Combine base ingredients
steps.details: In a large pitcher, stir together the cooled syrup, 1 1/2 cups fresh lemon juice, and 4 cups cold water. Taste; it should be tart and just sweet.

steps.title: Add lemon and mint
steps.details: Add the lemon slices and a few mint sprigs to the pitcher. Press the mint gently against the side with a spoon to release its aroma, then refrigerate the base until thoroughly chilled, at least 30 minutes.

steps.title: Top with soda and serve
steps.details: Just before serving, pour in the chilled soda water and stir very gently once or twice. Add the ice, stir lightly, and serve immediately in tall glasses garnished with mint sprigs and lemon wheels.

recipe.title: Buttermilk Fried Chicken
recipe.intro: Brine the chicken in buttermilk for at least 4 hours (up to overnight). Use a heavy Dutch oven or deep cast-iron skillet and a clip-on thermometer. Fry in batches; keep finished pieces on a rack in a 200°F oven.
recipe.finish: Chicken is done when the juices run clear and the internal temperature at the thickest part (not touching bone) reaches 165°F. Drain on a rack, not paper towels, and rest 5 minutes before serving.

steps.title: Brine chicken in buttermilk
steps.details: In a large bowl or zip bag, combine chicken with 2 cups buttermilk and 1 tbsp hot sauce. Refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight.

steps.title: Heat frying oil
steps.details: Pour oil into a heavy Dutch oven to about 2 inches deep. Heat over medium-high to 350°F, monitoring with a clip-on thermometer.

steps.title: Make seasoned flour
steps.details: In a wide dish, whisk 2 1/2 cups flour with 1 tbsp salt, 2 tsp pepper, 2 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, and 1 tsp baking powder.

steps.title: Dredge chicken
steps.details: Lift each piece from the buttermilk, letting excess drip off, then coat thoroughly in seasoned flour. Press flour on, shake off loose excess, and set on a rack.

steps.title: Fry first batch
steps.details: Fry dark meat pieces in batches, skin side down, without crowding, keeping oil between 325°F and 350°F. Turn every 4–5 minutes until deep golden and internal temp reaches 165°F, 14–18 minutes.

steps.title: Fry second batch
steps.details: Fry breast pieces, turning every 4–5 minutes, until golden and 165°F at the center, 15–20 minutes depending on size.

steps.title: Drain and hold
steps.details: Transfer fried chicken to a wire rack over a sheet pan and keep warm in a 200°F oven while finishing remaining pieces. Rest 5 minutes before serving.

generatedRecipes.title: Slow-Cooker Pulled Pork with Carolina Sauce

recipe.title: Slow-Cooker Pulled Pork with Carolina Sauce
recipe.intro: Use a 6-quart slow cooker. Pat the pork dry and trim large hard fat caps; leave some fat for moisture. No preheating needed. Mix the dry rub and the Carolina sauce while the pork starts cooking, or make the sauce up to 3 days ahead and refrigerate.
recipe.finish: Pork is done when a fork twists easily and the meat shreds with almost no resistance (at least 195°F in the thickest part). Rest 15 minutes, shred, discard excess fat, and toss with 1/2 cup of the sauce plus 1 cup of defatted cooking liquid. Serve on soft buns or plates with extra sauce and slaw on the side.

ingredients.name: boneless pork shoulder (Boston butt)
ingredients.prep: pat dry, trim hard fat, cut into 3-4 large chunks

steps.title: Rub the pork
steps.details: In a small bowl, stir together 2 tbsp brown sugar, smoked paprika, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder and cayenne. Rub all over the pork chunks and place them in the slow cooker.

steps.title: Make Carolina sauce
steps.details: While the pork starts cooking, whisk cider vinegar, water, ketchup, 1 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tsp salt, red pepper flakes and 1/4 tsp black pepper until dissolved. Set aside; refrigerate if making ahead.

steps.title: Slow-cook the pork
steps.details: Cover and cook on LOW for 7 hours without opening the lid. The pork should be fork-tender and reach at least 195°F in the thickest chunk.

steps.title: Rest the pork
steps.details: Turn off the slow cooker and transfer the pork to a large bowl or board. Rest 15 minutes, then shred with two forks, discarding excess fat and any bone.

steps.title: Defat the juices
steps.details: Skim the fat from the slow-cooker liquid and reserve 1 cup of the defatted juices for moistening.

steps.title: Toss and serve
steps.details: Toss the shredded pork with 1/2 cup Carolina sauce and the 1 cup reserved juices, adding more juice or sauce to taste. Serve with extra sauce alongside.

recipe.title: Skillet Cornbread
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 425°F with a 10-inch cast-iron skillet (or 9-inch round pan) inside. Have a whisk, bowl, and pot holders ready; the skillet will be very hot.
recipe.finish: Cornbread is done when the top is golden and the center springs back, 18–22 minutes; a toothpick in the center should come out clean. Rest 5 minutes, then loosen the edge with a knife and invert or slice into wedges in the skillet. Serve warm.

ingredients.name: unsalted butter
ingredients.prep: melt, plus 1 tablespoon for the skillet

steps.title: Heat the skillet
steps.details: Place a 10-inch cast-iron skillet in the oven and preheat to 425°F. While it heats, assemble the batter.

steps.title: Whisk the dry ingredients
steps.details: In a large bowl, whisk cornmeal, flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, and sugar until evenly combined.

steps.title: Combine the wet ingredients
steps.details: In a bowl or measuring cup, whisk the buttermilk, eggs, and melted butter until smooth.

steps.title: Fold the batter together
steps.details: Pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients and stir with a spatula just until no dry streaks remain. The batter will be thick; do not overmix.

steps.title: Butter the hot skillet
steps.details: Wearing oven mitts, pull the hot skillet onto a heatproof surface and swirl the 1 tablespoon butter in it until the bottom and lower sides are coated.

steps.title: Add batter and bake
steps.details: Pour the batter into the hot buttered skillet and spread it evenly. Bake until golden on top and the center springs back when pressed, 18–22 minutes; a toothpick in the center should come out clean.

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.details: Cool in the skillet for 5 minutes. Run a knife around the edge, then slice into 8 wedges or invert onto a plate. Serve warm.

recipe.title: Creamy Baked Macaroni and Cheese
recipe.intro: Heat oven to 375°F. Boil water in a large pot and grate the cheese while it heats. Use a 9x13-inch baking dish.
recipe.finish: The center should be set and bubbly with a golden-brown crust; let it rest 10 minutes before serving so the sauce thickens.

steps.title: Boil salted water
steps.details: Fill a large pot with water, add 1 tablespoon salt, and bring to a rolling boil over high heat.

steps.title: Grate cheeses
steps.details: Grate the cheddar and Gruyere while the water heats; keep 1 cup cheddar separate for the top.

steps.title: Preheat oven
steps.details: Set oven to 375°F with a rack in the middle.

steps.title: Cook macaroni
steps.details: Add macaroni and cook 1 minute less than package directions, about 6 minutes, until just shy of al dente. Drain and set aside.

steps.title: Make roux
steps.details: In the empty pot over medium heat, melt 1/2 cup butter, whisk in flour, and cook 2 minutes until lightly golden and bubbling.

steps.title: Simmer cheese sauce
steps.details: Slowly whisk in milk and cream, then add salt, pepper, and dry mustard. Simmer, whisking, 5 minutes until slightly thickened.

steps.title: Melt in cheese
steps.details: Turn heat to low and stir in 3 cups cheddar and all the Gruyere until smooth; do not boil.

steps.title: Combine pasta and sauce
steps.details: Stir the drained macaroni into the cheese sauce until evenly coated.

steps.title: Assemble and top
steps.details: Pour into the baking dish. Toss panko with melted butter and scatter over the top with the reserved 1 cup cheddar.

steps.title: Bake until golden
steps.details: Bake 25 to 30 minutes, until the sauce bubbles at the edges and the top is golden brown. Rest 10 minutes before serving.

recipe.title: Collard Greens with Smoked Turkey
recipe.intro: Have a large pot with a lid and a cutting board ready. Rinse the collards well; no oven needed. Start the turkey simmering while you strip and chop the greens.
recipe.finish: The greens are done when the stems are tender and the leaves are silky, about 60–75 minutes total. Fish out the turkey, pull the meat off the bones, discard skin and bones, and stir the meat back in. Taste and add salt or a splash of vinegar if desired. Serve hot with the pot likker spooned over.

ingredients.name: collard greens
ingredients.prep: rinsed, thick stems stripped, leaves chopped into 2-inch pieces

steps.title: Simmer the smoked turkey
steps.details: Put the turkey and water in a large pot. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce to a steady low simmer, cover, and cook until the meat is tender and pulling from the bone, 45–60 minutes.

steps.title: Prep the greens and aromatics
steps.details: While the turkey simmers, rinse the collards in a sink of cold water, strip the thick stems, and chop the leaves into 2-inch pieces. Chop the onion and smash the garlic.

steps.title: Add the seasonings
steps.details: Stir the sugar, red pepper flakes, salt, and vinegar into the simmering broth.

steps.title: Add the greens and onion
steps.details: Add the chopped collards, onion, and garlic to the pot in handfuls, pressing them down as they wilt. Cover and return to a simmer.

steps.title: Slow-simmer the greens
steps.details: Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, stirring every 15 minutes, until the greens are very tender and the stems are soft, 60–75 minutes.

steps.title: Shred the turkey and finish
steps.details: Remove the turkey to a board and pull the meat off the bones; discard skin and bones. Stir the meat back into the pot, taste, and add salt or vinegar if needed before serving.

recipe.title: Southern Green Beans with Bacon
recipe.intro: Have a large skillet or Dutch oven with a lid, a colander, and a cutting board ready. No oven needed. Cook bacon first, then braise the beans in the bacon fat and broth for tender, pot-liquor-style beans.
recipe.finish: The beans should be tender and slightly wrinkled, and the broth should taste savory and smoky. If the pan looks dry before the beans are tender, add a splash more broth. Taste and add salt and pepper, then serve hot with a slotted spoon.

steps.title: Render the bacon
steps.details: Put the bacon pieces in a large skillet or Dutch oven over medium heat. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the fat renders and the bacon is crisp, 8 to 10 minutes. Do not let it burn.

steps.title: Soften onion in bacon fat
steps.details: Leave the bacon in the pan and add the diced onion. Cook over medium heat, stirring, until the onion is soft and lightly golden, about 5 minutes.

steps.title: Bloom the garlic
steps.details: Stir in the minced garlic and cook just until fragrant, about 1 minute. Keep it moving so the garlic does not brown or burn.

steps.title: Add beans and seasonings
steps.details: Add the trimmed green beans, chicken broth, sugar if using, salt, and pepper. Stir to coat everything and scrape up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan.

steps.title: Braise until tender
steps.details: Bring the liquid to a gentle simmer, then cover the pan and reduce the heat to medium-low. Cook, stirring once or twice, until the beans are very tender and the broth is flavorful, 20 to 25 minutes. Add a splash of broth or water if the pan dries out.

steps.title: Finish with vinegar and taste
steps.details: Uncover the pan and stir in the cider vinegar if using. Simmer uncovered for 2 to 3 minutes to concentrate the broth, then taste and add more salt and pepper as needed.

recipe.title: Classic Deviled Eggs
recipe.intro: Use a 4-quart pot and a steamer basket or colander insert if you have one. Start the eggs in cold water so they heat gently and don't crack. Have a bowl of ice water ready before the eggs finish.
recipe.finish: Eggs are done when yolks are firm and fully set with no dark ring, and the filling is smooth and seasoned. Serve chilled, dusted with paprika. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

steps.title: Boil the eggs
steps.details: Place eggs in a pot and cover with at least 1 inch of cold water. Bring to a rolling boil over high heat, then cover, remove from heat, and let stand 11 minutes.

steps.title: Ice bath the eggs
steps.details: Transfer eggs with a slotted spoon to a bowl of ice water and cool at least 10 minutes to stop cooking and make peeling easy.

steps.title: Peel and halve eggs
steps.details: Crack each egg all over, peel under cool running water, then halve lengthwise. Pop yolks into a bowl and set whites on a serving plate.

steps.title: Mash yolks
steps.details: Mash the yolks with a fork until no lumps remain.

steps.title: Make the filling
steps.details: Stir mayonnaise, mustard, salt, and pepper into the yolks until smooth and creamy. Taste and adjust salt.

steps.title: Fill the egg whites
steps.details: Spoon or pipe the filling into the whites, mounding slightly.

steps.title: Dust and garnish
steps.details: Lightly dust paprika over the filling and scatter chives on top just before serving.

recipe.title: Southern Peach Cobbler
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 375°F. Use a 9x13-inch baking dish and a mixing bowl. If using fresh peaches, peel and slice them; frozen sliced peaches can be used straight from the bag after thawing slightly.
recipe.finish: The cobbler is done when the topping is golden brown and a toothpick inserted into the biscuit center comes out clean, about 35–45 minutes. Let it rest 15 minutes so the juices set, then serve warm, ideally with vanilla ice cream.

ingredients.name: sliced peaches (fresh or frozen)
ingredients.prep: peel and slice if fresh; thaw slightly if frozen

steps.title: Heat oven and melt butter
steps.details: Heat oven to 375°F. Melt 2 tbsp butter for the peach filling; keep the remaining cold butter in the fridge until needed for the topping.

steps.title: Toss peaches with sugar
steps.details: In the baking dish or a large bowl, stir sliced peaches with 3/4 cup sugar, cornstarch, cinnamon, 1/4 tsp salt and lemon juice until evenly coated.

steps.title: Bake peach base
steps.details: Spread the peach mixture evenly in the 9x13-inch baking dish and bake uncovered for 10 minutes to start the juices bubbling.

steps.title: Mix dry topping
steps.details: While the peaches bake, whisk flour, 2 tbsp sugar, baking powder and 1/4 tsp salt in a bowl.

steps.title: Cut in cold butter
steps.details: Add cubed cold butter and rub or cut it in until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs with some pea-size bits.

steps.title: Stir milk and vanilla
steps.details: Stir milk and vanilla together, then pour into the flour mixture and stir just until a soft, sticky dough forms; do not overmix.

steps.title: Drop topping on hot peaches
steps.details: Pull the hot peach base from the oven. Spoon the dough in about 12 small mounds over the hot peaches, leaving some gaps for steam. Combine topping rows with the peach rows.

steps.title: Sprinkle coarse sugar
steps.details: Scatter coarse sugar evenly over the biscuit mounds for a crisp top.

steps.title: Bake until golden
steps.details: Bake at 375°F until the topping is golden brown and a toothpick in a biscuit center comes out clean, 35–45 minutes. The peach juices should bubble at the edges.

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.details: Cool the cobbler on a rack at least 15 minutes so the filling sets. Serve warm, spooned into bowls, with vanilla ice cream if you like.

recipe.title: Southern Sweet Tea
recipe.intro: Use a 3-quart saucepan and a 2-quart pitcher. Fill the pitcher with 6 cups cold water and keep it handy; a handful of ice goes in the glasses, not the pitcher. No specialty gear needed.
recipe.finish: Tea is ready when fully chilled and clear amber-brown. Taste and stir in more sugar while cold if you want it sweeter, since sugar dissolves slowly in cold tea. Pour over ice and serve; refrigerate leftovers up to 3 days.

ingredients.name: black tea bags
ingredients.prep: or 8 regular tea bags, tags removed

steps.title: Boil the water
steps.details: Pour 4 cups water into a 3-quart saucepan and bring to a rolling boil over high heat.

steps.title: Steep the tea
steps.details: Turn off the heat. Add the tea bags and optional baking soda, dunking the bags a few times so they are submerged. Cover and steep 6 minutes; do not squeeze the bags.

steps.title: Remove bags and stir in sugar
steps.details: Lift out the tea bags and discard. Stir in the sugar until completely dissolved, about 1 minute; the liquid should look clear, not gritty.

steps.title: Add cold water
steps.details: Pour the hot tea into a 2-quart pitcher, then add the 6 cups cold water and stir.

steps.title: Chill the tea
steps.details: Refrigerate uncovered until cold, at least 2 hours or up to overnight. Cover once chilled.

steps.title: Serve over ice
steps.details: Fill glasses with ice and pour the chilled tea over it. Add lemon wedges if using.

recipe.title: Classic Banana Pudding
recipe.intro: No-cook layered dessert. Have a 9x13-inch dish ready. For best flavor, let the finished pudding chill at least 2 hours (or overnight) before serving.
recipe.finish: Spoon into bowls, making sure each portion gets bananas, wafers, and topping. Store covered in the refrigerator up to 2 days; wafers soften over time.

ingredients.name: instant vanilla pudding mix
ingredients.prep: use box and cold milk per package

ingredients.name: ripe bananas
ingredients.prep: peel and slice 1/4 inch thick just before layering

steps.title: Make pudding base
steps.details: Whisk instant pudding mix with cold milk in a large bowl for 2 minutes until slightly thickened. Whisk in sweetened condensed milk until smooth.

steps.title: Whip the cream
steps.details: In a chilled bowl, beat heavy cream, sugar, and vanilla with a hand mixer on medium-high until soft peaks form, about 3 minutes. Stop when the beaters leave a brief trail that slowly settles.

steps.title: Fold cream into pudding
steps.details: Fold about half the whipped cream into the pudding base until mostly combined, then fold in the rest gently. Keep it light and airy; do not overmix.

steps.title: Layer wafers and bananas
steps.details: Spread 1 cup pudding in the bottom of a 9x13-inch dish. Top with one-third of the wafers in a single layer, then half the banana slices. Repeat once more, using another 1 cup pudding and the remaining banana half.

steps.title: Finish layers
steps.details: Spread the remaining pudding over the bananas. Arrange remaining wafers, standing some upright around the edge if desired, and scatter reserved wafers on top.

steps.title: Chill until set
steps.details: Cover and refrigerate until pudding is cold and set and wafers have softened, at least 2 hours or up to overnight.

steps.title: Check doneness and serve
steps.details: Pudding should be firm enough to hold a spoon trail and cold throughout. Spoon into bowls and serve.

recipe.title: Queso Fundido with Chorizo
recipe.intro: Use a 10-inch cast-iron or oven-safe skillet. Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and warm tortillas just before serving. Have all ingredients ready before melting the cheese, since queso fundido is best eaten immediately.
recipe.finish: The queso is ready when the cheese is fully melted, bubbling at the edges, and the chorizo is hot. Serve sizzling in the skillet with warm tortillas; it thickens quickly, so keep warm tortillas and chips alongside and eat right away.

ingredients.name: small flour torillas
ingredients.prep: warmed in a dry skillet or microwave

steps.title: Heat oven and prep toppings
steps.details: Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Dice the onion, slice the jalapeño, chop the cilantro, and shred the cheese. Warm tortillas covered in foil in the oven or briefly in a dry skillet.

steps.title: Brown the chorizo
steps.details: Heat oil in a 10-inch cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat. Add chorizo and cook, breaking it up, until browned and cooked through, 6–8 minutes. Transfer chorizo to a bowl, leaving about 1 tbsp fat in the skillet; wipe out excess if needed.

steps.title: Slick the skillet
steps.details: Return the skillet to medium-low heat and use the reserved chorizo fat to coat the bottom and sides. This helps the cheese release.

steps.title: Layer the cheese
steps.details: Spread half the shredded Oaxaca cheese in the skillet, scatter over about three-quarters of the chorizo, then top with the remaining shredded cheese.

steps.title: Melt in the oven
steps.details: Bake uncovered until the cheese is fully melted and bubbling at the edges, 10–12 minutes. Do not let it brown or the cheese will separate.

steps.title: Top and serve hot
steps.details: Top with the remaining chorizo, crumbled queso fresco, onion, jalapeño, and cilantro. Serve immediately in the skillet with warm tortillas for scooping.

recipe.title: Classic Chunky Guacamole
recipe.intro: No cooking needed. Have a bowl, fork, knife, and cutting board ready. Serve with tortilla chips. Make just before serving so the avocado stays bright green.
recipe.finish: Taste and adjust salt or lime. Press plastic wrap directly onto the surface if not serving right away, and use within 2 hours. Serve with tortilla chips.

steps.title: Chop onion and cilantro
steps.details: Finely chop the white onion and cilantro. Put both in a medium bowl.

steps.title: Prep tomato and chile
steps.details: Seed and finely chop the tomato, and mince the jalapeño if using. Add both to the bowl.

steps.title: Mash avocados with lime
steps.details: Halve, pit, and peel the avocados. Add to the bowl with the lime juice and salt. Mash with a fork until chunky, leaving some avocado pieces intact.

steps.title: Fold everything together
steps.details: Add the onion, cilantro, tomato, and jalapeño to the mashed avocado. Fold gently with a fork until combined, keeping it chunky.

steps.title: Taste and season
steps.details: Taste and add a pinch more salt or a squeeze of lime if needed. Transfer to a serving bowl.

steps.title: Serve with chips
steps.details: Serve immediately with tortilla chips. Press plastic wrap onto the surface of any leftovers.

generatedRecipes.title: Beef Fajitas with Peppers and Onions

recipe.title: Beef Fajitas with Peppers and Onions
recipe.intro: Get everything sliced before you start cooking, since the fajitas cook fast. You'll need a large cast-iron skillet or heavy skillet, a small bowl, a plate, and a clean kitchen towel or tortilla warmer. Have tortillas, lime wedges, and toppings ready at the table.
recipe.finish: Check beef is at least 145°F (63°C) for medium-rare with a 3-minute rest, or cook a little longer for medium. Serve immediately while sizzling, with warm tortillas, lime wedges, sour cream, and salsa.

ingredients.name: skirt steak
ingredients.prep: pat dry, trim any hard silverskin

steps.title: Warm tortillas
steps.details: Heat oven to 300°F. Put the foil-wrapped tortillas in the oven to warm for 10 minutes while you prep and cook.

steps.title: Season the steak
steps.details: In a small bowl, mix chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Rub the spice mixture and 1 tablespoon of the oil all over both sides of the steak. Whisk lime juice into any leftover spice mixture and set aside for drizzling later.

steps.title: Char peppers and onions
steps.details: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large cast-iron skillet over high heat until shimmering. Add peppers and onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and charred in spots, 7-9 minutes. Transfer to a plate.

steps.title: Sear the steak
steps.details: Add steak to the hot skillet and cook undisturbed until browned and it releases easily, about 4 minutes. Flip and cook 3-4 minutes more, until an instant-read thermometer in the thickest part reads 130-135°F for medium-rare.

steps.title: Rest the beef
steps.details: Transfer steak to a cutting board and rest 5 minutes before slicing. Keep the skillet off the heat.

steps.title: Slice the beef
steps.details: Slice the steak thinly across the grain.

steps.title: Reheat and combine
steps.details: Return peppers and onion to the skillet over medium-high heat. Add sliced steak and any resting juices and toss just until hot, about 2 minutes.

steps.title: Serve sizzling
steps.details: Drizzle with the reserved lime-spice mixture. Bring the skillet to the table with warm tortillas, lime wedges, sour cream, and salsa.

recipe.title: Green Chile Chicken Enchiladas
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Use a 9x13-inch baking dish. Have a ladle and tongs ready for assembling. Grate the cheese and shred the chicken first so everything is ready to roll.
recipe.finish: The enchiladas are done when the sauce bubbles at the edges and the cheese is melted and lightly golden, about 20 minutes. Let rest 5 minutes so the filling sets, then serve with sour cream, cilantro and lime.

steps.title: Heat oven and prep
steps.details: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Grate the cheese and shred the cooked chicken; chop cilantro and set aside for serving.

steps.title: Warm sauce
steps.details: Spread 1/2 cup green chile sauce on the bottom of the baking dish. Warm the remaining sauce in a small saucepan over medium-low heat until steamy but not boiling, about 4 minutes.

steps.title: Soften the tortillas
steps.details: Pour the oil into a small skillet over medium heat. Quickly dip each tortilla in the oil for about 5-10 seconds per side until pliable, then blot on paper towels. Do not let them get crisp.

steps.title: Fill the tortillas
steps.details: Lay a softened tortilla on a plate. Add a small handful of shredded chicken (about 2 tbsp) and a sprinkle of cheese (about 1 tbsp) down the center. Roll up snugly and place seam-side down in the baking dish. Repeat with all 12 tortillas.

steps.title: Top with sauce and cheese
steps.details: Pour the remaining warm green chile sauce evenly over the rolled enchiladas, then scatter the rest of the Monterey Jack cheese on top.

steps.title: Bake until bubbling
steps.details: Bake uncovered until the sauce is bubbling at the edges and the cheese is melted and lightly golden, 18-22 minutes.

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.details: Let the dish rest 5 minutes. Serve topped with sour cream and fresh cilantro.

recipe.title: Mexican Rice (Arroz Rojo)
recipe.intro: Have everything measured before you start: the rice gets toasted and then simmered without stirring, so it helps to have the blended tomato broth ready to pour. Use a heavy 3-quart saucepan with a tight lid. No preheat needed; you can start this on the stove while other dishes cook.
recipe.finish: Fluff the rice with a fork and taste; it should be tender with a little bite and all the broth absorbed. If it is still firm, add 1/4 cup hot water, cover, and cook 5 more minutes. Let it rest 5 minutes off heat, then serve warm alongside the rest of the fiesta.

ingredients.name: long-grain white rice
ingredients.prep: rinse in a sieve until water runs mostly clear, then drain well

ingredients.name: low-sodium chicken broth
ingredients.prep: measure out; have extra hot water ready

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.prep: measure out, plus more to taste

steps.title: Blend the tomato broth
steps.details: In a blender, combine the diced tomatoes with juice, garlic, cumin, salt, and 1 cup of the chicken broth. Blend until smooth, about 30 seconds. Set aside with the remaining 1 1/2 cups broth.

steps.title: Toast the rice
steps.details: Heat the oil in a heavy 3-quart saucepan over medium-high heat. Add the drained rice and cook, stirring often, until the grains turn light golden and smell nutty, 5 to 7 minutes. Do not let them brown deeply.

steps.title: Soften the onion
steps.details: Push the rice to one side, add the onion to the pan, and cook, stirring the onion occasionally, until translucent and soft, about 4 minutes. Stir it into the rice.

steps.title: Add the tomato mixture
steps.details: Carefully pour in the blended tomato mixture (it will bubble and steam). Stir constantly for 1 minute so the rice is evenly coated.

steps.title: Add broth and simmer
steps.details: Stir in the remaining 1 1/2 cups chicken broth and bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Reduce heat to low, cover tightly, and simmer without stirring until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed, 18 to 20 minutes.

steps.title: Rest off heat
steps.details: Turn off the heat and let the covered pan stand undisturbed for 5 minutes so the rice finishes steaming and firms up.

steps.title: Fluff and garnish
steps.details: Remove the lid, fluff the rice with a fork, and taste for salt. Scatter the cilantro over the top, if using, and serve hot.

recipe.title: Charro Beans
recipe.intro: Use a 4-quart pot. If using dried beans, soak overnight or quick-soak before starting; the timeline below assumes beans are already soaked and drained. Canned beans can be substituted (see notes in steps) and need only 20 minutes of simmering. Have everything chopped before you turn on the heat.
recipe.finish: The beans are done when the broth is slightly thickened and the beans are fully tender but not falling apart; taste and stir in more salt or a splash of bean liquid if needed. Serve hot in bowls with a slotted spoon, topped with cilantro and a squeeze of lime. Keeps refrigerated up to 4 days.

ingredients.name: dried pinto beans, soaked overnight and drained
kosher salt, plus more to taste

steps.title: Render the bacon
steps.details: Heat a 4-quart pot over medium heat. Add the chopped bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crisp and golden, about 8 minutes.

steps.title: Soften onion and jalapeño
steps.details: Add the diced onion and minced jalapeño to the bacon fat. Cook, stirring, until the onion is soft and translucent, about 5 minutes.

steps.title: Bloom garlic and spices
steps.details: Stir in the garlic, cumin, smoked paprika, and 1 teaspoon salt. Cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.

steps.title: Add beans, tomatoes, broth
steps.details: Add the drained soaked pinto beans, diced tomatoes with their juice, and 6 cups broth or water. Stir and scrape up any browned bits.

steps.title: Simmer until beans are tender
steps.details: Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to a gentle simmer. Cover partially and cook, stirring every 20 minutes, until beans are fully tender, 60 to 75 minutes. Add hot water if the pot looks dry.

steps.title: Check doneness and season
steps.details: Taste a bean: it should mash easily with no chalky center. Stir in the smoked paprika if you want a deeper smoky note, then add salt a little at a time until the broth tastes seasoned. If you used canned beans, simmer only 20 minutes here instead.

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.details: Let the pot rest off heat for 5 minutes so the broth thickens. Ladle into bowls and top with chopped cilantro and lime wedges.

recipe.title: Elote (Mexican Street Corn)
recipe.intro: Preheat a grill to medium-high (about 450°F) or heat a grill pan. Have tongs and a small bowl ready. Mix the creamy sauce while the grill heats.
recipe.finish: Serve the elotes warm, rolled in the cheese and chile right before eating, with lime wedges on the side. Corn is done when lightly charred in spots and tender.

steps.title: Heat the grill
steps.details: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high, about 450°F, with the lid closed.

steps.title: Mix the creamy sauce
steps.details: Whisk mayonnaise, sour cream, lime juice, lime zest, 1/4 tsp chili powder and salt in a small bowl until smooth.

steps.title: Grill the corn
steps.details: Place husked corn on the hot grill. Cook 10–12 minutes, turning every 2–3 minutes, until tender and lightly charred in spots.

steps.title: Set up the toppings
steps.details: While corn grills, put crumbled cotija and chopped cilantro in shallow dishes and keep the remaining 1/4 tsp chili powder nearby.

steps.title: Coat the corn
steps.details: Using tongs, brush or slather each hot corn cob generously with the creamy lime sauce on all sides.

steps.title: Add cheese and chile
steps.details: Roll each coated cob in cotija, sprinkle with a pinch of chili powder and scatter with cilantro. Serve with lime wedges.

recipe.title: Cinnamon Churros with Chocolate Sauce
recipe.intro: Get ready: a sturdy pot, a piping bag fitted with a large star tip (or a zip-top bag with a corner snipped), a candy/deep-fry thermometer, and paper towels. Start the chocolate sauce while the oil heats. Use a deep pot with at least 3 inches of oil and never fill it more than halfway.
recipe.finish: Churros are best fresh; serve within 20 minutes while crisp. Re-warm chocolate sauce gently if needed, stirring in a splash of warm milk if it thickens. Serve churros with the warm sauce for dipping.

steps.title: Mix cinnamon sugar
steps.details: Stir 1/2 cup sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon in a shallow bowl; set aside for coating.

steps.title: Heat frying oil
steps.details: Pour 6 cups oil into a deep heavy pot, keeping it no more than halfway full. Heat over medium to 360°F (180°C); adjust heat to hold that temperature.

steps.title: Warm chocolate sauce
steps.details: Heat 1/2 cup cream in a small saucepan over low until steaming but not boiling. Off heat, add chopped chocolate and stir until smooth; keep warm on low, stirring occasionally.

steps.title: Boil dough base
steps.details: Combine 1 cup water, 2 tbsp sugar, 1/4 tsp salt and butter in a saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium-high, stirring to melt butter.

steps.title: Make churro dough
steps.details: Off heat, stir in flour all at once until a smooth thick paste forms. Return to medium-low heat and cook 1 minute, stirring, until dough pulls from pan sides. Cool 3 minutes, then beat in egg until glossy and pipeable.

steps.title: Pipe churros
steps.details: Spoon dough into a piping bag with a large star tip. Pipe 4-inch strips onto a parchment-lined tray; work in batches so dough does not sit long.

steps.title: Fry first batch
steps.details: Fry 4–5 churros at a time at 360°F (180°C) for 2–3 minutes per side, turning once, until deep golden brown and crisp. Do not crowd the pot.

steps.title: Fry remaining batches
steps.details: Continue frying remaining churros in batches at 360°F (180°C), 2–3 minutes per side, until deep golden and crisp.

steps.title: Coat churros
steps.details: Drain each batch on paper towels 30 seconds, then roll warm churros in the cinnamon sugar until fully coated.

steps.title: Serve with sauce
steps.details: Arrange coated churros on a platter and serve with the warm chocolate sauce for dipping.

recipe.title: Fresh Lime Agua Fresca
recipe.intro: No special equipment needed: a pitcher, a citrus juicer or reamer, and a long spoon. Chill the water and serving glasses ahead if possible.
recipe.finish: Taste once more before serving; it should be tart, light, and just sweet enough. Pour over ice so it stays cold, and garnish with lime slices. Best the day it's made; stir before each refill since the juice settles.

ingredients.name: granulated sugar
ingredients.prep: start with less, adjust to taste

steps.title: Juice the limes
steps.details: Roll the 6 limes firmly on the counter, then halve and juice them into a small bowl, straining out seeds. You should get about 3/4 cup fresh juice.

steps.title: Dissolve sugar in water
steps.details: Pour 2 cups of the cold water into the pitcher, add the sugar and optional salt, and stir for about 1 minute until the sugar fully dissolves and no grains remain.

steps.title: Add juice and remaining water
steps.details: Stir the fresh lime juice and the remaining 6 cups cold water into the pitcher until evenly combined.

steps.title: Chill and taste
steps.details: Refrigerate the pitcher for at least 20 minutes to chill and let flavors meld. Taste and stir in a little more sugar only if it's too tart.

steps.title: Serve over ice
steps.details: Fill 8 glasses with the ice, pour the agua fresca over it, and garnish each with a lime wheel.

recipe.title: Creamy Cinnamon Horchata
recipe.intro: You need a blender and a fine-mesh strainer or cheesecloth. No cooking required, but the rice needs a long soak and the drink must chill thoroughly, so start the night before. Have plenty of ice ready for serving.
recipe.finish: Horchata is best very cold and well stirred, since the rice settles. Taste after chilling and add a splash more milk or sugar if you like. Serve over plenty of ice and dust with extra cinnamon. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge up to 3 days and stir before serving.

ingredients.name: cinnamon sticks
ingredients.prep: broken into pieces, or 1 tablespoon ground cinnamon

steps.title: Soak the rice
steps.details: Put the rice, 2 cups of the water and the cinnamon sticks in a blender jar. Cover and leave at room temperature at least 6 hours or overnight, so the rice softens completely.

steps.title: Blend until smooth
steps.details: Blend on high 2 to 3 minutes until the liquid is milky and only fine grit remains. Stop once to scrape down the sides if needed.

steps.title: Strain the rice mixture
steps.details: Pour through a fine-mesh strainer or cheesecloth set over a large pitcher, pressing the solids with a spoon to extract as much liquid as possible. Discard the solids.

steps.title: Stir in milks and flavoring
steps.details: Add the remaining 2 cups water, the cold milk, sweetened condensed milk and vanilla to the pitcher. Stir well until evenly combined.

steps.title: Sweeten to taste
steps.details: Taste and stir in sugar only if needed, a tablespoon at a time. The drink should be creamy and lightly sweet.

steps.title: Chill until very cold
steps.details: Cover and refrigerate the horchata at least 2 hours, or until chilled through to about 40 F.

steps.title: Stir and serve over ice
steps.details: Stir the chilled horchata well, since the rice settles. Fill glasses with ice, pour over the ice and dust with ground cinnamon if desired.

recipe.title: Classic Ground Beef Tacos
recipe.intro: Get ready: chop onion, shred lettuce, dice tomato, shred cheese, and set out toppings. Use a large skillet and a second skillet or griddle for warming tortillas. No oven needed.
recipe.finish: Beef is done when no pink remains and it reaches 160°F. Serve in warm tortillas with toppings; keep tortillas covered with a towel so they stay soft.

steps.title: Prep toppings
steps.details: Chop onion, shred lettuce, dice tomato, shred cheese, and put sour cream and salsa in bowls. Keep cold toppings chilled until serving.

steps.title: Brown the beef
steps.details: Heat a large skillet over medium-high. Add beef and chopped onion. Cook, breaking up with a spoon, until no pink remains, about 8 minutes; beef should reach 160°F.

steps.title: Drain excess fat
steps.details: Carefully tilt skillet and spoon off excess fat, leaving about 1 tablespoon in the pan.

steps.title: Add seasonings
steps.details: Sprinkle chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, salt, and pepper over beef. Stir and cook 1 minute until fragrant.

steps.title: Simmer the filling
steps.details: Add water and simmer, stirring occasionally, until water is mostly absorbed and beef is saucy but not wet, about 4 minutes. Turn heat to low to keep warm.

steps.title: Warm tortillas
steps.details: While beef simmers, heat a dry skillet or griddle over medium. Warm tortillas about 30 seconds per side until pliable and lightly toasted. Stack and cover with a clean towel.

steps.title: Assemble and serve
steps.details: Spoon about 1/4 cup beef into each warm tortilla. Top with lettuce, tomato, cheese, sour cream, and salsa. Serve immediately.

recipe.title: Slow Cooker Shredded Chicken Tacos
recipe.intro: Get ready: 6-quart slow cooker, two forks for shredding, small bowls for toppings. No preheat needed; the slow cooker does the work. Set out warm tortillas and toppings for self-serve.
recipe.finish: Chicken is done when it shreds easily and reaches 165°F (74°C) at the thickest part. Shred, toss in the juices to keep it moist, and keep warm on the 'warm' setting. Serve in warm tortillas with lime, cilantro, onion, and salsa.

steps.title: Season the chicken
steps.details: In the slow cooker insert, toss the chicken thighs with the chili powder, cumin, salt, and garlic powder until evenly coated.

steps.title: Add braising liquids
steps.details: Pour in the salsa, orange juice, and lime juice. Stir to coat the chicken, then spread the thighs in an even layer.

steps.title: Slow-cook the chicken
steps.details: Cover and cook on LOW for 5 to 6 hours (or HIGH for 3 to 4 hours) until the chicken is very tender and reaches 165°F (74°C) at the thickest part.

steps.title: Prep taco toppings
steps.details: While the chicken cooks, dice the onion, chop the cilantro, and cut the lime into wedges. Set out tortillas so they are ready to warm.

steps.title: Shred the chicken
steps.details: Transfer chicken to a bowl and shred with two forks. Return the shredded meat to the slow cooker and toss in the cooking juices; taste and adjust salt.

steps.title: Warm the tortillas
steps.details: Warm tortillas on a dry skillet over medium heat for 30 to 45 seconds per side, or wrap in foil and heat at 350°F for 10 minutes. Keep them covered so they stay soft and warm.

steps.title: Set up the taco bar and serve
steps.details: Set out the warm chicken, tortillas, onion, cilantro, and lime wedges for self-serve tacos.

recipe.title: Smoky Charro Beans
recipe.intro: Get ready: dice the onion, mince the garlic, and chop the tomatoes. Have a large pot and a wooden spoon ready. No oven needed; this simmers on the stovetop.
recipe.finish: Beans are done when they are tender and the broth is slightly thickened and smoky, about 45 minutes of simmering. Fish out the bay leaf, taste and add salt if needed. Serve hot in a bowl with a slotted spoon, topped with cilantro, alongside tacos.

steps.title: Cook the bacon
steps.details: Put the bacon in a large pot over medium heat. Cook, stirring occasionally, until crisp and the fat has rendered, 8 to 10 minutes. Do not let it burn.

steps.title: Soften onion and garlic
steps.details: Add the onion to the bacon and its fat. Cook, stirring, until soft and translucent, 5 to 6 minutes. Stir in the garlic and cook 1 minute more until fragrant.

steps.title: Add tomatoes and spices
steps.details: Stir in the drained tomatoes, smoked paprika, bay leaf, and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Cook 2 minutes, scraping up browned bits, until the tomatoes soften.

steps.title: Add beans and broth
steps.details: Add the pinto beans, chicken broth, and 1/2 cup of the reserved tomato liquid. Stir to combine and bring to a gentle boil over medium-high heat, about 4 minutes.

steps.title: Simmer the beans
steps.details: Lower the heat to a gentle simmer. Cook uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the beans are tender and the broth thickens slightly, 35 to 45 minutes. Add a splash of water if it gets too dry.

steps.title: Season and finish
steps.details: Remove the bay leaf. Taste and add more salt if needed. Stir in the chopped cilantro and serve hot.

recipe.title: Mexican Rice
recipe.intro: Fluffy tomato-tinged rice with a hint of cumin. Use a heavy 3-quart saucepan with a tight lid. Rinse the rice until the water runs mostly clear so the grains stay separate; preheat nothing, but have everything measured before you start.
recipe.finish: Fluff with a fork, taste, and add salt if needed. Serve hot alongside tacos, beans, and salsa; it holds well covered off heat for 10 minutes.

ingredients.name: long-grain white rice
ingredients.prep: rinse in a sieve until water runs mostly clear, drain well

steps.title: Toast the rice
steps.details: Heat the oil in a 3-quart saucepan over medium heat. Add the drained rice and cook, stirring often, until the grains turn opaque and lightly golden, about 5 minutes.

steps.title: Soften onion and garlic
steps.details: Add the onion and cook, stirring, for 3 minutes, then add the garlic and stir for 30 seconds until fragrant; do not let the garlic brown.

steps.title: Bloom the cumin
steps.details: Stir the cumin into the rice and onion mixture and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.

steps.title: Add sauce and broth
steps.details: Pour in the tomato sauce and chicken broth, add the salt, and stir once to combine. Scrape up any browned bits from the bottom.

steps.title: Simmer covered
steps.details: Bring to a boil over medium-high heat, then reduce to low, cover tightly, and cook without stirring until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed, 18 to 20 minutes.

steps.title: Rest off heat
steps.details: Remove from heat and let stand covered for 10 minutes so the rice firms up and finishes steaming.

steps.title: Fluff and finish
steps.details: Uncover and fluff gently with a fork. Fold in the cilantro if using, taste, and adjust salt.

recipe.title: Creamy Guacamole
recipe.intro: No cooking needed. Have a cutting board, chef's knife, fork or potato masher, and a medium bowl ready. Make just before serving for best color.
recipe.finish: Taste and adjust salt or lime. Serve immediately with tortilla chips. Press plastic wrap directly onto the surface if it must wait up to 1 hour; a squeeze of lime helps slow browning.

steps.title: Chop onion and cilantro
steps.details: Finely chop the onion and cilantro; seed and finely chop the jalapeño if using. Keep them separate and set aside.

steps.title: Scoop the avocado
steps.details: Halve and pit the avocados, then scoop the flesh into a medium bowl. Discard skins and pits.

steps.title: Mash with lime and salt
steps.details: Add the lime juice and salt to the avocado. Mash with a fork to desired texture, leaving some small chunks for creaminess.

steps.title: Fold in flavorings
steps.details: Add the onion, cilantro, jalapeño, garlic powder, and sour cream if using. Stir gently until just combined.

steps.title: Taste and serve
steps.details: Taste; add a pinch more salt or a squeeze of lime if needed. Serve right away with tortilla chips.

recipe.title: Fresh Pico de Gallo
recipe.intro: No cooking required; just sharp knife, cutting board, and a mixing bowl. Use ripe but firm tomatoes so the salsa stays chunky, not watery.
recipe.finish: Let the pico rest at least 10 minutes so flavors meld, then taste and adjust salt or lime. Serve within 4 hours for best texture; drain any juice before refilling the bowl.

ingredients.name: ripe but firm Roma or plum tomatoes

steps.title: Dice the tomatoes
steps.details: Cut tomatoes into 1/4-inch dice, discarding excess watery seeds. You should have about 3 cups.

steps.title: Mince onion and jalapeño
steps.details: Dice the onion into 1/8-inch pieces and mince the jalapeño finely; use 1 for mild heat or 2 for spicier.

steps.title: Chop the cilantro
steps.details: Chop cilantro leaves and tender stems until you have about 1/2 cup loosely packed.

steps.title: Combine and season
steps.details: In a mixing bowl, gently toss tomatoes, onion, jalapeño, cilantro, lime juice, salt, and pepper until evenly mixed.

steps.title: Rest for flavors
steps.details: Let the pico de gallo stand at room temperature so the salt draws juices and the flavors meld.

steps.title: Taste and adjust
steps.details: Taste; add a pinch more salt or a squeeze of lime if needed. Drain excess liquid before serving.

recipe.title: Warm Tortilla Chips
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Have two rimmed baking sheets ready. Use store-bought corn tortillas or thick-cut tortilla chips. If using tortillas, cut into wedges. Arrange in a single layer on sheets.
recipe.finish: Chips are ready when hot and fragrant, about 5–7 minutes. Sprinkle with salt while warm. Serve immediately with salsa or guacamole.

steps.title: Preheat oven
steps.details: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Position racks in upper and lower thirds.

steps.title: Prepare tortillas
steps.details: Cut each tortilla into 6 wedges. Brush both sides lightly with oil.

steps.title: Arrange on sheets
steps.details: Arrange wedges in a single layer on two baking sheets, not overlapping.

steps.title: Bake chips
steps.details: Bake for 5–7 minutes, until hot and lightly crisp. Watch closely to avoid burning.

steps.title: Salt and serve
steps.details: Sprinkle hot chips with salt. Transfer to a bowl and serve immediately.

recipe.title: Cinnamon Churro Bites
recipe.intro: Get ready: line a plate with paper towels, set out a slotted spoon or spider, and heat 2 inches of oil in a heavy pot to 350°F (175°C) over medium heat. Have a heatproof candy/deep-fry thermometer clipped to the pot. Keep kids clear of the hot oil.
recipe.finish: Bites are best within 15 minutes of tossing. Check the oil temperature before each batch and adjust as needed—too hot darkens the outside before the center cooks; too cool makes them greasy. Serve warm for dipping in chocolate or caramel sauce.

ingredients.name: egg
ingredients.prep: cracked into a small bowl and beaten

ingredients.name: vegetable oil
ingredients.prep: for deep frying, about 2 inches in a heavy pot

steps.title: Heat frying oil
steps.details: Pour the vegetable oil into a heavy pot to a depth of about 2 inches and heat over medium. Clip on a thermometer and bring it to 350°F (175°C); this takes about 12 minutes. Meanwhile, line a plate with paper towels.

steps.title: Mix cinnamon sugar
steps.details: In a shallow bowl, stir together the 1/2 cup sugar and the cinnamon until even. Set aside near the stove.

steps.title: Boil water and butter
steps.details: In a medium saucepan over medium-high, combine the water, butter pieces, 1 tbsp sugar, and salt. Stir until the butter melts, then bring to a full boil.

steps.title: Make the dough
steps.details: Add the flour all at once and stir hard with a wooden spoon until the mixture pulls into a smooth ball and pulls away from the pan, 1–2 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in the vanilla, then the beaten egg until fully absorbed; the dough should be thick and slightly sticky.

steps.title: Pipe or drop bites into oil
steps.details: Working in batches of about 10, use two spoons (or a piping bag with a wide tip) to drop walnut-size pieces of dough carefully into the 350°F oil. Do not crowd the pot; keep the oil between 340°F and 350°F.

steps.title: Fry until golden
steps.details: Fry each batch for 2–3 minutes, turning once, until the bites are deep golden brown and float; cut one open to check the center is cooked through, not doughy. Lift out with a slotted spoon and drain on the paper towels. Keep frying the remaining batches, letting the oil return to 350°F between batches (total about 12 minutes).

steps.title: Toss warm bites in cinnamon sugar
steps.details: While still warm, roll each drained batch in the cinnamon sugar to coat all over, then transfer to a serving bowl. Repeat with all batches.

steps.title: Warm the dipping sauce
steps.details: If using, warm the chocolate or caramel sauce gently in the microwave or a small pan until pourable. Serve with the churro bites for dipping.

recipe.title: Horchata
recipe.intro: You'll need a blender, a fine-mesh sieve or cheesecloth, and a large pitcher. Start the night before: the rice and cinnamon need a long soak to build the flavor. No cooking is required, just blending, straining, and chilling.
recipe.finish: The horchata should be cold, creamy, and sweet, with a clear cinnamon aroma. Taste again after chilling and add a splash more milk or sugar if it tastes too thick or too thin. Serve over plenty of ice; stir before pouring and keep it refrigerated for up to 3 days.

steps.title: Soak rice and cinnamon
steps.details: Combine the rinsed rice, 2 cups of the water, and the broken cinnamon sticks in a blender jar or large bowl. Cover and let sit at room temperature at least 4 hours or overnight; the rice should soften enough to crush easily between your fingers.

steps.title: Blend the rice mixture
steps.details: Pour the soaked mixture into the blender with the remaining 3 cups water. Blend on high for 2 full minutes until the rice is finely ground and the liquid looks milky and slightly frothy.

steps.title: Strain the liquid
steps.details: Set a fine-mesh sieve lined with a double layer of cheesecloth over the large pitcher. Pour the blended mixture through, then gather the cloth and squeeze to press out as much liquid as possible. Discard the solids; the strained liquid should be smooth and milky.

steps.title: Stir in milk and sugar
steps.details: Add the cold milk, sugar, and vanilla if using to the pitcher. Stir for about 30 seconds until the sugar dissolves completely and the drink is evenly creamy.

steps.title: Chill the horchata
steps.details: Cover the pitcher and refrigerate for at least 1 hour, or until thoroughly cold. Taste after chilling and adjust with more sugar if needed.

steps.title: Serve over ice
steps.details: Fill glasses with the ice and stir the horchata well before pouring over the ice. Serve immediately while cold.

recipe.title: Garlic Bread with Parsley Butter
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C) with a rack in the upper-middle position. You'll need a small saucepan, a small bowl, a fork, a serrated knife, a rimmed baking sheet, and a pastry brush. Let butter soften at room temperature for about 20 minutes while you measure everything else. Use a 12- to 16-ounce loaf of Italian bread or a baguette.
recipe.finish: The bread is done when the cut faces are deep golden brown at the edges and crisp, 8–12 minutes. Serve hot, stacked in a napkin-lined basket, alongside pasta for mopping up sauce. Leftovers re-crisp in a 350°F oven for 4–5 minutes.

ingredients.name: Italian bread or baguette
ingredients.prep: cut crosswise into 12 slices, each about 1 inch thick

steps.title: Preheat the oven
steps.details: Set a rack in the upper-middle position and preheat to 425°F (220°C). Have the baking sheet ready; no need to line it.

steps.title: Chop parsley and mince garlic
steps.details: Finely chop the parsley and mince the garlic. Keep them separate for now so you can bloom the garlic without scorching the parsley.

steps.title: Toast bread lightly
steps.details: Arrange the bread slices cut-side up on the baking sheet. Toast in the oven until dry on the surface and just barely golden, 4–5 minutes, while you make the butter. Watch closely so they don't brown before the garlic butter goes on.

steps.title: Make garlic parsley butter
