steps.details: Melt the butter in a small saucepan over medium-low heat. Add the garlic and cook just until fragrant, 30–60 seconds; do not let it brown. Off the heat, stir in the parsley, salt, and pepper with a fork until evenly combined.

steps.title: Brush bread with garlic butter
steps.details: Pull the sheet out of the oven. Brush the cut faces of the warm slices generously with the garlic parsley butter, using all of it and letting it pool slightly at the edges. Sprinkle with Parmesan if using.

steps.title: Bake until golden and crisp
steps.details: Return the sheet to the upper-middle rack and bake until the edges are deep golden and the bread is crisp, 8–12 minutes. Rotate the pan halfway through if browning unevenly.

steps.title: Cool briefly and serve
steps.details: Transfer the garlic bread to a board or basket. Cool about 2 minutes so the butter settles, then serve warm with pasta.

generatedRecipes.title: Classic Bruschetta with Tomatoes and Basil

recipe.title: Classic Bruschetta with Tomatoes and Basil
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C) with a rack in the upper third. Use a rimmed baking sheet, a serrated knife, a mixing bowl, and a broiler or hot oven for the bread. Ripe but firm tomatoes give the best texture.
recipe.finish: Spoon the tomato mixture over the warm bread just before serving so the toast stays crisp. Drizzle with any remaining olive oil and finish with a pinch of flaky salt if you have it. Serve within 15 minutes while the bread is still toasty.

ingredients.name: ripe tomatoes
ingredients.prep: seeded if very juicy and diced 1/4 inch

ingredients.name: fresh basil leaves
ingredients.prep: thinly sliced, plus small leaves for garnish

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.prep: plus a pinch for the bread

steps.title: Heat oven and slice bread
steps.details: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C) with a rack in the upper third. Cut the bread into 12 half-inch slices on the bias, keeping them even for uniform toasting.

steps.title: Brush bread with oil
steps.details: Arrange the slices on a rimmed baking sheet. Brush both sides lightly with about 2 tablespoons of the olive oil and sprinkle with a pinch of salt.

steps.title: Toast until golden
steps.details: Bake on the upper rack for 6–8 minutes, turning once, until the edges are golden and the centers are crisp but not hard. Watch closely in the last 2 minutes; do not let the bread burn.

steps.title: Chop tomatoes and drain
steps.details: While the bread toasts, dice the tomatoes and put them in a bowl. If they are very juicy, lightly drain off excess liquid so the topping does not sog the bread.

steps.title: Mince garlic and slice basil
steps.details: Mince 1 garlic clove and thinly slice the basil leaves. Reserve the remaining garlic half for rubbing the toast.

steps.title: Season tomato topping
steps.details: Add the minced garlic, basil, 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt, pepper, and 1 tablespoon olive oil to the tomatoes. Toss gently and taste; add a pinch more salt only if needed. Let sit for 5 minutes to develop flavor.

steps.title: Rub warm toast with garlic
steps.details: When the bread is done, remove it from the oven and immediately rub one side of each hot slice with the cut garlic clove. Use light pressure so it seasons the bread without tearing it.

steps.title: Spoon on tomatoes and serve
steps.details: Spoon the tomato mixture generously over the garlic-rubbed toast, dividing it evenly. Drizzle with the remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil, garnish with small basil leaves, and serve immediately.

generatedRecipes.title: Simple Green Salad with Lemon Vinaigrette

recipe.title: Simple Green Salad with Lemon Vinaigrette
recipe.intro: No special equipment needed. Make the dressing and wash the greens first; they can be prepped while pasta water boils.
recipe.finish: Toss just before serving so the greens stay crisp. Taste and add a pinch of salt or a squeeze of lemon if needed.

ingredients.name: mixed salad greens (such as romaine, arugula, or spring mix)

steps.title: Whisk lemon vinaigrette
steps.details: In a small bowl or jar, whisk or shake together olive oil, lemon juice, Dijon mustard, salt, and pepper until emulsified. Set aside.

steps.title: Wash and dry greens
steps.details: Rinse greens and dry very well in a salad spinner or with paper towels. Tear into bite-size pieces if needed.

steps.title: Toss salad
steps.details: Just before serving, place greens in a large bowl. Drizzle with dressing (use about 3/4 of it) and toss gently to coat. Taste and add more dressing or salt if desired.

steps.title: Finish with Parmesan
steps.details: Sprinkle with shaved Parmesan if using. Serve immediately.

recipe.title: Spaghetti alla Carbonara
recipe.intro: Use a large pot for pasta, a 12-inch skillet for the pancetta, and a heatproof bowl for the egg mixture. Boil water while you prep. Have everything chopped and grated before the pasta finishes, since the sauce comes together off the heat in about 2 minutes.
recipe.finish: The sauce should be glossy and creamy, coating each strand, with no scrambled egg. Serve immediately in warmed bowls with extra Pecorino and black pepper. Do not reheat in the microwave or on the stove; the eggs will curdle.

ingredients.name: black pepper
ingredients.prep: freshly ground, plus more to serve

steps.title: Boil the pasta water
steps.details: Fill a large pot with 5 quarts of water. Add the salt. Cover and bring to a rolling boil over high heat. This can run while you prep the other ingredients.

steps.title: Dice pancetta and grate cheese
steps.details: Cut the pancetta into 1/4-inch dice. Finely grate the Pecorino. This prep can happen while the water heats.

steps.title: Make the egg mixture
steps.details: In a heatproof bowl, whisk the 3 whole eggs and 1 yolk. Stir in the grated Pecorino and 1/2 teaspoon black pepper until a thick paste forms. Set aside.

steps.title: Cook the pancetta
steps.details: Put the diced pancetta in a cold 12-inch skillet and set over medium heat. Cook, stirring occasionally, until golden and crisp and the fat has rendered, 7 to 9 minutes. Do not let it burn. Turn off the heat and leave the pancetta and fat in the skillet.

steps.title: Cook the spaghetti
steps.details: Add the spaghetti to the boiling water and cook, stirring once or twice, until al dente, 1 to 2 minutes less than the package directions. Reserve 1 1/2 cups pasta water, then drain.

steps.title: Combine pasta with pancetta
steps.details: Add the drained spaghetti to the skillet with the pancetta and fat. Toss over low heat for 30 seconds so the pasta is coated and hot. Remove the skillet from the heat.

steps.title: Temper the egg mixture
steps.details: Whisk 1/2 cup of the hot reserved pasta water into the egg mixture, a splash at a time, until smooth and warmed. Add another splash if needed to loosen it.

steps.title: Toss into a creamy sauce
steps.details: With the skillet off the heat, pour the egg mixture over the pasta. Toss quickly and continuously with tongs, adding reserved pasta water a tablespoon at a time, until the sauce is glossy and coats the pasta, about 2 minutes. Do not return the skillet to the heat.

steps.title: Season and serve
steps.details: Taste and adjust salt and black pepper. Serve immediately in warmed bowls with extra grated Pecorino and a grind of black pepper.

recipe.title: Penne all'Arrabbiata
recipe.intro: Get ready: bring a large pot of water to a boil for the pasta, and have a wide skillet and a colander handy. No special equipment needed beyond a pot, skillet, and wooden spoon.
recipe.finish: The sauce is done when it is glossy and slightly thickened. Toss with the drained penne, taste for salt, and serve at once with grated pecorino or parmesan and extra red pepper flakes on the side. Pasta should be al dente and hot when coated.

ingredients.name: canned whole peeled tomatoes
ingredients.prep: crushed by hand in a bowl with their juice

steps.title: Boil pasta water
steps.details: Fill a large pot with 4–5 quarts water, add 1 tbsp salt, and set over high heat. Begin the sauce while the water heats; it will take about 10 minutes to reach a rolling boil.

steps.title: Warm oil and garlic
steps.details: In a large cold skillet, combine the olive oil and sliced garlic. Set over medium-low heat and cook gently for 3–4 minutes, until the garlic is pale golden and fragrant. Do not let it brown.

steps.title: Bloom pepper flakes
steps.details: Stir in the red pepper flakes and cook 30 seconds until fragrant. If the pasta water is not yet boiling, lower the heat slightly so the garlic does not burn.

steps.title: Add tomatoes and simmer
steps.details: Add the hand-crushed tomatoes with their juice, the salt, and the sugar if using. Simmer uncovered over medium-low heat for 15–20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce is glossy and slightly thickened.

steps.title: Cook the penne
steps.details: When the water is at a rolling boil, add the penne and cook according to the package directions (usually 10–12 minutes) until al dente; taste a piece 1 minute before the low end of the time. Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water before draining.

steps.title: Add parsley to sauce
steps.details: Stir the chopped parsley into the simmering sauce and cook 1 more minute. Taste and adjust salt and red pepper flakes.

steps.title: Toss pasta with sauce
steps.details: Drain the penne and add it to the skillet with the sauce. Toss for 1–2 minutes over medium heat, adding a splash of reserved pasta water if it looks dry, until the sauce clings evenly.

steps.title: Serve with cheese
steps.details: Divide among warm bowls, sprinkle with the grated pecorino or parmesan, and serve immediately.

generatedRecipes.title: Baked Rigatoni with Sausage and Mozzarella

recipe.title: Baked Rigatoni with Sausage and Mozzarella
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Use a 9x13-inch baking dish. Have a colander ready in the sink.
recipe.finish: Let the baked rigatoni rest 10 minutes before serving so the cheese sets. It is done when the edges bubble and the center reads at least 165°F; serve hot with extra Parmesan.

steps.title: Boil the rigatoni
steps.details: Cook rigatoni in salted boiling water until just shy of al dente, about 10 minutes. Drain and return to the pot. Start the sausage sauce while the water heats and pasta cooks.

steps.title: Brown the sausage
steps.details: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high. Add crumbled sausage and cook, breaking it up, until browned and no pink remains, 7 to 8 minutes.

steps.title: Soften onion and garlic
steps.details: Push sausage to the side, or remove it. Add onion to the skillet and cook until soft, about 5 minutes. Stir in garlic and cook 1 minute more until fragrant.

steps.title: Simmer the sauce
steps.details: Stir in marinara sauce and oregano. Simmer 5 minutes until slightly thickened and hot throughout.

steps.title: Combine pasta and sauce
steps.details: Add drained rigatoni to the skillet and toss with the sausage sauce. Stir in 1/4 cup Parmesan.

steps.title: Layer into baking dish
steps.details: Spoon half the pasta mixture into the baking dish. Scatter half the mozzarella over it, then add the remaining pasta and top with the remaining mozzarella and 1/4 cup Parmesan.

steps.title: Bake until bubbling
steps.details: Bake uncovered at 375°F until the cheese is melted and golden at the edges and the center is hot, 20 to 25 minutes.

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.details: Let rest 10 minutes, then sprinkle with torn basil and serve.

recipe.title: Garlicky Sautéed Broccoli Rabe
recipe.intro: Wash and trim the broccoli rabe while a pot of water comes to a boil. Have a colander and a large skillet ready.
recipe.finish: The rabe is done when the stems are tender-crisp and the leaves are glossy and wilted. Taste and add salt if needed. Serve hot alongside pasta; a squeeze of lemon is optional.

ingredients.name: broccoli rabe
ingredients.prep: trim 1 inch off stems, cut into 2-inch pieces

steps.title: Boil water and blanch rabe
steps.details: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add the broccoli rabe and cook 2 minutes, until bright green and slightly softened. Drain well, reserving 1/4 cup cooking water.

steps.title: Heat oil and aromatics
steps.details: While the water heats, warm the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the garlic and red pepper flakes and cook 1 minute, until fragrant but not browned.

steps.title: Sauté the rabe
steps.details: Add the drained broccoli rabe and salt to the skillet. Toss to coat and cook 4 to 5 minutes over medium-high heat, until stems are tender-crisp and leaves are wilted. Add a splash of reserved cooking water if the pan looks dry.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.details: Taste and adjust salt. Transfer to a serving dish and sprinkle with Parmesan if using. Serve hot.

recipe.title: Tiramisu Cups
recipe.intro: No-bake individual tiramisu cups. You need 6 small glasses or cups (about 6 oz each), a hand mixer or whisk, and a shallow dish for dipping. Use strong brewed coffee cooled to room temperature, or espresso. Have a spot in the fridge ready. Mascarpone should be softened at room temperature for about 15 minutes while the coffee cools.
recipe.finish: Chill at least 2 hours (or up to overnight) so the cups set and the ladyfingers soften. Before serving, dust generously with cocoa powder. The cups are done when a spoon cuts through easily and the cream holds its layers. Serve cold; refrigerate leftovers up to 24 hours.

ingredients.name: strong brewed coffee or espresso
ingredients.prep: brew and cool to room temperature

ingredients.name: unsweetened cocoa powder, plus extra for dusting
store-bought ladyfingers (savoiardi)
ingredients.prep: cut or broken to fit cups if needed

steps.title: Brew and cool coffee
steps.details: Brew 1 cup strong coffee or espresso. Stir in the 2 tbsp granulated sugar until dissolved, then let cool to room temperature (about 15 minutes).

steps.title: Whip mascarpone cream
steps.details: Beat the softened mascarpone, cold heavy cream, powdered sugar, and vanilla with a hand mixer on medium-high until thick, smooth, and just holding soft peaks, 2 to 3 minutes. Do not overbeat or it may turn grainy.

steps.title: Chill the cream
steps.details: Cover and refrigerate the mascarpone cream while you set up the cups, up to 15 minutes.

steps.title: Dip ladyfingers quickly
steps.details: Pour cooled coffee into a shallow dish. Dip each ladyfinger for just 1 second per side; it should be moist but not falling apart. Work in small batches so they do not sit and get soggy.

steps.title: Layer ladyfingers and cream
steps.details: In each cup, place a layer of dipped ladyfingers (about 1 1/2 ladyfingers per cup, broken to fit), then a spoonful of mascarpone cream. Repeat for a second layer, ending with cream. Tap cups gently to settle.

steps.title: Sift cocoa on top
steps.details: Sift a thin, even layer of cocoa powder over the cream in each cup.

steps.title: Chill until set
steps.details: Cover loosely and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or up to overnight, until the ladyfingers are softened and the cream is firm.

recipe.title: Sparkling Italian Soda with Lemon
recipe.intro: Chill the soda water and glasses ahead if possible. No cooking needed; assemble just before serving so it stays fizzy.
recipe.finish: Serve immediately over ice while bubbly. Stir gently before drinking; add more syrup to taste.

ingredients.name: cold sparkling water or club soda
lemon
ingredients.prep: cut into thin slices or wedges

steps.title: Chill glasses
steps.details: Fill four tall glasses with the ice cubes so they chill while you measure.

steps.title: Slice lemon garnish
steps.details: Cut the lemon into thin slices or wedges for garnish, discarding any seeds.

steps.title: Add syrup and lemon juice
steps.details: Pour 1 tablespoon lemon syrup and 1 tablespoon lemon juice into each ice-filled glass.

steps.title: Top with soda water
steps.details: Pour about 3/4 cup cold sparkling water into each glass, filling to the rim.

steps.title: Stir and garnish
steps.details: Stir gently once to combine, tuck a lemon slice into each glass, and serve at once.

recipe.title: Classic Pizza Dough
recipe.yield: 4 balls (about 1 lb each), enough for 4 large pizzas
recipe.intro: A forgiving yeasted dough for a make-your-own pizza party. You need a large bowl, a wooden spoon, a clean counter (or cutting board), and a baking steel or stone plus parchment for baking. Warm the water to about 100-110 F (warm to the touch, not hot) before starting. If your kitchen is cool, let the dough rise in an oven that is off but with the l
recipe.finish: Dough balls should be puffed, smooth, and nearly double in size; poke with a floured finger and the dent should spring back slowly. Stretch each ball on a floured counter or sheet pan, top lightly, and bake at 500-550 F on a preheated steel or stone for 8-12 minutes until the crust is spotted brown and the bottom is crisp. Let finished pizzas rest 2 minutes before slicing.

ingredients.name: all-purpose flour, plus more for dusting
instant yeast
ingredients.prep: from a fresh packet or jar

ingredients.name: warm water (100-110 F)
ingredients.prep: warm tap water, tested with finger

ingredients.name: olive oil, plus more for bowls
ingredients.prep: measured, plus a little for greasing

ingredients.name: semolina or extra flour for dusting

steps.title: Warm water and mix dry
steps.details: Warm 1 1/2 cups water to 100-110 F (warm to the touch, not hot). In a large bowl, stir together 4 1/2 cups flour, 1 1/2 teaspoons instant yeast, and 2 teaspoons salt. Make a well in the center.

steps.title: Add water and oil
steps.details: Pour the warm water and 1 tablespoon olive oil into the well. Stir with a wooden spoon until a shaggy dough forms and no dry flour remains, about 1 minute.

steps.title: Knead the dough
steps.details: Turn dough out onto a lightly floured counter. Knead 8 minutes, dusting lightly only if sticky, until dough is smooth, elastic, and springs back when poked. It should feel soft but not stick to clean hands.

steps.title: First rise
steps.details: Lightly oil the mixing bowl, put dough in, and turn once to coat. Cover with a clean towel or plastic wrap. Let rise in a warm, draft-free spot until doubled, 60-90 minutes (start checking at 60).

steps.title: Divide into balls
steps.details: Lightly flour the counter. Punch down dough and divide into 4 equal pieces (about 1 lb each; a scale helps). Shape each into a tight ball by pulling the surface taut and pinching the bottom seam.

steps.title: Second rise
steps.details: Place balls seam-side down on a lightly oiled sheet pan or floured board, spaced 2 inches apart. Cover loosely. Let rise 45-60 minutes until puffy and nearly doubled; they are ready when a floured finger poke springs back slowly.

steps.title: Preheat baking surface
steps.details: About 45 minutes before baking, set a baking steel or stone on the middle rack and preheat oven to 500-550 F. If using a stone, leave it in the whole preheat. Have semolina or flour ready for dusting.

steps.title: Shape and top pizza
steps.details: Dust a peel or upside-down sheet pan with semolina. Press one dough ball into a 10-12 inch round, leaving a 1-inch rim, then stretch over your knuckles. Transfer to the peel, top with sauce and toppings, and slide onto the hot steel. Bake 8-12 minutes until crust is spotted brown and bottom is crisp. Repeat with remaining balls.

recipe.title: No-Cook Pizza Sauce
recipe.intro: Use a 1-quart bowl and a whisk or fork. Open the can, peel the garlic, and get a small grater or knife ready. No stovetop needed; the sauce flavors blend while the oven preheats for the pizzas.
recipe.finish: Taste and adjust salt or oregano. Spread ⅓–½ cup per pizza, leaving a ½-inch border. Use within 1 hour at room temperature, or refrigerate up to 3 days; stir before using.

ingredients.name: crushed tomatoes
ingredients.prep: open can and pour into a bowl

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.prep: peeled and finely grated or minced

steps.title: Combine tomatoes and garlic
steps.details: Pour the crushed tomatoes into a 1-quart bowl. Add the grated garlic and stir with a whisk or fork until evenly mixed, about 30 seconds.

steps.title: Add herbs, salt, oil
steps.details: Add the oregano, basil, salt, olive oil, and vinegar if using. Stir until the herbs are evenly distributed and no dry clumps remain, about 1 minute.

steps.title: Rest to blend flavors
steps.details: Let the sauce sit at room temperature so the garlic and herbs mellow into the tomatoes. Stir once halfway through.

steps.title: Taste and adjust
steps.details: Taste a small spoonful. If it needs more punch, stir in a pinch more salt or oregano; if it tastes sharp, add a few drops of olive oil.

recipe.title: Margherita Pizza
recipe.intro: Heat oven to 500°F (260°C) with a pizza stone or inverted baking sheet on the middle rack for 30 minutes. Let dough sit at room temperature 30 minutes. Have flour, a rolling pin or hands, and parchment ready.
recipe.finish: Pizza is done when the crust is puffed and browned at the edges and the cheese is melted and bubbling. Rest 1 minute, scatter remaining basil, slice, and serve immediately.

ingredients.name: store-bought pizza dough
ingredients.prep: divide into 2 balls, rest 30 minutes covered

ingredients.name: tomato sauce (plain crushed tomatoes or passata)

steps.title: Preheat oven and stone
steps.details: Place a pizza stone or inverted baking sheet on the middle rack and heat oven to 500°F (260°C) for 30 minutes so it is fully hot.

steps.title: Rest and divide dough
steps.details: Let dough sit covered at room temperature 30 minutes to relax, then cut into 2 equal balls.

steps.title: Season the sauce
steps.details: Stir tomato sauce with salt, oregano, and black pepper in a small bowl while the oven heats.

steps.title: Prep cheese and basil
steps.details: Slice mozzarella and pat dry with paper towels. Tear basil leaves and set half aside for finishing.

steps.title: Shape first dough round
steps.details: On a floured surface, press and stretch one dough ball into a 10–11 inch round, leaving a slightly thicker rim. Dust a sheet of parchment with flour and transfer the round onto it.

steps.title: Top first pizza
steps.details: Spread about 1/2 cup sauce over the round, leaving a 1-inch border. Arrange half the mozzarella slices on top and drizzle with 1 tablespoon olive oil.

steps.title: Bake first pizza
steps.details: Slide parchment and pizza onto the hot stone. Bake 8–12 minutes until crust is puffed and browned and cheese is bubbling. Check at 8 minutes.

steps.title: Finish and start second pizza
steps.details: Transfer first pizza to a board, scatter half the remaining basil over it, and let rest. Meanwhile shape and top the second dough ball the same way with remaining sauce, mozzarella, and 1 tablespoon oil.

steps.title: Bake second pizza
steps.details: Slide second pizza onto the hot stone and bake 8–12 minutes until crust is browned and cheese bubbles.

steps.title: Finish, slice, and serve
steps.details: Scatter remaining basil over the second pizza. Rest each pizza 1 minute, slice into 8 wedges, and serve hot.

recipe.title: Pepperoni and Mushroom Pizza
recipe.intro: Let refrigerated dough sit at room temperature 30 minutes while the oven preheats to 500°F with a rack in the lower third; if you have a pizza stone or inverted baking sheet, heat it too. Have a large rimmed baking sheet or pizza pan, a skillet, and a spoon ready.
recipe.finish: Slide the pizza onto a cutting board, let it rest 2 minutes, then slice into 8 pieces. The crust should be deeply golden and crisp underneath and the cheese bubbling with lightly browned pepperoni.

ingredients.name: store-bought pizza dough
ingredients.prep: let sit covered at room temperature 30 minutes

steps.title: Preheat oven and rest dough
steps.details: Set oven to 500°F with a rack in the lower third and a pizza stone or inverted baking sheet inside if using. Leave the dough in its covered bowl on the counter to relax for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Brown the mushrooms
steps.details: Heat 1/2 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high. Add sliced mushrooms and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until they release their liquid and the edges brown, about 7 to 8 minutes. Remove to a plate.

steps.title: Stretch dough on pan
steps.details: Brush a rimmed baking sheet or pizza pan with the remaining 1/2 tbsp olive oil. Stretch or press the dough into a 13-inch round about 1/4 inch thick, leaving a slightly thicker rim.

steps.title: Sauce and cheese the base
steps.details: Spread pizza sauce evenly over the dough, leaving a 1/2-inch border. Scatter the mozzarella over the sauce.

steps.title: Add mushrooms and pepperoni
steps.details: Scatter the browned mushrooms over the cheese, then arrange pepperoni slices on top, slightly overlapping. Sprinkle with oregano if using.

steps.title: Bake until crisp and bubbling
steps.details: Bake on the lower rack until the crust is golden and crisp underneath and the cheese is bubbling with browned spots, 10 to 13 minutes. If the top browns too fast, move the pan up a rack for the last 2 minutes.

steps.title: Rest and slice
steps.details: Transfer the pizza to a cutting board and rest 2 minutes so the cheese sets, then cut into 8 slices and serve hot.

recipe.title: Garlic Butter Breadsticks
recipe.intro: Use leftover pizza dough (about 1 lb / 450 g) from your pizza party. Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C) with a rack in the middle. Line a large baking sheet with parchment. Melt butter and mince garlic while the dough comes to room temperature.
recipe.finish: Breadsticks are done when puffed, golden brown on the edges, and springy when pressed. Brush with any remaining garlic butter right out of the oven and serve warm for snacking while pizzas bake.

ingredients.name: leftover pizza dough
ingredients.prep: let sit at room temperature 20 minutes

steps.title: Preheat oven and warm dough
steps.details: Set oven to 425°F (220°C) with a rack in the middle. Leave the leftover dough on the counter to lose its chill, about 20 minutes. Line a large baking sheet with parchment.

steps.title: Make garlic butter
steps.details: Melt the butter in a small saucepan or microwave, then stir in the minced garlic, 1/2 tsp kosher salt, Parmesan, and oregano. Let sit so the garlic flavors the butter.

steps.title: Roll and cut dough
steps.details: Lightly flour the counter. Pat or roll the dough into a 12 x 8-inch rectangle about 1/2 inch thick. Cut into twelve 1 x 8-inch strips with a knife or pizza cutter.

steps.title: Twist and arrange sticks
steps.details: Twist each strip gently and lay on the parchment-lined sheet, spacing them about 1 inch apart. Press ends down so they hold their twist.

steps.title: Brush with garlic butter
steps.details: Brush about two-thirds of the garlic butter over the tops of the breadsticks. Sprinkle lightly with extra salt if you like. Reserve the rest for after baking.

steps.title: Bake until golden
steps.details: Bake at 425°F (220°C) until puffed, golden brown on the edges, and springy when pressed, 12–15 minutes. Rotate the pan halfway if your oven bakes unevenly.

steps.title: Brush and serve warm
steps.details: Brush the hot breadsticks with the reserved garlic butter and serve warm while pizzas bake.

recipe.title: Italian Chopped Salad
recipe.intro: No cooking needed—just chop, whisk and toss. Serve this bright, crunchy salad alongside hot pizza. Have a large salad bowl and a small jar or whisk handy.
recipe.finish: Toss once more right before serving so the romaine stays crisp. Taste and add a pinch of salt or a splash of vinegar if needed. Serve immediately alongside the pizza.

ingredients.name: romaine lettuce
ingredients.prep: rinsed, dried well, chopped into bite-size pieces

ingredients.name: red onion
ingredients.prep: thinly sliced and rinsed under cold water

steps.title: Make the vinaigrette
steps.details: In a small jar or bowl, combine olive oil, red wine vinegar, oregano, salt and pepper. Shake or whisk until evenly blended; set aside.

steps.title: Chop the vegetables
steps.details: Chop the dried romaine into bite-size pieces, halve the cherry tomatoes, thinly slice the rinsed red onion and slice the pepperoncini and olives.

steps.title: Combine salad ingredients
steps.details: Put the romaine, tomatoes, chickpeas, red onion, pepperoncini and olives in a large salad bowl.

steps.title: Toss with dressing
steps.details: Give the vinaigrette a final shake, pour it over the salad and toss gently until everything is lightly coated.

steps.title: Finish with Parmesan
steps.details: Scatter the grated Parmesan over the top and serve right away while the romaine is crisp.

recipe.title: Roasted Vegetable Antipasto Platter
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C) with racks in upper and middle positions. Line two rimmed baking sheets with parchment. Have a large serving platter ready. This platter can be assembled while the oven heats and served at room temperature before pizza baking begins.
recipe.finish: Let roasted vegetables cool 10 minutes, then arrange on the platter with olives, mozzarella, and basil. Drizzle with balsamic and olive oil. Serve at room temperature with breadsticks or crusty bread. Refrigerate leftovers up to 3 days.

steps.title: Preheat oven and line sheets
steps.details: Heat oven to 425°F (220°C). Line two rimmed baking sheets with parchment paper and set them nearby.

steps.title: Toss peppers and onion
steps.details: On one baking sheet, toss red pepper strips and onion wedges with 1 tbsp olive oil, 1/4 tsp salt, and 1/8 tsp pepper until evenly coated.

steps.title: Toss zucchini and mushrooms
steps.details: On the second baking sheet, toss zucchini and mushrooms with 1 tbsp olive oil, 1/4 tsp salt, and 1/8 tsp pepper. Spread in a single layer.

steps.title: Roast peppers and onion
steps.details: Roast the pepper-onion sheet on the upper rack until peppers are softened and lightly charred at the edges, 18–22 minutes, stirring once halfway through.

steps.title: Roast zucchini and mushrooms
steps.details: Roast the zucchini-mushroom sheet on the middle rack until browned and tender, 16–20 minutes, stirring once halfway through.

steps.title: Arrange olives and cheese
steps.details: While vegetables roast, arrange drained olives and mozzarella bocconcini on the serving platter.

steps.title: Cool roasted vegetables
steps.details: Remove both sheets from the oven and let vegetables cool on the sheets for 10 minutes so they are easy to handle and not steaming hot.

steps.title: Build the platter
steps.details: Arrange cooled roasted vegetables in colorful piles around the olives and mozzarella. Drizzle everything with balsamic vinegar and remaining 1 tbsp olive oil. Scatter with torn basil.

steps.title: Serve with bread
steps.details: Set out sliced crusty bread or breadsticks alongside the platter and serve at room temperature before the pizza-making begins.

recipe.title: Nutella Dessert Pizza
recipe.intro: Let refrigerated pizza dough sit at room temperature 30 minutes before starting. Heat oven to 475°F with a rack in the lower-middle position; if you have a pizza stone, preheat it 30 minutes. Have a baking sheet or pizza peel, parchment paper, and a rolling pin ready.
recipe.finish: The crust is done when the bottom is golden and crisp and the edges are puffed and browned. Spread Nutella on the hot crust so it melts, top with strawberries, and serve warm within 20 minutes so the dough stays crisp.

steps.title: Preheat oven and stone
steps.details: Heat oven to 475°F with a rack in the lower-middle position. If using a pizza stone, leave it in the oven to preheat at least 30 minutes.

steps.title: Slice the strawberries
steps.details: While the oven heats, hull and thinly slice the strawberries; set aside in a bowl. Stir the Nutella so it is smooth and spreadable.

steps.title: Shape the crust
steps.details: Lightly flour a work surface and a sheet of parchment. Press and stretch the dough into a 12-inch round, leaving a slightly thicker rim; transfer to the parchment.

steps.title: Butter and bake the crust
steps.details: Brush the rim with melted butter. Slide the parchment onto a baking sheet (or the preheated stone) and bake until the bottom is golden and the edges are puffed and browned, 10 to 14 minutes.

steps.title: Spread Nutella on hot crust
steps.details: Transfer the crust to a cutting board and immediately spread the Nutella over it, leaving a 1-inch border; the heat will soften it into an even layer.

steps.title: Add strawberries and finish
steps.details: Arrange the sliced strawberries over the Nutella, dust with powdered sugar, and scatter with torn mint if using. Slice into 8 wedges and serve warm.

recipe.title: Sparkling Citrus Punch
recipe.intro: Have a large 2-quart pitcher, a long spoon, a measuring cup, and a knife and cutting board ready. Chill the juices and sparkling water beforehand if possible. No cooking or heating is needed; the punch is assembled cold and served over ice.
recipe.finish: Serve immediately over ice in tall glasses. If the punch will sit out more than 30 minutes, add the ice to glasses only, not the pitcher, so it does not dilute. Stir gently before each refill; add more sparkling water if it goes flat.

ingredients.name: orange juice
ingredients.prep: chilled, pulp or no-pulp as preferred

steps.title: Dissolve sugar in water
steps.details: Pour the cold water into the pitcher, add the sugar, and stir briskly for about 1 minute until the sugar mostly dissolves and no big crystals remain.

steps.title: Slice citrus for garnish
steps.details: While the sugar sits, slice the orange and lemon into thin round slices and set aside. This can be done during the sugar-dissolving time if you have a helper, or right after.

steps.title: Add citrus juices
steps.details: Pour the chilled orange juice and lemon juice into the pitcher with the sugar water and stir for 30–60 seconds until evenly blended. Taste; if your juices are very tart, stir in 1 extra tablespoon of sugar.

steps.title: Chill punch base
steps.details: Refrigerate the juice base uncovered or loosely covered for at least 15 minutes, or up to 4 hours, so it is thoroughly cold before the sparkling water is added. Do not add ice to the pitcher yet.

steps.title: Add sparkling water gently
steps.details: Just before serving, open the chilled sparkling water and pour it slowly down the inside of the pitcher. Stir once or twice very gently with a long spoon to combine; do not whisk, or the bubbles will escape.

steps.title: Garnish and serve over ice
steps.details: Float most of the citrus slices in the pitcher, fill 8 tall glasses about halfway with ice, and ladle or pour the punch over the ice. Add a citrus slice to each glass and serve at once.

generatedRecipes.title: Hummus with Olive Oil and Paprika

recipe.title: Hummus with Olive Oil and Paprika
recipe.intro: No cooking required beyond warming the pita. Use a food processor or blender; if yours is weak, add chickpea liquid a spoonful at a time. Have all ingredients at room temperature for the creamiest result.
recipe.finish: Taste and adjust salt or lemon. Sprinkle paprika over the olive oil pool just before serving so it stays vivid. Serve with the warm pita for dipping.

ingredients.name: ice water or reserved chickpea liquid

steps.title: Warm the pita
steps.details: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Wrap the pita wedges in foil and place in the oven to warm while you make the hummus.

steps.title: Blend tahini and lemon
steps.details: In the food processor, blend the tahini and lemon juice for 1 minute until pale and slightly thickened—this makes the dip creamier. Scrape down the sides.

steps.title: Add chickpeas and seasonings
steps.details: Add the drained chickpeas, garlic, salt, and cumin, if using. Process for 1 to 2 minutes, scraping down as needed, until finely ground.

steps.title: Stream in ice water
steps.details: With the processor running, add 3 tablespoons ice water or chickpea liquid one spoonful at a time. Blend 2 to 3 minutes more, adding up to 2 tablespoons extra, until the hummus is smooth and creamy.

steps.title: Finish the hummus
steps.details: Stop and scrape down; blend a final 30 to 60 seconds if any grit remains. Taste and add a pinch more salt or a squeeze of lemon if needed.

steps.title: Swirl, oil, and paprika
steps.details: Spread the hummus in a shallow bowl, making a wide swirl with the back of a spoon. Drizzle olive oil into the swirl, then dust with paprika.

steps.title: Serve with warm pita
steps.details: Unwrap the warm pita and serve immediately alongside the hummus. The hummus can be covered and refrigerated up to 3 days; let it come to room temperature before serving.

recipe.title: Greek Village Salad
recipe.intro: No cooking required. Assemble the salad just before serving so the vegetables stay crisp. Use a large shallow bowl or platter for best presentation. Have a cutting board, sharp knife, and serving spoon ready.
recipe.finish: The salad is ready when the vegetables are glossy with dressing and topped with feta and oregano. Serve immediately as a fresh side. If holding, refrigerate undressed components separately and toss just before serving.

ingredients.name: green bell pepper
ingredients.prep: seeded and cut into 1/4-inch rings or strips

steps.title: Prepare vegetables
steps.details: Cut tomatoes into 1-inch chunks, halve cucumber lengthwise and slice 1/4-inch thick, thinly slice red onion, and seed and slice green pepper into rings. Place all in a large bowl.

steps.title: Add olives and feta
steps.details: Add Kalamata olives and feta slabs or crumbles to the bowl with the vegetables.

steps.title: Whisk dressing
steps.details: In a small bowl, whisk olive oil, red wine vinegar, dried oregano, salt, and black pepper until combined.

steps.title: Toss and serve
steps.details: Drizzle dressing over salad and toss gently to coat. Taste and adjust salt if needed. Serve immediately.

recipe.title: Warm Olive-Oil Pita Bread
recipe.intro: Use store-bought pita rounds for speed. You need a sheet pan, a small bowl, and a pastry brush or spoon. Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C) while you mix the oil and set out the pitas.
recipe.finish: Pitas are ready when soft and steamy, with faint toasted spots and a warm, pliable feel. Keep them stacked in a clean towel so they stay soft, and serve right away with hummus, baba ghanoush, or dips.

ingredients.name: pita bread rounds
ingredients.prep: leave whole; cut into halves after warming if desired

steps.title: Preheat oven and mix oil
steps.details: Set a rack in the middle of the oven and preheat to 350°F (175°C). Stir the olive oil with the salt in a small bowl.

steps.title: Brush pitas with oil
steps.details: Lay the pita rounds on a sheet pan and brush both sides lightly with the salted olive oil, using about two-thirds of it and leaving the rest for finishing.

steps.title: Warm pitas in oven
steps.details: Bake the pitas on the sheet pan until soft, steamy, and faintly toasted in spots, 6 to 8 minutes. Do not let them crisp or brown deeply.

steps.title: Brush and garnish
steps.details: Transfer the warm pitas to a clean towel, brush with the remaining salted oil, and sprinkle with parsley if using. Stack and wrap loosely to keep soft, then cut into halves or wedges for serving.

recipe.title: Herb-Roasted Leg of Lamb
recipe.intro: Let the lamb sit at room temperature for 30 minutes before roasting. Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C) with a rack in the lower third. Have a roasting pan with a rack ready, plus a meat thermometer.
recipe.finish: The lamb is done when the thickest part (away from bone) reads 130–135°F for medium-rare or 140–145°F for medium. Rest loosely tented with foil for 15–20 minutes before carving; the temperature will rise about 5°F. Slice against the grain and spoon pan juices over the top.

ingredients.name: bone-in leg of lamb
ingredients.prep: trimmed of excess fat, patted dry

steps.title: Preheat oven
steps.details: Set oven to 425°F (220°C) with a rack in the lower third. It will be ready by the time the lamb is seasoned.

steps.title: Make herb paste
steps.details: Chop rosemary and thyme, zest the lemon, and combine with 2 tablespoons olive oil, the salt and pepper in a small bowl. Cut the zested lemon into wedges and set aside.

steps.title: Stud and rub lamb
steps.details: Make 12 small slits in the lamb and push in the garlic halves. Rub the herb paste all over the lamb, massaging it into the surface.

steps.title: Sear fat side down
steps.details: Heat the remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil in a roasting pan over medium-high heat on the stovetop. Sear the lamb fat side down until browned, about 5 minutes, then turn it fat side up on the rack.

steps.title: Roast at high heat
steps.details: Roast uncovered at 425°F for 20 minutes to develop a crust.

steps.title: Lower heat and roast
steps.details: Reduce oven to 350°F (175°C). Add half the broth to the pan and continue roasting until the thickest part reads 130–135°F for medium-rare, 60–75 minutes more.

steps.title: Rest the lamb
steps.details: Transfer lamb to a cutting board and tent loosely with foil. Rest 15–20 minutes.

steps.title: Make quick pan sauce
steps.details: Set the roasting pan over medium heat and stir in the remaining broth, scraping up browned bits. Simmer 3–4 minutes, then season with salt and squeeze in lemon juice to taste.

steps.title: Carve and serve
steps.details: Slice the lamb against the grain, arrange on a platter, and spoon pan sauce over the slices. Serve with remaining lemon wedges.

recipe.title: Lemon Herb Roast Chicken
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C) with a rack in the lower-middle position. Have a roasting pan with a rack (or a large ovenproof skillet) and a meat thermometer ready. Pat the chicken dry and let it sit at room temperature while you prepare the herb mixture.
recipe.finish: Let the chicken rest 10–15 minutes before carving so juices stay in the meat. The breast should read 165°F (74°C) and the thigh 175°F (79°C). Carve and spoon the pan juices over the slices; serve with lemon wedges.

ingredients.name: lemons
ingredients.prep: 1 zested and halved, 1 cut into wedges for serving

steps.title: Season and rest chicken
steps.details: Rub the chicken all over with 1 tsp salt and let it sit on the pan while you make the herb paste; this brief rest helps the skin dry and season.

steps.title: Mix lemon herb paste
steps.details: Stir together the olive oil, minced garlic, oregano, pepper, lemon zest, and remaining 1 tsp salt in a small bowl.

steps.title: Spread paste on chicken
steps.details: Rub the herb paste under the breast skin and all over the outside of the chicken. Squeeze the juice of one lemon half over the bird and tuck both halves into the cavity.

steps.title: Scatter onion in pan
steps.details: Toss the onion chunks with a spoonful of the herb paste if any remains and scatter them around the chicken in the roasting pan. Pour 1/2 cup broth into the pan.

steps.title: Roast chicken uncovered
steps.details: Roast at 425°F (220°C) until the skin is golden and the breast reads 165°F (74°C) and the thigh 175°F (79°C) in the thickest part away from bone, 60–75 minutes. If the top browns too fast, tent loosely with foil after 45 minutes.

steps.title: Rest and make pan sauce
steps.details: Move the chicken to a cutting board and rest 10–15 minutes. Meanwhile, set the pan over medium heat and add the remaining 1/2 cup broth, scraping up browned bits; simmer 3–4 minutes.

steps.title: Carve and serve
steps.details: Carve the chicken, strain the pan sauce if you like, and serve with lemon wedges and the roasted onion.

recipe.title: Greek Lemon Potatoes
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C) with a rack in the middle. Use a large roasting pan or a 9x13-inch baking dish and a whisk. Juice the lemons and keep the spent halves for the pan.
recipe.finish: Potatoes should be fork-tender with golden edges and most of the liquid absorbed into a glossy, lemony sauce. If the pan looks dry before the potatoes are tender, add 2 tablespoons hot water and continue roasting. Let rest 5 minutes, taste the pan sauce, and add salt or lemon juice if needed. Serve warm alongside grilled meats or roasted fish.

ingredients.name: Yukon Gold or russet potatoes
ingredients.prep: peel if desired, cut into 1½-inch wedges

steps.title: Heat oven and cut potatoes
steps.details: Heat oven to 425°F (220°C). Scrub and cut the potatoes into 1½-inch wedges; peel first if you prefer. Keep the wedges similar in size so they cook evenly.

steps.title: Whisk the braising liquid
steps.details: In a bowl or measuring cup, whisk the olive oil, lemon juice, hot water, oregano, salt, pepper, and lemon zest until combined. The mixture will look cloudy and separated; that is fine.

steps.title: Arrange potatoes in pan
steps.details: Spread the potato wedges in a single layer in a large roasting pan or 9x13-inch baking dish, cut sides facing down where possible. Tuck the smashed garlic cloves among the potatoes.

steps.title: Pour liquid over potatoes
steps.details: Pour the lemon-olive oil mixture evenly over the potatoes. The liquid should come about one-third of the way up the wedges; do not submerge them completely.

steps.title: Roast uncovered
steps.details: Roast uncovered for 35 minutes. The liquid will bubble and the potatoes will begin to brown at the edges. Do not stir during this first stretch.

steps.title: Turn and baste potatoes
steps.details: Carefully turn the potatoes with a spatula and spoon the pan juices over them. This helps them brown evenly and absorb the lemon sauce.

steps.title: Roast until tender
steps.details: Continue roasting 20–25 minutes, until a knife slides easily into the thickest part of a wedge and the edges are deep golden. Most of the liquid should be absorbed; add 2 tablespoons hot water if the pan is scorching dry.

steps.title: Rest and finish
steps.details: Remove from the oven and rest 5 minutes so the pan juices settle. Discard the garlic if desired, spoon the remaining lemony juices over the potatoes, and taste for salt or lemon before serving.

recipe.title: Garlicky Green Beans with Tomatoes
recipe.intro: Get ready: wash and trim the green beans, chop the garlic, and open the canned tomatoes. Use a large skillet or Dutch oven with a lid and a large pot for blanching. No oven needed.
recipe.finish: The green beans should be tender-crisp and the tomatoes broken down into a glossy sauce. Taste and add salt or a squeeze of lemon if needed. Serve warm or at room temperature alongside the rest of the Mediterranean dinner.

steps.title: Boil water for blanching
steps.details: Fill a large pot two-thirds full with water and bring to a boil over high heat. This can heat while you finish prepping the beans and garlic.

steps.title: Chop garlic and parsley
steps.details: Thinly slice the garlic and chop the parsley. Measure the red pepper flakes, salt, and pepper into small dishes so they are ready to add.

steps.title: Blanch green beans
steps.details: Add the trimmed green beans to the boiling water and cook 4 to 5 minutes, until bright green and just tender-crisp. Drain well in a colander.

steps.title: Warm olive oil and garlic
steps.details: Set the empty skillet over medium heat and add 2 tablespoons of the olive oil. When it shimmers, add the sliced garlic and red pepper flakes and cook 30 to 60 seconds, until fragrant but not browned.

steps.title: Add tomatoes and seasonings
steps.details: Stir in the diced tomatoes with their juice, salt, black pepper, and water. Bring to a gentle simmer, scraping up any bits from the bottom of the pan.

steps.title: Simmer beans in tomato sauce
steps.details: Add the drained green beans to the skillet and toss to coat. Cover and simmer 10 to 12 minutes, stirring once or twice, until the beans are tender and the tomatoes have softened into a sauce.

steps.title: Finish with oil and lemon
steps.details: Uncover and stir in the remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil and the lemon juice, if using. Taste and adjust salt.

steps.title: Garnish and serve
steps.details: Scatter the chopped parsley over the top and serve warm or at room temperature.

recipe.title: Walnut Baklava with Honey Syrup
recipe.intro: Let frozen phyllo thaw in the fridge overnight (or 4 hours on the counter) before starting. You need a 9x13-inch baking pan, a small saucepan, a food processor or knife, a pastry brush, and a clean damp towel to cover the phyllo. Preheat the oven to 325°F (165°C) with a rack in the center. Make the syrup first so it can cool while you build the lay
recipe.finish: The baklava is done when the top is deep golden brown and the edges sound crisp when tapped; if the center looks pale, bake 5 more minutes. Immediately pour the cooled syrup evenly over the hot baklava — it should sizzle. Let it sit uncovered at room temperature at least 4 hours (overnight is best) so the syrup soaks in and the layers stay crisp. Cut again along the scored lines and serve at room temperature. Store loosely covered at room temperature up to 3 days.

ingredients.name: phyllo dough (about 20 sheets)
ingredients.prep: thawed, kept covered with a damp towel

steps.title: Simmer the honey syrup
steps.details: Combine sugar, honey, water and lemon juice in a small saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat, stirring until the sugar dissolves, then lower to a gentle simmer for 8 minutes until slightly thickened. Remove from heat and cool completely.

steps.title: Toast the walnuts
steps.details: Spread chopped walnuts on a rimmed baking sheet and toast at 325°F for 8 minutes, until fragrant and lightly darker. Stir in the 1 tsp cinnamon and the salt; cool slightly.

steps.title: Brush the pan and phyllo
steps.details: Brush the bottom and sides of the 9x13-inch pan with melted butter. Unroll the phyllo and keep it under a damp towel. Lay one sheet in the pan and brush it lightly with butter. Repeat with 9 more sheets, buttering every sheet, for 10 layers total.

steps.title: Add the walnut filling
steps.details: Scatter the cooled cinnamon walnuts evenly over the phyllo, pressing them gently into an even layer and leaving a 1/2-inch border at the edges.

steps.title: Layer the remaining phyllo
steps.details: Set one phyllo sheet over the filling and brush with butter. Repeat with the remaining 9 sheets, buttering each one, and finish by brushing the top generously with butter so no dry patches remain.

steps.title: Score and bake
steps.details: Using a sharp knife, cut the baklava into 24 diamond or square pieces, cutting all the way to the bottom of the pan. Bake at 325°F for 45–50 minutes, until the top is deep golden brown and the edges look crisp.

steps.title: Syrup the hot baklava
steps.details: Set the hot pan on a rack. Stir the cooled syrup and ladle it evenly over the entire surface — it will sizzle. Do not cover.

steps.title: Soak and serve
steps.details: Let the baklava stand uncovered at room temperature at least 4 hours so the syrup soaks in and layers stay crisp. Recut along the score lines and serve at room temperature.

recipe.title: Fresh Mint Lemonade
recipe.intro: No cooking required—just a quick mint syrup made with hot water straight from the kettle, plus fresh lemons. You'll need a small saucepan or heatproof bowl, a pitcher, a fine sieve, and a long spoon. Chill glasses in the freezer if you like extra-cold lemonade.
recipe.finish: Stir the lemonade well just before pouring (the syrup settles), then pour over plenty of ice and float a fresh mint sprig in each glass. Taste and add a splash more syrup if your lemons were very tart. Best the day it's made; keep any leftovers covered in the fridge for up to 2 days and stir before serving.

ingredients.name: fresh mint leaves
ingredients.prep: rinsed, plus extra sprigs for serving

steps.title: Boil water and muddle mint
steps.details: Bring the 1 cup water to a boil in a kettle or small saucepan. Meanwhile, put the sugar and mint leaves in a heatproof bowl or saucepan and press the leaves with the back of a spoon a few times to bruise them and release their oils.

steps.title: Make mint syrup
steps.details: Pour the just-boiled water over the sugar and mint and stir until the sugar is completely dissolved, about 1 minute. Let steep off the heat for 10 minutes so the mint flavor infuses.

steps.title: Strain the syrup
steps.details: Set a fine sieve over a pitcher or large bowl and pour the syrup through, pressing gently on the mint with a spoon. Discard the spent leaves. The syrup should be clear and taste strongly of mint.

steps.title: Add lemon juice and water
steps.details: Pour the strained lemon juice and 3 cups cold water into the pitcher with the syrup and stir well to combine.

steps.title: Chill the lemonade
steps.details: Refrigerate the pitcher, uncovered, until thoroughly cold, at least 1 hour (or up to 1 day). The lemonade should be noticeably chilled before serving.

steps.title: Serve over ice with mint
steps.details: Fill 6 tall glasses with the ice cubes, pour the chilled lemonade over the ice, and garnish each glass with a fresh mint sprig. Stir each glass once before drinking.

generatedRecipes.title: Warm Pita with Olive Oil and Oregano

recipe.title: Warm Pita with Olive Oil and Oregano
recipe.intro: Preheat a dry large skillet over medium heat (about 3 minutes) or the oven to 350°F. Have a pastry brush and a small bowl ready. This is a quick bread component; warm the pitas just before serving while the rest of the meal is on the table.
recipe.finish: Pitas should be soft and pliable with lightly golden edges and smell of warm oregano. Stack on a plate or basket and serve immediately while warm, with hummus, tzatziki, or olive oil for dipping.

steps.title: Preheat skillet and mix topping
steps.details: Set a large dry skillet over medium heat to preheat about 3 minutes. Meanwhile, stir the olive oil, oregano, and salt together in a small bowl.

steps.title: Warm the first pita
steps.details: Place one whole pita in the dry skillet and warm 1 minute per side, until soft and lightly golden in spots.

steps.title: Brush and season first pita
steps.details: Transfer the warm pita to a cutting board and brush the top evenly with about half the oregano oil.

steps.title: Warm second pita
steps.details: Warm the second pita in the skillet 1 minute per side, until soft and lightly golden.

steps.title: Season second pita
steps.details: Brush the second pita with the remaining oregano oil.

steps.title: Cut into wedges
steps.details: Cut each pita into 4 wedges and scatter with chopped parsley if using. Serve warm.

recipe.title: Tzatziki with Cucumber and Dill
recipe.intro: No cooking required, but the dip needs 30 minutes of chilling for the flavors to meld. Have a box grater, a clean kitchen towel or cheesecloth, a colander, and a mixing bowl ready. Serve cold with warm pita and raw vegetables.
recipe.finish: The tzatziki is ready when thick, creamy, and speckled with green. Taste and adjust salt or lemon. Keep chilled until serving; it holds up to 3 days in a sealed container. Serve with warm pita wedges and cucumber, carrot, and bell pepper sticks.

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.prep: peeled and finely minced or microplaned

steps.title: Grate and salt cucumber
steps.details: Grate the cucumber on the large holes of a box grater into a colander set over a bowl. Toss with 1/4 tsp of the salt and let stand 10 minutes to release water.

steps.title: Prep garlic and dill
steps.details: While the cucumber drains, finely mince the garlic and chop the dill. Measure the lemon juice and olive oil.

steps.title: Squeeze cucumber dry
steps.details: Wrap the grated cucumber in a clean kitchen towel or cheesecloth and squeeze hard until no more liquid drips out; you should have about 1/2 cup of dry shreds. Discard the liquid.

steps.title: Mix the yogurt base
steps.details: In a mixing bowl, stir the yogurt with the remaining 1/4 tsp salt and the pepper until smooth.

steps.title: Fold in cucumber, garlic, dill, lemon, oil
steps.details: Add the squeezed cucumber, garlic, dill, lemon juice, and olive oil to the yogurt. Fold gently until evenly combined; do not overmix or it may thin out.

steps.title: Chill to meld flavors
steps.details: Cover and refrigerate at least 30 minutes for the garlic and dill to flavor the yogurt. Taste after chilling and adjust salt or lemon if needed.

steps.title: Serve with a drizzle
steps.details: Spoon into a shallow bowl, make a small swirl, and drizzle with a little olive oil. Serve cold with warm pita and vegetables.

recipe.title: Classic Horiatiki Village Salad
recipe.intro: A no-cook Greek salad built on ripe tomatoes and briny feta. Use a wide shallow bowl so the olive oil and juices pool nicely. Have a colander and a small bowl ready; no oven or stove needed.
recipe.finish: The salad is ready when the tomatoes glisten, the feta is intact on top, and the oregano and olive oil have soaked in. Serve immediately with crusty bread to mop up the juices; it is best eaten within 1 hour of dressing.

ingredients.name: English cucumber
ingredients.prep: halved lengthwise, seeded, sliced 1/4 inch thick

ingredients.name: red onion
ingredients.prep: thinly sliced and soaked in cold water 10 minutes

ingredients.name: block feta cheese
ingredients.prep: left whole or cut into 2 slabs

steps.title: Soak sliced onion
steps.details: Put the sliced red onion in a small bowl of cold water and let it sit 10 minutes to mellow its bite. Drain well and pat dry.

steps.title: Cut tomatoes and cucumber
steps.details: Chunk the tomatoes over the serving bowl so their juices collect in it. Halve, seed, and slice the cucumber. Keep both ready near the bowl.

steps.title: Build the vegetable base
steps.details: Add the drained onion, cucumber, and olives to the bowl of tomatoes. Sprinkle with the salt and pepper and toss gently with clean hands just until combined.

steps.title: Top with feta and oregano
steps.details: Lay the feta block or slabs on top of the salad. Scatter the crumbled oregano over the cheese and vegetables.

steps.title: Dress and rest briefly
steps.details: Drizzle the olive oil evenly over the salad. Let it stand 5 minutes so the juices, oil, and oregano mingle, then serve.

recipe.title: Spanakopita Triangles
recipe.intro: Thaw phyllo in the refrigerator overnight. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C) and line two baking sheets with parchment. Have a damp towel ready to cover phyllo.
recipe.finish: Bake until golden brown and crisp, 20–25 minutes. Let cool 10 minutes before serving. Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days; reheat in a 350°F oven for 8–10 minutes to re-crisp.

ingredients.name: unsalted butter
ingredients.prep: melted, or olive oil for brushing

steps.title: Preheat oven and prep
steps.details: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Line two baking sheets with parchment paper. Thaw phyllo if frozen (see intro).

steps.title: Cook spinach and scallions
steps.details: In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add scallions and cook 2 minutes until softened. Add spinach in batches and cook until wilted, about 5 minutes. Transfer to a colander and press out as much liquid as possible.

steps.title: Mix filling
steps.details: In a large bowl, combine the spinach mixture with dill, parsley, feta, eggs, salt, and pepper. Mix well.

steps.title: Prepare phyllo station
steps.details: Melt butter. Unroll phyllo and keep covered with a damp towel. Lay one sheet on a clean surface and brush lightly with butter.

steps.title: Layer phyllo
steps.details: Top with a second sheet and brush with butter. Repeat until you have 3 sheets stacked, brushing each layer. Cut the stack lengthwise into 3 equal strips (about 3 inches wide).

steps.title: Fill and fold triangles
steps.details: Place 1 tablespoon filling at the bottom of each strip. Fold the bottom corner over the filling to form a triangle, then continue folding like a flag to the end of the strip. Brush finished triangle with butter and place on baking sheet. Repeat with remaining phyllo and filling.

steps.title: Bake spanakopita
steps.details: Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 20–25 minutes, until golden brown and crisp. Rotate sheets halfway through if needed.

steps.title: Cool and serve
steps.details: Let cool on baking sheets for 10 minutes before serving. Serve warm or at room temperature.

recipe.title: Chicken Souvlaki Skewers
recipe.intro: Soak 8 bamboo skewers in water for at least 30 minutes (or use metal skewers). You need a grill or grill pan and a cutting board. If using wooden skewers, start soaking before you begin the marinade. Have a clean platter ready for the cooked skewers.
recipe.finish: Chicken is done when the thickest piece reads 165°F (74°C) on an instant-read thermometer and juices run clear, with charred edges and juicy meat. Rest 5 minutes, then serve with warm pita, tzatziki, sliced tomato, red onion, and lemon wedges.

steps.title: Soak the skewers
steps.details: Submerge the bamboo skewers in a pan of water so they don't burn on the grill. Leave them soaking while you marinate the chicken.

steps.title: Cut the chicken
steps.details: Pat the chicken thighs dry and cut into even 1 1/2-inch chunks so they cook at the same rate.

steps.title: Mix the marinade
steps.details: In a large bowl, whisk the olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, garlic, salt, and pepper until combined.

steps.title: Marinate the chicken
steps.details: Add the chicken chunks to the marinade and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes; don't go past 2 hours or the lemon makes the texture chalky.

steps.title: Preheat the grill
steps.details: Heat a grill or grill pan to medium-high, about 400–450°F (200–230°C). Clean and lightly oil the grates so the chicken doesn't stick. Preheat while the chicken finishes marinating.

steps.title: Thread the skewers
steps.details: Thread the chicken onto the soaked skewers, leaving a small gap between pieces and a little bare skewer at each end for handling. Discard the leftover marinade.

steps.title: Grill the skewers
steps.details: Grill over direct medium-high heat, turning every 2–3 minutes, until lightly charred on all sides and the thickest chunk registers 165°F (74°C), about 10–12 minutes total. If flare-ups occur, move the skewers to a cooler spot.

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.details: Transfer the skewers to a clean platter and rest 5 minutes. Serve with lemon wedges and the sides from your taverna menu.

recipe.title: Lemon Herb Roasted Potatoes
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C) with a rack in the middle. Have a large rimmed baking sheet ready. Wash and scrub potatoes; leave skins on.
recipe.finish: Wedges should be deep golden and crisp at the edges, easily pierced with a knife, and tender inside. Taste and add a squeeze of lemon or pinch of salt if needed. Serve hot alongside Greek taverna dishes.

steps.title: Preheat the oven
steps.details: Set oven to 425°F (220°C) with a rack in the middle. Let it fully heat while you cut and season the potatoes.

steps.title: Cut the potato wedges
steps.details: Scrub potatoes and cut into 1-inch wedges, keeping skins on. Pat dry with a clean towel so they brown rather than steam.

steps.title: Mix oil and seasonings
steps.details: In a large bowl, stir together olive oil, minced garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper.

steps.title: Toss potatoes to coat
steps.details: Add the dry wedges to the bowl and toss until evenly coated with the garlic-herb oil.

steps.title: Arrange on baking sheet
steps.details: Spread wedges in a single layer on the baking sheet, cut sides down and not touching, for maximum crispness.

steps.title: Roast until golden
steps.details: Roast 25 minutes. Then flip wedges with a spatula and continue roasting until deep golden and tender, about 10–15 minutes more.

steps.title: Finish with lemon
steps.details: Transfer hot potatoes to a serving bowl, drizzle with fresh lemon juice, and toss gently. Serve with lemon wedges.

generatedRecipes.title: Green Beans in Tomato and Olive Oil

recipe.title: Green Beans in Tomato and Olive Oil
recipe.intro: A Greek taverna classic: tender flat beans braised in tomato, onion, and plenty of olive oil. Use a wide pot or Dutch oven with a lid; no special equipment needed. Have everything chopped before you start.
recipe.finish: The beans are done when they are completely tender, wrinkled, and the tomato sauce has thickened and no longer tastes sharp; if the pot looks dry, add a splash of water and cook 5 more minutes. Taste and adjust salt and pepper. Serve warm or at room temperature with crusty bread, feta, and grilled meats.

ingredients.name: flat green beans (or regular green beans)

steps.title: Warm oil and soften onion
steps.details: Heat the olive oil in a wide pot over medium heat. Add the sliced onion and 1/4 tsp of the salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until soft and translucent, about 8 minutes. Do not brown.

steps.title: Add garlic and tomato paste
steps.details: Stir in the garlic, tomato paste, and oregano. Cook, stirring constantly, until the paste darkens slightly and smells sweet, about 2 minutes.

steps.title: Add tomatoes and water
steps.details: Pour in the diced tomatoes with their juices and the water. Stir, scraping the bottom of the pot, and bring to a gentle simmer.

steps.title: Add beans and season
steps.details: Add the trimmed green beans, remaining 1/4 tsp salt, and black pepper. Stir so the beans are mostly submerged; add a little more water if needed, but keep the beans just barely covered.

steps.title: Braise beans covered
steps.details: Cover and simmer gently over low heat, stirring every 15 minutes, until the beans are nearly tender, about 35 minutes. Keep the heat low so the sauce does not scorch.

steps.title: Uncover and thicken
steps.details: Uncover and continue simmering, stirring occasionally, until the beans are completely tender and the sauce has thickened and clings to them, about 15 more minutes. If the pot dries out before the beans are tender, add water 2 tbsp at a time.

steps.title: Rest and adjust seasoning
steps.details: Remove from heat and let rest 5 minutes. Taste and add salt and pepper as needed; drizzle with a little more olive oil before serving.

recipe.title: Baklava with Walnuts and Honey
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Thaw phyllo overnight in the refrigerator if frozen. Use a 9x13-inch baking pan. Have a clean, damp towel ready to cover phyllo sheets to prevent drying.
recipe.finish: Let baklava cool completely in the pan on a wire rack (about 2 hours) before cutting and serving. Store at room temperature for up to 1 week.

steps.title: Make walnut filling
steps.details: In a medium bowl, mix chopped walnuts, 1/4 cup sugar, cinnamon, and cloves until evenly combined.

steps.title: Layer phyllo and butter
steps.details: Brush bottom of 9x13-inch pan with melted butter. Layer 10 phyllo sheets, brushing each sheet with melted butter and keeping unused sheets covered with a damp towel. (If phyllo sheets are larger than pan, trim to fit.)

steps.title: Add walnut filling
steps.details: Spread half of the walnut filling evenly over the phyllo in the pan.

steps.title: Layer remaining phyllo
steps.details: Layer 10 more phyllo sheets on top, brushing each with melted butter as before. Top with remaining walnut filling.

steps.title: Finish top layers
steps.details: Layer final 10 phyllo sheets on top, brushing each with melted butter. Brush top generously with remaining butter.

steps.title: Cut into diamonds
steps.details: Using a sharp knife, cut through all layers into diamond shapes about 1.5 inches wide (cut diagonal lines about 1.5 inches apart, then cut lines in the opposite diagonal direction).

steps.title: Bake baklava
steps.details: Bake at 350°F (175°C) until golden brown and crisp, 45-50 minutes. If edges brown too quickly, cover loosely with foil.

steps.title: Make honey syrup
steps.details: While baklava bakes, combine honey, water, 1 cup sugar, lemon juice, and lemon peel in a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat, stirring until sugar dissolves. Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes. Remove from heat and discard lemon peel.

steps.title: Pour syrup over hot baklava
steps.details: When baklava is done, remove from oven and immediately pour the warm honey syrup evenly over the hot baklava. Let cool completely in pan on a wire rack, about 2 hours, until syrup is absorbed.

steps.title: Cool and serve
steps.details: Let baklava cool completely in the pan, about 2 hours, before serving. Cut along the scored lines to serve.

generatedRecipes.title: Greek Yogurt with Honey and Walnuts

recipe.title: Greek Yogurt with Honey and Walnuts
recipe.intro: Toast the walnuts on the stovetop while warming the honey, then spoon both over thick strained yogurt. Use full-fat Greek yogurt for the thickest texture. Have 4 small bowls ready.
recipe.finish: Spoon the warm honey and toasted walnuts over the yogurt just before serving so the yogurt stays cold and the nuts stay crisp. Serve immediately; drizzle extra honey at the table if you like.

steps.title: Toast the walnuts
steps.details: Put the chopped walnuts in a dry skillet over medium heat. Stir often until fragrant and lightly golden, 4 to 6 minutes; watch closely so they don't burn.

steps.title: Warm the honey
steps.details: While the walnuts toast, warm the honey in a small saucepan over low heat until it flows easily and is just warm to the touch, about 3 minutes. Do not let it boil.

steps.title: Spoon yogurt into bowls
steps.details: Divide the cold Greek yogurt among 4 small bowls, about 1/2 cup each, and smooth the tops with the back of a spoon.

steps.title: Add honey and walnuts
steps.details: Drizzle about 2 tablespoons of warm honey over each bowl of yogurt, then scatter the toasted walnuts evenly over the top.

steps.title: Dust with cinnamon and serve
steps.details: Sprinkle a little ground cinnamon over each bowl, if using, and serve right away while the honey is warm.

recipe.title: Fresh Lemonade with Mint
recipe.intro: No special equipment needed: a saucepan, a pitcher, a citrus juicer or reamer, and a fine sieve. Make the mint syrup first, then juice the lemons while it steeps. Chill everything well before serving for the best taverna-style pour.
recipe.finish: Taste and adjust: the lemonade should be tart-sweet and brightly minty. Serve over plenty of ice with a lemon slice and a mint sprig. Keep the pitcher chilled and stir before each refill, since the syrup settles.

steps.title: Make mint syrup
steps.details: Combine sugar and 1 cup water in a small saucepan over medium heat. Stir until sugar dissolves, about 3 minutes, then bring just to a gentle simmer. Do not boil hard.

steps.title: Steep the mint
steps.details: Take the pan off the heat, add the bruised mint leaves, cover, and let steep 15 minutes off the heat so the syrup takes on a clear mint flavor.

steps.title: Juice and strain lemons
steps.details: While the mint steeps, juice the lemons and strain out seeds and pulp. You need 1 cup of juice. This runs concurrently with the steep.

steps.title: Strain the syrup
steps.details: Pour the steeped syrup through a fine sieve into a pitcher, pressing the mint gently, then discard the leaves. The syrup should be pale green-gold and fragrant.

steps.title: Combine and chill
steps.details: Add the lemon juice and 5 cups cold water to the syrup in the pitcher and stir well. Refrigerate until thoroughly chilled, at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 days.

steps.title: Serve over ice
steps.details: Fill glasses with ice, pour the chilled lemonade, and garnish with a lemon slice and mint sprig. Stir the pitcher before each pour.

recipe.title: French Onion Soup
recipe.intro: Use a wide heavy pot for faster caramelizing. Slice onions thinly, grate the Gruyère, and slice the baguette before starting. Preheat the broiler only when the soup is nearly done.
recipe.finish: Ladle soup into broiler-safe bowls, top with toasted bread and Gruyère, and broil until bubbly and browned. Let bowls stand 2 minutes before serving; warn guests the bowls are hot.

steps.title: Melt butter and oil
steps.details: Melt the butter with the olive oil in a wide heavy pot over medium heat until foaming.

steps.title: Caramelize the onions
steps.details: Add the onions, salt, pepper and sugar. Cook, stirring every few minutes, until deeply golden brown and jammy, 35 to 40 minutes; reduce heat to medium-low if the onions start to scorch.

steps.title: Deglaze with wine
steps.details: Pour in the wine and scrape up the browned bits from the bottom. Simmer until the wine has nearly evaporated, about 3 minutes.

steps.title: Stir in flour
steps.details: Sprinkle the flour over the onions and stir constantly for 1 minute so it coats the onions and loses its raw taste.

steps.title: Simmer the soup
steps.details: Add the beef broth and thyme, if using. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a gentle simmer and cook uncovered for 20 minutes. Taste and adjust salt.

steps.title: Toast the baguette
steps.details: While the soup simmers, arrange the baguette slices on a baking sheet and toast under the broiler or in a 400°F oven until crisp and lightly golden, 4 to 6 minutes; turn once if using the broiler.

steps.title: Heat the broiler
steps.details: Turn on the broiler and position a rack about 6 inches from the heat while you ladle the soup.

steps.title: Top and broil the soup
steps.details: Ladle the soup into 4 broiler-safe bowls, float 2 toast slices on each, and cover generously with Gruyère. Broil until the cheese is melted, bubbly and browned in spots, 3 to 5 minutes; watch closely.

recipe.title: Warm Goat Cheese Salad
recipe.intro: A classic French bistro starter: crisp breaded goat cheese rounds on peppery greens with Dijon vinaigrette. You'll need a baking sheet, a small shallow bowl, a large salad bowl, and a whisk. Have everything prepped before you start; the cheese needs a quick chill so the coating sticks.
recipe.finish: Serve immediately while the goat cheese is warm and the greens are still crisp. Each plate gets a mound of dressed greens topped with two warm cheese rounds; a little extra vinaigrette can be drizzled over the cheese.

ingredients.name: all-purpose flour
ingredients.prep: in a shallow bowl, seasoned with a pinch of salt and pepper

ingredients.name: mixed peppery greens (arugula and/or baby spinach)

steps.title: Coat and chill goat cheese
steps.details: Roll each goat cheese round in flour, dip in beaten egg, then press firmly into panko to coat all sides. Place on a plate and refrigerate at least 15 minutes so the coating sets.

steps.title: Preheat oven
steps.details: Heat oven to 450°F (230°C) with a rack in the upper third. Line a baking sheet with parchment or foil and lightly oil it.

steps.title: Make Dijon vinaigrette
steps.details: In the salad bowl, whisk Dijon, vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper. Slowly stream in the extra-virgin olive oil while whisking until emulsified and slightly thickened. Taste and adjust salt.

steps.title: Bake goat cheese
steps.details: Arrange chilled cheese rounds on the prepared sheet, drizzle lightly with olive oil, and bake 8–10 minutes until the panko is golden and the cheese feels soft when pressed. Do not let it ooze.

steps.title: Toss greens
steps.details: Add greens to the vinaigrette and toss gently just until coated; don't over-dress.

steps.title: Plate and serve
steps.details: Divide dressed greens among 4 plates, top each with two warm goat cheese rounds, and serve immediately.

recipe.title: Coq au Vin
recipe.intro: A classic French chicken braise with red wine, mushrooms, pearl onions, and bacon. Use a large Dutch oven or heavy pot. Have all ingredients prepped before starting. No need to preheat oven; cooking is on stovetop, then oven. Preheat oven to 325°F (165°C) when you start step 6.
recipe.finish: Chicken should be tender and cooked through (internal temperature 165°F). Sauce should be thickened and glossy. Serve hot with mashed potatoes, egg noodles, or crusty bread.

ingredients.name: chicken pieces (bone-in, skin-on)
ingredients.prep: pat dry, season with salt and pepper

ingredients.name: pearl onions
ingredients.prep: fresh or frozen, thawed if frozen

ingredients.name: dry red wine (Burgundy or Pinot Noir)
all-purpose flour (for beurre manié)
ingredients.prep: mixed with butter to form a paste

steps.title: Brown bacon
steps.details: In a large Dutch oven, cook bacon over medium heat until crisp, about 8 minutes. Remove bacon with a slotted spoon; leave fat in pot.

steps.title: Brown chicken
steps.details: Increase heat to medium-high. Working in batches, brown chicken pieces in bacon fat, about 5 minutes per side. Transfer chicken to a plate.

steps.title: Sauté vegetables
steps.details: Pour off all but 2 tablespoons fat. Add pearl onions, mushrooms, and carrots to pot. Cook over medium heat until lightly browned, about 8 minutes. Add garlic and cook 1 minute more.

steps.title: Add tomato paste and flour
steps.details: Stir in tomato paste and 2 tablespoons flour; cook, stirring, for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Deglaze and simmer
steps.details: Pour in wine and broth, scraping up browned bits. Add bay leaf and thyme. Return chicken and bacon to pot. Bring to a simmer.

steps.title: Braise in oven
steps.details: Cover pot and transfer to preheated 325°F oven. Bake until chicken is tender and cooked through (165°F), about 45 minutes.

steps.title: Thicken sauce
steps.details: Remove pot from oven. Transfer chicken and vegetables to a serving dish; keep warm. Discard bay leaf. Bring braising liquid to a boil over medium-high heat and reduce slightly, about 5 minutes. Whisk in beurre manié (butter-flour paste) and cook until thickened, about 2 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Serve
steps.details: Pour sauce over chicken and vegetables. Serve hot.

recipe.title: Steak Frites with Garlic-Herb Butter
recipe.intro: Use a heavy skillet or cast-iron pan for the steak and a deep pot with a thermometer for frying. Pat the steak very dry and salt it while the oil heats. Have a plate lined with paper towels ready for the fries.
recipe.finish: Steak is ready at 130–135°F for medium-rare; rest it at least 5 minutes before slicing across the grain. Toss the hot fries with the remaining salt and parsley, top the sliced steak with the garlic-herb butter, and serve immediately while the fries are crisp.

ingredients.name: skirt steak
ingredients.prep: trimmed, patted very dry, cut into 2 or 3 pieces if long

steps.title: Season the steak
steps.details: Pat the steak very dry, then rub with 1 tsp of the kosher salt and all the black pepper. Let it sit at room temperature while you start the potatoes and make the butter.

steps.title: Make garlic-herb butter
steps.details: Mash the softened butter with the minced garlic, half the parsley, the lemon juice and a pinch of the remaining salt. Scrape into a small bowl and refrigerate until serving.

steps.title: Heat frying oil
steps.details: Pour the frying oil into a deep heavy pot to a depth of about 3 inches. Heat over medium-high to 325°F, clipping a thermometer to the side so it does not touch the bottom.

steps.title: First-fry the potatoes
steps.details: Working in 2 or 3 batches so the oil stays hot, fry the potato batons at 325°F for 4–5 minutes until pale and tender but not browned. Lift out with a spider or slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.

steps.title: Raise oil to 375°F
