steps.details: Increase the heat and bring the frying oil to 375°F. Keep the first-fried potatoes at room temperature on the paper towels.

steps.title: Second-fry until crisp
steps.details: Fry the potatoes again in batches at 375°F for 2–3 minutes, until deep golden and crisp. Drain on fresh paper towels, sprinkle with salt and the remaining parsley, and keep warm in a low oven.

steps.title: Sear the steak
steps.details: Heat the neutral oil in a heavy skillet over high heat until shimmering. Add the steak and sear undisturbed for 3–4 minutes per side for medium-rare, until a thermometer in the thickest part reads 130–135°F. Lower the heat if the pan smokes heavily.

steps.title: Rest and slice
steps.details: Transfer the steak to a cutting board and rest for 5 minutes. Slice thinly across the grain, sprinkle with the last pinch of salt if needed, and top with the chilled garlic-herb butter so it melts over the hot meat.

steps.title: Plate and serve
steps.details: Pile the crisp fries beside the sliced steak and spoon any butter from the board over the top. Serve right away.

recipe.title: Gratin Dauphinois
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C) with a rack in the middle. You need a 2-quart (8x8-inch or 9-inch round) baking dish, a mandoline or sharp knife, and a saucepan. No need to peel if using thin-skinned potatoes, but peel if you prefer.
recipe.finish: The gratin is done when the tip of a knife slides through the potatoes with no resistance and the top is deep golden with bubbling cream at the edges. Let rest 10 minutes before serving so it slices cleanly. Serve alongside roast chicken or steak.

ingredients.name: russet or Yukon Gold potatoes
ingredients.prep: peeled if desired, sliced 1/8 inch thick

steps.title: Preheat oven
steps.details: Set oven to 350°F (175°C) with a rack in the middle.

steps.title: Slice potatoes
steps.details: Slice potatoes 1/8 inch thick with a mandoline or sharp knife. Keep slices in a bowl of cold water if working ahead, then drain and pat dry.

steps.title: Warm cream mixture
steps.details: Combine cream, milk, garlic, salt, pepper, and nutmeg in a saucepan. Bring to a bare simmer over medium heat, then turn off heat and steep 10 minutes.

steps.title: Butter and layer potatoes
steps.details: Grease the baking dish with butter. Layer potato slices in overlapping shingles. Remove garlic from the cream, then pour the warm cream mixture over the potatoes, pressing down so all slices are submerged.

steps.title: Bake covered
steps.details: Cover tightly with foil and bake 45 minutes, until the potatoes are nearly tender when pierced with a knife.

steps.title: Uncover and add cheese
steps.details: Remove foil, sprinkle Gruyère evenly over the top if using, and return to the oven uncovered.

steps.title: Bake until golden
steps.details: Bake uncovered 25–30 minutes more, until the top is deep golden and the cream bubbles at the edges. A knife should slide through the potatoes with no resistance.

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.details: Let the gratin rest 10 minutes on a rack before cutting into squares or wedges.

recipe.title: Haricots Verts with Shallots
recipe.intro: Use a large pot of salted water for blanching and a wide skillet for sautéing. Set a bowl of ice water near the stove for shocking the beans. Have everything prepped before starting, as the cooking goes quickly.
recipe.finish: The beans should be tender-crisp, glossy from the butter, and lightly coated with shallots. Taste and adjust salt and lemon, then transfer to a warm serving platter and serve immediately.

steps.title: Boil salted water
steps.details: Fill a large pot with about 4 quarts water, add 1 tablespoon salt, and bring to a rolling boil over high heat.

steps.title: Prep beans and shallots
steps.details: While the water heats, trim the stem ends of the haricots verts and thinly slice the shallots. Set up a large bowl of ice water.

steps.title: Blanch beans
steps.details: Add the beans to the boiling water and cook until bright green and just tender-crisp, 2 to 3 minutes. Do not overcook.

steps.title: Shock in ice water
steps.details: Drain the beans and immediately plunge them into the ice water for about 3 minutes to stop cooking and set the color. Drain well and pat dry.

steps.title: Sauté shallots
steps.details: Melt 2 tablespoons butter in a wide skillet over medium heat. Add the shallots and cook, stirring often, until softened and lightly golden, about 4 minutes.

steps.title: Add beans and season
steps.details: Add the drained beans, 1/2 teaspoon salt, and 1/4 teaspoon pepper to the skillet. Toss to coat and heat through until tender, 3 to 4 minutes.

steps.title: Finish with butter and lemon
steps.details: Remove from heat. Stir in the remaining 1 tablespoon butter and the lemon juice until the beans are glossy. Taste and adjust salt.

recipe.title: Crusty Baguettes
recipe.intro: Use a food processor or stand mixer if you have one; otherwise mix by hand. Bread flour gives the chewiest crumb but all-purpose works. A spray bottle of water and a rimmed pan for steam help the crust; a baking stone is nice but optional. Start the dough about 3½ hours before you want bread.
recipe.finish: Baguettes are done when deep golden brown and the internal temperature reads 200–205°F (93–96°C), or when tapped on the bottom they sound hollow. Cool on a rack at least 15 minutes before slicing; the crust crisps as it cools. Serve warm with butter or for sopping up pan sauces.

steps.title: Mix the dough
steps.details: In a large bowl stir the flour, yeast and salt together. Pour in the warm water and mix with a sturdy spoon or your hand until no dry flour remains and a shaggy dough forms, about 2 minutes.

steps.title: Knead until smooth
steps.details: Turn the dough onto a lightly floured counter and knead 8–10 minutes, until smooth, elastic and slightly tacky; it should spring back when poked. If using a stand mixer, knead with the dough hook on medium-low for 6–8 minutes.

steps.title: First rise
steps.details: Lightly oil the bowl, turn the dough in it to coat, cover with a damp towel or plastic wrap and let rise in a warm spot until doubled, about 75–90 minutes.

steps.title: Divide and preshape
steps.details: Punch down the dough and turn it onto a lightly floured counter. Cut into 3 equal pieces (about 270 g each). Pat each into a rough 6x8-inch rectangle, fold the long edges to the center and pinch to seal, then roll gently into a loose log. Cover and rest 15 minutes.

steps.title: Shape the baguettes
steps.details: Working one at a time, press a piece into a 6x10-inch rectangle, fold the top edge to the center and press, fold again and seal the seam. Roll the log under your palms into a 14–15-inch rope, tapering the ends. Place seam-side down on a floured towel or parchment, cover, and repeat with the rest.

steps.title: Second rise and preheat
steps.details: Let the shaped loaves rise, covered, 35–45 minutes until puffy and barely springing back when pressed. Meanwhile heat the oven to 475°F (245°C) with a rack in the middle and a rimmed pan on the bottom rack.

steps.title: Score the loaves
steps.details: Slide the loaves onto a parchment-lined baking sheet (or peel). With a sharp knife or razor held at a shallow angle, make 3–4 quick ½-inch-deep diagonal slashes down each loaf.

steps.title: Bake with steam
steps.details: Carefully pour the hot water into the preheated pan (it will steam and spit), set the loaves on the middle rack and close the door. Bake 12 minutes, then reduce heat to 425°F (220°C) and rotate the pan.

steps.title: Finish baking
steps.details: Continue baking 14–18 minutes more, until deep golden brown and an instant-read thermometer in the center reads 200–205°F. Remove the steam pan if it still holds water.

steps.title: Cool on a rack
steps.details: Transfer the baguettes to a wire rack and cool at least 15 minutes so the crust sets and crisps. Slice when warm or at room temperature.

recipe.title: Tarte Tatin
recipe.intro: A classic French upside-down apple tart with caramelized apples on flaky pastry. You'll need a 9-inch oven-safe skillet (cast iron works best) and a roll of puff pastry. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
recipe.finish: Let the tart rest 5 minutes before flipping. Run a knife around the edge, place a plate over the skillet, and invert carefully. Serve warm, preferably with crème fraîche or vanilla ice cream.

ingredients.name: Golden Delicious or Granny Smith apples

steps.title: Preheat oven
steps.details: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Place rack in center.

steps.title: Peel and core apples
steps.details: Peel, core, and quarter the apples. Toss with lemon juice to prevent browning.

steps.title: Make caramel
steps.details: In a 9-inch oven-safe skillet, melt butter over medium heat. Add sugar and salt. Cook, swirling occasionally, until mixture turns deep amber, about 8–10 minutes. Do not stir vigorously.

steps.title: Arrange apples
steps.details: Remove skillet from heat. Carefully arrange apple quarters in the caramel, rounded side down, packing tightly in concentric circles.

steps.title: Top with pastry
steps.details: Lay puff pastry over apples, tucking edges down inside the skillet. Prick pastry several times with a fork.

steps.title: Bake tart
steps.details: Bake until pastry is golden brown and puffed, and caramel is bubbling, 30–35 minutes. Let rest 5 minutes before flipping.

steps.title: Rest and flip
steps.details: Let tart rest 5 minutes. Run a knife around edge. Place a serving plate over skillet and invert carefully. Lift off skillet. Serve warm.

recipe.title: Crème Brûlée
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 325°F (165°C). Bring a kettle of water to a boil for the water bath. You need six 5-ounce ramekins and a roasting pan large enough to hold them. Let eggs and cream come to room temperature; separate the yolks while the oven heats.
recipe.finish: Chill at least 3 hours before torching. Sprinkle an even thin layer of sugar over each custard, tilt to coat, and torch in small circles until bubbling and deep amber. Let the sugar harden 1–2 minutes, then crack with a spoon and serve within 15 minutes so the topping stays crisp.

ingredients.name: vanilla bean
ingredients.prep: split and seeds scraped, or 1 1/2 tsp vanilla extract added off heat

ingredients.name: egg yolks
ingredients.prep: separated, whites reserved for another use

steps.title: Heat cream and vanilla
steps.details: Combine the cream, milk, granulated sugar, vanilla bean and seeds (if using extract, add it later), and salt in a saucepan. Warm over medium-low heat, stirring, until steaming and sugar dissolves, about 5 minutes; do not boil.

steps.title: Whisk egg yolks
steps.details: While the cream heats, whisk the 6 egg yolks in a bowl just until smooth; avoid making foam.

steps.title: Temper the yolks
steps.details: Slowly ladle about 1/2 cup of the hot cream into the yolks while whisking constantly, then pour the yolk mixture back into the saucepan, whisking. Add vanilla extract now if using.

steps.title: Thicken to custard
steps.details: Cook over low heat, stirring constantly with a spatula, until the custard coats the back of the spatula and reaches 170–175°F (77–79°C), about 3–4 minutes. Do not let it simmer.

steps.title: Strain and fill ramekins
steps.details: Strain the custard through a fine sieve into a pitcher, then divide evenly among the six ramekins, skimming any foam.

steps.title: Bake in water bath
steps.details: Set ramekins in the roasting pan and pour hot water into the pan to reach halfway up the ramekins. Bake at 325°F (165°C) until edges are set and centers jiggle slightly, 35–40 minutes.

steps.title: Cool and chill
steps.details: Lift ramekins from the water bath and cool on a rack 20 minutes, then cover and refrigerate at least 3 hours or overnight until fully set.

steps.title: Torch the sugar
steps.details: Blot any moisture from the custards. Sprinkle 1 tbsp turbinado sugar evenly over each, tilt off excess, and torch in small circles until bubbling and amber, about 1 minute per ramekin.

recipe.title: Kir Royale
recipe.intro: Chill the wine and glasses well in advance. A classic Kir Royale is crème de cassis topped with dry sparkling wine; use a Champagne flute or white wine glass so the bubbles last.
recipe.finish: Serve immediately while still cold and bubbly. Don't stir vigorously; one gentle lift with a spoon is enough.

ingredients.name: crème de cassis (blackcurrant liqueur)
ingredients.prep: measure and have bottle chilled if possible

ingredients.name: dry sparkling wine or Champagne
ingredients.prep: well chilled, bottle opened just before serving

steps.title: Chill glasses and wine
steps.details: Put a Champagne flute in the freezer and the sparkling wine in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes before serving; the wine should be very cold to keep bubbles lively.

steps.title: Pour cassis into flute
steps.details: Take the chilled flute and pour in 1 tbsp crème de cassis; it should pool at the bottom.

steps.title: Top with sparkling wine
steps.details: Tilt the flute slightly and slowly fill with the chilled sparkling wine, pouring gently down the side to preserve bubbles; fill to about 1 inch from the rim.

steps.title: Bring together and serve
steps.details: Let the drink settle for 10–15 seconds so the cassis rises into a soft gradient; no stirring needed. Serve immediately while cold and fizzy.

recipe.title: Oktoberfest Brezeln (Soft German Pretzels)
recipe.intro: Get ready: whisk the lye bath in a well-ventilated spot and line two baking sheets with parchment. Preheat oven to 450°F (230°C) with racks in the upper and lower thirds about 20 minutes before baking. A stand mixer helps but isn't required — knead by hand 8–10 minutes. Wear gloves or use tongs when dipping in the lye bath, and never use an aluminu
recipe.finish: Pretzels are done when deep mahogany brown and firm to the touch, with an internal temperature of about 190–200°F if checked. Cool 5 minutes on the sheet, then serve warm with coarse mustard and butter. Best the day they're made; reheat leftovers at 350°F for 5 minutes.

ingredients.name: coarse pretzel salt or flaky sea salt

steps.title: Mix and knead dough
steps.details: Stir flour, warm water, yeast, sugar and fine salt together, then add the softened butter. Knead 8–10 minutes by hand or 5 minutes in a stand mixer until smooth and slightly tacky but not sticky.

steps.title: Let dough rise
steps.details: Shape into a ball, cover the bowl, and let rise in a warm spot until doubled, about 60 minutes.

steps.title: Heat lye bath and oven
steps.details: While the dough rises, stir baking soda into the 6 cups water in a wide non-aluminum pot and bring to a gentle simmer. Preheat oven to 450°F (230°C) with racks in the upper and lower thirds.

steps.title: Divide and shape pretzels
steps.details: Punch down dough and divide into 8 pieces. Roll each into a 22-inch rope, thicker in the middle, then twist into a pretzel: loop the ends, cross them, and press onto the dough. Place on parchment-lined sheets.

steps.title: Dip in lye bath
steps.details: Using gloves or tongs, dip each pretzel in the simmering baking soda bath for 20–30 seconds, then lift out, let drain briefly, and return to the parchment. Work in batches of two or three.

steps.title: Salt and bake
steps.details: Sprinkle pretzels with coarse salt. Bake at 450°F for 12–15 minutes, rotating sheets halfway, until deep mahogany brown and firm. Bake in batches if needed so the sheets aren't crowded.

steps.title: Cool and serve
steps.details: Cool pretzels on the sheet 5 minutes, then serve warm with coarse mustard for dipping.

recipe.title: Obatzda (Bavarian Cheese Spread)
recipe.intro: Let the Camembert sit at room temperature for 30 minutes so it mashes smoothly. Have a mixing bowl and fork or potato masher ready; no cooking is needed. Serve chilled or at cool room temperature with soft pretzels, rye bread, and radishes.
recipe.finish: Taste and adjust salt and paprika. The spread should be creamy but still hold a slight chunkiness, with a rosy-orange color and a tangy, savory flavor. Serve with pretzels or crusty bread. Store covered in the refrigerator up to 3 days; let it soften slightly before serving.

ingredients.name: fresh chives
ingredients.prep: finely chopped, plus extra to garnish

steps.title: Trim and break up cheese
steps.details: Remove the rind from the room-temperature Camembert and break the cheese into rough chunks into a large mixing bowl.

steps.title: Grate onion
steps.details: Grate or finely mince the onion. Reserve 1 tsp of the grated onion for garnish if desired.

steps.title: Mash cheese with butter
steps.details: Add the softened butter and cream cheese to the Camembert and mash with a fork or potato masher until mostly smooth with small lumps remaining.

steps.title: Mix in seasonings
steps.details: Stir in the onion, sweet paprika, crushed caraway seeds if using, chives, salt, and pepper until evenly combined.

steps.title: Adjust texture
steps.details: If the spread is too thick, stir in the beer 1 tsp at a time until creamy but still scoopable. Taste and adjust salt and paprika.

steps.title: Chill and rest
steps.details: Cover and refrigerate 20 minutes to firm up and let the flavors meld. Do not chill longer than needed or it will be hard to spread.

steps.title: Garnish and serve
steps.details: Transfer to a serving bowl, dust with sweet paprika, and scatter with reserved onion and extra chives. Serve cool, not ice-cold, with pretzels or bread.

recipe.title: Sauerbraten with Red Cabbage
recipe.intro: A classic German pot roast marinated in a sweet-sour mix, then braised until tender and served with braised red cabbage. Start the marinade at least 3 days ahead (or up to 5 days). Use a large pot with a tight-fitting lid and a heavy skillet or Dutch oven for the cabbage.
recipe.finish: Slice the roast against the grain and serve with the red cabbage and some of the gravy. The roast is done when a fork twists easily in the center and the internal temperature reaches at least 200°F (93°C). Let the roast rest 10 minutes before slicing. The cabbage is tender when pierced easily with a knife.

ingredients.name: beef chuck roast or bottom round

steps.title: Marinate the beef
steps.details: In a large non-reactive bowl or zip-top bag, combine the beef, vinegar, water, sliced onion, bay leaves, peppercorns, and cloves. Cover or seal and refrigerate for at least 3 days or up to 5 days, turning the beef once a day.

steps.title: Remove beef and strain marinade
steps.details: Remove the beef from the marinade and pat dry with paper towels. Strain the marinade through a fine-mesh sieve into a bowl, reserving the liquid and discarding the solids. Set aside.

steps.title: Brown the beef
steps.details: Heat the vegetable oil in a large Dutch oven or heavy pot over medium-high heat. Add the beef and brown on all sides, about 8 to 10 minutes total. Transfer the beef to a plate.

steps.title: Make the gravy base
steps.details: Reduce heat to medium. Add the flour to the pot and whisk constantly for 1 to 2 minutes to make a roux. Gradually whisk in the reserved marinade and the sugar. Bring to a simmer, whisking until slightly thickened.

steps.title: Braise the beef
steps.details: Return the beef to the pot, cover, and transfer to a 325°F (165°C) oven. Braise until the beef is fork-tender, about 2.5 to 3 hours. Check after 2 hours and add water if the pot looks dry. The beef should reach at least 200°F (93°C) and a fork should twist easily in the center.

steps.title: Cook the red cabbage
steps.details: While the beef braises, heat 1 tablespoon vegetable oil in a large skillet or Dutch oven over medium heat. Add the shredded cabbage, sliced onion, and chopped apple. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the cabbage begins to soften, about 10 minutes. Stir in the vinegar, sugar, salt, pepper, and water. Cover and cook over low heat, stirring occasionally, until the cabbage is very tender, about 45 to 60 minutes. Keep warm.

steps.title: Finish the gravy
steps.details: When the beef is tender, transfer it to a cutting board and cover loosely with foil. Skim excess fat from the cooking liquid. Stir in the crushed gingersnaps and simmer over medium heat, stirring, until the gravy thickens slightly, about 5 minutes. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

steps.title: Rest and slice the beef
steps.details: Let the beef rest for 10 minutes. Slice against the grain into 1/2-inch-thick slices. Serve with the red cabbage and gravy.

recipe.title: Grilled Bratwurst with Sauerkraut
recipe.intro: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high (about 400°F). Have a large skillet and tongs ready. Drain sauerkraut and slice onion.
recipe.finish: Bratwursts should be browned and reach 160°F internally. Serve hot with mustard and crusty bread or potato salad.

ingredients.name: bratwurst sausages
ingredients.prep: prick each a few times with a fork

steps.title: Preheat grill
steps.details: Preheat a gas grill to medium-high (about 400°F) or set a grill pan over medium-high heat.

steps.title: Sauté onion and caraway
steps.details: In a large skillet over medium heat, melt butter. Add sliced onion and caraway seeds; cook, stirring occasionally, until onion is soft and golden, about 8 minutes.

steps.title: Simmer sauerkraut
steps.details: Add drained sauerkraut, broth, and brown sugar to skillet. Stir, cover, and simmer over low heat for 15 minutes to blend flavors. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

steps.title: Grill bratwursts
steps.details: Place bratwursts on grill. Cook, turning occasionally, until browned and cooked through (160°F), 12–15 minutes.

steps.title: Rest sausages
steps.details: Transfer bratwursts to a plate and let rest for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.details: Serve bratwursts with sauerkraut and German mustard.

recipe.title: Käsespätzle (Cheese Spätzle with Crispy Onions)
recipe.intro: A classic Oktoberfest main: soft egg noodles layered with melted cheese and topped with crispy fried onions. You'll need a large pot, a colander or spätzle press/board, a large skillet, and a 9x13-inch baking dish (or a large ovenproof skillet). Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) while you prep. If using a spätzle press or board, have it ready; a coland
recipe.finish: The Käsespätzle is done when the cheese is fully melted, bubbling at the edges, and the top is lightly golden, about 15–20 minutes. The onions should be deep golden and crisp. Let rest 5 minutes, then serve hot with a green salad and Oktoberfest sausages if desired.

steps.title: Preheat oven and slice onions
steps.details: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Thinly slice the onions. Set aside.

steps.title: Fry onions until crisp
steps.details: Melt 2 tablespoons butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add sliced onions and cook, stirring often, until deep golden and crisp, 12–15 minutes. Transfer to a plate.

steps.title: Make spätzle batter
steps.details: In a large bowl whisk flour and 1 teaspoon salt. Add eggs, milk, and 1/2 cup water; whisk to a thick, smooth batter that slowly ribbons off a spoon (add water 1 tablespoon at a time if too thick).

steps.title: Boil water for spätzle
steps.details: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.

steps.title: Cook and drain spätzle
steps.details: Working in batches, press or scrape batter through a spätzle press, colander, or board into boiling water. When spätzle float, cook 1–2 minutes more, then lift out with a slotted spoon into a colander. Rinse briefly with cold water and drain well.

steps.title: Layer spätzle and cheese
steps.details: Butter a 9x13-inch baking dish with remaining 1 tablespoon butter. Spread half the spätzle in the dish, top with half the Emmentaler and half the cheddar, then repeat with remaining spätzle and cheeses.

steps.title: Bake until bubbling
steps.details: Bake uncovered until cheese is melted and lightly golden, 15–20 minutes.

steps.title: Top with crispy onions and chives
steps.details: Scatter fried onions and chives over the hot Käsespätzle. Serve immediately.

recipe.title: Warm German Potato Salad (Kartoffelsalat)
recipe.intro: Boil the potatoes and cook the bacon while you slice onions and measure the dressing. Use a large skillet and a 4-quart pot. Serve warm; this salad is best within an hour of making.
recipe.finish: Taste and adjust with salt, pepper, and a splash more vinegar if needed. Serve warm or at room temperature alongside sausages and sauerkraut. Refrigerate leftovers up to 3 days and reheat gently with a splash of water.

ingredients.name: waxy potatoes (Yukon Gold or red)
ingredients.prep: scrub, peel if desired, cut into 1-inch chunks

steps.title: Boil the potatoes
steps.details: Put potatoes in a 4-quart pot, add cold water to cover by 1 inch, and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce to a gentle simmer and cook 12–15 minutes, until a knife slides in with no resistance. Drain well and return to the warm pot off heat.

steps.title: Crisp the bacon
steps.details: While the potatoes cook, put bacon in a cold large skillet and set over medium heat. Cook 6–8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until crisp and golden. Use a slotted spoon to transfer bacon to a paper-towel-lined plate, leaving the fat in the skillet.

steps.title: Soften the onion
steps.details: Add onion to the bacon fat in the skillet and cook over medium heat 4–5 minutes, stirring, until softened and lightly golden.

steps.title: Build the dressing
steps.details: Stir broth, vinegar, sugar, mustard, salt, and pepper into the skillet with the onions. Simmer 2–3 minutes, scraping up browned bits, until the dressing is hot and the sugar dissolves.

steps.title: Toss potatoes with dressing
steps.details: Add the warm drained potatoes to the skillet and gently fold 2 minutes, until every piece is coated and has absorbed some dressing. Doneness cue: potatoes look glossy and the dressing clings without pooling.

steps.title: Add bacon and parsley
steps.details: Fold in the reserved bacon and half the parsley. Taste and adjust salt, pepper, or vinegar. Scatter the remaining parsley over the top and serve warm.

recipe.title: Apfelstrudel
recipe.intro: A classic German apple strudel with flaky pastry, spiced apples, and raisins, served with vanilla sauce. Use store-bought puff pastry for ease. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
recipe.finish: Let cool 15 minutes before slicing. Serve warm with vanilla sauce.

steps.title: Preheat oven and thaw pastry
steps.details: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. If puff pastry is frozen, thaw according to package directions (about 30 minutes).

steps.title: Prepare apple filling
steps.details: In a large bowl, combine sliced apples, sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg, raisins, walnuts, and flour. Toss until apples are evenly coated.

steps.title: Roll out pastry
steps.details: On a lightly floured surface, roll each puff pastry sheet into a 12x10-inch rectangle. If using one large sheet, roll to 12x16 inches.

steps.title: Fill and roll strudel
steps.details: Spread half the apple filling along one long edge of each pastry rectangle, leaving a 1-inch border. Roll up tightly, starting from the filled edge, and pinch seams to seal. Place seam-side down on prepared baking sheet.

steps.title: Brush with butter and bake
steps.details: Brush tops with melted butter. Bake until golden brown and apples are tender, about 40-45 minutes. Let cool 15 minutes before slicing.

steps.title: Serve with vanilla sauce
steps.details: Slice strudel into portions and serve warm with vanilla sauce.

recipe.title: Schwarzwälder Kirschtorte (Black Forest Cake)
recipe.intro: You will need a 9-inch round springform pan, parchment paper, two large mixing bowls, an electric hand mixer, a rubber spatula, a wire rack, and a long serrated knife. Let eggs and 1 jar of cherries come to room temperature. Preheat the oven to 350°F and line the pan bottom with parchment; do not grease the sides. Have a kettle of hot water ready f
recipe.finish: Let the chilled cake stand 10 minutes before releasing the springform ring. Wipe the knife clean between slices. Serve within 2 hours or keep refrigerated up to 24 hours; refrigerate leftovers promptly, loosely covered, for up to 3 days.

ingredients.name: eggs, room temperature
ingredients.prep: separated, whites in a clean dry bowl

ingredients.name: all-purpose flour
ingredients.prep: whisked with cocoa, baking powder, and salt

ingredients.name: unsweetened cocoa powder
ingredients.prep: whisked with flour, baking powder, and salt

ingredients.name: morello cherries in juice
ingredients.prep: drained, juice reserved; 3/4 cup juice set aside

ingredients.name: dark chocolate (70% cacao)
ingredients.prep: shaved with a vegetable peeler or grated

ingredients.name: sliced almonds
ingredients.prep: optional, for the sides (toasted at 350°F for 5 minutes if using)

steps.title: Preheat and prep pan
steps.details: Set a rack in the middle of the oven and preheat to 350°F. Line the bottom of a 9-inch springform pan with parchment and leave the sides ungreased so the sponge can climb.

steps.title: Whisk dry ingredients
steps.details: Combine the flour, cocoa, baking powder, and salt in a small bowl and whisk until evenly blended; set aside.

steps.title: Whip egg whites
steps.details: Beat the egg whites with a clean beater on medium-high until foamy, then add 1/3 cup of the sugar and beat to soft peaks. Set aside; do not overbeat.

steps.title: Whisk yolks and water
steps.details: In the larger bowl, whisk the egg yolks with the remaining 2/3 cup sugar until pale and slightly thickened, about 3 minutes. Whisk in the boiling water.

steps.title: Fold batter and bake
steps.details: Sprinkle the dry mixture over the yolk mixture and fold gently, then fold in one-third of the whites to lighten, followed by the rest just until no streaks remain. Pour into the pan, smooth the top, and bake at 350°F until the center springs back when pressed and a skewer comes out clean, 25–30 minutes.

steps.title: Cool sponge
steps.details: Cool the sponge in the pan on a wire rack 10 minutes, run a thin knife around the edge, release the springform ring, invert onto the rack, and peel off the parchment. Cool completely, about 45 minutes.

steps.title: Flavor cherry juice
steps.details: While the cake cools, stir the kirsch into the reserved 3/4 cup cherry juice. Refrigerate the drained cherries until assembly.

steps.title: Whip the cream
steps.details: Whip the cold cream with the powdered sugar and vanilla on medium-high until stiff peaks form, about 3 minutes. Keep cold; whip in two batches if your bowl is small.

steps.title: Split and soak cake
steps.details: Slice the cooled sponge horizontally into 3 even layers. Place one layer on a serving plate and brush with about one-third of the kirsch juice. Spread with a generous 1 cup whipped cream and top with half the cherries.

steps.title: Stack and coat cake
steps.details: Add the second layer, brush with one-third of the juice, spread with 1 cup cream and the remaining cherries, then top with the third layer and brush with the last of the juice. Coat the top and sides with a thin layer of cream to seal in crumbs.

steps.title: Decorate and chill
steps.details: Spread the remaining cream over the top and sides, press almonds onto the sides if using, and scatter chocolate shavings over the top. Refrigerate to set the cream, at least 1 hour.

recipe.title: Oktoberfest Beer Selection
recipe.intro: Chill 6 bottles of German beer (Weihenstephaner or Paulaner) in the fridge for at least 4 hours before the event. Have a bottle opener and clean 0.5 L steins or pints ready. Lager and wheat beers are best at 40–45°F (4–7°C); do not freeze.
recipe.finish: Pour lager down the side of a tilted glass, then straighten to build a 1-inch head. For wheat beer, rinse the glass with cold water first, pour two-thirds, swirl the bottle, then top off. Serve immediately and keep remaining bottles on ice.

ingredients.name: clean 0.5 L steins or pint glasses

steps.title: Chill beers and glasses
steps.details: Refrigerate all 12 bottles at least 4 hours, or 1 hour in an ice-water bucket. Chill glasses in the fridge 30 minutes.

steps.title: Set up ice bucket
steps.details: Fill a bucket or cooler halfway with ice and water to hold backup bottles at serving temperature.

steps.title: Open first round
steps.details: Open 6 chilled bottles (3 lager, 3 wheat). Work over a tray to catch drips.

steps.title: Pour lagers
steps.details: Tilt each glass 45 degrees and pour lager slowly down the side, then straighten for a 1-inch foam head.

steps.title: Pour wheat beers
steps.details: Rinse wheat-beer glasses with cold water; pour two-thirds down the side, swirl the bottle to lift yeast, then top off.

steps.title: Serve and refresh
steps.details: Hand out the first round and replenish from the ice bucket as glasses empty; keep opened bottles on ice.

recipe.title: Apfelschorle
recipe.intro: A refreshing German apple juice spritzer. Use chilled ingredients for best results. No special equipment needed—just a pitcher and glasses.
recipe.finish: Serve immediately over ice. Stir gently before pouring if it has been sitting. Enjoy cold.

steps.title: Chill ingredients
steps.details: Place apple juice and sparkling water in the refrigerator until cold, at least 2 hours or overnight.

steps.title: Fill pitcher with ice
steps.details: If using ice, fill a large pitcher with ice cubes.

steps.title: Pour in apple juice
steps.details: Pour the chilled apple juice into the pitcher over the ice.

steps.title: Add sparkling water
steps.details: Slowly pour the chilled sparkling water into the pitcher to preserve carbonation. Stir gently once.

steps.title: Serve with lemon
steps.details: Pour into glasses and garnish with lemon wedges if desired. Serve immediately.

recipe.title: Corned Beef and Cabbage
recipe.intro: Use a 6-quart or larger pot. Rinse the brisket to remove surface brine, then simmer gently — never at a hard boil. Have the potatoes, carrots, and cabbage cut before the meat is done so the last 25 minutes run smoothly.
recipe.finish: The brisket is done when a fork slides in with little resistance, about 3 hours; slice across the grain. The vegetables are done when the cabbage is tender but still holds its shape. Serve with mustard and a little of the cooking broth spooned over.

ingredients.name: corned beef brisket with spice packet
ingredients.prep: rinse well; set spice packet aside

ingredients.name: green cabbage
ingredients.prep: cut into 6 to 8 wedges, core left on

steps.title: Start the brisket
steps.details: Put the rinsed brisket in a large pot with the water, spice packet contents, and onion. Bring to a gentle simmer over medium-high heat, skimming foam, then lower to a bare simmer.

steps.title: Simmer the brisket
steps.details: Cover partly and simmer very gently until a fork pierces the thickest part with little resistance, about 2 hours 30 minutes. Keep the liquid just bubbling, not boiling.

steps.title: Add potatoes and carrots
steps.details: Add the potatoes and carrots to the pot around the brisket. Simmer uncovered until the potatoes are nearly fork-tender, about 15 minutes.

steps.title: Cook the cabbage
steps.details: Nestle the cabbage wedges into the pot, cover, and simmer until the cabbage is tender but still holds its shape and the potatoes are fully tender, 10 to 12 minutes.

steps.title: Rest and slice
steps.details: Transfer the brisket to a board and rest 10 minutes, then slice thinly across the grain. Keep the vegetables warm in the broth.

steps.title: Serve
steps.details: Arrange sliced brisket with the cabbage, potatoes, and carrots; spoon over a little broth and finish with butter if using. Serve with coarse mustard.

recipe.title: Irish Soda Bread
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C) with a rack in the middle. Have a baking sheet lined with parchment ready, plus a bowl, a whisk, and a butter knife. Let the buttermilk sit out only briefly; cold is fine.
recipe.finish: The loaf is done when deep golden and it sounds hollow when tapped on the bottom, 30–35 minutes. Cool on a rack at least 15 minutes before slicing so the crumb sets. Serve warm with butter for sopping up dinner juices.

steps.title: Preheat the oven
steps.details: Heat oven to 425°F (220°C) with a rack in the middle. Line a baking sheet with parchment.

steps.title: Whisk dry ingredients
steps.details: In a large bowl, whisk together 3 cups flour, baking soda, and salt until evenly combined.

steps.title: Add buttermilk and mix
steps.details: Pour in the buttermilk all at once. Stir with a sturdy spoon just until no dry flour remains; the dough will be shaggy and slightly sticky. Do not overmix.

steps.title: Shape the loaf
steps.details: Turn dough onto a lightly floured counter. With floured hands, gently pat into a round about 1½ inches thick. Transfer to the parchment-lined sheet and dust the top with 1 tbsp flour.

steps.title: Score a deep cross
steps.details: Using a butter knife, cut a cross about ½ inch deep across the top, reaching nearly to the edges. This helps the center cook through.

steps.title: Bake until golden
steps.details: Bake at 425°F for 30–35 minutes, until deep golden brown and the bottom sounds hollow when tapped. If the top darkens too fast after 25 minutes, tent loosely with foil.

steps.title: Cool before slicing
steps.details: Transfer loaf to a rack and cool at least 15 minutes. Slice into 8 wedges and serve warm.

recipe.title: Colcannon
recipe.intro: Get ready: peel and cut the potatoes, wash the kale, and slice the scallions. Use a large pot for potatoes and a large skillet for the greens. No specialty equipment needed beyond a potato masher.
recipe.finish: Taste and adjust salt and pepper. Serve hot with a well of melted butter in the center if you like. Colcannon is best fresh but holds on low heat, loosely covered, for up to 20 minutes.

ingredients.name: scallions
ingredients.prep: thinly sliced, whites and greens separated

steps.title: Boil the potatoes
steps.details: Put the potatoes in a large pot and cover with cold water by 1 inch. Add 1 tablespoon salt and bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce to a steady simmer. Cook until a knife slides in with no resistance, 15 to 18 minutes.

steps.title: Butter the kale
steps.details: While the potatoes cook, melt 2 tablespoons butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the scallion whites and kale with a pinch of salt and cook, stirring, until the kale is tender and wilted, 5 to 7 minutes. Remove from the heat.

steps.title: Warm the dairy
steps.details: Warm the milk and cream together in a small saucepan or the microwave until steaming but not boiling, about 2 minutes. Keep warm.

steps.title: Drain the potatoes
steps.details: Drain the potatoes in a colander and return them to the dry pot over low heat for 1 minute to steam off excess moisture.

steps.title: Mash the potatoes
steps.details: Mash the hot potatoes with the remaining 2 tablespoons butter until smooth. Stir in the warm milk and cream, then season with 1/4 teaspoon pepper and salt to taste.

steps.title: Fold in the greens
steps.details: Fold the buttered kale and scallion whites into the mashed potatoes until evenly combined. Cook gently for 2 minutes to heat through.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.details: Scatter the scallion greens over the top and serve hot, with extra butter melted into a small well in the center if desired.

recipe.title: Honey-Glazed Roasted Carrots
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Use a rimmed baking sheet; line with foil for easier cleanup if you like. Peel and trim the carrots while the oven heats.
recipe.finish: Carrots should be tender when pierced with a knife and lightly browned at the edges. Toss once more with the honey-butter glaze, taste for salt, and serve warm alongside the St. Patrick's Day dinner.

ingredients.name: carrots
ingredients.prep: peeled, trimmed, halved lengthwise if thick

steps.title: Preheat oven
steps.details: Set oven to 425°F (220°C) with a rack in the middle. Let it fully preheat while you prep the carrots.

steps.title: Prep the carrots
steps.details: Peel and trim the carrots. Cut thick carrots in half lengthwise so all pieces are roughly the same thickness, about 3/4 inch at the widest point.

steps.title: Season on the sheet
steps.details: Pile the carrots on a rimmed baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil, sprinkle with salt and pepper, and toss with your hands until evenly coated. Spread into a single layer with space between pieces.

steps.title: Roast the carrots
steps.details: Roast on the middle rack for 20 minutes, until the carrots start to soften and brown at the edges.

steps.title: Make the honey butter
steps.details: While the carrots roast, melt the butter in a small bowl in the microwave or on the stove. Stir in the honey until smooth.

steps.title: Glaze and finish roasting
steps.details: Pull the sheet out and drizzle the honey butter over the carrots. Toss gently to coat, spread back into a single layer, and roast 8–10 minutes more, until a knife slides easily into the thickest carrot and the edges are glossy and browned.

steps.title: Garnish and serve
steps.details: Sprinkle with parsley if using and serve warm.

recipe.title: Irish Cheddar and Stout Fondue
recipe.intro: A quick stovetop fondue for a St. Patrick's Day starter. Use a heavy saucepan or fondue pot and keep the heat low so the cheese stays smooth. Grate the cheese and cube the bread before you start; have everything within reach.
recipe.finish: Serve immediately while warm and fluid, with bread cubes and apple or veggie dippers alongside. If it thickens, stir in a splash of warm stout or milk over low heat. Don't let it boil once the cheese is in.

ingredients.name: apple
ingredients.prep: cored and cut into wedges (optional dipper)

steps.title: Prep cheese and bread
steps.details: Grate the cheddar and Gruyère into a bowl. Toss with the cornstarch until evenly coated. Cut the bread into 1-inch cubes and set out on a platter with apple wedges if using.

steps.title: Rub pot with garlic
steps.details: Rub the inside of a heavy saucepan or fondue pot thoroughly with the cut garlic clove, then discard the garlic.

steps.title: Warm stout with mustard
steps.details: Add the stout, Dijon and nutmeg to the pot. Heat over medium-low until gently steaming and small bubbles form at the edges, about 3 minutes. Do not let it boil hard.

steps.title: Melt cheese in batches
steps.details: Reduce heat to low. Add the cheese mixture a handful at a time, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon or whisk until each addition melts before adding the next, 6 to 8 minutes total.

steps.title: Season and check texture
steps.details: Stir in the black pepper. The fondue should coat the back of a spoon smoothly. If it looks thick, stir in a splash of warm stout; if loose, keep stirring over low heat a minute more.

steps.title: Serve warm with dippers
steps.details: Transfer to a warm fondue pot or serving bowl. Set out the bread cubes and apple wedges and serve right away while warm.

recipe.title: Smoked Salmon on Brown Bread
recipe.intro: A no-cook starter: soft butter on slices of Irish brown bread, topped with smoked salmon, black pepper and lemon. Soften the butter for 10 minutes first; use a sharp knife and a cutting board. No oven needed.
recipe.finish: Serve within 15 minutes of assembling so the bread stays fresh. Each piece should look glossy and slightly ruffled, with a lemon wedge alongside for squeezing at the table.

steps.title: Soften the butter
steps.details: Set the butter out on the counter for 10 minutes until it spreads easily without tearing the bread. Meanwhile, cut the bread, drain the salmon and cut the lemon wedges.

steps.title: Butter the bread
steps.details: Spread about 1 teaspoon of soft butter edge to edge on each bread slice. Work gently so the slices don't break.

steps.title: Top with salmon
steps.details: Drape 2-3 loose folds of smoked salmon over each buttered slice; don't press flat. Leave a little bread showing at the edges for contrast.

steps.title: Season and finish
steps.details: Grind a little black pepper over the salmon, scatter dill if using, and set a lemon wedge on each plate. Squeeze lemon over just before eating.

recipe.title: Guinness Chocolate Cake
recipe.intro: Heat oven to 350°F. Grease and line a 9-inch round springform or cake pan with parchment. Bring butter, eggs, and cream cheese to room temperature. Have all ingredients measured before starting.
recipe.finish: Let cake cool completely before frosting. Spread cream cheese frosting over the top (and sides if desired). Slice with a warm knife and serve at room temperature. Store leftovers covered in the refrigerator for up to 4 days and bring to room temperature before serving.

steps.title: Preheat the oven
steps.details: Set oven to 350°F with a rack in the middle. Grease a 9-inch round pan and line the bottom with parchment.

steps.title: Melt butter and stout
steps.details: In a medium saucepan over medium heat, warm the stout and butter together until the butter melts and the mixture is hot but not boiling, about 4 minutes.

steps.title: Whisk in cocoa
steps.details: Off the heat, whisk the cocoa powder into the warm stout mixture until smooth. Let it cool slightly while you combine the dry ingredients.

steps.title: Mix dry ingredients
steps.details: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, baking soda, salt, and sugar until evenly combined.

steps.title: Combine wet ingredients
steps.details: Whisk the eggs, sour cream, and vanilla into the cooled cocoa-stout mixture until fully blended.

steps.title: Fold batter together
steps.details: Pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients and whisk just until no dry streaks remain; the batter will be thin. Scrape into the prepared pan.

steps.title: Bake the cake
steps.details: Bake at 350°F for 40–45 minutes, until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out with just a few moist crumbs. Rotate the pan halfway through if your oven bakes unevenly.

steps.title: Cool the cake
steps.details: Set the pan on a wire rack for 15 minutes, then turn the cake out of the pan and cool completely on the rack, about 40 minutes more.

steps.title: Make cream cheese frosting
steps.details: In a large bowl, beat the softened cream cheese and butter until smooth. Gradually beat in the powdered sugar and vanilla until light and spreadable, about 3 minutes.

steps.title: Frost and serve
steps.details: Spread the frosting over the completely cooled cake. Slice with a warm knife and serve.

recipe.title: Irish Apple Crumble
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Use a 9-inch baking dish. Peel and core apples, cut into 1/2-inch slices. No specialty gear needed.
recipe.finish: Crumble is done when the topping is deep golden brown and the apples bubble at the edges. Cool 10 minutes before serving. Great warm with vanilla ice cream or custard.

ingredients.name: Baking apples (such as Granny Smith or Bramley)

steps.title: Mix apple filling
steps.details: In the baking dish, toss the sliced apples with granulated sugar, cinnamon, and lemon juice until evenly coated. Spread into an even layer.

steps.title: Preheat oven
steps.details: Set oven to 375°F (190°C) with a rack in the middle. Let it heat while you make the topping.

steps.title: Make crumble topping
steps.details: In a medium bowl, stir together flour, oats, brown sugar, and salt. Add cold butter cubes and rub in with fingertips (or cut with a pastry blender) until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs with some pea-sized butter bits.

steps.title: Top the apples
steps.details: Scatter the crumble topping evenly over the apples. Do not press it down; leave it loose and clumpy for a crisp texture.

steps.title: Bake until golden
steps.details: Bake uncovered 40–45 minutes, until topping is deep golden brown and juices bubble at the edges. If browning too fast, tent loosely with foil after 30 minutes.

steps.title: Cool and serve
steps.details: Remove from oven and cool on a rack 10 minutes. Serve warm, scooping apples and topping together.

recipe.title: Irish Coffee
recipe.intro: Preheat two sturdy 10-oz heatproof glasses or mugs with hot tap water (about 2 minutes), then empty and dry them. Have a small whisk or jar ready for the cream. Brew strong hot coffee and keep it hot.
recipe.finish: The cream should sit as a cool, lightly whipped layer on top of the sweet whiskey coffee; sip through the cream without stirring. Serve immediately while hot.

steps.title: Warm the glasses
steps.details: Fill two 10-oz heatproof glasses or mugs with hot tap water and let stand 2 minutes so the drinks stay hot. Empty and dry them.

steps.title: Whip the cream lightly
steps.details: In a small bowl or jar, whisk the cold heavy cream with the granulated sugar just until it thickens to a loose, pourable soft peak—about 20–30 seconds by hand or a few shakes in a jar. Stop before stiff peaks; it should still flow off a spoon. Refrigerate until step 5.

steps.title: Sweeten the hot coffee
steps.details: Divide the hot coffee between the two warmed glasses and stir in the brown sugar, 1 tsp per glass, until fully dissolved. Taste and add a pinch more sugar if you like it sweeter.

steps.title: Add the whiskey
steps.details: Pour 1½ tbsp (22 ml) Irish whiskey into each glass and stir gently to combine with the sweetened coffee.

steps.title: Float the cream
steps.details: Hold a spoon upside down just above the coffee and slowly pour half the lightly whipped cream over the back of it into each glass, letting it spread into a ½-inch float. Do not stir. Serve immediately.

recipe.title: Fresh Guacamole with Tortilla Chips
recipe.intro: No cooking required—just chopping and mashing. Have a bowl, fork or potato masher, knife, cutting board, and a serving bowl ready. Serve chips at room temperature.
recipe.finish: Taste and adjust salt or lime. Serve immediately, or press plastic wrap directly onto the surface and refrigerate up to 2 hours to slow browning. Serve with the tortilla chips for dipping.

ingredients.name: tortilla chips
ingredients.prep: open bag, serve in a bowl

steps.title: Chop onion and jalapeño
steps.details: Finely chop the onion and mince the seeded jalapeño. Put both in a medium bowl.

steps.title: Add lime and salt
steps.details: Squeeze the lime juice into the bowl and add the salt. Stir to combine.

steps.title: Prep tomato and cilantro
steps.details: Seed and dice the tomato and chop the cilantro; set both aside near the bowl.

steps.title: Mash avocados
steps.details: Add the avocado flesh to the onion mixture. Mash with a fork or potato masher until creamy but still slightly chunky.

steps.title: Fold in tomato and cilantro
steps.details: Gently stir in the tomato and cilantro until just combined. Avoid overmixing.

steps.title: Taste and adjust
steps.details: Taste and add salt or lime juice as needed. Transfer to a serving bowl.

steps.title: Serve with chips
steps.details: Set out the tortilla chips alongside the guacamole and serve right away.

recipe.title: Chicken Enchiladas Verdes
recipe.intro: Heat oven to 400°F. Use a 9x13-inch baking dish. Shred cooked chicken (rotisserie works well) and have everything measured before rolling.
recipe.finish: Enchiladas are done when sauce bubbles at the edges and cheese is fully melted, about 15 minutes. Let rest 5 minutes before serving; serve with sour cream, cilantro, and lime.

steps.title: Heat oven and warm chicken
steps.details: Heat oven to 400°F. Toss shredded chicken with 1/2 cup of the salsa verde in a bowl; set aside.

steps.title: Soften tortillas
steps.details: Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Warm each tortilla about 20 seconds per side until pliable; drain on paper towels.

steps.title: Fill and roll
steps.details: Put 1/4 cup chicken mixture and 2 tbsp cheese along one edge of each tortilla; roll tightly and place seam-side down in the baking dish.

steps.title: Top with sauce and cheese
steps.details: Pour remaining salsa verde over the rolled enchiladas, then scatter the remaining cheese evenly on top.

steps.title: Bake until bubbling
steps.details: Bake uncovered until sauce bubbles at the edges and cheese is fully melted, about 15 to 18 minutes.

steps.title: Rest and garnish
steps.details: Let the dish rest 5 minutes. Garnish with sour cream and cilantro just before serving.

recipe.title: Carne Asada Tacos
recipe.intro: Marinate the steak 30–120 minutes ahead if you can. You need a grill or a heavy cast-iron skillet, a cutting board, and a warm tortilla setup (oven or skillet). If using a grill, preheat it with the lid closed; if using a skillet, heat it about 5 minutes before searing.
recipe.finish: Steak is done when it reads 130–135°F for medium-rare (do not go past 140°F for skirt steak or it toughens). Rest 5 minutes, slice against the grain into thin strips, pile into warm tortillas, and top with onion, cilantro, and lime. Serve immediately with salsa.

ingredients.name: skirt steak
ingredients.prep: trim surface fat and silver skin

ingredients.name: neutral oil
ingredients.prep: measure, for skillet if not grilling

steps.title: Mix the marinade
steps.details: Whisk lime juice, orange juice, soy sauce, garlic, cumin, salt, and pepper in a glass dish or zip-top bag.

steps.title: Marinate the steak
steps.details: Add skirt steak to the marinade, turn to coat, cover, and refrigerate 30–120 minutes (do not exceed 2 hours).

steps.title: Prep the toppings
steps.details: While the steak marinates, dice the onion, chop the cilantro, and cut lime wedges; set aside in small bowls.

steps.title: Preheat the grill or skillet
steps.details: Heat a grill to medium-high (about 450°F) or a cast-iron skillet over medium-high with 2 tbsp oil until shimmering, about 5 minutes.

steps.title: Sear the steak
steps.details: Lift steak from marinade (discard marinade). Grill or sear 4–5 minutes per side, until well browned and an instant-read thermometer in the thickest part reads 130–135°F for medium-rare.

steps.title: Rest the steak
steps.details: Transfer steak to a cutting board and rest 5 minutes; juices will redistribute.

steps.title: Warm the tortillas
steps.details: While the steak rests, warm tortillas in a dry skillet over medium heat, about 30 seconds per side, or wrap in foil and heat in a 350°F oven for 8–10 minutes; keep wrapped in a clean towel.

steps.title: Slice the steak
steps.details: Slice rested steak thinly against the grain (across the muscle fibers) into strips.

steps.title: Assemble the tacos
steps.details: Place steak strips in warm tortillas and top with diced onion, cilantro, and a squeeze of lime; serve immediately.

recipe.title: Mexican Rice
recipe.intro: Have everything measured before starting: rinse the rice until the water runs mostly clear, then drain well and spread on a towel to dry for 5 minutes. Use a heavy 3-quart saucepan with a tight lid. No oven needed.
recipe.finish: Fluff with a fork, taste and add salt if needed, then cover and rest 5 minutes off heat before serving. Rice should be tender, separate, and lightly coated in tomato color, not soupy.

ingredients.name: long-grain white rice
ingredients.prep: rinse until water is mostly clear, drain, spread to dry 5 minutes

steps.title: Toast the rice
steps.details: Heat oil in a 3-quart saucepan over medium-high. Add drained rice and cook, stirring often, until grains turn light golden and smell nutty, 5 to 6 minutes. Do not let them brown deeply.

steps.title: Soften onion and garlic
steps.details: Reduce heat to medium. Push rice to the sides, add onion and garlic to the center, and cook until onion is soft and garlic fragrant, about 2 minutes, then stir into the rice.

steps.title: Add tomato and seasonings
steps.details: Stir in tomato sauce, cumin, and salt. Cook, stirring, until the sauce darkens slightly and coats the rice, about 2 minutes.

steps.title: Simmer covered
steps.details: Pour in broth and stir once, scraping the bottom. Bring to a boil, then reduce to low, cover tightly, and cook undisturbed 18 minutes. Do not lift the lid.

steps.title: Rest off heat
steps.details: Turn off heat and let the covered pot sit 8 minutes so steam finishes the rice.

steps.title: Fluff and finish
steps.details: Uncover, fluff with a fork, fold in cilantro, taste for salt, and serve.

recipe.title: Charro Beans
recipe.intro: Rinse and pick over the beans the night before if using dried; the recipe below uses canned pinto beans for a quick fiesta side. Have a large pot and a wooden spoon ready. No oven needed.
recipe.finish: Beans are done when the broth is slightly thickened and the beans are tender and hot, about 10 minutes after the chiles go in. Taste and add salt only if needed (bacon and canned beans are salty). Serve hot in a bowl with a slotted spoon or as a side to tacos and grilled meat.

steps.title: Crisp the bacon
steps.details: Put the bacon in a large pot over medium heat. Cook, stirring occasionally, until browned and crisp, 6 to 8 minutes.

steps.title: Soften onion and garlic
steps.details: Add the onion to the bacon fat and cook, stirring, until soft and translucent, about 5 minutes. Stir in the garlic and cook 1 minute more until fragrant.

steps.title: Add chiles and spices
steps.details: Stir in the green chiles, cumin, and black pepper. Cook 1 minute to bloom the spices.

steps.title: Add beans and broth
steps.details: Pour in the pinto beans and chicken broth or water. Stir to combine and scrape up any browned bits.

steps.title: Simmer the beans
steps.details: Bring to a gentle simmer, then lower the heat. Simmer uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the broth thickens slightly and the beans are hot and tender, about 10 minutes.

steps.title: Finish and taste
steps.details: Stir in the cilantro if using. Taste and add salt only if needed. Serve hot.

recipe.title: Street Corn Salad
recipe.intro: Use a large skillet or grill pan for charring. Have a bowl ready, crumble the cotija, chop the cilantro, and juice the limes before you start cooking corn.
recipe.finish: Taste and adjust lime and salt. Serve warm or at room temperature alongside the fiesta menu; refrigerate leftovers in a sealed container for up to 3 days.

ingredients.name: corn on the cob
ingredients.prep: shucked, or 5 cups frozen corn thawed

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.prep: measure out, plus more to taste

steps.title: Make the creamy dressing
steps.details: In a small bowl, whisk the mayonnaise, sour cream, chili powder, salt, and pepper until smooth.

steps.title: Char the corn
steps.details: Heat the oil in a large skillet over high heat. Add the corn kernels in a single layer and cook without stirring for 3 minutes so they blister and brown; stir and cook 2 more minutes until tender and spotted with char.

steps.title: Combine the corn base
steps.details: Tip the hot charred corn into a large bowl and let it sit 1 minute off the heat. Add the dressing and lime juice and toss to coat.

steps.title: Fold in cheese and cilantro
steps.details: Stir in the crumbled cotija and chopped cilantro, reserving a little of each for garnish.

steps.title: Taste and serve
steps.details: Taste and add salt or lime if needed, then serve warm or at room temperature.

generatedRecipes.title: Cinnamon Churros with Chocolate Dipping Sauce

recipe.title: Cinnamon Churros with Chocolate Dipping Sauce
recipe.intro: Get ready: whisk the cinnamon sugar in a shallow dish, line a plate with paper towels, and set a heavy pot with 2 inches of oil over medium heat to reach 360°F (use a thermometer). A pastry bag with a large star tip (or a zip-top bag with a 1/2-inch corner snipped) makes the grooves that hold the sugar.
recipe.finish: Churros are best within 30 minutes while crisp. Serve warm with the chocolate sauce for dipping. Reheat any leftovers at 350°F for 4–5 minutes; do not microwave or they go limp.

ingredients.name: vegetable oil
ingredients.prep: for frying, about 2 inches in a heavy pot

steps.title: Start heating frying oil
steps.details: Pour 2 inches of frying oil into a heavy pot and set over medium heat. Bring to 360°F; keep an eye on it while you work.

steps.title: Mix cinnamon sugar
steps.details: Stir 1/2 cup sugar with the cinnamon in a shallow dish until evenly combined.

steps.title: Make chocolate sauce
steps.details: Warm the cream in a small saucepan over low heat until steaming but not boiling, about 3 minutes. Off heat, add the chocolate and butter; stir until smooth. Keep warm on low.

steps.title: Make churro dough
steps.details: Boil the water with 2 tbsp sugar, the salt and 1 tbsp oil in a saucepan. Off heat, stir in the flour all at once until a smooth thick paste forms, then stir in the vanilla.

steps.title: Fill pastry bag
steps.details: Scrape the warm dough into a pastry bag fitted with a large star tip. Twist the top closed so the dough doesn't leak out.

steps.title: Fry first batch
steps.details: Check oil is 360°F. Pipe 5–6 inch lengths directly into the oil, cutting with scissors. Fry 5–6 pieces at a time for 3–4 minutes, turning, until deep golden brown and crisp.

steps.title: Fry remaining churros
steps.details: Drain the first batch on paper towels and return oil to 360°F between batches. Fry the rest the same way for 3–4 minutes per batch until deep golden.

steps.title: Coat in cinnamon sugar
steps.details: While still warm, roll each drained churro in the cinnamon sugar until well coated. Pile on a serving plate.

steps.title: Serve with chocolate sauce
steps.details: Rewarm the sauce gently if needed and pour into a small bowl. Serve the warm churros alongside for dipping.

recipe.title: Classic Margarita Pitcher
recipe.intro: Chill a 2-quart pitcher and 8 glasses in the freezer 20 minutes before serving. Have a jigger or measuring cup, a citrus juicer, and a small plate of coarse salt ready. Juice the limes while everything chills.
recipe.finish: Stir the pitcher once more before each pour to keep the tequila and lime juice balanced. Pour over fresh ice and garnish with a lime wheel. Serve immediately; the drink dilutes as the ice melts, so refill glasses rather than letting the pitcher sit out.

ingredients.name: simple syrup
ingredients.prep: measure out, or 1/3 cup agave nectar

ingredients.name: ice cubes, plus more for serving

steps.title: Chill pitcher and glasses
steps.details: Place the pitcher and 8 glasses in the freezer to chill for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Juice the limes
steps.details: Roll the limes firmly on the counter, halve them, and juice until you have 1 cup of strained juice. Set aside.

steps.title: Salt the glass rims
steps.details: Run a cut lime wheel around the rim of each chilled glass, then dip the rim into the coarse salt. Set glasses aside.

steps.title: Combine liquids in pitcher
steps.details: In the chilled pitcher, stir together the tequila, lime juice, orange liqueur, simple syrup, and water until fully blended.

steps.title: Add ice and stir
steps.details: Add 4 cups of ice cubes to the pitcher and stir gently for 30 seconds to chill the mixture. Taste and stir in 1 to 2 more tablespoons simple syrup if you prefer it sweeter.

steps.title: Pour and garnish
steps.details: Fill the salt-rimmed glasses with fresh ice, pour the margarita from the pitcher, and garnish each with a lime wheel. Serve right away.

recipe.title: Agua de Horchata
recipe.intro: No special equipment needed beyond a blender and a fine strainer or cheesecloth. Start the night before: the rice and cinnamon need a long soak to build that creamy, nutty body. Have a large pitcher and plenty of ice ready for serving.
recipe.finish: Stir the horchata well, then taste and adjust sugar and vanilla. Serve very cold over ice, dusted with a little extra cinnamon if you like. Keep leftovers covered in the refrigerator up to 3 days and stir before each pour, since the rice settles.

steps.title: Soak rice and cinnamon
steps.details: Combine the rinsed rice, 4 cups warm water and the broken cinnamon sticks in a large bowl or pitcher. Cover and let stand at room temperature on the counter overnight, 8 to 12 hours, until the rice is soft and the liquid smells strongly of cinnamon.

steps.title: Blend the rice mixture
steps.details: Pour the soaked rice and cinnamon liquid into a blender with the 4 cups room-temperature water. Blend on high for 2 minutes, until the rice is finely ground and the mixture looks milky and slightly thick.

steps.title: Strain out the solids
steps.details: Pour the blended mixture through a fine-mesh strainer lined with cheesecloth or a clean thin kitchen towel into a large pitcher. Press gently on the solids with a spoon to extract the creamy liquid, then discard the solids.

steps.title: Sweeten the horchata
steps.details: Add the sweetened condensed milk, whole milk, sugar and vanilla to the strained rice liquid. Stir with a long spoon until the sugar dissolves and the mixture is evenly pale and creamy, about 1 minute.

steps.title: Chill until very cold
steps.details: Cover the pitcher and refrigerate until thoroughly cold, at least 2 hours or up to overnight. Cold horchata should taste smooth and rich, not icy or thin.

steps.title: Serve over ice
steps.details: Fill glasses with the ice, pour the chilled horchata over it, and dust the top of each glass with a pinch of ground cinnamon. Serve immediately.

recipe.title: Chicken and Andouille Gumbo
recipe.intro: Get ready: chop the vegetables, cut the chicken and sausage, and start the rice. Use a heavy-bottomed pot or Dutch oven for the roux. Have all ingredients within reach before you start the roux, because it needs constant attention.
recipe.finish: The gumbo is done when the chicken is tender (165°F/74°C) and the broth is thickened. Stir in filé powder only after the pot is off the heat. Serve over hot rice with sliced scallions and hot sauce.

ingredients.name: filé powder
ingredients.prep: ready to use, added off heat

steps.title: Brown the sausage
steps.details: Heat a large heavy pot or Dutch oven over medium heat. Add the sliced andouille in a single layer and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned and lightly crisp at the edges, about 6 minutes. Transfer to a plate, leaving the rendered fat in the pot.

steps.title: Make the dark roux
steps.details: Add the oil to the pot and stir in the flour with a wooden spoon or spatula. Cook over medium-low heat, stirring constantly, until the roux turns the color of dark chocolate and smells nutty, 30–40 minutes. Scrape the bottom often so it does not burn; lower the heat if it starts to smoke.

steps.title: Add the vegetables
steps.details: Stir the onion, bell pepper, and celery into the roux and cook, stirring, for 3 minutes. Add the garlic and cook 1 minute more, until fragrant.

steps.title: Warm the broth with rice
steps.details: While the roux cooks, bring the broth to a simmer in a saucepan. In a separate pot, bring 4 cups water plus 1 tsp salt to a boil, add the rice, cover, and cook according to package directions, about 18 minutes; keep warm.

steps.title: Add broth and seasonings
steps.details: Slowly whisk in the warm chicken broth so the roux blends smoothly. Add the Cajun seasoning, thyme, bay leaves, 1 tsp salt, and black pepper. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a gentle simmer.

steps.title: Simmer the chicken
steps.details: Stir in the chicken and browned sausage. Return to a simmer and cook uncovered, stirring occasionally, until the chicken reaches 165°F/74°C and is tender, 25–30 minutes. Skim any foam from the surface.

steps.title: Finish the gumbo
steps.details: Remove from the heat and discard the bay leaves. Stir in the filé powder and let stand 5 minutes to thicken. Taste and add salt if needed.

steps.title: Serve over rice
steps.details: Spoon the gumbo over the warm rice in bowls. Scatter with sliced scallions and serve with hot sauce if desired.

recipe.title: Shrimp Étouffée
recipe.intro: Get ready: chop the holy trinity and garlic, measure the spices, and start the rice first. Use a large heavy skillet or Dutch oven and a separate covered pot for rice. Have everything near the stove before you start the roux; it moves fast once hot.
recipe.finish: The étouffée is done when the shrimp are opaque and curl into loose C shapes, 3 to 5 minutes after they turn pink. Taste and adjust salt, cayenne, and hot sauce. Serve over hot steamed rice with sliced scallions and extra hot sauce on the side.

ingredients.name: medium shrimp, 41–50 count
ingredients.prep: peeled and deveined, tails removed, patted dry

ingredients.name: hot sauce
ingredients.prep: such as Tabasco, plus more to serve

steps.title: Start the rice
steps.details: Combine the rice, water, and salt in a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil over high heat, stir once, cover tightly, and reduce heat to low. Cook 18 minutes without lifting the lid, then remove from heat and rest covered 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork just before serving.

steps.title: Season the shrimp
steps.details: While the rice cooks, toss the dry shrimp with 1/2 tsp of the Cajun seasoning. Put it back in the refrigerator until needed.

steps.title: Sauté the vegetables
steps.details: Melt 2 Tbsp of the butter in a large heavy skillet over medium-high heat. Add the onion, bell pepper, and celery with a pinch of salt. Cook 6 to 8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until softened and lightly browned. Add the garlic and cook 1 minute more, until fragrant.

steps.title: Make the spicy roux
steps.details: Reduce heat to medium-low. Push the vegetables to the edge and add the remaining 2 Tbsp butter and the flour to the center. Whisk constantly 2 to 3 minutes until the flour turns medium golden brown and smells nutty. Stir in the remaining Cajun seasoning, smoked paprika, and cayenne; cook 30 seconds.

steps.title: Build the sauce
steps.details: Stir in the diced tomatoes with juices, broth, Worcestershire, and hot sauce. Scrape up browned bits and bring to a simmer over medium heat. Cook uncovered 10 to 12 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce is slightly thickened and no raw flour taste remains.

steps.title: Poach the shrimp
steps.details: Add the seasoned shrimp and any juices to the simmering sauce. Cook, stirring gently, 3 to 5 minutes until the shrimp are opaque and curl into loose C shapes; do not overcook. Remove from heat and stir in the parsley. Taste and adjust salt, cayenne, and hot sauce.

steps.title: Fluff rice and serve
steps.details: Fluff the rested rice with a fork and spoon into shallow bowls. Ladle the shrimp étouffée over the rice, scatter with scallions and extra parsley, and serve with extra hot sauce.

recipe.title: Red Beans and Rice
recipe.intro: Classic Mardi Gras side: creamy kidney beans simmered with the Trinity, garlic, and smoked sausage, served over fluffy long-grain rice. Use a large pot and a saucepan with tight lids. No soaking needed with canned beans; if using dried, cook them fully first.
recipe.finish: Beans should be thick and creamy with sausage at 165°F (74°C); if too loose, simmer uncovered 5–10 minutes. Fluff rice with a fork, spoon beans over rice, and serve with hot sauce and sliced scallions.

steps.title: Brown the sausage
steps.details: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high. Add sausage and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned at the edges, about 6 minutes. Transfer sausage to a plate, leaving fat in the pot.

steps.title: Sauté the Trinity
steps.details: Add onion, bell pepper, and celery to the pot. Cook over medium heat, stirring, until softened and lightly golden, 6–8 minutes.

steps.title: Bloom garlic and spices
steps.details: Stir in garlic, thyme, paprika, and black pepper. Cook until fragrant, about 1 minute; do not let garlic brown.

steps.title: Simmer the beans
steps.details: Return sausage to the pot and add kidney beans, broth, and bay leaf. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a gentle simmer. Cook until beans are tender and broth is lightly thickened, 20–25 minutes, stirring occasionally.

steps.title: Start the rice
steps.details: While beans simmer, combine rinsed rice, water, and 1/2 tsp salt in a saucepan. Bring to a boil over high heat, then cover, reduce heat to low, and cook until water is absorbed, 15–18 minutes. Do not lift the lid.

steps.title: Rest and fluff rice
steps.details: Remove rice from heat and let stand covered 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork.

steps.title: Finish the beans
steps.details: Remove the bay leaf and mash about 1/4 of the beans against the side of the pot with a spoon to make the sauce creamy. Taste and add salt if needed. Ensure sausage reaches 165°F (74°C).

steps.title: Serve over rice
steps.details: Spoon beans and sausage over hot rice. Garnish with scallions, if using, and pass hot sauce at the table.

recipe.title: Cheesy Corn Maque Choux
recipe.intro: A quick Louisiana-style creamed corn side. Use a large skillet or Dutch oven. Have everything chopped before you start; the cooking moves fast. No preheat needed.
recipe.finish: The corn is done when tender and creamy, with the peppers and onions soft and the cheese fully melted. Taste and adjust salt and pepper. Serve warm alongside gumbo, jambalaya, or fried fish; it holds well on a buffet for about 30 minutes.

ingredients.name: corn kernels (fresh from about 6 ears, or frozen, thawed)

steps.title: Crisp the bacon
steps.details: Put the bacon in a cold large skillet over medium heat. Cook, stirring occasionally, until crisp and browned, 8 to 10 minutes. Scoop the bacon out with a slotted spoon and leave about 2 tablespoons of fat in the pan; discard the rest or save it.

steps.title: Soften the vegetables
steps.details: While the bacon fries, chop the onion, peppers, and celery. Add them to the hot bacon fat and cook over medium heat, stirring, until soft and lightly golden, about 8 minutes.

steps.title: Add garlic and spices
steps.details: Stir in the garlic, salt, pepper, and smoked paprika. Cook until fragrant, about 1 minute; do not let the garlic brown.

steps.title: Sauté the corn
steps.details: Stir in the corn and cook over medium-high heat until tender and lightly browned in spots, 8 to 10 minutes for fresh corn or about 6 minutes for thawed frozen corn.

steps.title: Cream the corn
steps.details: Reduce the heat to medium-low. Pour in the heavy cream and stir; simmer gently until slightly thickened, 3 to 4 minutes. Do not let it boil hard.

steps.title: Melt the cheese and finish
steps.details: Turn off the heat. Stir in the cheddar and the reserved bacon until the cheese melts and the mixture is creamy, about 2 minutes. Scatter the scallions over the top and serve warm.

recipe.title: Jambalaya-Spiced Deviled Eggs
recipe.intro: Hard-boil the eggs and cool them before peeling. You'll need a pot with a lid, a bowl of ice water, a small skillet, and a piping bag or zip-top bag. If using a piping tip, fit it now.
recipe.finish: Eggs are safe once the whites are firm and the yolks are fully set (165°F/74°C). Serve chilled or cool, within 2 hours of filling; refrigerate leftovers in a covered container for up to 2 days.

ingredients.name: Cajun or jambalaya seasoning
ingredients.prep: store-bought blend; plus extra for garnish

steps.title: Boil and cool eggs
steps.details: Place eggs in a single layer in a pot and cover with 1 inch of cold water. Bring to a rolling boil, cover, remove from heat, and let sit 12 minutes. Meanwhile fill a bowl with ice water. Transfer eggs to the ice bath for at least 10 minutes.

steps.title: Prep filling mix-ins
steps.details: While eggs cook, finely mince the celery and slice the green onions. Measure the mayonnaise, Cajun seasoning, hot sauce, and mustard into a small bowl and stir together.

steps.title: Peel and halve eggs
steps.details: Crack each chilled egg all over, peel under a trickle of cold water if needed, and pat dry. Halve lengthwise and pop the yolks into a medium bowl, setting the whites cut-side up on a serving platter.

steps.title: Make spiced yolk filling
steps.details: Mash the yolks with a fork until no lumps remain. Stir in the mayonnaise mixture, minced celery, half the green onions, and a pinch of salt and pepper until smooth and pipeable; add a splash of water if stiff.

steps.title: Pipe and garnish
steps.details: Spoon the filling into a piping bag or zip-top bag with the corner snipped. Pipe a generous mound into each egg white, then sprinkle with remaining green onions, a light dusting of Cajun seasoning, and black pepper.

steps.title: Chill before serving
steps.details: Cover and refrigerate at least 20 minutes so the flavors meld and the filling sets. Keep chilled until serving.

recipe.title: Crawfish Boil Dip
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 375°F. Use a 9-inch skillet or 1-quart baking dish. Have all ingredients ready before starting.
recipe.finish: Let dip rest 5 minutes before serving. Serve hot with crackers. Internal temperature should be at least 165°F.

steps.title: Preheat oven and prep
steps.details: Preheat oven to 375°F. While oven heats, soften cream cheese and chop vegetables and crawfish.

steps.title: Sauté peppers and onions
steps.details: In a skillet over medium heat, cook diced red bell pepper and white parts of green onions in a little oil until soft, about 5 minutes.

steps.title: Mix creamy base
steps.details: In a large bowl, beat softened cream cheese, sour cream, mayonnaise, Creole seasoning, smoked paprika, and garlic powder until smooth.

steps.title: Combine ingredients
steps.details: Stir in sautéed peppers and onions, chopped crawfish, green onion tops, half the Monterey Jack, and half the cheddar into the creamy base.

steps.title: Transfer and top
steps.details: Spread mixture into a 9-inch skillet or 1-quart baking dish. Sprinkle remaining Monterey Jack and cheddar on top.

steps.title: Bake dip
steps.details: Bake at 375°F until bubbly and cheese is melted, about 20 minutes. Dip should reach 165°F.

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.details: Let dip rest 5 minutes. Serve warm with crackers.

recipe.title: Skillet Buttermilk Cornbread
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C) with a 10-inch cast-iron skillet inside. Have all ingredients at room temperature. You'll need a large bowl, whisk, measuring cups/spoons, and oven mitts.
recipe.finish: Cornbread is done when golden brown and a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean, 20–25 minutes. Let cool in skillet 5 minutes, then cut into wedges and serve warm.

ingredients.name: unsalted butter
ingredients.prep: melted, plus extra for greasing skillet

steps.title: Preheat oven and skillet
steps.details: Place a 10-inch cast-iron skillet on middle rack and preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Let skillet heat for at least 15 minutes.

steps.title: Mix dry ingredients
steps.details: In a large bowl, whisk together cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt until evenly combined.

steps.title: Whisk wet ingredients
steps.details: In a medium bowl, whisk buttermilk, eggs, and melted butter until smooth.

steps.title: Combine wet and dry
steps.details: Pour wet mixture into dry ingredients and stir gently with a spatula just until moistened; small lumps are fine. Do not overmix.

steps.title: Heat skillet with fat
steps.details: Carefully remove hot skillet from oven. Add bacon drippings or oil and swirl to coat bottom and sides. Return skillet to oven for 2 minutes to heat fat.

steps.title: Pour batter into skillet
steps.details: Remove skillet from oven. Pour batter into hot skillet (it should sizzle). Smooth top with spatula.

steps.title: Bake until golden
