steps.details: Bake at 425°F (220°C) until top is golden brown and a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean, 20–25 minutes.

steps.title: Cool and serve
steps.details: Let cornbread cool in skillet 5 minutes. Run a knife around edge, cut into wedges, and serve warm.

recipe.title: Mardi Gras King Cake
recipe.intro: You'll need a stand mixer with dough hook (or strong arm and spoon), a large bowl, a lightly floured surface, a baking sheet, and parchment. A candy thermometer helps for the milk. Have the plastic baby ready—but remember to warn guests and push it in after baking.
recipe.finish: The cake is done when the ring is deep golden brown and the internal temperature of the thickest part reads about 190°F (88°C). Cool at least 20 minutes before icing so it doesn't melt off. Drizzle with the glaze, then immediately sprinkle alternating bands of purple, green, and gold sugar. Serve slightly warm or at room temperature. Slice and warn everyone about the hidden baby.

ingredients.name: small plastic baby
ingredients.prep: wrapped in foil, inserted after baking

ingredients.name: coarse decorating sugar
ingredients.prep: 1 tbsp each purple, green, and gold

steps.title: Warm milk and bloom yeast
steps.details: Warm the milk to 110°F (43°C)—comfortably warm, not hot. Stir in 1 tablespoon of the granulated sugar and the yeast. Let stand 10 minutes until foamy.

steps.title: Mix dry ingredients
steps.details: In a large bowl whisk the flour, salt, and 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon. Set aside.

steps.title: Mix dough
steps.details: Add the foamy yeast mixture, remaining 3 tablespoons sugar, eggs, and softened butter to the dry ingredients. Mix with a dough hook on low until a shaggy dough forms, then knead on medium-low 8–10 minutes until smooth and elastic; it should pull cleanly from the bowl.

steps.title: First rise
steps.details: Scrape dough into a greased bowl, cover, and let rise in a warm spot until doubled, about 60–75 minutes.

steps.title: Make filling
steps.details: Stir together the brown sugar and 1 1/2 teaspoons cinnamon; melt 2 tablespoons butter. Set both aside.

steps.title: Roll and fill dough
steps.details: Punch down dough and roll on a floured surface into a 12x20-inch rectangle. Brush with melted butter, leaving a 1-inch border, then sprinkle evenly with the cinnamon-sugar.

steps.title: Shape ring
steps.details: Roll up tightly from the long side into a log. Pinch the seam closed and place seam-side down on a parchment-lined baking sheet, curving ends together into a ring and pinching to seal.

steps.title: Second rise and preheat
steps.details: Cover loosely and let rise 30–40 minutes until puffy. During the last 15 minutes preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C).

steps.title: Bake cake
steps.details: Bake 25–30 minutes until deep golden brown and the center reads about 190°F (88°C). Tent with foil if browning too fast. Cool on the pan 20 minutes, then slide onto a rack.

steps.title: Make glaze
steps.details: Whisk powdered sugar, 2 tablespoons milk, and vanilla until smooth and pourable; add drops of milk if too thick.

steps.title: Insert baby and decorate
steps.details: Once cake is mostly cool, push the foil-wrapped baby into the underside. Drizzle glaze over the ring, then immediately band the top with coarse purple, green, and gold sugars.

recipe.title: Louisiana Pecan Pralines
recipe.intro: Get ready: a candy thermometer is the surest tool; otherwise use the cold-water test. Line 2 baking sheets with parchment or wax paper and set them near the stove. Toast the pecans first for deeper flavor. Have all ingredients measured before you start, because the sugar mixture moves fast once hot.
recipe.finish: The pralines are done when they hold their shape and are firm to the touch, about 30 minutes. Peel from the paper. Store in a single layer in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 5 days; refrigerate if the kitchen is warm and humid.

ingredients.name: unsalted butter
ingredients.prep: cut into pieces, plus extra for the pan

steps.title: Toast the pecans
steps.details: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Spread the pecans on a baking sheet and toast 8 to 10 minutes, until fragrant and one shade darker; do not let them burn. Cool completely, then roughly chop.

steps.title: Set up the praline station
steps.details: While the pecans cool, line 2 baking sheets with parchment or wax paper and set them near the stove. Measure all remaining ingredients so they are ready.

steps.title: Combine sugars and dairy
steps.details: In a heavy 4-quart saucepan, stir together the brown sugar, granulated sugar, milk, heavy cream, butter and salt until evenly moistened.

steps.title: Boil to soft-ball stage
steps.details: Bring the mixture to a boil over medium-high heat, stirring gently. Wash down the pan sides with a wet pastry brush, then stop stirring. Boil until a candy thermometer reads 236° to 240°F (113° to 116°C), 8 to 12 minutes. For the cold-water test, drop a little syrup into cold water; it should form a soft, squishy ball.

steps.title: Add pecans and vanilla
steps.details: Remove the pan from the heat. Stir in the vanilla and chopped pecans, then let the mixture rest undisturbed 5 minutes so it cools slightly and thickens.

steps.title: Beat until creamy and matte
steps.details: Using a sturdy wooden spoon or heatproof spatula, stir the mixture vigorously and steadily until it thickens, turns slightly matte and just starts to lose its gloss, 1 to 3 minutes. This is the key step: if it seizes, stir in a teaspoon of hot water and keep going.

steps.title: Drop the pralines
steps.details: Working quickly, drop heaping tablespoonfuls onto the lined sheets, leaving 2 inches between. If the mixture stiffens in the pan, stir in 1 teaspoon hot water and continue.

steps.title: Cool and firm up
steps.details: Leave the pralines undisturbed at room temperature until firm to the touch, about 30 minutes. Do not move them while they set.

recipe.title: Hurricane Punch
recipe.intro: A fruity, tropical party punch with citrus juices and grenadine, served over ice. Use a large punch bowl or pitcher and a ladle. Chill all juices and soda beforehand, and make an ice ring or have plenty of ice ready.
recipe.finish: Ladle into ice-filled glasses and garnish with orange slices and maraschino cherries. Stir the punch occasionally as the ice melts. Keep the bowl in the shade or on ice at a party, and discard any punch left out for more than 2 hours.

ingredients.name: light rum
ingredients.prep: optional; omit for a nonalcoholic punch

ingredients.name: ice
ingredients.prep: cubes or a frozen ice ring

steps.title: Chill and set up
steps.details: Refrigerate the orange juice, pineapple juice, soda, and lime juice until cold, at least 2 hours. Set out a large punch bowl or pitcher and a ladle.

steps.title: Squeeze the limes
steps.details: Roll the limes on the counter, halve them, and squeeze until you have 1 cup of juice. Discard the spent halves.

steps.title: Slice the orange
steps.details: Cut the orange into thin rounds, then cut each round in half. Set aside for garnish.

steps.title: Combine the juices
steps.details: In the punch bowl, stir together the chilled orange juice, pineapple juice, and lime juice until blended.

steps.title: Add grenadine and rum
steps.details: Pour in the grenadine and the rum, if using. Stir gently so the grenadine streaks through the punch rather than fully blending.

steps.title: Add ice and soda
steps.details: Add the ice or ice ring to the bowl, then pour the chilled soda slowly down the side and stir once. The punch should be cold and lightly fizzy.

steps.title: Garnish and serve
steps.details: Float the orange slices on top and scatter the cherries over the surface. Ladle into ice-filled glasses right away.

recipe.title: Kentucky Hot Brown Sliders
recipe.intro: Preheat broiler to high with a rack about 6 inches from the heat. Have a rimmed sheet pan and a small saucepan ready. Cook the bacon first, then make the Mornay sauce while the bacon drains. Use deli turkey slices about 1/8 inch thick.
recipe.finish: Let the sliders rest 2 minutes, then scatter with diced tomato and parsley and serve hot. The sauce should be bubbling and lightly browned at the edges, and the turkey should be steaming hot.

ingredients.name: slider rolls (such as King's Hawaiian or mini brioche)
ingredients.prep: split horizontally, keep connected as one slab if possible

steps.title: Cook the bacon
steps.details: Lay the bacon halves in a cold large skillet and set over medium heat. Cook 8–10 minutes, turning once, until crisp and deep golden; drain on paper towels. Do not pour bacon fat down the drain.

steps.title: Toast the roll bottoms
steps.details: While the bacon cooks, arrange the roll bottoms cut-side up on the sheet pan. Broil 1–2 minutes until lightly toasted, watching closely so they do not burn. Set the tops aside.

steps.title: Make the Mornay base
steps.details: In a small saucepan over medium heat, melt the butter. Whisk in the flour and cook 1 minute until bubbly and lightly golden, whisking constantly.

steps.title: Whisk in milk and thicken
steps.details: Slowly pour in the warm milk while whisking. Cook 3–4 minutes, whisking often, until the sauce is thick enough to coat the back of a spoon and just bubbles at the edges.

steps.title: Finish the sauce
steps.details: Off the heat, whisk in the Parmesan, salt, pepper and nutmeg until smooth. Taste and adjust salt. Keep warm over low heat, stirring occasionally.

steps.title: Layer turkey on rolls
steps.details: Fold the turkey slices loosely onto the toasted roll bottoms, dividing evenly and keeping the meat in modest mounds so the sauce can settle around it.

steps.title: Add bacon and sauce
steps.details: Top each turkey mound with 1–2 bacon halves, then spoon the warm Mornay sauce generously over the top, letting it pool around the meat. Reserve any extra sauce for serving.

steps.title: Broil until bubbly
steps.details: Broil 3–4 minutes until the sauce is bubbling and lightly browned in spots and the turkey reaches 165°F. Watch closely; rotate the pan if browning unevenly.

steps.title: Garnish and serve
steps.details: Rest 2 minutes, then top with diced tomato and parsley. Serve hot, with the reserved sauce and roll tops on the side if desired.

recipe.title: Bourbon-Glazed Ham Biscuits
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 450°F (230°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment. Have a pastry brush ready. These buttermilk biscuits are split and filled with thin-sliced ham brushed with a sticky bourbon-mustard glaze — perfect for a Derby party.
recipe.finish: Serve biscuits warm while the glaze is still sticky; the ham should be heated through (165°F / 74°C) and the biscuit bottoms lightly golden. These are best assembled just before serving so they don't get soggy.

steps.title: Mix dry ingredients
steps.details: Whisk flour, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl until evenly combined.

steps.title: Cut in cold butter
steps.details: Add cubed cold butter and work it in with fingertips or a pastry cutter until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs with pea-sized butter pieces.

steps.title: Add buttermilk and form dough
steps.details: Pour in cold buttermilk and stir just until a shaggy dough forms; do not overmix. Turn out onto a floured surface and pat gently into a 3/4-inch-thick round.

steps.title: Cut and bake biscuits
steps.details: Cut 12 rounds with a 2-inch cutter (press straight down, don't twist). Place on the lined sheet and bake 12–15 minutes until risen and golden brown.

steps.title: Make bourbon glaze
steps.details: While biscuits bake, whisk brown sugar, bourbon, melted butter, Dijon mustard, and black pepper in a small bowl until smooth.

steps.title: Heat ham in glaze
steps.details: Warm a large skillet over medium heat. Add ham slices in a single layer (work in batches if needed) and brush with glaze; cook 3–4 minutes, turning and brushing once, until heated through and sticky.

steps.title: Split and fill biscuits
steps.details: Split warm biscuits horizontally, layer with glazed ham, and brush cut tops with any remaining glaze before closing.

recipe.title: Pimento Cheese Deviled Eggs
recipe.intro: Hard-boil eggs and cool them; while they cool, make the pimento cheese filling. Use a pot large enough to hold eggs in a single layer.
recipe.finish: Pipe or spoon filling into egg white halves. Garnish with paprika and chives. Serve chilled or at cool room temperature. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

steps.title: Boil eggs
steps.details: Place eggs in a pot and cover with 1 inch cold water. Bring to a rolling boil over high heat, then cover, remove from heat, and let stand 12 minutes.

steps.title: Ice bath
steps.details: Transfer eggs to a bowl of ice water and cool at least 10 minutes.

steps.title: Make pimento cheese
steps.details: In a medium bowl, beat cream cheese until smooth; stir in mayonnaise, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Fold in cheddar and pimentos until combined.

steps.title: Peel eggs
steps.details: Crack shells and peel eggs under cool running water. Pat dry.

steps.title: Halve and separate
steps.details: Cut eggs in half lengthwise. Gently pop yolks into the pimento cheese bowl; arrange whites on a platter.

steps.title: Mash and mix filling
steps.details: Mash yolks into the pimento cheese mixture until smooth and creamy. Taste and adjust salt if needed.

steps.title: Fill egg whites
steps.details: Spoon or pipe filling into egg white halves, mounding slightly.

steps.title: Garnish and chill
steps.details: Sprinkle with smoked paprika and chives. Chill 20 minutes before serving.

recipe.title: Benedictine Spread Tea Sandwiches
recipe.intro: Classic Kentucky tea-room cucumber spread on soft white bread. Use a box grater and a fine sieve or clean kitchen towel; no specialty equipment needed. Chill the spread at least 1 hour before assembling (the passive step below covers it).
recipe.finish: Trim crusts, cut each sandwich into thirds, and keep covered with damp paper towels until serving. Best within 2 hours of assembly; refrigerate leftovers up to 1 day.

ingredients.name: cucumber
ingredients.prep: peeled, halved lengthwise, seeds scooped out, grated

steps.title: Drain grated cucumber
steps.details: Wrap the grated cucumber in a clean kitchen towel or press in a fine sieve and squeeze firmly until it feels dry, about 1/2 cup packed. Discard the liquid.

steps.title: Beat cream cheese smooth
steps.details: In a medium bowl, beat the softened cream cheese, grated onion, mayonnaise, lemon juice and salt until smooth and fluffy.

steps.title: Fold in cucumber and tint
steps.details: Stir the drained cucumber and optional food coloring into the cream cheese mixture until evenly pale green. Taste and adjust salt.

steps.title: Chill the spread
steps.details: Cover and refrigerate the Benedictine spread until firm and cold, at least 1 hour and up to 1 day.

steps.title: Spread bread and close
steps.details: Spread about 2 tablespoons chilled Benedictine on each of 12 bread slices, leaving a thin border. Top with remaining slices and press gently.

steps.title: Trim and cut sandwiches
steps.details: Trim crusts from the stacked sandwiches and cut each into 3 finger sandwiches, about 1 inch wide. Arrange on a platter.

generatedRecipes.title: Derby Day Crudités with Buttermilk Ranch

recipe.title: Derby Day Crudités with Buttermilk Ranch
recipe.intro: A crisp, colorful vegetable platter with a tangy homemade buttermilk ranch. You'll need a large platter or board, a cutting board, a chef's knife, a vegetable peeler, a colander, and a medium bowl. No cooking heat required—just chill and assemble. Wash and dry all vegetables well so the dip clings.
recipe.finish: Arrange the vegetables in colorful groups on the platter, keeping the dip bowl in the center or at one end. Serve immediately while the vegetables are crisp and cold; the ranch keeps 3 days refrigerated in a sealed container. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

ingredients.name: English cucumber
ingredients.prep: halved lengthwise and cut into spears

steps.title: Whisk the ranch base
steps.details: In a medium bowl, whisk 1 cup mayonnaise, 1/2 cup buttermilk, and 1/2 cup sour cream until smooth and pourable.

steps.title: Season the ranch
steps.details: Stir in 2 tbsp chives, 2 tbsp dill, 1 tbsp parsley, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp onion powder, 1/2 tsp salt, and 1/4 tsp pepper. Taste and adjust salt.

steps.title: Chill the dip
steps.details: Cover and refrigerate the ranch at least 30 minutes so the flavors meld. Meanwhile, prep the vegetables.

steps.title: Cut carrots and celery
steps.details: Peel 8 oz carrots and cut into 3-inch sticks. Cut 1 bunch celery into 3-inch sticks. Keep pieces similar in size for easy dipping.

steps.title: Cut cucumber and tomatoes
steps.details: Halve an English cucumber lengthwise and cut into spears. Rinse 1 pint cherry tomatoes and remove stems.

steps.title: Prep radishes and broccoli
steps.details: Trim and halve the radishes. Cut 1 head broccoli into bite-size florets.

steps.title: String the snap peas
steps.details: Remove the strings from 1/2 lb sugar snap peas by snapping the stem end and pulling the string down the pod.

steps.title: Chill vegetables
steps.details: Pat all vegetables dry and refrigerate them until serving so they stay crisp.

steps.title: Arrange the platter
steps.details: Spoon the chilled ranch into a small serving bowl. Arrange the carrots, celery, cucumber, tomatoes, radishes, broccoli, and snap peas in colorful groups around the bowl.

recipe.title: Cheddar-Chive Buttermilk Cornbread Squares
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 400°F with a 10-inch cast-iron skillet (or 8-inch square pan) inside. Gather a mixing bowl, whisk, rubber spatula, and measuring cups/spoons. Let buttermilk, eggs, and butter come to room temperature for even mixing; have cheddar shredded and chives chopped before you start.
recipe.finish: Cornbread is done when the top is golden and a toothpick in the center comes out clean, 20–25 minutes. Cool in the pan 10 minutes, then cut into 9 squares; serve warm or at room temperature.

steps.title: Heat oven and skillet
steps.details: Place an empty 10-inch cast-iron skillet (or 8-inch square pan) on the middle rack and preheat the oven to 400°F.

steps.title: Whisk dry ingredients
steps.details: In a large bowl, whisk together the cornmeal, flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.

steps.title: Whisk wet ingredients
steps.details: In a second bowl, whisk the buttermilk, eggs, and melted butter until smooth.

steps.title: Fold batter and add-ins
steps.details: Pour the wet mixture into the dry and fold with a spatula just until no dry streaks remain; gently stir in the cheddar and chives.

steps.title: Butter the hot skillet
steps.details: Carefully remove the hot skillet from the oven, add the 1 Tbsp butter, and swirl until the bottom and sides are coated.

steps.title: Bake cornbread
steps.details: Pour the batter into the hot skillet and bake at 400°F for 20–25 minutes, until the top is golden and a toothpick in the center comes out clean.

steps.title: Cool and cut
steps.details: Cool in the pan 10 minutes, then turn out or cut directly in the pan into 9 squares.

recipe.title: Bluegrass Cole Slaw
recipe.intro: A crunchy, tangy cider-vinegar slaw for a Derby party. You need a large bowl, a small bowl or jar for the dressing, a whisk, and a sharp knife or box grater. No cooking required; chilling time is built into the timeline.
recipe.finish: Taste and adjust salt and pepper before serving. The slaw is best the day it is made but holds up to 24 hours in the fridge; stir once more before serving. Serve chilled alongside fried chicken, sandwiches, or barbecue.

ingredients.name: scallions
ingredients.prep: thinly sliced, white and green parts separated

ingredients.name: neutral oil, such as vegetable or canola

steps.title: Shred cabbage and carrots
steps.details: Finely shred the cored cabbage and coarsely grate the peeled carrots. Put both in a large bowl and toss with your hands until evenly mixed.

steps.title: Slice scallions
steps.details: Thinly slice the scallions, keeping the white and green parts separate. Set the green parts aside for garnish and add the white parts to the cabbage mixture.

steps.title: Whisk the dressing
steps.details: In a small bowl or jar, whisk or shake the cider vinegar, sugar, kosher salt, black pepper, and celery seed until the sugar and salt dissolve. Slowly whisk in the oil until the dressing looks slightly creamy.

steps.title: Toss slaw with dressing
steps.details: Pour the dressing over the cabbage, carrots, and scallion whites. Toss well so every shred is coated. The slaw will look wet at first; the cabbage will soften slightly as it chills.

steps.title: Chill and meld flavors
steps.details: Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes so the cabbage absorbs the dressing and the flavors come together.

steps.title: Taste and adjust
steps.details: Remove from the fridge, toss again, and taste. Add a pinch more salt or a splash of vinegar if needed. The slaw should be crunchy and tangy, not watery.

steps.title: Garnish and serve
steps.details: Scatter the reserved scallion greens over the top and serve chilled.

recipe.title: Kentucky Derby Pie Bars
recipe.intro: Heat oven to 350°F and line a 9x13-inch baking pan with parchment, leaving an overhang. These chewy shortbread bars have a buttery crust, a gooey chocolate-walnut filling spiked with a splash of bourbon, and bake in one pan. Let the bars cool completely before cutting so the filling sets.
recipe.finish: The bars are done when the edges are golden and the center is set but still slightly soft; a gentle jiggle should barely move. Cool completely in the pan on a rack, at least 1 hour, then lift out by the parchment and cut into 24 bars. Store covered at room temperature up to 3 days.

ingredients.name: unsalted butter, softened
ingredients.prep: divided; 12 tbsp for crust, 4 tbsp for filling

steps.title: Heat oven and line pan
steps.details: Heat oven to 350°F. Line a 9x13-inch pan with parchment, leaving overhang on two sides, and grease lightly.

steps.title: Make shortbread crust
steps.details: Beat 12 tbsp (1 1/2 sticks) softened butter with the granulated sugar until fluffy, about 2 minutes. Mix in flour and 1/4 tsp salt just until crumbly.

steps.title: Press and bake crust
steps.details: Press crumbs firmly into the pan. Bake 15–18 minutes until pale golden and set. Keep oven on.

steps.title: Whisk filling base
steps.details: Whisk corn syrup, brown sugar, eggs, vanilla, bourbon, and remaining 1/4 tsp salt until smooth. Stir in 1 cup chocolate chips and 1 cup walnuts.

steps.title: Melt remaining butter
steps.details: Melt the remaining 4 tbsp butter and whisk into the filling mixture.

steps.title: Pour filling over crust
steps.details: Pour filling over the hot crust. Scatter the remaining 1/2 cup chocolate chips and 1/4 cup walnuts evenly on top.

steps.title: Bake until set
steps.details: Bake 30–35 minutes until edges are golden and center is set but slightly soft. A knife inserted 2 inches from edge should come out with moist crumbs, not wet batter.

steps.title: Cool completely
steps.details: Cool in pan on a rack at least 1 hour until fully set. Do not cut warm or the filling will smear.

steps.title: Cut and serve
steps.details: Lift out by the parchment and cut into 24 bars with a sharp knife, wiping between cuts.

recipe.title: Fresh Mint Julep Pitcher
recipe.intro: Have a pitcher, a small saucepan, and plenty of crushed ice ready. Make the mint syrup first and let it cool; a full pitcher can be mixed just before guests arrive and kept cold until serving.
recipe.finish: Stir well and serve over fresh crushed ice, topping each glass with mint. Taste and add a splash more syrup or bourbon if you like; keep the pitcher cold and do not let it sit out more than 2 hours.

ingredients.name: fresh mint leaves
ingredients.prep: rinse, plus extra sprigs for garnish

ingredients.name: crushed ice
ingredients.prep: crush or use bagged crushed ice

steps.title: Make mint simple syrup
steps.details: Combine sugar and water in a small saucepan over medium heat and stir until sugar dissolves, about 3 minutes; do not boil hard.

steps.title: Steep the mint
steps.details: Take the saucepan off the heat, add the packed mint leaves, cover, and steep 10 minutes.

steps.title: Strain and cool syrup
steps.details: Strain the syrup through a fine-mesh sieve into a bowl, pressing the leaves gently; discard leaves and cool the syrup at least 15 minutes.

steps.title: Chill the pitcher
steps.details: While the syrup cools, fill a large pitcher with 2 cups of the crushed ice and set it in the refrigerator or let it stand until the syrup is cool.

steps.title: Combine bourbon and syrup
steps.details: Pour the cooled mint syrup and the bourbon into the chilled pitcher and stir gently to combine.

steps.title: Top with crushed ice
steps.details: Add the remaining 4 cups crushed ice to the pitcher and stir once; the pitcher should be full and very cold.

steps.title: Garnish and serve
steps.details: Add lemon wedges if using, stir, and serve immediately over fresh crushed ice with mint sprigs.

recipe.title: Sweet Iced Tea with Lemon
recipe.intro: Use a 3-quart saucepan and a 2-quart pitcher. Start with fresh cold water and 5 black tea bags (or 5 teaspoons loose tea in a basket). Have ice and lemon slices ready before brewing.
recipe.finish: Tea is ready when deeply amber and fragrant. Pour over ice so each glass is cold, and add a lemon slice to every glass. Keep the pitcher refrigerated; stir before refilling.

ingredients.name: black tea (or 5 tsp loose leaf in a basket)
ingredients.prep: keep tags out of the pot

steps.title: Bring water to boil
steps.details: Pour the 8 cups cold water into the saucepan and set over high heat. Bring to a full rolling boil, about 6 to 8 minutes; watch for steady large bubbles across the surface.

steps.title: Steep the tea
steps.details: Turn off the heat. Add the tea bags, submerge them gently, and cover the pot. Steep exactly 5 minutes for a strong base that won't taste bitter.

steps.title: Remove tea bags
steps.details: Lift out the tea bags with a spoon and press them lightly against the side of the pot, then discard. Do not squeeze hard or the tea turns bitter.

steps.title: Stir in sugar
steps.details: Add the 3/4 cup sugar and stir for 1 to 2 minutes until fully dissolved and the liquid looks clear again, with no sugar grit at the bottom.

steps.title: Slice the lemon
steps.details: While the tea steeps, cut the lemon into thin round slices and set them on a small plate. Use a sharp knife on a stable board and keep the slices even.

steps.title: Chill the tea
steps.details: Fill a 2-quart pitcher with the 2 cups ice cubes, then pour the warm sweet tea over the ice. Stir for 1 to 2 minutes until the ice melts and the tea is cold, then refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to chill fully. The tea should be cold to the touch and clear amber.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.details: Stir the chilled tea, fill tall glasses with fresh ice, and pour the tea over the ice. Add a lemon slice to each glass and serve immediately.

recipe.title: Loaded Nachos Supreme
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a large rimmed baking sheet with foil or parchment. Have a skillet and a colander ready. Grate the cheese and chop the fresh toppings while the oven heats.
recipe.finish: Nachos are done when the cheese is fully melted and bubbling at the edges; serve immediately with salsa, sour cream, and guacamole on the side so chips stay crisp.

ingredients.name: jalapeños
ingredients.prep: thinly sliced (remove seeds for less heat)

steps.title: Heat oven and prep toppings
steps.details: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C); while it heats, shred the cheese, dice tomatoes and onion, slice jalapeños, chop cilantro, and drain and rinse beans.

steps.title: Brown the beef
steps.details: Heat a large skillet over medium-high. Add beef and cook 6–8 minutes, breaking it up, until no pink remains and juices run clear (160°F).

steps.title: Season the beef
steps.details: Stir in taco seasoning and water; simmer 3–4 minutes until the liquid thickens and coats the meat. Keep warm.

steps.title: Warm the beans
steps.details: Microwave beans in a bowl for 1–2 minutes, or warm briefly in a small pan, until hot.

steps.title: Layer chips and toppings
steps.details: Spread half the chips on the lined sheet. Scatter half the beef, beans, and cheese, then repeat with the remaining chips, beef, beans, and cheese. Dot jalapeños on top.

steps.title: Bake until melted
steps.details: Bake 8–10 minutes, until cheese is fully melted and bubbling at the edges. If needed, broil 1–2 minutes for browned spots — watch closely.

steps.title: Add fresh toppings
steps.details: Pull the tray from the oven and immediately scatter tomatoes, red onion, and cilantro over the hot nachos.

steps.title: Serve with sides
steps.details: Serve right away with sour cream, salsa, and guacamole on the side.

recipe.title: Buffalo Chicken Dip
recipe.intro: Heat oven to 375°F. Use an 8x8-inch baking dish or 9-inch pie plate. Soften cream cheese and shred cooked chicken before starting; preheat while you mix.
recipe.finish: Dip is done when bubbling at the edges and center reads 165°F. Rest 5 minutes, then serve hot with tortilla chips and celery sticks.

steps.title: Preheat oven
steps.details: Heat oven to 375°F with rack in the middle.

steps.title: Beat cream cheese base
steps.details: In a large bowl, beat softened cream cheese until smooth, then stir in ranch and hot sauce until evenly blended.

steps.title: Fold in chicken and cheese
steps.details: Stir in shredded chicken and 1 cup of the cheddar until well combined; the mixture will be thick.

steps.title: Spread and top
steps.details: Spread mixture evenly in the baking dish. Scatter remaining 1/2 cup cheddar over top, then blue cheese if using.

steps.title: Bake until bubbling
steps.details: Bake 20–25 minutes until bubbling at the edges and center reaches 165°F on an instant-read thermometer.

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.details: Let stand 5 minutes, then serve hot with tortilla chips.

generatedRecipes.title: Soft Pretzel Bites with Beer-Cheese Sauce

recipe.title: Soft Pretzel Bites with Beer-Cheese Sauce
recipe.intro: Heat oven to 425°F and line two baking sheets with parchment. Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Have a slotted spoon and clean towels ready. These are best fresh; start the cheese sauce while the bites bake.
recipe.finish: Bites are done when deep golden brown and firm to the touch; brush with butter and sprinkle with coarse salt. Serve warm with the cheese sauce, reheating the sauce gently with a splash of milk if it thickens.

ingredients.name: warm water (about 110°F)
ingredients.prep: run tap water and check temperature

steps.title: Activate yeast
steps.details: Whisk warm water, sugar and yeast in a large bowl; rest 5 minutes until foamy.

steps.title: Mix dough
steps.details: Stir in flour, fine salt and 2 tbsp melted butter until a shaggy dough forms.

steps.title: Knead dough
steps.details: Knead on a floured counter 5–6 minutes until smooth and slightly tacky, dusting with flour only as needed.

steps.title: Let dough rise
steps.details: Cover bowl and let rise in a warm spot about 45 minutes, until doubled. Meanwhile, make the sauce (next step).

steps.title: Make cheese sauce
steps.details: Melt 1 tbsp butter in a saucepan over medium heat; whisk in 1 tbsp flour and cook 1 minute. Whisk in milk and beer, simmer 2–3 minutes until slightly thick, then stir in cheddar, Dijon, kosher salt and pepper off heat until smooth. Keep warm.

steps.title: Shape pretzel bites
steps.details: Punch dough down, divide into 4 pieces, roll each into a 20-inch rope and cut into 12 pieces.

steps.title: Bathe in soda water
steps.details: Stir baking soda into the boiling water. Boil bites in batches 20–30 seconds, then lift out with a slotted spoon and drain on a towel.

steps.title: Egg-wash and salt
steps.details: Arrange bites on lined sheets, brush with egg wash and sprinkle with coarse salt.

steps.title: Bake bites
steps.details: Bake at 425°F, one sheet at a time if needed, 12–15 minutes until deep golden brown and firm. Switch racks halfway.

steps.title: Brush and serve
steps.details: Brush hot bites with 2 tbsp melted butter and serve with the warm cheese sauce.

recipe.title: Classic Deviled Eggs
recipe.intro: Hard-cook the eggs and shock them in ice water so they peel cleanly. While eggs cook and cool, set out a bowl of ice water and measure the filling ingredients. You need a saucepan, a bowl, a small mixing bowl, a fork, and a piping bag or spoon.
recipe.finish: Filling should be smooth, creamy, and bright with mustard tang; taste and adjust salt or mustard before piping. Dust generously with paprika just before serving. Keep refrigerated until serving and do not leave out more than 2 hours at game night; serve cold.

steps.title: Boil the eggs
steps.details: Place eggs in a saucepan and cover with 1 inch cold water. Bring to a rolling boil over high heat, then reduce to a gentle boil and cook exactly 10 minutes for firm yolks.

steps.title: Chill ice water
steps.details: While eggs boil, fill a bowl with ice and water and set it near the stove. This stops cooking and makes peeling easier.

steps.title: Ice-bath the eggs
steps.details: Drain hot water, then transfer eggs immediately to the ice water. Let sit at least 10 minutes until cool enough to handle.

steps.title: Peel and halve eggs
steps.details: Crack each egg all over on the counter, peel under cool running water, then pat dry. Slice lengthwise and gently pop yolks into a small bowl; set whites cut-side up on a plate.

steps.title: Mash and season filling
steps.details: Mash yolks with a fork until crumbly. Add mayonnaise, yellow mustard, Dijon, salt, and pepper; mash and stir until completely smooth and creamy. Taste and adjust salt or mustard.

steps.title: Fill the egg whites
steps.details: Spoon or pipe about 1 heaping teaspoon filling into each white, mounding slightly. Use a zip-top bag with a corner snipped for neat piping if you like.

steps.title: Dust and chill
steps.details: Dust tops lightly with paprika and scatter chives if using. Refrigerate 20–30 minutes before serving; serve cold.

recipe.title: Crispy Baked Chicken Wings
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 425°F. Line a rimmed baking sheet with foil and set a wire rack on top. Pat wings very dry; dryness is the key to crisp skin. Have paper towels and two bowls ready: one for the hot sauce, one for the honey-garlic sauce.
recipe.finish: Wings are done when skin is deep golden and crisp and a thermometer in the thickest part reads 175°F, or juices run clear. Toss half the wings in hot sauce and half in honey-garlic, or let guests choose. Serve immediately while crisp.

ingredients.name: chicken wings, split into flats and drumettes
ingredients.prep: pat completely dry with paper towels

ingredients.name: baking powder
ingredients.prep: measure plain baking powder, not baking soda

steps.title: Preheat oven and rack
steps.details: Set oven to 425°F with a rack in the upper-middle position. Line a rimmed baking sheet with foil and set a wire rack on it.

steps.title: Dry and season wings
steps.details: Pat the wings very dry. In a large bowl, toss wings with baking powder, salt and pepper until evenly coated.

steps.title: Arrange on rack
steps.details: Spread wings skin-side up on the rack in a single layer without touching, so hot air can circulate.

steps.title: Bake wings
steps.details: Bake 40–45 minutes, until skin is deep golden and crisp and a thermometer in the thickest part reads 175°F. Rotate the pan halfway through.

steps.title: Make hot sauce
steps.details: While wings bake, stir hot sauce and melted butter together in a small bowl.

steps.title: Make honey-garlic sauce
steps.details: In another small bowl, stir honey, minced garlic and soy sauce together.

steps.title: Toss and serve
steps.details: Let wings rest 2 minutes, then toss half with hot sauce and half with honey-garlic sauce, or serve sauces on the side. Serve immediately.

recipe.title: Veggie Tray with Ranch Dip
recipe.intro: No cooking needed—just washing, cutting and a quick stir-together dip. Have a large platter or tray and a small mixing bowl ready. Chill the dip while you cut the vegetables.
recipe.finish: Arrange the vegetables in colorful rows or clusters on the platter and set the bowl of chilled ranch dip in the center. Keep the tray refrigerated until serving if it will sit out longer than 2 hours; do not leave dip at room temperature more than 2 hours. Serve cold and crisp.

steps.title: Stir the ranch dip
steps.details: In a small bowl, whisk the sour cream, mayonnaise, ranch seasoning and lemon juice until smooth and evenly combined.

steps.title: Chill the dip
steps.details: Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 20 minutes so the herbs hydrate and the dip thickens slightly.

steps.title: Cut carrots and celery
steps.details: Peel the carrots and cut into 3-inch sticks about 1/2 inch thick. Trim the celery and cut into 3-inch sticks. Keep them in a bowl of ice water if cutting ahead.

steps.title: Cut celery and bell pepper
steps.details: Trim the celery and cut into 3-inch sticks. Seed the red bell pepper and slice into 1/2-inch strips.

steps.title: Slice cucumber and cut broccoli
steps.details: Slice the cucumber into 1/4-inch coins or sticks. Cut the broccoli head into bite-size florets, discarding thick woody stems.

steps.title: Finish vegetable prep
steps.details: Rinse and drain the cherry tomatoes. If the celery was not cut in step 4, trim and cut it now; otherwise confirm all vegetables are bite-size and dry.

steps.title: Arrange the tray
steps.details: Pat vegetables dry, then arrange carrots, celery, bell pepper, cucumber, broccoli and cherry tomatoes in separate colorful piles on a large platter. Set the chilled dip bowl in the center.

recipe.title: Garlic Parmesan Popcorn
recipe.intro: Use a large heavy pot with a lid and a big serving bowl. Have the Parmesan finely grated and herbs chopped before popping, since the tossing happens fast. No oven needed.
recipe.finish: The popcorn is done when popping slows to a few seconds between pops; do not let it scorch. Toss while hot so the butter and seasonings cling, then serve immediately in a wide bowl.

ingredients.name: popcorn kernels
ingredients.prep: pick out any unpopped loose hulls

ingredients.name: unsalted butter
ingredients.prep: melt in microwave or small pan

steps.title: Melt butter and mix seasonings
steps.details: Melt the butter in the microwave in 15-second bursts until liquid. In a small bowl, stir together the grated Parmesan, garlic powder, salt, and chopped parsley.

steps.title: Heat oil with test kernels
steps.details: Set a large heavy pot over medium-high heat. Add the oil and 3 popcorn kernels, cover, and wait for the test kernels to pop, about 2 to 3 minutes.

steps.title: Add kernels and cover
steps.details: Once the test kernels pop, add the remaining popcorn kernels in an even layer and cover the pot with the lid.

steps.title: Pop the corn
steps.details: Shake the pot gently every 20 to 30 seconds over medium-high heat. Pop until the popping slows to about one pop every 2 to 3 seconds, roughly 3 to 4 minutes total.

steps.title: Transfer popcorn to bowl
steps.details: Immediately pour the popped corn into a large bowl, leaving any unpopped kernels behind in the pot.

steps.title: Toss with butter
steps.details: Drizzle the melted butter over the hot popcorn in three additions, tossing gently between additions so it coats evenly without making the corn soggy.

steps.title: Season and toss
steps.details: Sprinkle the Parmesan mixture over the buttered popcorn in two additions, tossing gently after each so the seasonings are evenly distributed.

recipe.title: Chewy Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipe.intro: Let butter and egg come to room temperature. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C) and line two baking sheets with parchment. Use a stand or hand mixer and a 1-tablespoon scoop.
recipe.finish: Cookies are done when edges are golden and centers look slightly underbaked. Cool 5 minutes on the sheet, then move to a rack. Serve warm; store airtight up to 3 days.

ingredients.name: all-purpose flour
ingredients.prep: measure by spooning into cup and leveling

steps.title: Preheat oven
steps.details: Heat oven to 375°F (190°C) with racks in the middle and line two baking sheets with parchment. Start preheating now; it will finish while you mix.

steps.title: Whisk dry ingredients
steps.details: Whisk flour, baking soda and salt in a medium bowl until evenly blended.

steps.title: Cream butter and sugars
steps.details: Beat softened butter with brown sugar and granulated sugar on medium speed until pale and fluffy, about 2 minutes, scraping the bowl once.

steps.title: Beat in egg and vanilla
steps.details: Add the egg and vanilla and beat on medium until fully combined, about 1 minute.

steps.title: Combine flour mixture
steps.details: Add the flour mixture to the butter mixture and stir on low just until no dry flour remains; do not overmix.

steps.title: Fold in chocolate chips
steps.details: Stir in the chocolate chips until evenly distributed through the dough.

steps.title: Scoop onto sheets
steps.details: Drop rounded tablespoons of dough about 2 inches apart on the lined sheets, about 12 per sheet.

steps.title: Bake first sheet
steps.details: Bake one sheet at a time on the middle rack for 9–11 minutes, until edges are golden and centers still look slightly soft. Check at 9 minutes.

steps.title: Bake second sheet
steps.details: Bake the second sheet the same way, 9–11 minutes, until edges are golden.

steps.title: Cool and serve
steps.details: Let cookies rest on the sheet 5 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool completely. Serve warm.

generatedRecipes.title: Craft Root Beer and Lemonade Station

recipe.title: Craft Root Beer and Lemonade Station
recipe.yield: 8 servings (about 2 cups lemonade concentrate base + 2 L root beer)
recipe.intro: Set up a self-serve drink station for game night. You need a pitcher, a bowl or tray of ice, cups, and a long spoon. Chill the root beer and lemons ahead; make the lemonade base in the morning or right before guests arrive so it is cold by serving time.
recipe.finish: Guests pour lemonade base to about one-third of the cup, add water and ice to taste, or pour chilled root beer over ice. Stir lemonade before each pour; refill ice as needed. Keep root beer chilled and serve within the evening.

ingredients.name: lemons
ingredients.prep: rinsed; 1 sliced into thin wheels for garnish, rest halved

ingredients.name: hot water
ingredients.prep: just boiled or very hot tap

ingredients.name: craft root beer
ingredients.prep: chilled; keep bottles or cans closed until serving

steps.title: Chill drinks and make garnish
steps.details: Put the root beer in the refrigerator to chill for at least 2 hours. Slice 1 lemon into thin wheels and set aside on a small plate. Keep the remaining lemons at room temperature for juicing.

steps.title: Dissolve sugar in hot water
steps.details: In a large heatproof pitcher or bowl, stir the sugar into the hot water until no gritty sugar remains, about 1 minute. Let it sit 2 minutes to fully dissolve.

steps.title: Squeeze the lemons
steps.details: Roll the halved lemons on the counter, then squeeze them through a strainer into a measuring cup. You need about 1 cup of fresh juice; remove seeds. Discard the spent rinds.

steps.title: Combine lemonade base
steps.details: Pour the lemon juice into the sugar syrup, add 2 cups of the cold water, and stir well. This is the concentrate; it should taste strong and slightly sweet.

steps.title: Chill the lemonade
steps.details: Cover the pitcher and refrigerate the lemonade base for at least 30 minutes so it is properly cold before serving.

steps.title: Set up the station
steps.details: Place the chilled lemonade base, the remaining 2 cups cold water in a small pitcher, the chilled root beer, the ice bowl, cups, spoon, and lemon slices on a tray. Keep root beer closed until first pour to preserve fizz.

recipe.title: Loaded Nacho Platter
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Use a large rimmed baking sheet or oven-safe platter. Have all ingredients ready before assembling.
recipe.finish: Cheese should be fully melted and bubbly, beef heated through. Serve immediately with sour cream and salsa on the side.

steps.title: Preheat oven
steps.details: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).

steps.title: Brown beef
steps.details: Cook ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up, until no longer pink, about 6-8 minutes.

steps.title: Season beef
steps.details: Add taco seasoning and water to the beef. Simmer, stirring, until thickened, about 3-5 minutes.

steps.title: Assemble nachos
steps.details: Spread tortilla chips on a large rimmed baking sheet. Top with beef mixture, then sprinkle with cheese and jalapeños.

steps.title: Bake nachos
steps.details: Bake until cheese is melted and bubbly, about 5-7 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.details: Serve hot with sour cream and salsa on the side.

recipe.title: Buffalo Chicken Wings
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C) with a rack in the upper-middle position. Line a rimmed baking sheet with foil and set a wire rack on top. Have a large bowl ready for tossing. If your wings are whole, split them at the joints into flats and drumettes, and pat very dry.
recipe.finish: Wings are done when the skin is crisp and golden and the thickest part of the meat reaches 175°F (79°C) on an instant-read thermometer, with juices running clear. Toss hot wings with the buffalo sauce and melted butter until evenly coated. Serve immediately with celery sticks, carrot sticks, and blue cheese or ranch dressing for dipping.

ingredients.name: chicken wings, split into flats and drumettes
ingredients.prep: pat very dry with paper towels

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.details: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C), rack in the upper-middle position. Line a rimmed baking sheet with foil and set a wire rack on it.

steps.title: Dry and season wings
steps.details: Pat wings very dry. In a large bowl, toss wings with the baking powder, salt, and pepper until evenly coated.

steps.title: Arrange on the rack
steps.details: Spread the wings on the wire rack in a single layer, skin side up, without crowding.

steps.title: Roast the wings
steps.details: Roast until crisp and golden and the thickest part of the meat reaches 175°F (79°C), about 40 to 45 minutes, turning the pan once halfway through.

steps.title: Prep the dip vegetables
steps.details: While the wings roast, cut the celery and carrots into sticks and arrange on a platter with the dressing.

steps.title: Make the buffalo sauce
steps.details: Melt the butter and whisk it with the hot sauce in a large bowl.

steps.title: Toss and serve
steps.details: Transfer the hot, crisp wings to the buffalo sauce bowl and toss until evenly coated. Serve right away with the vegetables and dressing.

generatedRecipes.title: Soft Pretzel Bites with Cheese Dip

recipe.title: Soft Pretzel Bites with Cheese Dip
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 425°F and line two baking sheets with parchment. Set out a large pot, a wide skillet or pot for the water bath, and a stand mixer or mixing bowl. Have a clean counter or board ready for shaping.
recipe.finish: Pretzel bites are done when deep golden brown and firm to the touch; serve warm with the cheese dip. Best within 30 minutes, but reheat at 350°F for 5 minutes.

ingredients.name: warm water (about 110°F)
ingredients.prep: run tap water and test with finger

steps.title: Preheat oven
steps.details: Set oven to 425°F with racks in upper and lower thirds. Line two baking sheets with parchment.

steps.title: Proof the yeast
steps.details: In a large bowl or stand mixer bowl, stir warm water and sugar. Sprinkle yeast on top and let stand 5 minutes until foamy; if it does not foam, the yeast is dead—start over with fresh yeast.

steps.title: Make the dough
steps.details: Add flour, salt, and melted butter to the yeast mixture. Mix with dough hook or wooden spoon until a shaggy dough forms, then knead 4–5 minutes by hand or 3 minutes on medium-low until smooth and slightly tacky.

steps.title: Let dough rise
steps.details: Cover bowl with a clean towel and let rise in a warm spot until nearly doubled, about 45–55 minutes.

steps.title: Make the cheese dip
steps.details: While dough rises, melt 2 tbsp butter in a small saucepan over medium heat. Whisk in 2 tbsp flour and cook 1 minute. Slowly whisk in milk and simmer 3–4 minutes until thickened. Off heat, stir in cheddar, salt, and paprika until smooth. Keep warm over low heat, stirring occasionally.

steps.title: Shape the bites
steps.details: Punch down dough and divide into 4 pieces. Roll each into a 20-inch rope and cut into 1-inch pieces.

steps.title: Prepare the water bath
steps.details: Bring 8 cups water and baking soda to a boil in a wide pot.

steps.title: Boil the bites
steps.details: Working in batches, boil bite pieces 30 seconds, then flip and boil 30 seconds more. Remove with a slotted spoon to the lined baking sheets.

steps.title: Brush and salt
steps.details: Brush boiled bites with egg wash and sprinkle with coarse salt.

steps.title: Bake until golden
steps.details: Bake 12–15 minutes, rotating sheets halfway, until deep golden brown and firm. Let cool 3 minutes before serving with warm cheese dip.

recipe.title: Popcorn Trio (Butter, Chili-Lime & Caramel)
recipe.intro: You'll make one big base batch of stovetop popcorn, then split it three ways. Set out a large pot with a tight lid, a baking sheet, a whisk, and three big bowls. Caramel corn needs a 250°F oven, so preheat during popping. Have all flavor ingredients measured before you start so the caramel doesn't burn.
recipe.finish: Let caramel corn cool fully on the sheet so it crisps up (about 15 minutes), then break into clusters. Toss butter popcorn and chili-lime popcorn in their bowls and serve all three side by side. Popcorn is best the same day; store any leftovers in airtight bags.

ingredients.name: popcorn kernels
ingredients.prep: pick out any unpopped old maids if visible

ingredients.name: cayenne pepper
ingredients.prep: measure out, optional for extra heat

steps.title: Preheat oven for caramel
steps.details: Heat oven to 250°F with a rack in the middle. Line a large rimmed baking sheet with parchment.

steps.title: Pop the base corn
steps.details: In a large heavy pot with a lid, combine kernels and oil over medium-high heat. Cover and shake occasionally until popping slows to one pop every 2-3 seconds, 3-5 minutes. Remove from heat, uncover carefully, and immediately toss with 1/2 tsp of the fine salt.

steps.title: Make butter popcorn
steps.details: Transfer about one-third of the hot popcorn to a big bowl. Drizzle with the 4 tbsp melted butter and toss well to coat evenly.

steps.title: Make chili-lime popcorn
steps.details: Transfer another third of the popcorn to a second bowl. Toss with chili powder, lime zest, cayenne if using, and the remaining 1/2 tsp fine salt. Taste and add a pinch more salt if needed.

steps.title: Boil caramel syrup
steps.details: In a medium saucepan over medium heat, stir together granulated sugar, brown sugar, caramel butter, and corn syrup. Bring to a boil, stirring, then let bubble without stirring for 2 minutes until slightly thickened; do not let it darken or smell burnt.

steps.title: Finish caramel sauce
steps.details: Remove saucepan from heat. Whisk in baking soda and vanilla; the mixture will foam up. Stir until smooth.

steps.title: Coat remaining popcorn
steps.details: Put the last third of the popcorn in a large bowl and pour the hot caramel over it. Toss quickly and thoroughly with a spatula to coat every piece. Spread on the prepared baking sheet in an even layer and sprinkle with flaky salt.

steps.title: Bake caramel corn crisp
steps.details: Bake at 250°F for 20 minutes, stirring every 7 minutes so it crisps evenly and does not scorch. It's done when it looks glossy but dry to the touch and holds together in loose clusters.

steps.title: Cool caramel corn
steps.details: Let the caramel corn cool on the baking sheet undisturbed for 15 minutes until crisp, then break into clusters. Serve alongside the butter and chili-lime bowls.

recipe.title: Pigs in a Blanket
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a large baking sheet with parchment. Have a small bowl of water and a pastry brush or your fingertips ready for sealing. Keep pastry cold until use.
recipe.finish: Pigs in a blanket are done when the pastry is puffed and deep golden brown and an instant-read thermometer in the center of a hot dog reads at least 165°F (74°C), about 18–22 minutes. Let cool 5 minutes on the tray, then serve warm with mustard and ketchup for dipping.

ingredients.name: all-butter puff pastry
ingredients.prep: thaw per package directions in the fridge; keep chilled

ingredients.name: cocktail-size smoked sausages or mini hot dogs
egg
ingredients.prep: beat with 1 tablespoon water for egg wash

steps.title: Preheat oven and prep sausages
steps.details: Heat oven to 400°F (200°C) with a rack in the middle. Pat the mini sausages completely dry so the pastry seals; set aside.

steps.title: Roll and cut pastry
steps.details: Lightly flour the counter. Unfold the chilled puff pastry and roll gently to a 12x9-inch rectangle, about 1/8 inch thick. Cut into 24 strips about 3/4 inch wide by 4 1/2 inches long with a knife or pizza cutter.

steps.title: Wrap each sausage
steps.details: Working one at a time, wrap a pastry strip around a dry sausage in a slight spiral, overlapping a bit. Press the seam and ends closed with a dab of water or egg wash so they don't unroll. Place seam-side down on the lined sheet, 1 inch apart.

steps.title: Brush with egg wash
steps.details: Brush the tops of all wrapped sausages lightly with egg wash. This gives the flaky golden finish.

steps.title: Bake until golden
steps.details: Bake 18–22 minutes, until pastry is puffed and deep golden brown and a hot dog in the center reads 165°F (74°C). Rotate the tray halfway through if browning is uneven.

steps.title: Cool and serve
steps.details: Cool on the tray 5 minutes. Transfer to a platter and serve warm with mustard and ketchup for dipping.

recipe.title: Veggie Sticks with Hummus
recipe.intro: No cooking required. Have a cutting board, chef's knife, vegetable peeler, colander, paper towels, and a serving platter or bowl ready. If making homemade hummus, a food processor helps; store-bought hummus works fine.
recipe.finish: The veggie sticks should be crisp and cold, and the hummus should be smooth and creamy. Serve immediately, or cover and refrigerate for up to 2 days; stir the hummus and blot any moisture from the vegetables before serving.

steps.title: Cut carrots into sticks
steps.details: Cut peeled carrots into 3-inch lengths, then cut each length into 1/4- to 1/2-inch-thick sticks. Pile on the serving platter.

steps.title: Cut celery into sticks
steps.details: Cut celery stalks crosswise into 3-inch lengths, then lengthwise into 1/4- to 1/2-inch-thick sticks. Add to the platter with the carrots.

steps.title: Cut peppers into strips
steps.details: Cut bell peppers into 1/4- to 1/2-inch-wide strips, about 3 inches long. Add to the platter.

steps.title: Chill and crisp vegetables
steps.details: Pat the cut vegetables dry with paper towels, cover loosely, and refrigerate until ready to serve. This keeps them crisp and cold.

steps.title: Spoon and garnish hummus
steps.details: Spoon the hummus into a shallow bowl or small serving dish. If using, drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with paprika or cumin.

steps.title: Arrange platter and serve
steps.details: Arrange the chilled veggie sticks around the hummus bowl on the platter. Serve right away, or keep refrigerated until serving time.

recipe.title: Classic Chewy Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipe.intro: Let butter and egg sit at room temperature for 30 minutes. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C) with a rack in the middle; line two baking sheets with parchment. You need a mixer or bowl and wooden spoon, measuring cups, and a spoon for dropping dough.
recipe.finish: Cookies are done when edges are golden and centers still look slightly soft and glossy, 9–11 minutes. Cool on the sheet 5 minutes, then move to a rack. Store airtight up to 4 days; dough balls freeze well for 2 months.

steps.title: Preheat the oven
steps.details: Set oven to 375°F (190°C) with a rack in the middle. Line two baking sheets with parchment paper.

steps.title: Whisk dry ingredients
steps.details: In a medium bowl, whisk flour, baking soda and salt together until evenly combined.

steps.title: Cream butter and sugars
steps.details: Beat softened butter with granulated and brown sugar until light and fluffy, about 2 minutes with a mixer or 4 minutes by hand.

steps.title: Beat in egg and vanilla
steps.details: Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each, then beat in vanilla and scrape the bowl.

steps.title: Mix in flour and chips
steps.details: Add the dry ingredients on low speed and mix just until no flour streaks remain, then stir in the chocolate chips. Do not overmix.

steps.title: Scoop dough onto sheets
steps.details: Drop rounded tablespoons of dough 2 inches apart on the lined sheets, about 12 per sheet.

steps.title: Bake first batch
steps.details: Bake one sheet at a time 9–11 minutes, until edges are golden and centers still look slightly soft. Rotate the sheet halfway through if your oven bakes unevenly.

steps.title: Cool and bake second batch
steps.details: Let cookies rest on the hot sheet 5 minutes, then transfer to a rack. Bake the second sheet the same way while the first cools.

recipe.title: Fudgy Brownie Bites
recipe.intro: Heat oven to 350°F (175°C). Line a 24-cup mini muffin pan with paper liners (or grease wells well). Gather a medium saucepan, whisk, spatula, and small scoop.
recipe.finish: Cool bites 10 minutes in the pan, then lift out. Centers should be moist and fudgy but not raw; a toothpick inserted at the edge should come out with a few crumbs. Serve slightly warm or at room temperature for easy popping.

steps.title: Preheat and line pan
steps.details: Heat oven to 350°F (175°C). Line a 24-cup mini muffin pan with paper liners or lightly grease each well.

steps.title: Melt butter and chocolate
steps.details: In a medium saucepan over low heat, stir butter and chopped chocolate until just melted and smooth, about 4 minutes. Remove from heat.

steps.title: Whisk in sugar and eggs
steps.details: Whisk sugar into the warm chocolate mixture, then whisk in eggs one at a time and the vanilla until glossy and combined.

steps.title: Fold in dry ingredients
steps.details: Add flour, cocoa powder, and salt; fold gently with a spatula just until no dry streaks remain. Do not overmix.

steps.title: Fill muffin wells
steps.details: Divide batter among the 24 wells, filling each about three-quarters full. A small scoop or two spoons helps keep portions even.

steps.title: Add chip topping
steps.details: Sprinkle mini chocolate chips evenly over the tops of the filled wells, if using.

steps.title: Bake brownie bites
steps.details: Bake at 350°F (175°C) until tops are set and a toothpick inserted near the center comes out with a few moist crumbs, 12–15 minutes. Do not overbake.

steps.title: Cool and remove
steps.details: Let bites cool in the pan 10 minutes, then lift them out and cool on a rack. Serve warm or at room temperature.

recipe.title: Craft Soda Selection
recipe.intro: Chill all sodas thoroughly before the party. Have an ice bucket, a bottle opener, and 8–10 glasses ready. This is a no-cook drink station: the only timing is chilling, arranging, and keeping everything cold during the marathon.
recipe.finish: Sodas are ready when icy cold (about 38–40°F / 3–4°C). Pour over fresh ice, refill the ice bucket as it melts, and keep unopened bottles on ice so the selection stays cold and bubbly throughout the movies.

ingredients.name: craft fruit soda (cherry, grapefruit, or berry)
bagged ice
ingredients.prep: divide: half for bucket, half for glasses

steps.title: Chill the sodas
steps.details: Place all unopened bottles in the refrigerator for at least 3 hours, or in a cooler with ice for 2 hours. They should feel ice-cold to the touch before serving.

steps.title: Set up the drink station
steps.details: While sodas chill, fill a large bucket or cooler with half the ice. Nestle bottles upright in the ice and add a little cold water so the ice surrounds them.

steps.title: Prep garnishes
steps.details: Cut the citrus into 8–12 wedges and rinse the mint. Arrange wedges and mint on a small plate next to the glasses.

steps.title: Arrange glassware and ice
steps.details: Set out 8–10 clean glasses and a bowl or scoop with the remaining ice. Keep a small towel nearby for condensation.

steps.title: Display the soda selection
steps.details: Once bottles are cold, stand one of each flavor upright in the ice bucket with labels facing out so guests can choose. Keep extra bottles chilling in the refrigerator.

steps.title: Serve and refresh
steps.details: Fill glasses with ice, pour the chosen soda, and garnish with citrus or mint if desired. Replenish ice and swap in cold bottles as the selection empties.

recipe.title: Roasted Tomato and Garlic Bruschetta
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 425°F with racks in the upper and lower thirds. Have a rimmed baking sheet, a serrated knife, and a small bowl ready. The tomatoes roast while you slice and toast the baguette.
recipe.finish: Tomatoes should be soft, shriveled at the edges, and sweet; garlic should be tender and lightly golden. Pile the warm tomato mixture onto the toasts, spoon over any pan juices, and top with torn basil and a little Parmesan if using. Serve within 20 minutes while the bread is still crisp.

ingredients.name: French baguette
ingredients.prep: sliced 1/2 inch thick on the bias

steps.title: Preheat oven
steps.details: Set oven to 425°F with racks in the upper and lower thirds. Let it heat fully, about 15 minutes.

steps.title: Toss and roast tomatoes
steps.details: On a rimmed baking sheet, toss halved tomatoes and whole garlic cloves with 2 tablespoons olive oil, 1/2 teaspoon salt, and 1/4 teaspoon pepper. Spread in a single layer. Roast on the upper rack, stirring once halfway, until tomatoes are collapsed, shriveled at the edges, and juicy, 25 to 30 minutes.

steps.title: Slice baguette
steps.details: While tomatoes roast, cut the baguette into 1/2-inch slices on the bias, about 18 slices. Arrange on a second baking sheet in a single layer.

steps.title: Brush bread with oil
steps.details: Brush both sides of each baguette slice lightly with the remaining 2 tablespoons olive oil.

steps.title: Toast baguette slices
steps.details: Bake the bread on the lower rack until crisp and lightly golden at the edges, 8 to 10 minutes, turning once. Watch closely near the end so the thin slices do not scorch.

steps.title: Chop basil and finish tomatoes
steps.details: Tear or slice the basil and grate the Parmesan while the bread toasts. When the tomatoes are done, taste the pan juices and add a pinch more salt if needed.

steps.title: Assemble bruschetta
steps.details: Spoon the warm tomatoes and garlic, plus some pan juices, onto the toasted baguette slices. Scatter with basil and, if using, Parmesan. Serve right away.

recipe.title: Herb-Roasted Chicken with Lemon
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C) with a rack in the lower third. Have ready a roasting pan with a rack, paper towels, kitchen twine, and an instant-read thermometer. Let the chicken sit at room temperature while the oven heats and while you prepare the herb butter and lemon.
recipe.finish: Let the chicken rest 15 minutes before carving so juices redistribute; the internal temperature should read at least 165°F (74°C) in the thickest part of the thigh without touching bone, and juices should run clear. Carve and serve with the pan juices spooned over, with extra lemon wedges on the side.

ingredients.name: whole roasting chicken
ingredients.prep: remove giblets and neck, pat very dry inside and out

ingredients.name: fresh thyme leaves
ingredients.prep: chopped, plus a few sprigs for the cavity

steps.title: Heat oven and dry chicken
steps.details: Set oven to 425°F (220°C) and let the chicken sit in its dry roasting pan at room temperature while the oven heats. Pat the skin dry again just before seasoning for crisper skin.

steps.title: Make lemon-herb butter
steps.details: Mash the softened butter with the thyme, rosemary, minced garlic, lemon zest, 1 1/2 tsp salt, and pepper until evenly combined.

steps.title: Season under the skin
steps.details: Starting at the neck, loosen the skin over the breast with your fingers without tearing it. Spread about two-thirds of the herb butter under the skin, smoothing it over the breast and thighs; rub the rest over the outside of the chicken.

steps.title: Stuff and truss
steps.details: Put the lemon wedges and smashed garlic clove in the cavity with a few thyme sprigs. Tie the legs together with kitchen twine and tuck the wing tips under the body. Scatter onion rings in the pan and pour in 1/2 cup broth.

steps.title: Roast the chicken
steps.details: Roast breast-side up at 425°F for 30 minutes, then lower to 375°F (190°C). Continue roasting until an instant-read thermometer in the thickest thigh reads at least 165°F (74°C) and the skin is deep golden, about 50 to 70 more minutes; check at 50 minutes and add the remaining 1/2 cup broth if the pan looks dry.

steps.title: Rest before carving
steps.details: Move the chicken to a warm platter, tent loosely with foil, and rest 15 minutes. Skim fat from the pan juices and spoon the juices over the carved chicken.

recipe.title: Creamy Parmesan Risotto
recipe.intro: Warm the stock in a saucepan and keep it barely simmering. Use a wide, heavy 4- to 5-quart pot for the rice. Grate the Parmesan finely so it melts smoothly. Have everything chopped and measured before you start stirring.
recipe.finish: The risotto is done when the rice is tender with a slight bite and the mixture flows slowly like lava when you shake the pot. Stir in the final butter and cheese off the heat, taste, and season. Serve right away in warm bowls alongside roast chicken.

steps.title: Warm the broth
steps.details: Bring the broth to a bare simmer in a saucepan over medium-low heat, then keep hot with a ladle nearby.

steps.title: Sweat the onion
steps.details: Melt 1 tbsp of the butter with the olive oil in a wide heavy pot over medium heat. Add the onion and cook, stirring, until soft and translucent but not browned, about 5 minutes.

steps.title: Toast the rice
steps.details: Add the arborio rice and stir for 2 minutes until the grains are glossy and smell lightly toasted.

steps.title: Add the wine
steps.details: Pour in the wine and stir constantly until nearly all of it has been absorbed, about 2 minutes.

steps.title: Simmer with broth
steps.details: Add hot broth one ladleful at a time, stirring often and waiting until each addition is mostly absorbed before adding more. Continue until the rice is tender with a slight bite, 18 to 22 minutes total.

steps.title: Finish with butter and cheese
steps.details: Take the pot off the heat and stir in the remaining 1 tbsp butter and all the Parmesan until creamy and smooth. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

recipe.title: Garlic Green Beans with Almonds
recipe.intro: Use a large skillet or wok so the beans stay crisp. Bring a large pot of water to a boil and have a bowl of ice water ready before you start. Toast the almonds while the water heats.
recipe.finish: The beans should be bright green and crisp-tender, the garlic fragrant but not browned, and the almonds golden. Serve warm as a side.

steps.title: Toast the almonds
steps.details: Put the sliced almonds in a dry large skillet over medium heat. Stir often until golden and fragrant, 4 to 6 minutes. Transfer to a plate to cool.

steps.title: Boil water and blanch beans
steps.details: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and add 1 tbsp salt. Add the green beans and cook until bright green and crisp-tender, 3 to 4 minutes. Do not overcook.

steps.title: Shock beans in ice water
steps.details: While the beans boil, fill a large bowl with ice water. Drain the beans and plunge them into the ice water for 2 minutes to stop cooking, then drain well and pat dry.

steps.title: Heat oil and sauté garlic
steps.details: Wipe the skillet dry if needed. Heat the olive oil in the skillet over medium heat. Add the sliced garlic and cook, stirring, until fragrant and pale gold, about 1 minute. Do not brown.

steps.title: Sauté beans and season
steps.details: Add the drained green beans, salt, and pepper to the skillet. Toss and cook over medium-high heat until heated through and lightly coated, 3 to 4 minutes.

steps.title: Finish with almonds and lemon
steps.details: Add the toasted almonds and lemon juice, toss for 30 seconds to combine, and taste for seasoning. Transfer to a serving dish and serve warm.

recipe.title: Warm Buttery Pull-Apart Dinner Rolls
recipe.intro: Get ready: soften 4 tbsp butter, warm milk to lukewarm (about 110°F), and lightly grease a 9x13-inch baking pan. A stand mixer or hand mixer helps but you can knead by hand. Have a clean towel ready for rising.
recipe.finish: Rolls are done when the tops are deep golden and the center roll reads about 190°F. Brush hot rolls with melted butter Pull them apart while warm and serve the same day.

ingredients.name: all-purpose flour, divided
ingredients.prep: measure 3 cups and reserve 1/2 cup for adjusting

ingredients.name: unsalted butter
ingredients.prep: melted, divided (3 tbsp for dough, 1 tbsp for brushing)

steps.title: Warm milk and melt butter
steps.details: Warm 1 cup milk to 105-115°F. Melt 4 tbsp butter and separate 3 tbsp for dough and 1 tbsp for brushing. If milk is too hot, let it cool before adding yeast.

steps.title: Mix yeast and dry ingredients
steps.details: In a large mixing bowl, whisk 3 cups flour with yeast, sugar, and salt. This is 3/4 of the flour; keep the rest nearby for kneading.

steps.title: Add milk, butter, egg
steps.details: Pour the warm milk and 3 tbsp melted butter into the dry ingredients, then add the beaten egg. Stir with a wooden spoon until a shaggy dough forms.

steps.title: Knead dough until smooth
steps.details: Turn dough onto a floured counter and knead 6-8 minutes, adding reserved flour a tablespoon at a time if sticky. Dough is ready when smooth, elastic, and springs back when pressed.

steps.title: First rise
steps.details: Shape dough into a ball, place in a greased bowl, cover with a clean towel, and let rise in a warm spot until doubled, about 60 minutes.

steps.title: Shape into 12 rolls
steps.details: Grease a 9x13-inch pan. Punch dough down, divide into 12 equal pieces, and roll each into a tight ball. Arrange in the pan with a little space between them.

steps.title: Second rise
steps.details: Cover pan loosely with a towel and let rolls rise until puffy and nearly touching, 30-40 minutes. Meanwhile, preheat oven to 375°F.

steps.title: Bake rolls
steps.details: Bake at 375°F for 18-22 minutes, until deep golden brown and an instant-read thermometer in the center roll reads about 190°F. If browning too fast, tent loosely with foil after 15 minutes.

steps.title: Brush with butter and serve
steps.details: Immediately brush hot rolls with the reserved 1 tbsp melted butter. Cool in the pan 5 minutes, then pull apart and serve warm.

recipe.title: Classic Caesar Salad
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 375°F. Have a large salad bowl, a small bowl for dressing, a whisk, a baking sheet, and a skillet or microwave-safe bowl for the croutons. Wash and dry romaine thoroughly so the dressing clings.
recipe.finish: Toss the chilled romaine with just enough dressing to coat, add croutons and shaved Parmesan, and serve immediately while the croutons are crisp. Extra dressing keeps 3 days in the fridge.

ingredients.name: romaine lettuce
ingredients.prep: washed, dried, torn into bite-size pieces, chilled

ingredients.name: Parmesan cheese
ingredients.prep: finely grated, plus extra shaved for serving

steps.title: Toast the croutons
steps.details: Toss bread cubes with olive oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet and bake at 375°F for 12–15 minutes, stirring once, until golden and crisp.

steps.title: Whisk Caesar dressing
steps.details: Whisk garlic, lemon juice, Dijon, and mayonnaise in a small bowl. Stir in grated Parmesan, water, salt, and pepper until smooth and pourable.

steps.title: Chill dressing and lettuce
steps.details: Refrigerate the dressing and prepared romaine while the croutons finish so the salad stays crisp.

steps.title: Cool the croutons
steps.details: Remove croutons from the oven and let them cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes; they crisp further as they cool.

steps.title: Toss and serve
steps.details: In a large bowl, toss the chilled romaine with dressing to coat lightly, then fold in croutons. Top with shaved Parmesan and serve at once.

recipe.title: Birthday Chocolate Layer Cake
recipe.intro: Get-ready: Let eggs and buttermilk sit out 20 minutes; bring butter to room temperature. You need two 9-inch round pans, parchment, an electric mixer, and a cooling rack. Position a rack in the middle and preheat oven to 350°F (175°C) while you make the batter.
recipe.finish: Cake is done when the center springs back and a toothpick comes out with a few moist crumbs, about 30–35 minutes. Cool layers in pans 10 minutes, then turn out onto a rack and cool completely before frosting for a tidy finish. Frost the cooled bottom layer, set the second layer on top, then cover the top and sides. Slice with a long knife and serve at room temperature.

ingredients.name: hot brewed coffee or boiling water

steps.title: Prep pans and dry mix
steps.details: Grease two 9-inch round pans, line bottoms with parchment, and grease the parchment. In a large bowl whisk the flour, granulated sugar, 3/4 cup cocoa, baking soda, and 1 tsp salt until evenly combined.

steps.title: Whisk wet ingredients
steps.details: In a second large bowl whisk the buttermilk, oil, eggs, and 1 tsp vanilla until smooth and uniform.

steps.title: Combine into batter
steps.details: Pour the wet mixture into the dry mixture and stir just until no dry streaks remain. Slowly stir in the hot coffee or water until the batter is smooth and thin; it will look soupy, which is correct. Divide evenly between the prepared pans.

steps.title: Bake the layers
steps.details: Bake at 350°F (175°C), switching pan positions halfway through, until the center springs back and a toothpick inserted near the center comes out with a few moist crumbs, 30–35 minutes.

steps.title: Make chocolate frosting
steps.details: While the cakes bake and cool, beat the softened butter with an electric mixer until creamy. Gradually add the powdered sugar and 1/2 cup cocoa along with the pinch of salt, then the remaining 1 tsp vanilla. Add milk 1 tbsp at a time, beating until fluffy and spreadable.

steps.title: Cool the cakes
steps.details: Cool layers in their pans on racks 10 minutes, then run a knife around the edges and turn them out onto the racks. Peel off the parchment and cool completely before frosting, about 30 minutes. Refrigerate the frosting if the cake is still warm.

steps.title: Fill and frost the cake
steps.details: Place one cooled layer on a serving plate. Spread about 3/4 cup frosting over the top, set the second layer on it, then spread the remaining frosting over the top and sides in swoops. Chill 15 minutes to set before slicing.

steps.title: Slice and serve
steps.details: Cut with a long knife dipped in hot water and wiped dry between slices. Serve at room temperature; refrigerate leftovers covered for up to 3 days.

recipe.title: Sparkling Berry Birthday Punch
recipe.intro: Make this just before the party so it stays fizzy. You need a large punch bowl or big pitcher, a ladle, and a freezer for the ice ring. Chill the cranberry juice and sparkling water in the fridge for at least 2 hours ahead.
recipe.finish: Ladle into cups and top each with a few berries. Add fresh ice right before serving and stir gently once; the punch is ready when it is cold and visibly sparkling. Keep the sparkling water chilled until the last minute so the fizz holds.

steps.title: Chill everything
steps.details: Put the cranberry juice, orange juice, simple syrup, and sparkling water in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours. They should be refrigerator-cold before mixing, which keeps the punch fizzy and refreshing.

steps.title: Prep fruit garnish
steps.details: While the drinks chill, rinse and slice the strawberries, rinse the blueberries and raspberries, and slice the orange and lemon into thin rounds. Set aside about 1 cup of the mixed berries and a few citrus slices for garnish.

steps.title: Slice citrus rounds
steps.details: Cut the orange and lemon into thin rounds, discarding any seeds. Keep the slices whole so they float prettily in the bowl.

steps.title: Build the punch base
steps.details: In the large punch bowl or pitcher, combine the chilled cranberry juice, orange juice, and simple syrup. Stir with a ladle until the syrup is fully mixed in.

steps.title: Add fruit and ice
steps.details: Add the remaining berries, citrus slices, and the ice to the punch base. Stir gently once; the mixture should be very cold and the berries should look glossy and wet.

steps.title: Slowly add sparkling water
steps.details: Pour the chilled sparkling water slowly down the side of the bowl and stir just once or twice. Stop stirring as soon as it is combined; the punch should still look bubbly. Taste and add a splash more simple syrup only if it needs it.

steps.title: Garnish and serve
steps.details: Float a few reserved berries and citrus slices on top, then ladle into cups. Add a fresh ice cube to each glass if the punch has been sitting, and serve right away while it is sparkling.

recipe.title: Vanilla Bean Ice Cream
recipe.intro: You'll need an ice cream maker (don't forget the freezer bowl, which needs 12-24 hours in the freezer), a medium saucepan, a whisk, and an instant-read thermometer. Make the custard base the day before so it can chill thoroughly; churn just before serving or up to a few hours ahead and keep it hard in the freezer.
recipe.finish: The ice cream is done when it looks like soft-serve and holds a slow ribbon off the paddle. Pack it into a chilled loaf pan, press plastic wrap onto the surface, and freeze for 2 hours for a scoopable texture. If it's been frozen solid overnight, let it sit at room temperature for 5-10 minutes before scooping. Serve one generous scoop alongside the birthday cake.

ingredients.name: vanilla bean
ingredients.prep: split lengthwise and seeds scraped (or 2 tsp vanilla extract)

ingredients.name: vanilla extract
ingredients.prep: if using a vanilla bean, stir in at the end

steps.title: Split and scrape vanilla bean
steps.details: Use a small paring knife to split the bean open lengthwise. Scrape out the sticky black seeds with the tip of the knife. Set both the seeds and the pod aside.

steps.title: Warm cream and milk
