steps.details: In a medium saucepan, combine the heavy cream, milk, the 1/2 cup sugar, salt, vanilla seeds, and the empty vanilla pod. Heat over medium, stirring occasionally, until steaming and just beginning to bubble at the edges, about 5 minutes; do not let it boil hard.

steps.title: Whisk yolks with sugar
steps.details: While the cream mixture heats, whisk the egg yolks with the remaining 1/4 cup sugar in a medium bowl until pale and slightly thickened, about 1 minute.

steps.title: Temper the egg yolks
steps.details: Slowly drizzle about 1 cup of the hot cream mixture into the yolks while whisking constantly. This warms the eggs gently so they don't scramble.

steps.title: Cook custard to 170F
steps.details: Pour the yolk mixture back into the saucepan. Cook over medium-low, stirring constantly with a spatula, until the custard thickens enough to coat the back of the spatula and reads 170°F on an instant-read thermometer, 4-6 minutes. Do not let it boil.

steps.title: Strain and chill base
steps.details: Immediately pour the custard through a fine-mesh strainer into a clean bowl and discard the vanilla pod. Stir in the vanilla extract. Chill uncovered 15 minutes, then cover and refrigerate until very cold, at least 4 hours or overnight.

steps.title: Churn the ice cream
steps.details: Pour the chilled base into the frozen ice cream maker bowl and churn according to the manufacturer's instructions until thick and soft-serve consistency, typically 20-25 minutes.

steps.title: Freeze to firm up
steps.details: Transfer to a chilled loaf pan and press a sheet of plastic wrap directly onto the surface. Freeze until scoopable, about 2 hours, before serving with the cake.

recipe.title: Mini Corn Dog Bites
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Grease 24-cup mini muffin tin well with cooking spray or butter, or line with mini paper liners. Have a cutting board and knife ready for the hot dogs.
recipe.finish: Let bites cool in the pan 5 minutes, then run a knife around edges and lift out. Serve warm with ketchup and mustard for dipping. Refrigerate leftovers up to 3 days and reheat at 350°F until hot.

ingredients.name: hot dogs
ingredients.prep: pat dry, cut into 4 pieces each

steps.title: Preheat oven and prep pan
steps.details: Heat oven to 400°F (200°C). Grease 24 mini muffin cups generously with cooking spray or butter so bites release easily.

steps.title: Cut hot dogs
steps.details: Pat hot dogs dry and cut each crosswise into 4 equal pieces, making 24 pieces total. Keep refrigerated until needed.

steps.title: Whisk dry ingredients
steps.details: In a large bowl, whisk flour, cornmeal, sugar, baking powder and salt until evenly combined.

steps.title: Whisk wet ingredients
steps.details: In a medium bowl or large measuring cup, whisk buttermilk, egg and melted butter until smooth.

steps.title: Make cornmeal batter
steps.details: Pour wet mixture into dry ingredients and stir just until no dry streaks remain; a few small lumps are fine. Do not overmix.

steps.title: Fill muffin cups
steps.details: Spoon about 1 tablespoon batter into each greased mini muffin cup, filling each about two-thirds full.

steps.title: Insert hot dog pieces
steps.details: Press one hot dog piece upright into the center of each batter-filled cup, pushing down until batter comes about halfway up the piece.

steps.title: Bake until golden
steps.details: Bake 12–15 minutes, until cornbread is golden and a toothpick inserted into the batter (not the hot dog) comes out clean. Hot dogs should be steaming hot.

steps.title: Cool and release
steps.details: Let pan cool 5 minutes, then loosen edges with a knife and lift bites out. Serve warm with ketchup and mustard.

recipe.title: Rainbow Fruit Skewers
recipe.intro: No cooking needed—just wash, cut, and thread. Use wooden skewers (soak briefly if you like), a cutting board, a knife, and a melon baller or small spoon. Make these close to party time and keep them chilled until serving.
recipe.finish: Serve chilled within 2 hours of assembly, or keep refrigerated up to 8 hours. Skewers are done when every piece is bite-size, fruit is dry to the touch, and points are facing away from little hands.

ingredients.name: wooden skewers
ingredients.prep: soak in water 10 minutes if desired, then pat dry

ingredients.name: red or green grapes
ingredients.prep: rinsed and patted dry, removed from stems

ingredients.name: cantaloupe
ingredients.prep: seeds and rind removed, cut into 3/4-inch chunks

ingredients.name: honeydew melon
ingredients.prep: seeds and rind removed, cut into 3/4-inch chunks

steps.title: Wash and dry fruit
steps.details: Rinse strawberries, grapes, and melons under cool running water. Pat everything completely dry with paper towels so the fruit doesn't slide on the skewers.

steps.title: Cut melon and pineapple
steps.details: Peel, deseed, and cut pineapple, cantaloupe, and honeydew into bite-size 3/4-inch chunks. Keep piles separate by color.

steps.title: Soak skewers
steps.details: While cutting fruit, set wooden skewers in a shallow dish of water so they don't splinter. Pat dry just before threading.

steps.title: Assemble color pattern
steps.details: Thread each skewer in a rainbow order: strawberry, grape, pineapple, cantaloupe, honeydew, then repeat or finish with a grape. Leave a small handle at the blunt end and keep pieces snug but not crushed.

steps.title: Chill until serving
steps.details: Arrange skewers on a tray, cover loosely, and refrigerate until party time. Serve cold; discard any skewers left out over 2 hours.

recipe.title: Cheesy Mini Pizzas
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or foil. Have kids help assemble after setup.
recipe.finish: Let cool 2 minutes before serving. Cheese should be melted and bubbly, edges toasted.

ingredients.name: mini pepperoni or sliced black olives

steps.title: Preheat oven
steps.details: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C).

steps.title: Split muffins
steps.details: Split each English muffin in half with a fork or knife. Place halves cut-side up on a baking sheet.

steps.title: Spread sauce and add toppings
steps.details: Spread about 1 tablespoon sauce on each muffin half. Sprinkle with cheese and add optional toppings.

steps.title: Bake until melted
steps.details: Bake for 10–12 minutes, until cheese is melted and bubbly and edges are lightly toasted.

steps.title: Cool and serve
steps.details: Let cool 2 minutes before serving.

recipe.title: Oven-Baked Chicken Tenders
recipe.intro: Heat oven to 425°F with a rack in the upper-middle position. Line a large rimmed baking sheet with parchment or foil and set a wire rack on it if you have one (crispier bottoms); otherwise grease the parchment lightly. Set out three shallow dishes and a pair of tongs. Keep raw chicken separate from ready-to-eat items and wash hands after handling.
recipe.finish: Tenders are done when the coating is deep golden and an instant-read thermometer in the thickest part reads 165°F, about 16–20 minutes. Let rest 2 minutes, then serve warm with ketchup, ranch, or honey mustard. For a party, hold on a tray in a 200°F oven up to 20 minutes; re-crisp at 425°F for 3 minutes if needed.

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breast tenders
ingredients.prep: pat very dry; cut larger pieces to about 1 inch thick

ingredients.name: eggs
ingredients.prep: beat with 1 tbsp water in second shallow dish

ingredients.name: plain dry breadcrumbs
ingredients.prep: combine with 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp pepper, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp paprika in third dish

steps.title: Heat oven and set up
steps.details: Heat oven to 425°F. Line a large rimmed baking sheet with parchment (add a wire rack if you have one). Set the flour, beaten egg, and breadcrumb-Parmesan mixture in three shallow dishes.

steps.title: Dry and trim chicken
steps.details: While the oven heats, pat the tenders very dry with paper towels and trim any tough white tendons. Cut any thick pieces to about 1 inch thick so they cook evenly.

steps.title: Coat in flour
steps.details: Working in batches, dredge each tender in flour, shaking off the excess so the coating is thin and even. Place coated pieces on a clean plate.

steps.title: Dip in egg
steps.details: Dip each floured tender in the beaten egg, letting the excess drip back into the dish. Keep one hand for dry steps and one for wet if possible.

steps.title: Press into crumbs
steps.details: Lay each egg-coated tender in the breadcrumb mixture and press crumbs firmly onto all sides. Set on the prepared baking sheet, spacing pieces at least 1/2 inch apart; do not crowd.

steps.title: Drizzle and bake
steps.details: Lightly drizzle or brush the tops with olive oil. Bake at 425°F until deep golden and an instant-read thermometer in the thickest part reads 165°F, 16–20 minutes.

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.details: Rest tenders 2 minutes on the pan, then transfer to a serving platter. Serve warm with ketchup or ranch for dipping.

recipe.title: Mac and Cheese Cups
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C) and grease a 12-cup standard muffin tin well, including the rims. Boil water in a large pot. Have a colander, a whisk, and a large bowl ready. These cups are best served warm; bake in batches if your tin is small.
recipe.finish: Let the cups rest in the tin 5 minutes, then run a thin knife around each and lift out. They should be golden on top and hold together when nudged. Serve warm; cups firm up as they cool. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and reheat to steaming hot.

steps.title: Preheat oven and prep
steps.details: Heat oven to 375°F (190°C). Generously grease a 12-cup muffin tin, including the top rims. Measure ingredients while the oven heats.

steps.title: Boil pasta
steps.details: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add macaroni and cook 1 minute less than package directions, until just tender but still firm. Do not overcook.

steps.title: Drain and reserve
steps.details: Drain pasta in a colander, rinse briefly with cool water to stop cooking, and drain well. Leave it in the colander.

steps.title: Make cheese sauce
steps.details: In the same pot over medium heat, melt 2 tbsp butter. Whisk in flour and cook 1 minute. Add milk gradually, whisking, and cook 3–4 minutes until bubbling and thickened. It should coat a spoon.

steps.title: Melt in cheese
steps.details: Reduce heat to low. Stir in cheddar, salt, and pepper until cheese melts and sauce is smooth. Remove from heat. Taste and adjust salt if needed.

steps.title: Combine pasta and sauce
steps.details: Fold the drained pasta into the cheese sauce until evenly coated. The mixture should be thick and creamy, not runny.

steps.title: Make crumb topping
steps.details: In a small bowl, stir panko, Parmesan, and 1 tbsp melted butter until evenly moistened.

steps.title: Fill muffin cups
steps.details: Spoon mac and cheese firmly into each greased cup, mounding slightly and pressing gently so cups hold shape. Sprinkle crumb topping over each.

steps.title: Bake until set
steps.details: Bake 18–22 minutes until tops are golden and cups are set. Centers should not look wet. Ovens vary, so check at 18 minutes.

recipe.title: Buttered Corn on the Cob
recipe.intro: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Have a slotted spoon or tongs and a plate ready. Cut cobs in half so they are kid-sized.
recipe.finish: Corn is done when kernels are bright yellow and tender, about 3–4 minutes after the water returns to a boil. Drain, brush generously with butter, sprinkle lightly with salt, and serve warm.

ingredients.name: fresh corn on the cob, husked

steps.title: Boil the water
steps.details: Fill a large pot with 4 quarts water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat.

steps.title: Husk and halve corn
steps.details: While the water heats, husk the corn and remove silk. Cut each ear in half crosswise; keep cobs whole and ready.

steps.title: Melt the butter
steps.details: Melt 3 tablespoons butter in a small saucepan or microwave-safe bowl until liquid; set aside.

steps.title: Cook the corn
steps.details: Add corn halves to boiling water. Once water returns to a boil, cook 3–4 minutes until kernels are bright and tender. Do not overcook.

steps.title: Drain the corn
steps.details: Drain well using tongs or a slotted spoon and transfer to a serving plate.

steps.title: Butter and salt
steps.details: Brush each piece with melted butter and sprinkle with salt to taste. Serve warm.

recipe.title: Soft Garlic Breadsticks
recipe.intro: Perfect for a kids' birthday party: pillowy, buttery, and easy to hold. You'll need a large bowl, a sturdy spoon, a lightly floured counter, a rolling pin, a knife or bench scraper, and 2 baking sheets. Let butter and milk come to room temperature before starting.
recipe.finish: Breadsticks are done when golden brown on top and the internal center reads 200°F (93°C) on an instant-read thermometer. Brush with the remaining garlic butter while hot, then cool 5 minutes on the pan so they firm up slightly. Serve warm with marinara or pizza sauce for dunking.

ingredients.name: unsalted butter, softened
ingredients.prep: divided: 2 tablespoons for dough, 2 tablespoons for garlic butter

steps.title: Proof the yeast
steps.details: Whisk warm milk, yeast, and sugar in a large bowl. Let sit 8 minutes until foamy on top; if it doesn't foam, the milk was too hot or the yeast is dead, so start again with fresh yeast.

steps.title: Make the dough
steps.details: Stir 2 tablespoons softened butter and the salt into the yeast mixture. Add 3 cups flour and mix until a shaggy dough forms.

steps.title: Knead until smooth
steps.details: Turn dough onto a floured counter and knead 6 minutes, adding flour 1 tablespoon at a time if sticky, until smooth and slightly tacky but not sticking to your hands.

steps.title: Let dough rise
steps.details: Lightly oil the bowl, return dough, cover with a clean towel, and let rise in a warm spot 45 minutes until doubled in size.

steps.title: Heat oven and make garlic butter
steps.details: Heat oven to 375°F with racks in the upper and lower thirds. Melt the remaining 2 tablespoons butter and stir in the minced garlic and parsley; set aside off the heat.

steps.title: Shape the breadsticks
steps.details: Punch down dough and divide into 16 equal pieces. Roll each piece into a 7-inch rope and place on two parchment-lined baking sheets, spacing 2 inches apart.

steps.title: Second rise
steps.details: Cover the pans loosely with towels and let rise 20 minutes until puffy and nearly doubled.

steps.title: Bake the breadsticks
steps.details: Bake 14 to 16 minutes, rotating pans halfway through, until golden brown and the center of a breadstick reads 200°F. If baking one pan at a time, add 2 minutes.

steps.title: Brush with garlic butter
steps.details: Immediately brush hot breadsticks with the garlic butter. Let cool 5 minutes on the pan, then transfer to a basket.

steps.title: Warm the dipping sauce
steps.details: While breadsticks cool, warm marinara or pizza sauce in a small saucepan over low heat or in the microwave, then pour into small cups for dunking.

recipe.title: Birthday Cake with Buttercream Frosting
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and flour two 9-inch round cake pans and line bottoms with parchment. Let butter and eggs sit at room temperature; gather a stand or hand mixer, two mixing bowls, and a cooling rack.
recipe.finish: Cake is done when a toothpick in the center comes out clean and the top springs back, 28–32 minutes. Cool layers in pans 10 minutes, then turn out onto a rack to cool completely before frosting. Frost the cooled cake, decorate with sprinkles, then serve at room temperature.

steps.title: Preheat and prep pans
steps.details: Heat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and flour two 9-inch round pans and line the bottoms with parchment.

steps.title: Whisk dry ingredients
steps.details: In a medium bowl whisk together the flour, baking powder, and salt until evenly combined.

steps.title: Cream butter and sugar
steps.details: In a large bowl beat the softened butter and granulated sugar with a mixer on medium-high until pale and fluffy, about 3 minutes.

steps.title: Beat in eggs and vanilla
steps.details: Beat in the eggs one at a time, scraping the bowl after each addition, then add 1 1/2 tsp vanilla. The mixture should look smooth.

steps.title: Fold in flour and milk
steps.details: On low speed, alternately add the dry mix in three additions and the milk in two additions, starting and ending with the flour. Mix just until no flour streaks remain; do not overbeat.

steps.title: Divide and bake
steps.details: Divide the batter evenly between the two pans, smoothing the tops. Bake at 350°F until a toothpick in the center comes out clean and the tops spring back, 28–32 minutes.

steps.title: Cool the cakes
steps.details: Cool layers in the pans 10 minutes, then turn out onto a wire rack, remove parchment, and cool completely before frosting.

steps.title: Beat buttercream base
steps.details: In a large bowl beat the softened frosting butter with a mixer until smooth and creamy, about 2 minutes.

steps.title: Add sugar and milk
steps.details: Gradually beat in the sifted powdered sugar on low speed, alternating with 3–4 tbsp milk and the remaining 1/2 tsp vanilla, until smooth and spreadable.

steps.title: Tint frosting
steps.details: Divide frosting into bowls and tint each with food coloring gel until vibrant, then stir each bowl to blend evenly.

steps.title: Frost the cake
steps.details: Place one cooled layer on a plate, spread about 3/4 cup frosting on top, add the second layer, then cover the top and sides with remaining frosting.

steps.title: Decorate with sprinkles
steps.details: Add colored swirls with the tinted frosting if using, then scatter sprinkles over the top and sides.

recipe.title: Chewy Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipe.intro: Let butter and egg come to room temperature. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C) with a rack in the middle. Line two baking sheets with parchment. You will bake in batches, reusing cooled sheets.
recipe.finish: Cookies are done when edges are golden and centers look slightly underdone and soft. Cool 5 minutes on the sheet, then transfer to a rack. Store airtight up to 3 days; dough balls can be refrigerated and baked later.

steps.title: Heat oven and line pans
steps.details: Heat oven to 350°F (175°C) and line two baking sheets with parchment.

steps.title: Whisk dry ingredients
steps.details: Whisk flour, baking soda and salt together in a medium bowl; set aside.

steps.title: Cream butter and sugars
steps.details: Beat softened butter, brown sugar and granulated sugar with a mixer or sturdy spoon until light and fluffy, about 2–3 minutes.

steps.title: Add egg and vanilla
steps.details: Beat in the egg and vanilla until smooth and fully combined.

steps.title: Fold in flour and chips
steps.details: Stir in the flour mixture just until no dry streaks remain, then fold in the chocolate chips. Do not overmix.

steps.title: Scoop dough balls
steps.details: Scoop rounded 1 1/2-tablespoon balls (about 24) onto the lined sheets, spacing 2 inches apart. Use one sheet now and chill the rest on the second sheet.

steps.title: Bake first batch
steps.details: Bake one sheet at a time, 10–12 minutes, until edges are golden and centers look slightly underdone. Rotate the pan halfway through.

steps.title: Cool and switch batches
steps.details: Cool cookies on the sheet 5 minutes, then move to a rack. Let the sheet cool, load the next dough balls and bake the remaining batches the same way.

recipe.title: Festive Fruit Punch
recipe.intro: Chill all liquids in the fridge at least 4 hours before the party. You need a large 1-gallon punch bowl or pitcher, a long spoon, and a knife for the fruit. Keep the soda cold until the last minute so it stays fizzy.
recipe.finish: The punch is ready when the fruit slices are floating and the drink is well chilled and fizzy. Ladle into cups over ice right away; add more cold soda or ice if it sits out. Leftovers keep covered in the fridge up to 24 hours, though fizz fades.

steps.title: Chill all liquids
steps.details: Put orange juice, pineapple juice, cranberry juice cocktail, lemon juice, water, and lemon-lime soda in the fridge for at least 4 hours, or overnight. Do not open the soda.

steps.title: Slice the fruit
steps.details: Slice the orange and lemon into thin rounds and cut strawberries in half. Remove any seeds and thick white pith. Set fruit aside on a plate.

steps.title: Combine the juices
steps.details: In the punch bowl or pitcher, stir together the chilled orange juice, pineapple juice, cranberry juice cocktail, lemon juice, and cold water until evenly blended.

steps.title: Add the fruit
steps.details: Float the orange slices, lemon slices, and strawberry halves in the juice mixture. Gently press some fruit against the side of the bowl so it shows through.

steps.title: Add bowl ice
steps.details: Add the 3 cups of ice for the punch bowl. Stir gently for a few seconds to start chilling the punch.

steps.title: Pour in the soda
steps.details: Just before serving, slowly pour the cold lemon-lime soda down the side of the bowl and stir once or twice very gently. Stop stirring as soon as it is combined so the fizz stays.

steps.title: Serve over ice
steps.details: Fill cups with the 1 cup of serving ice, ladle the punch over it, and spoon a little fruit into each cup. Serve immediately.

recipe.title: Slow-Cooker Shredded Beef Sliders
recipe.intro: Chuck roast slow-cooked until shreddable, then piled on soft slider buns. You need a 5–7 qt slow cooker and a fork or two for shredding. No preheat needed; start the beef early in the day so it holds warm for the open house.
recipe.finish: Beef is done when it shreds with almost no resistance and reaches at least 200°F (93°C); if still tough, cook up to 1 hour more. Keep beef warm on the Keep Warm setting and set out buns, cheese, and pickles just before serving so buns stay soft.

ingredients.name: beef chuck roast
ingredients.prep: trim large fat caps, cut into 3-inch chunks

steps.title: Season the beef
steps.details: Pat the chuck chunks dry, then sprinkle all over with the salt and pepper.

steps.title: Brown the beef
steps.details: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high. Brown the beef in two batches, about 4 minutes per side, until a deep crust forms; transfer to the slow cooker.

steps.title: Soften onion and garlic
steps.details: Lower heat to medium and cook the onion in the same skillet for 4 minutes, then add the garlic for 1 minute until fragrant. Scrape into the slow cooker.

steps.title: Add braising liquid
steps.details: Pour the broth into the hot skillet and stir in the tomato paste, Worcestershire, and oregano, scraping up browned bits. Pour over the beef.

steps.title: Slow-cook the beef
steps.details: Cover and cook on Low for 8 hours or on High for 5 hours, until the beef shreds easily with a fork and reaches at least 200°F (93°C).

steps.title: Shred and season
steps.details: Transfer the beef to a bowl and shred with two forks, discarding large fat pieces. Skim excess fat from the cooker liquid, then return the beef to the liquid and toss; taste and add salt if needed.

steps.title: Warm and fill buns
steps.details: Keep the beef on Keep Warm. Split the slider buns, add a half-slice of cheddar if using, and top each with about 1/4 cup hot shredded beef and a pickle slice.

recipe.title: Lemon Herb Grilled Chicken Skewers
recipe.intro: Soak 16 bamboo skewers in water 30 minutes if using bamboo. Use 2 large rimmed trays or a platter for raw and grilled skewers. Marinate chicken 30–60 minutes while soaking skewers and prepping. Preheat a gas grill to medium-high (about 400–450°F) or light a charcoal chimney; oil the hot grates just before grilling.
recipe.finish: Chicken is ready when the thickest piece reaches 165°F on an instant-read thermometer and juices run clear, with light char marks. Rest skewers 5 minutes, then arrange on a platter keeping cooked skewers warm or at room temperature; they hold well for arriving guests. Grill in batches as needed so the grill is never crowded.

ingredients.name: boneless skinless chicken breasts or thighs

steps.title: Soak skewers
steps.details: Put the 16 bamboo skewers in a long dish of water so they are fully submerged; let soak for 30 minutes while you make the marinade and cut chicken.

steps.title: Mix the marinade
steps.details: In a large bowl, whisk 2 tablespoons olive oil, lemon zest, all lemon juice, garlic, oregano, thyme, 1 teaspoon salt, and 1/2 teaspoon pepper. Reserve 1 tablespoon of the mixture in a small cup if you want a last-minute drizzle.

steps.title: Marinate the chicken
steps.details: Add chicken chunks to the bowl and toss until evenly coated. Cover and refrigerate 30–60 minutes; do not marinate longer than 1 hour or the lemon can make the texture spongy.

steps.title: Preheat the grill
steps.details: Preheat a gas grill to medium-high, about 400–450°F, or light a full chimney of charcoal. Aim for 10–15 minutes of heating so the grates are hot when you are ready to cook.

steps.title: Skewer the chicken
steps.details: Thread chicken chunks onto the soaked skewers, leaving a small gap at each end and not packing pieces too tightly. Put finished raw skewers on a tray and lightly brush with the remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil.

steps.title: Oil the hot grates
steps.details: Fold a paper towel into a pad, hold it with tongs, dip in a little oil, and wipe the hot grill grates. This helps keep the skewers from sticking.

steps.title: Grill the first batch
steps.details: Place skewers on the hot grill with space between them. Grill 5 minutes, then turn and grill 5–7 minutes more, until browned and the thickest chicken piece reaches 165°F. Brush with any reserved marinade only during the last 2 minutes of grilling.

steps.title: Grill remaining skewers
steps.details: Move finished skewers to a clean tray and repeat grilling the remaining skewers in uncrowded batches, about 10–12 minutes per batch depending on your grill. Check each batch reaches 165°F; do not reuse the raw chicken tray.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.details: Let skewers rest 5 minutes, then shower with chopped parsley and serve with lemon wedges. Skewers hold well at room temperature for up to 1 hour, making them easy to set out as guests arrive; serve extra lemon wedges on the platter.

recipe.title: Baked Macaroni and Cheese Bites
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Grease a 24-cup nonstick mini muffin tin well with cooking spray or butter. Have a large pot, colander, and a mixing bowl ready. These bake in batches-friendly single-tin amounts; double the recipe for a bigger crowd.
recipe.finish: Bites are done when the tops are golden and set and a skewer inserted in the center comes out clean, about 18–22 minutes. Cool in the tin 5 minutes, then run a thin knife around each and lift out. Serve warm; they hold at room temperature for about 1 hour. Refrigerate leftovers up to 3 days and reheat at 350°F until hot.

steps.title: Boil the macaroni
steps.details: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the macaroni 1 minute less than the package's al dente time (about 5–6 minutes for elbow macaroni) so it stays firm. Drain well and return to the pot off the heat to steam dry for 1 minute.

steps.title: Grease the muffin tin
steps.details: While the water heats and pasta cooks, coat all 24 cups of a nonstick mini muffin tin thoroughly with cooking spray or softened butter.

steps.title: Make the cheese binder
steps.details: In a large bowl, whisk the egg, milk, melted butter, flour, salt, garlic powder, and pepper until smooth with no flour lumps.

steps.title: Stir in the cheeses
steps.details: Reserve 2 tablespoons cheddar and 1 tablespoon Parmesan for topping. Stir the remaining cheddar and Parmesan into the egg mixture.

steps.title: Combine pasta and sauce
steps.details: Add the drained hot macaroni to the cheese mixture and stir until every piece is coated. The mixture should be moist and scoopable, not soupy.

steps.title: Fill the muffin cups
steps.details: Spoon about 1 tablespoon of the mixture into each greased cup, pressing gently so it holds together and comes just to the top of each cup.

steps.title: Add the reserved cheese
steps.details: Sprinkle the reserved cheddar and Parmesan evenly over the tops of the bites.

steps.title: Bake until golden
steps.details: Bake at 400°F (200°C) until the tops are golden and the centers are set, 18–22 minutes. A skewer inserted in the center should come out clean.

steps.title: Cool and release
steps.details: Let the tin sit on a rack 5 minutes. Run a thin knife around each bite and lift out. Serve warm.

recipe.title: Veggie and Dip Cups
recipe.intro: Use 24 clear 9-oz plastic cups. No cooking needed—just wash, cut, and assemble. Make these within 2 hours of serving and keep them chilled until the table is set.
recipe.finish: Serve cold as a grab-and-go appetizer. Cups hold best if assembled within about 2 hours of serving; if made earlier, keep covered and refrigerated. Discard any cups that sat out over 2 hours.

steps.title: Set up cups and dip
steps.details: Line up the 24 clear cups. Spoon about 1 rounded tablespoon (about 1½ teaspoons if using a narrow cup) of ranch dressing into the bottom of each cup. Keep the rest of the dressing chilled.

steps.title: Prep the vegetables
steps.details: Wash and cut the carrots, celery, cucumber, bell pepper, and broccoli into firm 3-inch sticks or small florets; leave cherry tomatoes whole. Pat everything dry so the dip stays neat.

steps.title: Fill the cups
steps.details: Stand 4–6 vegetable pieces upright in each cup, packing them snugly with the dip at the bottom. Mix and match colors; keep the tallest pieces around the edge so the cup looks full.

steps.title: Chill until serving
steps.details: Arrange cups on a tray, cover loosely with plastic wrap, and refrigerate until serving—at least 15 minutes and up to 2 hours. This keeps the vegetables crisp and the dip cold.

recipe.title: Classic Creamy Coleslaw
recipe.intro: For this classic side, use a sharp knife or box grater to shred the cabbage and carrots (or buy pre-shredded coleslaw mix to save time). No special equipment needed. This recipe is best served fresh but can be made a few hours ahead.
recipe.finish: Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper. For best texture, serve within 2 hours of mixing. Store leftovers covered in the refrigerator for up to 2 days.

steps.title: Shred cabbage and carrot
steps.details: Using a sharp knife or a box grater, finely shred the cabbage and carrot. Place them in a large bowl.

steps.title: Make dressing
steps.details: In a small bowl, whisk together mayonnaise, vinegar, sugar, mustard, celery seed (if using), salt, and pepper until smooth.

steps.title: Toss and chill
steps.details: Pour the dressing over the cabbage and carrot. Toss well to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to let flavors meld.

recipe.title: Summer Corn and Tomato Salad
recipe.intro: Bright, fresh side for a graduation open house. Use a large pot for blanching and a big serving bowl. No special equipment needed. If serving a crowd, make it up to 2 hours ahead and keep chilled.
recipe.finish: Taste and adjust salt and pepper. Serve chilled or at cool room temperature. Keeps in the refrigerator for up to 2 days; stir before serving.

ingredients.name: granulated sugar (optional)
ingredients.prep: measured, if corn is not very sweet

steps.title: Boil water and blanch corn
steps.details: Bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil. Add the husked corn and cook 3 to 4 minutes, until kernels are bright yellow and tender; do not overcook. Transfer corn to a plate to cool slightly.

steps.title: Chop tomatoes and onion
steps.details: While the water heats, halve the cherry tomatoes and finely dice the red onion. Put both in a large serving bowl.

steps.title: Slice herbs and make dressing
steps.details: Thinly slice basil and chop cilantro or parsley. Whisk olive oil, lime juice, salt, pepper and optional sugar in a small bowl until combined.

steps.title: Cut corn off cobs
steps.details: When corn is cool enough to handle, stand each cob upright in a wide bowl and cut kernels off close to the cob. You should have about 4 cups of kernels.

steps.title: Toss salad together
steps.details: Add the corn kernels and dressing to the bowl with the tomatoes and onion. Toss gently until evenly coated.

steps.title: Fold in herbs and chill
steps.details: Gently fold in the basil and cilantro. Refrigerate at least 15 minutes before serving to let flavors meld.

recipe.title: Soft Dinner Rolls with Honey Butter
recipe.intro: Warm, pull-apart rolls with whipped honey butter — great for sandwich building or snacking at a graduation open house. Use a stand mixer or mix by hand; a 9x13-inch pan and a clean towel are the main gear. Let the butter soften on the counter while the dough rises. All-purpose flour works well; measure by spooning into the cup and leveling.
recipe.finish: Rolls are done when the tops are deep golden and the center reads 190°F (88°C) on an instant-read thermometer. Brush hot rolls with melted butter, cool 10 minutes, then pull apart. Serve warm with the whipped honey butter; store cooled rolls in a sealed bag for up to 3 days and reheat at 300°F for 5 minutes.

ingredients.name: all-purpose flour, plus 1/4 cup for dusting
unsalted butter, plus more for pan and topping

steps.title: Warm milk and proof yeast
steps.details: Warm the milk to 110°F (43°C) — warm to the touch but not hot. Stir in the yeast and 1 tbsp of the sugar. Let stand 5–10 minutes until foamy on top; if it doesn't foam, the yeast is dead and you should start with new yeast.

steps.title: Melt butter and prep pan
steps.details: Melt the 4 tbsp butter and let it cool slightly. Grease a 9x13-inch pan with a little extra softened butter while the yeast proofs.

steps.title: Make and knead dough
steps.details: Stir the foamy yeast mixture, remaining sugar, melted butter, salt, and beaten egg into the 4 cups flour. Mix until a shaggy dough forms, then knead on a floured surface 8–10 minutes until smooth and elastic. Dough should spring back when pressed lightly; add flour a tablespoon at a time if too sticky.

steps.title: Let dough rise
steps.details: Shape dough into a ball, place in a lightly oiled bowl, turn to coat, cover with a clean towel, and let rise in a warm spot 60–75 minutes until doubled in size.

steps.title: Whip honey butter
steps.details: Beat the softened 1 cup butter with the honey using a hand mixer or whisk 2–3 minutes until light and fluffy. Scrape into a small bowl, cover, and refrigerate until serving; soften slightly at room temperature before serving.

steps.title: Shape into rolls
steps.details: Punch down the dough and turn onto a floured surface. Divide into 24 equal pieces (about 40 g each), roll each into a smooth ball, and arrange 6 across by 4 down in the greased pan.

steps.title: Second rise
steps.details: Cover the shaped rolls with a clean towel and let rise 30–40 minutes until puffy and nearly touching; they should barely spring back when pressed.

steps.title: Preheat oven
steps.details: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C) with a rack in the middle while the rolls finish their second rise.

steps.title: Bake the rolls
steps.details: Bake 18–22 minutes until deep golden brown and the center roll reads 190°F (88°C). If the tops brown too fast, tent loosely with foil after 15 minutes. Let cool in the pan 10 minutes.

steps.title: Brush and serve
steps.details: Brush the warm rolls with a little melted butter, cool 5–10 minutes, and pull apart at the seams. Serve warm with whipped honey butter.

recipe.title: Sheet-Pan Chocolate Chip Cookie Bars
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C) with a rack in the middle. Line a 13x18-inch half-sheet pan with parchment paper, leaving an overhang on the long sides for easy lifting. Butter or nonstick spray the parchment. Let butter and eggs sit at room temperature while you gather everything else.
recipe.finish: Bars are done when the edges are golden brown and the center is pale gold and just set; a toothpick in the center should come out with moist crumbs, not wet batter. Cool completely in the pan on a wire rack, about 60 minutes, before lifting out by the parchment and cutting into 24 squares with a long knife. Store airtight at room temperature up to 3 days.

steps.title: Preheat and line pan
steps.details: Heat oven to 350°F (175°C). Line a 13x18-inch half-sheet pan with parchment, leaving an overhang on the long sides, and grease the parchment.

steps.title: Cream butter and sugars
steps.details: In a large bowl, beat softened butter, granulated sugar and brown sugar with a hand mixer or wooden spoon until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes.

steps.title: Beat in eggs and vanilla
steps.details: Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each, then beat in vanilla until smooth.

steps.title: Whisk dry ingredients
steps.details: In a separate medium bowl, whisk flour, baking soda and salt until evenly combined.

steps.title: Fold in dry ingredients
steps.details: Add the flour mixture to the butter mixture in two additions, stirring on low just until no dry streaks remain. Do not overmix.

steps.title: Stir in chocolate chips
steps.details: Fold in the chocolate chips until evenly distributed through the dough.

steps.title: Spread dough in pan
steps.details: Scrape dough onto the lined pan and press into an even layer with a spatula or damp fingertips, pushing into corners. Keep thickness as uniform as possible.

steps.title: Bake until set
steps.details: Bake 22–26 minutes, until edges are golden brown and the center is pale gold and just set. A toothpick in the center should come out with moist crumbs, not wet batter. Rotate the pan halfway through.

steps.title: Cool in pan
steps.details: Set pan on a wire rack and cool completely, about 60 minutes, before lifting out by the parchment. Cutting while warm gives ragged squares.

steps.title: Cut and store
steps.details: Lift bars out by the parchment overhang, transfer to a cutting board and cut into 24 squares with a long knife. Store airtight at room temperature up to 3 days.

recipe.title: Graduation Cap Cupcakes
recipe.intro: A crowd-pleasing dessert for a graduation open house: tender chocolate cupcakes topped with a swirl of chocolate buttercream and a simple chocolate mortarboard. You will need a standard 12-cup muffin tin (bake in two batches), paper liners, a hand or stand mixer, a small microwave-safe bowl, a rolling pin, and a small sharp knife. Let butter and eg
recipe.finish: Let frosted cupcakes set at room temperature for 10 minutes so the caps adhere. Store at cool room temperature in a single layer or in a covered carrier for up to 2 days; refrigerate only if your kitchen is warm, and let them come back toward room temperature before serving. Arrange on a platter for the dessert table.

ingredients.name: chocolate cake mix
ingredients.prep: plus eggs, oil and water per box instructions

ingredients.name: chocolate-covered graham crackers or chocolate square cookies
semi-sweet chocolate chips
ingredients.prep: melted for tassels and cap bases

ingredients.name: yellow or red fruit leather or licorice string

steps.title: Preheat oven and line tins
steps.details: Heat oven to 350°F (175°C). Line 12 muffin cups with paper liners and have a second tin or the same tin ready for the second batch.

steps.title: Mix cake batter
steps.details: In a large bowl, whisk cake mix, eggs, oil and water (use amounts called for on the box) for 2 minutes until smooth and slightly glossy. Scrape the bowl.

steps.title: Bake first batch
steps.details: Divide half the batter among 12 liners, filling each about two-thirds full. Bake 18 to 22 minutes, until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out with only a few moist crumbs.

steps.title: Bake second batch
steps.details: Move cupcakes to a rack to cool 10 minutes, then remove from the tin and cool completely. Wipe the tin, add fresh liners and bake the remaining batter the same way.

steps.title: Make chocolate buttercream
steps.details: Beat softened butter on medium for 2 minutes until creamy. Add powdered sugar, cocoa, 3 tablespoons milk and vanilla; beat on low to combine, then on medium 1 to 2 minutes until fluffy, adding the last tablespoon of milk only if needed for a pipeable consistency.

steps.title: Make chocolate cap bases
steps.details: Melt chocolate chips in a microwave-safe bowl in 20-second bursts, stirring between, until smooth and warm (about 90 to 100°F). Dollop 24 small 1-inch rounds onto a parchment-lined sheet, press a cookie square onto each melted round and let set at room temperature 10 minutes.

steps.title: Frost cooled cupcakes
steps.details: Fit a piping bag with a star tip (or snip a corner from a zip-top bag). Pipe a 2-inch swirl of buttercream on each completely cooled cupcake, leaving room at the edges for the cap.

steps.title: Attach cap tops and tassels
steps.details: Dab a small dot of melted chocolate on the center of each frosted cupcake, press on a cookie-square cap unit and add a small dab of chocolate to the corner; press a fruit leather or licorice tassel into it. Let set 10 minutes before stacking or moving.

recipe.title: Sparkling Citrus Punch
recipe.intro: Use a large 2-gallon dispenser or punch bowl. Chill all juices and sparkling water beforehand. Have plenty of ice and a long spoon ready; stir gently so the punch keeps its fizz.
recipe.finish: Serve immediately over ice. If the punch sits out more than 2 hours, replace it with a fresh batch or nest the dispenser in a bowl of ice to keep it cold. Garnish cups with citrus slices if desired.

ingredients.name: large orange
ingredients.prep: sliced into thin rounds for garnish

steps.title: Chill and set up
steps.details: Refrigerate all juices and the sparkling water until cold, at least 2 hours. Set out a large 2-gallon dispenser or punch bowl.

steps.title: Mix the citrus base
steps.details: In the dispenser, stir together the orange juice, pineapple juice, lemon juice, and lime juice until combined. Taste and stir in up to 1/4 cup sugar only if the punch is too tart.

steps.title: Slice the garnish
steps.details: While the base rests, thinly slice the orange into rounds and set aside for cups or the dispenser.

steps.title: Add ice to dispenser
steps.details: Add about half the ice to the dispenser, or fill it about one-third full, to keep the punch cold without over-diluting it.

steps.title: Add sparkling water
steps.details: Pour the chilled sparkling water slowly down the side of the dispenser and stir gently just once or twice. Do not stir vigorously, or the fizz will escape.

steps.title: Serve over ice
steps.details: Fill glasses with fresh ice, ladle the punch over it, and garnish with orange slices. Refill the dispenser with remaining ice and punch as needed.

recipe.title: Mini Spinach and Feta Quiches
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C) with a rack in the middle. Lightly grease a 24-cup mini muffin tin with nonstick spray or butter. Thaw and squeeze dry the frozen spinach; crumble the feta. These are best served warm or at room temperature within 2 hours.
recipe.finish: Let the quiches cool in the tin for 5 minutes, then run a thin knife around each and lift out. Serve warm or at room temperature. Store leftovers covered in the fridge up to 3 days and reheat at 300°F (150°C) for about 8 minutes.

ingredients.name: mini phyllo shells or 1 sheet pie crust
ingredients.prep: phyllo shells thawed, or pie crust cut into 24 small rounds

steps.title: Heat oven and prep pan
steps.details: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C) and grease a 24-cup mini muffin tin. Thaw and squeeze the spinach very dry; crumble the feta.

steps.title: Press in liners
steps.details: Press a mini phyllo shell (or a small pie-crust round) into each cup, gently shaping it up the sides.

steps.title: Squeeze and chop spinach
steps.details: Squeeze the spinach in a clean towel until no more water drips out, then roughly chop so it mixes evenly.

steps.title: Whisk custard
steps.details: In a bowl, whisk the eggs, milk, flour, salt, pepper and nutmeg until smooth with no flour lumps.

steps.title: Add spinach and cheeses
steps.details: Stir the spinach, feta and Parmesan into the custard until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Fill cups
steps.details: Spoon the filling into the lined cups, filling each about 3/4 full and dividing the spinach and cheese evenly.

steps.title: Bake until set
steps.details: Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 16–20 minutes, until the centers are just set and a toothpick comes out clean. Do not let them brown too much.

steps.title: Cool and release
steps.details: Cool in the tin for 5 minutes, then run a thin knife around each and lift out. Serve warm or at room temperature.

generatedRecipes.title: Fresh Fruit Salad with Honey-Lime Dressing

recipe.title: Fresh Fruit Salad with Honey-Lime Dressing
recipe.intro: A bright, colorful bowl of seasonal fruit tossed in a light honey-lime dressing. You will need a small bowl for the dressing, a whisk or fork, a large mixing bowl, and a serving bowl. No cooking or oven needed. Chill the serving bowl if you like. Wash and dry all fruit before starting.
recipe.finish: Taste a piece of fruit with a little dressing; add more lime juice for brightness or honey for sweetness if needed. Serve immediately, or cover and refrigerate for up to 2 hours (add bananas just before serving). Spoon into a chilled bowl and garnish with mint if using.

ingredients.name: bananas
ingredients.prep: peeled and sliced just before serving

steps.title: Whisk the dressing
steps.details: In a small bowl, whisk the honey, lime juice, lime zest, and salt until the honey dissolves and the dressing is smooth. Set aside.

steps.title: Prepare the strawberries
steps.details: Hull the strawberries and cut them into quarters; place in the large mixing bowl.

steps.title: Prepare the grapes
steps.details: Halve the grapes and add them to the bowl with the strawberries.

steps.title: Cut the pineapple
steps.details: Cut the pineapple into bite-size chunks, discarding any tough core, and add to the bowl.

steps.title: Slice the kiwi
steps.details: Peel the kiwi and slice into rounds; add to the bowl.

steps.title: Toss with dressing
steps.details: Drizzle the dressing over the fruit and gently toss with a large spoon until evenly coated.

steps.title: Chill the salad
steps.details: Cover and refrigerate for 20 minutes so the flavors meld. Do not add bananas yet.

steps.title: Add bananas and mint
steps.details: Just before serving, slice the bananas and fold them in gently with the mint, if using, so they do not brown or break apart.

generatedRecipes.title: Smoked Salmon and Cream Cheese Bagel Platter

recipe.title: Smoked Salmon and Cream Cheese Bagel Platter
recipe.intro: A make-ahead brunch platter. You need a large platter or board, a small bowl, a sharp knife, and a cutting board. No oven needed. Keep the salmon refrigerated until serving. Toast bagels shortly before serving if you like, or serve them split and fresh.
recipe.finish: Serve within 1 hour of setting out, keeping the salmon and cream cheese cool. Leftover salmon and cream cheese keep refrigerated up to 2 days; discard anything left out over 2 hours.

ingredients.name: cream cheese
ingredients.prep: softened at room temperature if spreading

ingredients.name: cold-smoked salmon
ingredients.prep: drained and separated into loose slices

steps.title: Soften cream cheese
steps.details: Set the cream cheese out in a bowl to soften while you prep, about 30 minutes. This makes it easy to spread.

steps.title: Slice onion and lemon
steps.details: Very thinly slice the red onion and cut the lemon into wedges. Keep them separate on small plates.

steps.title: Split and toast bagels
steps.details: Split the bagels and toast lightly if desired, working in batches, until just golden at the edges. Let cool a few minutes so they do not soften the cream cheese.

steps.title: Drain salmon and capers
steps.details: Drain the smoked salmon and separate the slices gently. Drain the capers and pat dry. Keep the salmon cold until arranging.

steps.title: Whisk cream cheese
steps.details: Stir the softened cream cheese until smooth and spreadable. Add a pinch of black pepper if you like.

steps.title: Arrange bagels on platter
steps.details: Arrange the split bagels around the edge of a large platter or board, cut sides up.

steps.title: Add cream cheese and salmon
steps.details: Put the cream cheese in a small bowl in the center, or spread a little onto each bagel half. Drape the salmon slices in loose folds around the bowl.

steps.title: Add capers, onion, lemon, dill
steps.details: Scatter capers and red onion over the salmon. Tuck lemon wedges around the platter. Sprinkle dill on top and finish with black pepper.

steps.title: Chill until serving
steps.details: Cover loosely and refrigerate the assembled platter until serving, up to 1 hour. Let it sit out no more than 30 minutes before guests arrive.

recipe.title: Cheddar and Chive Egg Strata
recipe.intro: Use a 9x13-inch baking dish. Butter the dish and have a whisk, large bowl, and foil ready. Best made the night before; if making same day, allow at least 1 hour to soak before baking.
recipe.finish: Let the strata rest 10 minutes before cutting. It is done when puffed, golden, and the center registers 160°F or a knife inserted in the center comes out clean. Serve warm with a green salad or fruit.

ingredients.name: day-old sturdy white or sourdough bread

steps.title: Grease dish and layer bread
steps.details: Butter the 9x13-inch dish. Spread half the bread cubes in an even layer.

steps.title: Add cheese and chives
steps.details: Scatter 1 1/2 cups cheddar and 2 tbsp chives over the bread. Top with remaining bread cubes, then remaining 1 cup cheddar and remaining 2 tbsp chives.

steps.title: Whisk custard
steps.details: In a large bowl, whisk eggs, milk, cream, salt, pepper, and Dijon until smooth and no streaks of egg remain.

steps.title: Pour custard over strata
steps.details: Slowly pour custard evenly over the bread and cheese. Press bread down gently so it soaks up custard.

steps.title: Chill overnight or 1 hour
steps.details: Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour or overnight. If chilled overnight, let stand at room temperature 20 minutes before baking.

steps.title: Preheat oven
steps.details: Set a rack in the middle of the oven and preheat to 350°F.

steps.title: Bake covered
steps.details: Cover dish with foil and bake 30 minutes.

steps.title: Bake uncovered until set
steps.details: Remove foil and bake 20 to 25 minutes more, until puffed, golden, and center registers 160°F. If browning too fast, tent loosely with foil.

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.details: Let rest 10 minutes before cutting into squares. Serve warm.

recipe.title: Maple-Glazed Bacon
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment or foil for easy cleanup. Have a pastry brush or spoon ready for glazing.
recipe.finish: Bacon is done when deeply browned and crisp at the edges with a glossy maple glaze. Transfer to a paper-towel-lined plate and serve warm; it will crisp further as it rests for 1-2 minutes.

steps.title: Preheat and line pan
steps.details: Heat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment or foil.

steps.title: Lay out bacon
steps.details: Arrange bacon slices in a single layer on the lined sheet, slightly overlapping only if needed to fit.

steps.title: Bake bacon first side
steps.details: Bake on the middle rack for 12 minutes, until bacon is partially rendered and beginning to brown.

steps.title: Mix maple glaze
steps.details: While bacon bakes, stir maple syrup with black pepper if using.

steps.title: Flip and brush
steps.details: Flip bacon slices with tongs and brush the tops generously with the maple mixture, using about half of it.

steps.title: Bake glazed side
steps.details: Return to oven for 8 minutes, until glaze bubbles and bacon is browned at the edges.

steps.title: Glaze again and crisp
steps.details: Brush with remaining maple mixture and bake 3-5 minutes more, watching closely so it does not burn, until deep brown and crisp.

steps.title: Drain and serve
steps.details: Move bacon to a paper-towel-lined plate to drain briefly, then serve warm.

recipe.title: Garlic Herb Roasted Baby Potatoes
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C) with racks in upper and lower thirds. Have two rimmed baking sheets ready. Rinse potatoes well and halve any larger ones so all pieces are about 1 inch.
recipe.finish: Potatoes are done when deep golden and a knife slides in with no resistance. Toss with the remaining garlic-herb oil right before serving; taste and add salt if needed. Serve warm.

ingredients.name: baby potatoes
ingredients.prep: rinsed, halved if larger than 1 inch

steps.title: Preheat oven
steps.details: Set oven to 425°F (220°C) with racks in upper and lower thirds. Let it heat fully, about 15 minutes, while you prep.

steps.title: Prep potatoes and garlic
steps.details: Rinse potatoes and halve any larger than 1 inch. Mince garlic and chop parsley and chives; strip thyme leaves.

steps.title: Toss potatoes with oil
steps.details: Pat potatoes dry, then on the two baking sheets toss with 3 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp salt and the pepper until evenly coated. Spread cut-side down in a single layer with space between pieces.

steps.title: Roast potatoes
steps.details: Roast 30–35 minutes, swapping sheet positions and rotating pans halfway through, until deep golden and a knife slides in easily.

steps.title: Warm garlic in oil
steps.details: Near the end of roasting, gently warm remaining 1 tbsp olive oil with garlic in a small skillet over low heat for 1–2 minutes until fragrant but not browned.

steps.title: Toss with garlic and herbs
steps.details: Transfer hot potatoes to a bowl. Toss with garlic oil, parsley, chives, thyme and remaining 1/2 tsp salt. Taste and adjust seasoning, then serve warm.

recipe.title: Buttermilk Biscuits with Honey Butter
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Use a box grater for cold butter. Have a biscuit cutter or glass ready.
recipe.finish: Bake until golden brown, 12–15 minutes. Serve warm with whipped honey butter.

steps.title: Preheat oven
steps.details: Set oven to 425°F (220°C) with rack in middle position.

steps.title: Mix dry ingredients
steps.details: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, and salt.

steps.title: Cut in butter
steps.details: Add cold butter cubes and toss to coat. Use a pastry blender or fingers to cut butter into flour until mixture resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces.

steps.title: Add buttermilk and stir
steps.details: Pour buttermilk over flour mixture. Stir with a fork just until dough comes together; do not overmix.

steps.title: Knead and pat dough
steps.details: Turn dough onto a lightly floured surface. Knead gently 3–4 times, then pat into a 1-inch-thick round.

steps.title: Cut biscuits
steps.details: Dip a 2½-inch biscuit cutter in flour and cut straight down without twisting. Reroll scraps once and cut more biscuits. Place on an ungreased baking sheet, sides touching for softer biscuits.

steps.title: Make honey butter
steps.details: While biscuits bake, whip softened butter with honey until light and fluffy.

steps.title: Bake biscuits
steps.details: Bake at 425°F until tops are golden brown and biscuits sound hollow when tapped, 12–15 minutes.

recipe.title: Vanilla Bean Mini Cheesecakes
recipe.intro: A baby shower brunch dessert: individual creamy vanilla bean cheesecakes with a graham cracker crust. Preheat oven to 325°F (165°C). You will need a 12-cup muffin tin and paper liners. Bring cream cheese and eggs to room temperature for smooth batter.
recipe.finish: Cheesecakes are done when centers are set but still slightly jiggly, about 20–25 minutes. Cool completely, then refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving. Serve chilled, topped with fresh berries if desired.

ingredients.name: Ingredient
ingredients.prep: split and seeds scraped (or 2 teaspoons vanilla extract)

steps.title: Preheat and line pan
steps.details: Preheat oven to 325°F (165°C). Line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper liners.

steps.title: Make crust
steps.details: In a medium bowl, mix graham cracker crumbs and 2 tablespoons sugar. Stir in melted butter until evenly moistened.

steps.title: Press crust
steps.details: Spoon about 1 tablespoon crumb mixture into each liner. Press firmly with the back of a spoon or your fingers to form a flat bottom crust.

steps.title: Prebake crusts
steps.details: Bake crusts for 5 minutes, until fragrant and set. Remove from oven and set aside. Leave oven on.

steps.title: Beat cream cheese and sugar
steps.details: In a large bowl, beat cream cheese and 1/2 cup sugar with an electric mixer on medium speed until smooth and fluffy, about 2 minutes. Scrape bowl.

steps.title: Add vanilla and eggs
steps.details: Add vanilla bean seeds (or extract), eggs, sour cream, and lemon juice (if using). Beat on low just until combined; do not overmix. Scrape bowl as needed.

steps.title: Fill liners
steps.details: Divide batter evenly among prepared liners, filling each about 3/4 full (about 3 tablespoons each).

steps.title: Bake cheesecakes
steps.details: Bake at 325°F for 20–25 minutes, until edges are set and centers are slightly jiggly when gently shaken. Do not overbake.

steps.title: Cool and chill
steps.details: Cool in pan on a wire rack for 30 minutes, then refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving.

recipe.title: Sparkling Berry Punch Mocktail
recipe.intro: A bright, bubbly, non-alcoholic punch for a brunch crowd. You need a large punch bowl or 3- to 4-quart pitcher, a fine-mesh strainer, and a long spoon. Chill everything thoroughly and make the fruit base up to 4 hours ahead; add the sparkling water only just before serving so it stays fizzy.
recipe.finish: Ladle into punch cups over a little ice, spooning a few berries into each glass. The punch is best within the first hour; if it sits longer, top with a splash of fresh chilled sparkling water and stir gently. Do not add ice directly to the whole bowl—it dilutes the punch.

ingredients.name: chilled cranberry-raspberry juice or white grape juice
chilled plain sparkling water or club soda
ingredients.prep: keep sealed and refrigerated until serving

steps.title: Muddle berries with sugar
steps.details: In the bottom of a large punch bowl or pitcher, combine the raspberries, strawberries, blueberries, and sugar. Gently mash with the back of a wooden spoon for about 2 minutes until the berries release juice and the sugar looks wet and sandy.

steps.title: Make quick sugar syrup
steps.details: In a small saucepan, heat the 1/2 cup water until simmering, then stir in any loose sugar from the bowl setup or reserve this step's water to dissolve residual sugar. Simmer 1 minute, stirring, until the sugar is fully dissolved and the liquid is clear. Let cool 5 minutes off the heat.

steps.title: Add citrus and chill base
steps.details: Pour the cooled syrup into the berry mixture, then stir in the lemon juice, cranberry-raspberry juice, and orange juice. Stir well, cover, and refrigerate at least 30 minutes (or up to 4 hours) so the flavors meld and the punch base is very cold.

steps.title: Add sparkling water before serving
steps.details: Just before serving, slowly pour the chilled sparkling water down the side of the bowl and stir once or twice—gently, so you keep the bubbles. Taste; if it is too tart, stir in 1–2 tablespoons more sugar until dissolved.

steps.title: Serve over ice
steps.details: Fill glasses partway with ice, ladle the punch over the ice, and spoon a few of the macerated berries into each glass. Serve immediately while still fizzy.

recipe.title: Iced Peach Tea
recipe.intro: Use ripe or frozen peaches and regular or decaf black tea bags. You need a medium saucepan, a large pitcher (2-quart or larger), a fine strainer, and a long spoon. Start the tea concentrate first, then simmer the peaches while it steeps; both cool in the fridge before mixing.
recipe.finish: Stir the pitcher well, taste, and add more syrup or lemon if desired. Serve over plenty of ice in tall glasses with peach slices. Add ice only to glasses so the pitcher doesn't get watery; keep any extra tea chilled up to 3 days.

ingredients.name: honey
ingredients.prep: optional; use more sugar if omitting

ingredients.name: ripe peaches
ingredients.prep: about 1 1/2 lb; pitted and sliced, or 1 lb frozen sliced peaches

steps.title: Boil water for tea
steps.details: Bring 4 cups of the water to a rolling boil in a medium saucepan over high heat, about 5 minutes.

steps.title: Steep the tea
steps.details: Remove the saucepan from the heat, add the tea bags, and cover. Steep 5 minutes for a full-flavored tea, then lift out and discard the bags so the tea doesn't turn bitter.

steps.title: Simmer peaches with sugar
steps.details: While the tea steeps, combine the peaches, sugar, and honey (if using) with 1 cup of the remaining water in a small saucepan. Simmer over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the peaches are very soft and the liquid is syrupy, 8 to 10 minutes.

steps.title: Strain the peach syrup
steps.details: Pour the peach mixture through a fine strainer into a heatproof bowl, pressing the fruit with a spoon to extract all the syrup. Discard the solids or save them for yogurt. Stir the lemon juice into the syrup.

steps.title: Combine tea and syrup
steps.details: Pour the steeped tea and the peach syrup into a large pitcher. Add the remaining 3 cups of cool water and stir well.

steps.title: Chill the tea
steps.details: Refrigerate the covered pitcher until thoroughly cold, at least 2 hours, or up to 2 days.

steps.title: Taste and serve over ice
steps.details: Stir the chilled tea, taste, and adjust sweetness or lemon. Fill tall glasses with ice and fresh peach slices, then pour the tea over the ice.

recipe.title: Sparkling Raspberry Lemonade Punch
recipe.intro: Chill all liquids overnight if possible. You need a large punch bowl or a 4-quart pitcher, a fine-mesh strainer, and a ladle. Make the raspberry ice ring the morning of the shower so it has time to freeze; the punch itself is assembled just before serving.
recipe.finish: Ladle into cups over the ice ring, spooning a few raspberries into each glass. The punch is at its best during the first 2 hours; once the ice ring melts, the punch dilutes, so keep backup chilled lemonade and sparkling water (or a second small ice ring) to top it off.

ingredients.name: frozen raspberries
ingredients.prep: divided; 1 cup for the ice ring, 1 cup for the punch

ingredients.name: chilled sparkling water or club soda
lemon
ingredients.prep: sliced into thin rounds, optional garnish

steps.title: Freeze raspberry ice ring
steps.details: Place 1 cup frozen raspberries in a 6-cup ring mold or Bundt pan. Add 1 1/2 cups water and freeze at least 4 hours, or overnight, until solid.

steps.title: Make lemon simple syrup
steps.details: Stir 1 cup sugar into 1 cup boiling water until completely dissolved, about 2 minutes. Let cool 10 minutes, then refrigerate until cold.

steps.title: Juice and strain lemons
steps.details: Juice the lemons and strain out seeds and pulp; you need 1 1/2 cups juice. Refrigerate until assembly.

steps.title: Chill the punch base
steps.details: Combine the cooled syrup, lemon juice, 4 cups cold water, and the remaining 1 cup frozen raspberries in a large punch bowl or pitcher. Refrigerate at least 1 hour until very cold.

steps.title: Unmold the ice ring
steps.details: Dip the bottom of the mold briefly in warm water and invert onto a plate. Keep frozen until serving.

steps.title: Add sparkling water
steps.details: Just before serving, pour the chilled sparkling water into the punch base and stir gently once or twice; do not overmix, or the fizz will fade.

steps.title: Add ice ring and garnish
steps.details: Slide the raspberry ice ring into the bowl, then float lemon slices and fresh raspberries. Ladle into cups immediately.

generatedRecipes.title: Cucumber Tea Sandwiches with Herbed Cream Cheese

recipe.title: Cucumber Tea Sandwiches with Herbed Cream Cheese
recipe.intro: No cooking—just assembly and a short chill. You need a cutting board, knife, vegetable peeler, box grater, fine-mesh sieve, mixing bowl, rubber spatula, and a 2-inch round biscuit cutter (or a glass). Make the herbed cream cheese first so it can firm up while you prep the cucumbers.
recipe.finish: Sandwiches are best within 2 hours of assembly. To hold, layer them in a single row in a shallow container, cover with a damp paper towel and plastic wrap, and refrigerate up to 4 hours. Serve chilled on a platter, or stand them on edge for a classic tea-service look.

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.prep: plus a pinch for the cucumbers

steps.title: Make herbed cream cheese
steps.details: In a mixing bowl, beat the softened cream cheese and butter with a rubber spatula until smooth and spreadable. Stir in the chopped dill, chives, lemon juice, 1/4 tsp salt and pepper until evenly combined.

steps.title: Chill the spread
steps.details: Cover the bowl and refrigerate the herbed cream cheese for at least 20 minutes so it firms up and the flavors meld. This keeps it from making the bread soggy.

steps.title: Slice and salt cucumbers
steps.details: While the spread chills, thinly slice the English cucumber (a vegetable peeler or mandoline makes even 1/8-inch rounds). Lay the slices on paper towels, sprinkle with a pinch of salt, and let sit 10 minutes.

steps.title: Pat cucumbers dry
steps.details: Press another paper towel over the cucumber slices to blot away the released moisture thoroughly. Dry slices are the key to crisp, non-soggy sandwiches.

steps.title: Trim bread and cut rounds
steps.details: Trim the crusts from the bread slices. Using a 2-inch round cutter (or a glass), cut two rounds from each slice; you should get about 40–48 rounds total. Keep them covered with a damp towel so they don't dry out.

steps.title: Spread the bread
steps.details: Lay half the bread rounds on a work surface and spread each with about 1 1/2 tsp of the chilled herbed cream cheese, right to the edges. Keep the remaining rounds plain for the tops.

steps.title: Add cucumber layer
steps.details: Place one layer of well-dried cucumber slices on each spread round, overlapping slightly but staying within the bread edge. Do not mound them high or the top won't sit flat.

steps.title: Cap and gently press
steps.details: Top each cucumber layer with a plain bread round and press very gently to adhere. If your spread is stiff, a tiny extra dab on the top round helps seal the sandwich.

steps.title: Chill, garnish and serve
steps.details: Refrigerate sandwiches 15 minutes to set. If desired, dip a skewer into water and press a sprig of dill onto each top. Arrange on a platter and serve within 2 hours.

generatedRecipes.title: Mixed Greens with Strawberries, Feta, and Poppyseed Dressing

recipe.title: Mixed Greens with Strawberries, Feta, and Poppyseed Dressing
recipe.intro: Rinse and dry the greens thoroughly (a salad spinner or clean towels work well) so the dressing clings instead of pooling. Have a large serving bowl ready. No cooking required beyond toasting the almonds.
recipe.finish: Drizzle the dressing over the salad just before serving and toss gently with tongs so the berries and feta stay intact. Taste and add a pinch of salt or a squeeze of lemon if needed. Serve immediately; leftovers keep poorly once dressed, so dress only what you will eat.

ingredients.name: neutral oil such as canola or grapeseed

steps.title: Toast the almonds
steps.details: Spread the sliced almonds in a dry skillet over medium heat and toast, stirring often, until light golden and fragrant, 4 to 5 minutes. Watch closely; they burn fast. Slide onto a plate to cool.

steps.title: Whisk the dressing
steps.details: While the almonds toast, whisk the oil, cider vinegar, honey, poppy seeds, salt, and pepper in a small bowl or shake in a jar until thickened and evenly combined.

steps.title: Prep the berries and feta
steps.details: Slice the strawberries and crumble the feta while the almonds finish; set both aside.

steps.title: Build the salad base
steps.details: Place the dried mixed greens in a large serving bowl and scatter the sliced strawberries, crumbled feta, and cooled toasted almonds over the top.

steps.title: Dress and serve
steps.details: Drizzle about three-quarters of the dressing over the salad, toss gently with tongs, and add more dressing to taste. Serve right away.

recipe.title: Chicken Salad on Mini Croissants
recipe.intro: Poach chicken breasts gently, chill, then fold into a creamy, lightly seasoned salad and fill split mini croissants just before serving. Use a large skillet with lid, two forks, and a cutting board. Have a tray ready for assembly.
recipe.finish: Spoon about 2 tablespoons chicken salad into each split mini croissant. Serve within 2 hours of filling, or keep the salad chilled separately up to 1 day. Garnish with chives if desired.

steps.title: Poach chicken gently
steps.details: Place chicken in a single layer in a large skillet. Pour in broth; it should mostly cover the chicken. Bring to a gentle simmer over medium heat, then cover, reduce heat to low, and cook 14 minutes. Chicken is done when it reaches 165°F in the thickest part.

steps.title: Chill chicken to firm
steps.details: Transfer chicken to a plate and refrigerate uncovered 15 minutes to cool and firm up. Discard poaching liquid.

steps.title: Make creamy dressing
steps.details: While chicken chills, whisk mayonnaise, sour cream, Dijon, salt and pepper in a large bowl until smooth.

steps.title: Dice celery and onion
steps.details: Finely dice celery and red onion; chop parsley and add both to the dressing bowl.

steps.title: Shred cooled chicken
steps.details: Shred or finely dice the chilled chicken with two forks and add it to the bowl.

steps.title: Fold salad together
steps.details: Fold chicken into the dressing and vegetables until evenly coated. Taste and adjust salt and pepper. Keep chilled until needed.

steps.title: Fill mini croissants
steps.details: Split croissants and fill each with about 2 tablespoons chicken salad. Arrange on a platter and serve promptly.

recipe.title: Quiche Lorraine Bites
recipe.intro: Heat oven to 375°F with a rack in the middle. You need a 24-cup mini muffin pan, ideally nonstick, plus a 3-inch round cutter (or a drinking glass). Lightly grease the pan. Let one 14-ounce package of refrigerated pie crusts sit at room temperature for 15 minutes so they unroll without cracking.
recipe.finish: Cool the bites in the pan for 5 minutes, then run a thin knife around the edges and lift them out. Serve warm or at room temperature. The custard should be just set with no wet jiggle; if it still looks liquid in the center, bake 2 to 3 more minutes. Bites hold neatly in one hand and can be made up to 4 hours ahead and rewarmed at 300°F for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Heat oven and prep pan
steps.details: Heat oven to 375°F with a rack in the middle and lightly grease a 24-cup mini muffin pan. Let the pie crusts soften on the counter while the oven heats.

steps.title: Cook the bacon
steps.details: Put the bacon pieces in a cold skillet over medium heat and cook 7 to 9 minutes, stirring, until crisp and golden. Transfer to a paper-towel-lined plate to drain.

steps.title: Cut and press crusts
steps.details: Unroll the crusts and cut 24 rounds with a 3-inch cutter, re-rolling scraps once if needed. Press one round into each muffin cup, easing it up the sides; the crust should reach the rim. Set the pan aside.

steps.title: Shred the Gruyère
steps.details: While the bacon cooks, finely shred the Gruyère on the small holes of a box grater so it melts evenly; you should have about 1 cup.

steps.title: Make the custard
steps.details: In a 4-cup measuring cup or bowl, whisk the eggs, milk, cream, salt, pepper and nutmeg until smooth and one color, about 30 seconds. Do not whip in air; let the foam settle.

steps.title: Fill the crusts
steps.details: Divide the bacon and Gruyère among the crust-lined cups, about 1 teaspoon of each per cup. Pour the custard over the fillings, filling each cup about three-quarters full, no higher than the crust rim.

steps.title: Bake until just set
steps.details: Bake 18 to 22 minutes, until the crusts are golden and the custard is puffed and set with only a faint jiggle in the center. Rotate the pan halfway through if your oven browns unevenly.

steps.title: Cool and release
steps.details: Cool in the pan 5 minutes, then loosen each bite with a thin knife and lift out onto a serving tray. Serve warm or at room temperature.

generatedRecipes.title: Roasted Asparagus with Lemon and Parmesan

recipe.title: Roasted Asparagus with Lemon and Parmesan
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C) with a rack in the upper third. Have a large rimmed baking sheet ready. Wash and trim the asparagus while the oven heats.
recipe.finish: Asparagus should be tender-crisp and lightly browned at the tips; a knife should pierce the thick end easily. Shower with Parmesan and serve warm, ideally within 15 minutes.

steps.title: Preheat the oven
steps.details: Set oven to 425°F (220°C) with a rack in the upper third. Let it heat fully, about 15 minutes, while you prep the asparagus.

steps.title: Trim the asparagus
steps.details: Rinse the spears and snap off the woody bottom ends where they break naturally. Pat dry thoroughly so they roast rather than steam.

steps.title: Season on the sheet
steps.details: Spread the dry asparagus on a large rimmed baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil, then sprinkle with salt and pepper. Toss with your hands until evenly coated and arrange in a single layer.

steps.title: Roast until tender-crisp
steps.details: Roast on the upper rack until spears are bright green, tender-crisp, and lightly browned at the tips, 10 to 12 minutes. A knife should pierce a thick stem easily. Shake the pan once halfway through.

steps.title: Add lemon and Parmesan
steps.details: Transfer asparagus to a serving platter. Drizzle with lemon juice, then scatter lemon zest and shaved Parmesan over the top. Serve warm.

recipe.title: Herbed New Potato Salad
recipe.intro: A warm, mayo-free potato salad with baby new potatoes in a light mustard-herb vinaigrette. Use a large pot, a colander, a whisk, and a serving bowl. No specialty equipment needed.
recipe.finish: The potatoes should be tender enough that a paring knife slides in with no resistance but the skin holds. Toss with the dressing while warm so it soaks in, then taste and add salt or lemon. Serve warm or at room temperature. Best within 2 hours of dressing; stir gently before serving and add a splash of olive oil if it has sat out.

ingredients.name: baby new potatoes
ingredients.prep: scrub, halve any larger than golf ball

steps.title: Boil the potatoes
steps.details: Put the potatoes in a large pot, add cold water to cover by 2 inches, and stir in the 1 tbsp salt. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce to a steady simmer. Cook until a paring knife slides into the center of a potato with no resistance, about 12–15 minutes after boiling starts.

steps.title: Make the vinaigrette
steps.details: While the potatoes boil, whisk the olive oil, Dijon, vinegar, honey, garlic, and pepper in a small bowl until smooth and emulsified.

steps.title: Chop the herbs
steps.details: Chop the parsley, slice the chives, and chop the dill. Juice the lemon and sliver the red onion. Keep the herbs and onion separate from the dressing until the potatoes are ready.

steps.title: Drain the potatoes
steps.details: Drain the potatoes in a colander and let them steam-dry for 2 minutes. Leave them whole or cut the largest ones in half so all pieces are bite-sized.

steps.title: Dress the warm potatoes
steps.details: Tip the warm potatoes into a large serving bowl. Whisk the vinaigrette again and pour it over, tossing gently to coat. Fold in the red onion and lemon juice.

steps.title: Rest and finish with herbs
steps.details: Let the salad sit 5 minutes so the potatoes absorb the dressing, toss once more, then fold in the parsley, chives, and dill just before serving. Taste and adjust with a pinch of salt or a squeeze of lemon.

recipe.title: Buttermilk Biscuits with Honey Butter
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C) with rack in the middle. You will need a large mixing bowl, a box grater, a pastry cutter or two knives, a 2½-inch round cutter, and a baking sheet. Cold butter and cold buttermilk are key to flakiness, so keep them refrigerated until the moment you use them. Let the honey butter soften and whip while the oven heats.
recipe.finish: Biscuits are done when tall, golden brown on top and bottoms, and steamy inside—about 14–16 minutes. Cool on the pan 2 minutes, then serve warm with the whipped honey butter. Best eaten the same day; reheat leftovers at 350°F for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Heat oven and freeze butter
steps.details: Set oven to 425°F (220°C). Put the ½ cup stick of butter in the freezer for 15 minutes so it grates cleanly.

steps.title: Whip honey butter
steps.details: Beat the softened ½ cup butter with honey and ¼ tsp salt until pale and fluffy, about 2 minutes. Scrape into a small bowl, cover, and refrigerate until serving.

steps.title: Whisk dry ingredients
steps.details: In a large bowl, whisk flour, baking powder, baking soda, 1 tsp salt, and sugar until evenly combined.

steps.title: Grate in frozen butter
steps.details: Coarsely grate the frozen butter into the flour. Toss gently with your fingers until the shreds are coated and separated.

steps.title: Cut in butter
steps.details: Use a pastry cutter or two knives to cut the butter into the flour until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces, about 3 minutes.

steps.title: Add buttermilk and fold
steps.details: Pour in the cold buttermilk and stir with a fork just until a shaggy dough forms and no dry flour remains—about 20 seconds. Do not overmix.

steps.title: Pat and cut biscuits
steps.details: Turn dough onto a floured surface and pat (don't roll) to 1 inch thick. Cut straight down with a floured 2½-inch cutter; press scraps together once and cut again. Place 2 inches apart on an ungreased baking sheet.

steps.title: Brush and bake
steps.details: Brush tops with melted butter. Bake until risen tall and golden brown, 14–16 minutes.

steps.title: Cool and serve
steps.details: Rest biscuits on the pan 2 minutes, then transfer to a basket or plate. Serve warm with the chilled whipped honey butter.

generatedRecipes.title: Mini Vanilla Cupcakes with Buttercream Frosting

recipe.title: Mini Vanilla Cupcakes with Buttercream Frosting
recipe.intro: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C) and line mini muffin tins with paper liners. Bring butter, eggs, and milk to room temperature. Use a stand or hand mixer and a piping bag fitted with a star tip for the pastel frosting.
recipe.finish: Cupcakes are done when a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean and tops spring back, about 12–14 minutes. Cool completely before frosting. Pipe small swirls of pastel buttercream, chill 15 minutes to set, and serve at room temperature. Refrigerate leftovers up to 3 days.

steps.title: Preheat and line pans
